1.재해개요: Around December 2015, at a military base protective door installation project, the victim was straightening a tilted reinforced-earth block wall by placing a square timber against the reinforced-earth wall and applying force with an excavator bucket, when the square timber suddenly dislodged and the victim was struck by the excavator bucket that was applying force, and died.
1.재해유발요인: While applying force with an excavator bucket to a square timber placed against the reinforced-earth wall, the timber suddenly dislodged and struck the victim.
1.위험성감소대책:
▶ When operating an excavator, use the equipment according to its intended purpose such as soil excavation and cutting
▶ Work in consideration of construction equipment specifications, performance, working radius, etc.

2.재해개요: Around June 2020, at the materials yard of OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OOO Township, OO County, OOO Province, while the victim was loading steel pipes (sewer pipes*) lifted by a crane (10-ton) onto a cargo truck (25.5-ton) from atop its cargo bed approximately 1.7 m high, the steel pipes, which had been unstably stacked in three tiers, collapsed and the victim fell to the yard floor, where he was crushed by a steel pipe (approx. 390kg) that fell from the truck bed and died. This was a fatal accident.
2.재해유발요인: While loading steel pipes lifted by a crane onto a vehicle, the steel pipes, unstably stacked in 3 tiers, collapsed and the victim was crushed under the steel pipes.
2.위험성감소대책:
▶ When stockpiling materials, stack them on flat ground and take rolling prevention measures
▶ Use wedges, etc. to secure hume pipes on slopes
▶ Prohibit excessive stacking of steel pipes such as three or more tiers

3.재해개요: Around April 2021, at the OOOO Co., Ltd. OOOO aging water supply pipe network improvement construction site located in OO Dong, OO City, OOO Province, during preparation work to unload cast-iron pipes loaded on a cargo truck by binding them with a sling belt, a cast-iron pipe slipped out of the sling belt and struck the victim, who fell from the side of the vehicle at a height of approximately 1.85m to the ground and died. This was a fatal accident.
3.재해유발요인: At a pipeline improvement work site, during preparation work to unload ductile iron pipes loaded on a truck by binding them with sling belts, a pipe slipped out of the sling belt and fell onto the victim.
3.위험성감소대책:
▶ When loading cargo, comply with measures such as the maximum load capacity and balanced loading without leaning to one side
▶ Before rope-untying work, control worker passage around the cargo bed, then carry out unloading work

4.재해개요: Around February 2017, at the OO new construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim, an employee of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a reinforced-concrete work subcontractor, was dismantling soundproof wall posts (supports), when a post that lost its balance toppled toward the victim and struck him, resulting in death.
4.재해유발요인: During dismantling work, demolished objects such as a soundproof wall and piping toppled toward the victim, striking and crushing him.
4.위험성감소대책:
▶ Take overturning prevention measures when demolished items, materials, etc. are kept on site
▶ Prohibit worker entry within the working radius during building demolition work

5.재해개요: Around February 2017, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site, the victim was moving steel pipes from the 4th tier of scaffold platforms on the 2nd-floor exterior wall up to the upper platform, when he lost his footing and fell 7m to the ground below and died.
5.재해유발요인: During dismantling work on the steel pipe supports of a temporary fence, the worker stepped on a previously dismantled horizontal member and fell to the ground.
5.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work at height such as scaffold dismantling, prohibit climbing onto steel pipe supports to work, and take measures to use mobile scaffolds or aerial work platforms
▶ For work at height such as scaffold dismantling, if mobile scaffolds, aerial work platforms, etc. cannot be used because the dismantling location is cramped or the terrain is steep, proceed with work after taking measures using construction equipment such as excavators to prevent casualties

6.재해개요: Around January 2018, at the OOO Korea Co., Ltd. new headquarters construction site being built by the OO branch of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (scaffolder), an employee of subcontractor OO Construction, was extending scaffold posts on top of the working platform of the exterior steel-pipe scaffold at the 4th-floor level of the front face, when he fell together with a toppling steel pipe (6m, approx. 15.78kg) to the 1st-floor ground (H≒15m) and died.
6.재해유발요인: With inadequate fall-prevention measures, while working on installing an outer vertical steel pipe on top of a scaffold working platform to assist with installing the vertical steel pipe outside the scaffold at the steel column on the front of the ground floor, the worker fell to the ground together with the toppling steel pipe.
6.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as safety nets, guardrails, and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Provide and wear safety harnesses before work, with thorough checking of fastening status by the supervisor

7.재해개요: Around August 2018, at the OO knowledge industry center new construction site, the victim, standing on the lower horizontal member to dismantle the steel-pipe supports of a temporary fence installed on the site boundary line, was dismantling the upper horizontal member when he fell approximately 3.5m to the ground together with the dismantled horizontal member and died.
7.재해유발요인: During dismantling work on the steel pipe supports of a temporary fence, the worker stepped on a previously dismantled horizontal member and fell to the ground.
7.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work at height such as scaffold dismantling, prohibit climbing onto steel pipe supports to work, and take measures to use mobile scaffolds or aerial work platforms
▶ For work at height such as scaffold dismantling, if mobile scaffolds, aerial work platforms, etc. cannot be used because the dismantling location is cramped or the terrain is steep, proceed with work after taking measures using construction equipment such as excavators to prevent casualties

8.재해개요: Around January 2019, on the scaffold inside the parking tower at OO Construction's knowledge industry center new construction site, while two victims were signaling and waiting to receive scaffold materials (steel pipes, clamps, etc.) being lifted by a tower crane, the lifted load caught on a guardrail installed at the edge of the parking tower opening on the 14th floor and tilted, causing scaffold materials such as steel pipes to slip out of the rigging; the two victims approximately 26.8m below were struck by the falling scaffold materials or, while trying to avoid them, fell to the basement floor and other areas, and died.
8.재해유발요인: After releasing the cargo-securing fiber belts to unload stacked bundles of single-pipe scaffolding, a scaffold bundle fell to the lower part of the vehicle and struck the worker.
8.위험성감소대책:
▶ When loading cargo, comply with measures such as the maximum load capacity and balanced loading without leaning to one side
▶ When untying ropes, confirm there is no risk of cargo falling from the cargo bed before taking action

9.재해개요: Around August 2020, at the OO construction site, the moment the victim released the cargo-fastening fiber belt (ratchet tie-down) that had been used as rigging in order to unload bundles of single-pipe scaffold loaded on a cargo truck bed, a bundle of single-pipe scaffold stacked on top fell toward the lower part of the vehicle (H≒2.3m) and struck the victim's upper body (head and chest), resulting in death.
9.재해유발요인: After releasing the cargo-securing fiber belts to unload stacked bundles of single-pipe scaffolding, a scaffold bundle fell to the lower part of the vehicle and struck the worker.
9.위험성감소대책:
▶ When loading cargo, comply with measures such as the maximum load capacity and balanced loading without leaning to one side
▶ When untying ropes, confirm there is no risk of cargo falling from the cargo bed before taking action

10.재해개요: While the victim was loading a bundle of steel pipes (weight≒630kg) on top of a cargo truck, the boom and the steel pipe bundle rotated due to the excavator operator's erroneous operation, striking the victim in the face and resulting in death.
10.재해유발요인: Due to a misoperation by the excavator operator, a bundle of steel pipes rotated together with the boom and struck the victim in the face.
10.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thorough performance of hazard and risk prevention duties by the supervisor
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan for transport and other operations and instruct work to be done in accordance with the plan
▶ Thorough wearing and management of personal protective equipment

11.재해개요: Around August 2018, at the OO Elementary School classroom extension construction site being built by OO Construction, the victim was lifting a channel steel (149.45kg) hung on an electric winch and erecting it against a wall for seismic reinforcement of the interior walls of the 1st-floor kindergarten, when the anchor bolt for hanging the electric winch installed on the wall bent and the electric winch detached; the channel steel being lifted toppled over and struck the victim's head, resulting in death.
11.재해유발요인: While lifting a C-channel steel member hooked to an electric winch and standing it against a wall, the anchor bolt for hanging the electric winch bent, the winch detached, and the C-channel toppled over, striking the worker's head.
11.위험성감소대책:
▶ When handling heavy objects such as installing C-channel steel for seismic reinforcement, use anchor bolts of clear origin whose specifications can be identified
▶ When dismantling ceiling sections, prevent falling and overturning that may occur during lifting by considering the length of the C-channel steel, etc.

12.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO new construction site, a steel pipe (length: approx. 2m, weight: approx. 5kg) fell from the upper part of the exterior scaffold (height: approx. 9m) and struck the head of the victim, who was organizing materials in the passageway, resulting in death.
12.재해유발요인: A steel pipe on the upper part of the external scaffold fell and struck the victim, who was organizing materials in the passageway.
12.위험성감소대책:
▶ Manage scaffolds, working platforms, etc. so that falling objects such as materials and tools are not left unattended
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

13.재해개요: Around June 2019, at the OO installation site, while the victim was preparing to install greenhouse hoops (width 10m, height 7m, 30kg each, material: steel pipe (Ø50mm)), he lost his balance and slipped on a steel shelf (5.5m wide X 4.5m deep, H≒2.6m) being used as a work platform, and fell to the 1st-floor ground (H≒2.6m) and died.
13.재해유발요인: During preparation work for installing greenhouse hoop rods, the worker lost his balance on a steel shelf being used as a work platform, slipped, and fell to the floor.
13.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prohibit work on unstable working platforms

14.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO Construction site, while the victim was fabricating slab beam formwork on the 2nd basement level, a load being lifted by a tower crane (timber for formwork fabrication (approx. 0.5-ton)) approached about 4m above the work area; the moment the victim moved under the load to prevent a collision between the work area and the load, the load suddenly dropped and struck the victim, resulting in death.
14.재해유발요인: While lifting timber for formwork fabrication and other materials with a tower crane, the unsecured load fell.
14.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing hazardous or dangerous machinery and equipment such as tower cranes, use them after obtaining safety certification
▶ During crane work, control worker access in advance to prevent hazards from falling objects
▶ When working with cranes, etc., inspect mechanical conditions such as the reducer before work

15.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OO detached house new construction site, the victim placed square timbers (sansunggak) between the top of the exterior scaffold and the building and was stacking formwork materials (square tubes, square timbers, etc.) on top, when a square timber placed underneath broke and the materials stacked on top collapsed, and the victim fell approximately 9m and died.
15.재해유발요인: With no working platform installed, square timbers were placed between the top of the external scaffold and the building, and while formwork materials were being stacked on them, a timber placed underneath broke, and the worker standing on the stacked materials above fell.
15.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install working platforms and guardrails in places with fall and tipping hazards
▶ When installing working platforms for material loading work, conduct structural review considering the upper stacking load before installation
▶ If supporting timbers are used because material stacking on the structure is difficult, conduct structural review (bending, shear) for the maximum stacking load

16.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO new construction site, the victim, an employee of a subcontractor, was organizing formwork under the 4th-tier square steel pipe strut of the wale (350mm×350mm×9t, L=34m(11m+11m+12m), W=3.33t), when the square steel pipe strut, which was being prepared for dismantling, fell and struck him on the head, resulting in death.
16.재해유발요인: With no access prohibition implemented for the falling-object danger zone, while performing formwork organizing work below the wale struts, a square steel pipe strut being prepared for dismantling fell and struck the worker on the head.
16.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare and comply with a work plan when dismantling temporary earth-retaining facilities
▶ Perform work in stages, such as attaching rigging to lifting unit members such as struts, then removing bolts and lifting
▶ Strictly prohibit entry of workers other than those concerned into the dismantling work area

17.재해개요: Around July 2016, at the 00 government building new construction site of 00 Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was lowering dismantled formwork shores (form-tie-less formwork, 51.8kg) tied to a work rope down to the floor below, from atop the plywood on top of the system shores of the 2nd basement water storage tank, when he tripped over materials scattered on the plywood atop the system shores and fell to the floor below (H≒3.3m) and died.
17.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures implemented, while lowering dismantled formwork shores tied to a work rope to the floor below from on top of the plywood above the system shores of the basement water tank, the worker tripped over materials scattered around the plywood and fell.
17.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with fall risk, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or work after wearing a safety harness
▶ Control worker access when lifting and transporting materials in zones with falling and overturning hazards

18.재해개요: Around March 2016, in the 3-story-high elevator pit of the OO construction housing redevelopment project site, while a co-worker cut rebar embedded for use as work platforms using an oxygen welder and hand grinder, the victim received the cut rebar and stacked and organized it on the outside; the victim, who had entered the elevator pit for work reasons, stepped on a platform (plywood) that flipped over, and he fell to the 2nd basement floor (H=11.2) and died.
18.재해유발요인: While working standing on an unsecured working platform, the platform flipped over and the worker fell.
18.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working on external scaffolds, install working platforms and guardrails tightly and firmly across the entire work section before work
▶ If installation of working platforms and guardrails is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities to which safety harnesses can be attached
▶ Thoroughly wear personal protective equipment when working in places with fall risk

19.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OO factory new construction site being built by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., while the victim was transporting materials (rebar-D13, L≒0.8m, approx. 200EA) to the freight lift section for 2nd-floor rebar placement work in Building A, three of the four square timbers (80mm×80mm×3,630mm) used as support plates fractured, and he fell to the 1st-floor ground (H≒5.8m) and died. This was a fatal accident.
19.재해유발요인: While transporting materials to the freight lift area for rebar placement work, a square timber used as a support plate fractured and the worker fell.
19.위험성감소대책:
▶ When stacking heavy materials such as rebar, stack on support plates with no risk of collapse, or stack within the maximum permissible load
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities for fall prevention measures and wear safety harnesses

20.재해개요: Around May 2017, on the 1st floor of the OO commercial-residential building new construction site, after assembling column hoop rebar with a co-worker, the victim was moving for follow-up work when he tripped over a wooden square timber lying on the floor and fell, and a wall rebar protruding from the floor pierced the victim's head, resulting in death.
20.재해유발요인: After assembling column hoop rebar, while moving for subsequent work, the worker tripped over a square timber lying on the floor and fell, and protruding wall rebar pierced the worker's head.
20.위험성감소대책:
▶ If the site interior is cramped, secure a separate material storage area and bring only some materials inside sequentially to secure work space and travel passages
▶ If materials such as square timber must unavoidably be placed on the floor, install a travel passage raised off the floor above them to prevent workers from tripping
▶ If accident-prone materials such as protruding rebar protrude in travel sections, install protective caps on the rebar protrusions

21.재해개요: Around March 2019, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO apartment complex new construction site, the victim (concrete worker), an employee of subcontractor OO Co., Ltd., was climbing up a wooden square timber leaned against the slab to move to the parking lot topping-concrete pouring location, when the timber broke and struck him in the abdomen, causing intra-abdominal hemorrhage and other injuries, resulting in death.
21.재해유발요인: While moving to the concrete pouring location without a secured passageway, the worker was climbing on a wooden square timber leaned against the slab when the timber broke and struck the worker in the abdomen.
21.위험성감소대책:
▶ Ensure safe passage with passage markings at major parts of passages leading to or within the workplace
▶ Avoid forcing work forward when subsequent work is affected by work conditions

22.재해개요: In December 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. apartment new construction site, the victim, an employee of OO Co., Ltd., was installing a curing tent frame for concrete curing on the 1st basement slab formwork of the underground parking lot, when he lost his balance and fell to the 1st basement floor (H≒4m) and died.
22.재해유발요인: While installing a curing cover tarp frame for concrete curing on top of the slab formwork, the worker lost his balance and fell from an edge where no guardrail had been installed.
22.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working near openings with fall risk, install guardrails and fall-prevention nets at the edges
▶ When working at fall-risk locations 2 m or higher, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

23.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the OO extension construction site (5 stories above ground) being built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame assembler) and one other worker were installing square pipes (100*50*9000) on the rooftop level, when the victim lost his balance and fell to the 3rd-floor concrete floor (height approx. 8.9m) and died.
23.재해유발요인: While transporting square pipes with a mobile crane, a pipe got caught on the safety harness anchorage installed on a girder; at the moment the worker exerted force to free the pipe, the victim, who had not secured his safety harness, lost his balance and fell.
23.위험성감소대책:
▶ Immediately after completing steel frame assembly, install fall-prevention nets on the relevant floor before proceeding with subsequent processes
▶ When working in places with fall risk, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

24.재해개요: Around October 2018, at the OO office extension construction site, the victim, an employee of OO, was moving after assisting with plywood cutting on top of the 2nd-floor steel structure (H-beams and square pipes installed crosswise), when he stepped on an unsupported corner of a plywood sheet; the plywood lifted upward, and he fell together with the plywood through an opening (1200mm×610mm) formed by the H-beams and square pipes (height≒3.2m) and died.
24.재해유발요인: After assisting with plywood cutting on top of a steel structure, while moving, the worker stepped on an unsupported corner of a plywood sheet, which tipped upward, and the worker fell together with the plywood.
24.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install protective measures such as covers on openings with fall risk
▶ When working in places with fall risk, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

25.재해개요: Around August 2021, at a factory new construction site, for wall furring channel welding work, two victims were welding upper furring channels while standing on furring channels (horizontal members), when the furring channel supporting them suddenly detached and both victims fell (H≒4m) and were injured.
25.재해유발요인: For wall furring-metal welding work, 2 victims were on furring metal (horizontal members) performing welding work on the upper furring metal when the furring metal supporting them suddenly detached, and both fell simultaneously.
25.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing safety harness anchorage facilities, install them firmly so they do not sag or come off
▶ Check safety harnesses and accessory equipment for defects before starting work

26.재해개요: Around July 2018, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. factory new construction site, while the victim (steel frame worker) was receiving unloaded materials on the 1st-floor ground, an upper fixing hardware piece (L=1.9m, W=8kg) of a deck plate bundle (packing) for 3rd-floor steel work fell (H=17.0m) and struck the victim on the head, resulting in death.
26.재해유발요인: While receiving unloaded materials at ground level, the upper securing hardware of a deck plate bundle for steel work on the 3rd floor above ground came off and fell onto the worker.
26.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thorough measures to prevent hazards from falling objects during deck plate installation work
▶ Thorough performance of hazard and risk prevention duties by the supervisor

27.재해개요: Around March 2019, in the 2nd basement stairwell within the site, while the victim was preparing for plastering work, another worker was lifting a container (total weight approx. 20Kg) holding materials for metal work from the upper floor (1st floor) to the reference floor (6th floor) through the stairwell open section using a lifting device (mini winch); the container collided with a guardrail already installed in the stairwell, the container's handle came off, and the container fell to the 2nd basement (H≒9.4m), striking the victim's head and resulting in death.
27.재해유발요인: In the process of lifting a container holding materials for metal work using a hoisting device, the container collided with a previously installed guardrail and fell onto the worker.
27.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access to falling-hazard areas during material lifting work
▶ Thorough wearing and management of personal protective equipment

28.재해개요: In August 2019, at a mechanical equipment installation site under construction by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (waterproofing worker) was checking the waterproofing work condition of the waterproof curb of a ventilation exhaust opening on the 3rd basement level or performing touch-up work, when square pipes and other objects fell from above the ventilation exhaust opening and struck him on the head, resulting in death (presumed).
28.재해유발요인: While checking the waterproofing condition of the ventilation exhaust curb or performing touch-up work, with no falling-object hazard prevention measures in place, a square pipe and other objects fell from above the ventilation exhaust opening, striking the worker on the head.
28.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in places where objects may fall or fly due to work, take necessary measures to prevent hazards, such as installing falling-object prevention nets, vertical protection nets, or protective shelves
▶ Prohibit entry of persons other than those concerned into places where objects may fall or fly

29.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the 4th-floor slab roof-truss stacking yard of the OO logistics warehouse new construction site, a roof truss being lifted by a mobile crane could not be lifted because a temporarily welded section connecting it to the roof truss beneath had not been cut; when it was being lowered, the victim, an employee of a subcontractor, entered the interior of the descending roof truss and cut the temporarily welded section, at which moment, as the lowering had not yet finished, a recoil force caused the roof truss to spring up and strike him in the chest, resulting in death.
29.재해유발요인: At the moment the joint (welded part) at the bottom of a load suspended from a mobile crane was cut, the load sprang up from the recoil and struck the victim.
29.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare and comply with a heavy-object handling work plan, and inform workers of its contents
▶ If measures on the lifted load are needed during lifting work, safely lower the load to the ground before working
▶ During heavy-object lifting work, control access within the working radius and assign a work commander

30.재해개요: Around February 2020, at the OO officetel new construction site, the victim was working atop a square-pipe support post approximately 5.5M high to dismantle the standing signboard above the site entrance gate, when he lost his balance, fell, and died.
30.재해유발요인: While dismantling a standing signboard on top of a square pipe (stepping width 10cm) above the site gate post, the worker missed his footing and fell to the ground.
30.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install a safe working platform appropriate for the work height (scaffold, aerial work platform, etc.), fasten the safety harness, then work safely
▶ When working in places with fall risk, thoroughly supervise the wearing of personal protective equipment such as safety helmets and safety harnesses

31.재해개요: Around March 2020, at a warehouse extension construction site, while the victim was performing dismantling work by cutting the welded parts of a square steel tube (T-shaped) of the existing warehouse structure, the vertical member of the square steel tube (100×100×3.2t, H=3.7m) toppled over together with the victim, and he struck the back of his head on the concrete floor and died.
31.재해유발요인: During steel pipe member dismantling work, while shaking a member that had not separated from the existing structure, the member detached and toppled, and the victim fell over together with it.
31.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control access within the working radius during lifting work
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan considering the work method and conditions, and inform workers
▶ Thorough management of wearing personal protective equipment (safety helmet)

32.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the OO church new construction site, while the victim, an employee of an interior work subcontractor, was transporting plywood, plywood stacked on the stair landing between the 2nd and 3rd floors toppled over and struck the victim, who was descending the stairs, knocking him to the floor.
32.재해유발요인: Materials (plywood) leaned against a stair landing toppled over due to work impact or the like, striking the victim, who was going down the stairs.
32.위험성감소대책:
▶ When stacking materials, lay them down in sections with no falling hazard; if they must be stacked upright, stack with the long side on the floor and take safety measures such as supports at the bottom of materials to prevent overturning
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' wearing of personal protective equipment

33.재해개요: Around February 2021, at the OO livestock barn extension construction site, the victim (common laborer) was moving on top of roof panels to remove lifting belts, when a sudden gust of wind caused a roof panel (EPS panel, 11,850×100×75mm) to fly up and strike him, and he fell approximately 10m to the concrete floor below and died.
33.재해유발요인: While moving on a roof, the worker was struck by finishing material lifted up by a sudden gust of wind, then fell to the ground.
33.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before moving or working in fall-risk sections such as roofs, install safety harness anchorage facilities, and inspect and supervise safety harness fastening when workers move and work
▶ Install working platforms and guardrails at roof edge sections to prevent falls
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' wearing of personal protective equipment

34.재해개요: Around September 2021, at a canopy installation site for a rain shelter behind a restaurant building located in OO, the victim (common laborer) was moving plywood to be used as a platform on top of the canopy, when he fell from a height of approximately 3.3 meters and died.
34.재해유발요인: While transporting materials on top of a canopy, the worker missed his footing and fell to the ground.
34.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work at height with fall risk, install working platforms such as mobile scaffolds, and take fall prevention measures by installing fall-prevention safety facilities (guardrails, safety harness anchorage facilities, etc.) at edge sections of platforms
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' wearing of personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

35.재해개요: Around June 2020, at the OO construction materials yard, in order to unload utility poles loaded on the bed of a truck-mounted mobile crane, the victim fastened the rigging wire rope hung on the crane hook to a utility pole and was balancing it horizontally, when a steel tubular pole loaded together with it slipped from the cargo bed and fell, and the victim was caught between the utility pole and the steel tubular pole.
35.재해유발요인: To unload a utility pole loaded on the bed of a mobile crane, the rigging wire rope hung on the crane hook was fastened to the pole; while balancing it horizontally, a steel pipe pole loaded together with it slipped off the bed and fell.
35.위험성감소대책:

▶ Follow work sequences that minimize risk exposure

175.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the OOOO structure installation construction site located in OO Dong, OO City, OOO Province, the victim, an employee of OOO Co., Ltd., performed silicone injection work at locations drilled to install solar equipment structure foundations on the roof of Factory Building 1, and while moving to Factory Building 2, fell from an opening between Factory Building 1 and Factory Building 2 (B≒0.48m) to the ground below (H=6.0m); he was transported to a hospital and died during treatment. 180.재해개요: Around February 2021, at the OOOO new construction site built by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO Dong, OO City, OOO Province, OOO (hereinafter 'the victim'), an employee of OOOO Co., Ltd., a joint contractor for the elevator installation work, was taking out a metal cutter, materials, and other items loaded in the carriage onto the landing in preparation for the freight elevator entrance door installation work in Tower Building B, when he lost his footing and fell approximately 15m through the opening between the carriage and the landing, collided with scaffolding installed on the 3rd basement level, and died.

181.재해개요: Around April 2017, at the elevator rail installation work area on the 9th floor of Building 105 of the OOOO Co., Ltd. OOOO new construction site located in OO Eup, OO City, OOO Province, the victim, an employee of OOOO, was moving between the elevator entrance floor and the 1st-tier working platform of a temporary car for rail installation work inside the elevator shaft, when the victim fell through the opening (width 1m, height 1.2m) between the entrance floor and the 1st-tier working platform of the temporary car, approximately 1.2m high, down to the 4th basement floor inside the elevator shaft, and is presumed to have died as a result. This was a fatal accident.

181.위험성감소대책:

▶ When workers work in fall-risk sections such as elevator hoistway pits, install safety blocks, etc. and work with safety harnesses fastened

182.재해개요: Around June 2017, at the OOOO Building elevator expansion construction site located in OO District, OOO City, the victim was pulling an H-beam lifted by winch at the 5th-floor elevator pit slab edge in order to move it onto the slab, when the rope supporting the H-beam suddenly came loose and he fell together with the H-beam approximately 15.0m to the elevator pit floor below and died. This was a fatal accident.
182.재해유발요인: While pulling an H-beam hoisted by winch at the slab edge to move it onto the slab, the rope supporting the H-beam suddenly came loose and the worker fell together with the H-beam to the elevator pit floor about 15.0 m below
182.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before lifting materials, attach and inspect the condition of the lifting wire rope and safety devices (hook safety latch, etc.)
▶ When working in places where workers may fall such as slab edges, install safety harness anchorage facilities and inspect and supervise safety harness fastening

183.재해개요: Around September 2020, at a factory new construction project, the victim was performing asphalt paving work in the exterior parking lot of the building, when, while trying to avoid a dump truck reversing to supply asphalt material to the paving equipment, he fell from the equipment intake opening 5.5m to the floor below and died.
183.재해유발요인: While performing asphalt paving work, stepping backward to avoid a reversing dump truck, the worker fell through a floor opening used for equipment delivery
183.위험성감소대책:
▶ If subsequent construction does not follow continuously, close off created openings (sump pits, etc.) using opening covers, etc.
▶ When working near openings, take fall prevention measures such as installing guardrails
▶ Assign spotters for vehicle-type material handling machinery

184.재해개요: Around March 2021, at an expressway construction project, while the victim was dismantling pier column formwork, the moment he removed the last horizontal bolt, a gap opened between the pier column and the formwork, and he fell through the resulting opening and died.
184.재해유발요인: At an expressway construction site, while dismantling pier column formwork, the moment the last horizontal bolt binding the formwork was removed, a gap opened between the pier column and the formwork and the worker slipped through the resulting opening and fell
184.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails, vertical fall-prevention nets, etc. in places with fall potential such as pier columns or openings
▶ Install fall-prevention nets when guardrails, etc. must be temporarily dismantled
▶ If fall-prevention net installation is difficult, take fall prevention measures such as wearing safety harnesses (fastening both safety hooks)

185.재해개요: In April 2019, at a national highway improvement construction site, while the victim was installing bridge abutment wall formwork, he fell 1.3m from the abutment foundation slab to the lean concrete floor and died.
185.재해유발요인: While installing bridge abutment wall formwork, the worker slipped at an opening in the abutment foundation slab and fell to the blinding concrete floor
185.위험성감소대책:
▶ In places where workers may fall, take protective measures such as (working-platform-type) covers of a structure with sufficient strength or guardrails
▶ For work at height with falling risk, take fall prevention measures such as wearing safety harnesses (fastening both safety hooks)

186.재해개요: Around January 2020, at the OO Construction apartment complex new construction site, the victim was performing floor clearing work in order to install scaffolding at the 11th-floor side wall section, when part of the side wall formwork (approx. 2.4-ton) toppled over and the victim's head was crushed between the stacked euro forms and the formwork, resulting in death.
186.재해유발요인: During floor cleanup work, part of the side wall formwork toppled over and the worker was caught between the stacked Euro forms and the formwork
186.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install braces or supports to prevent formwork overturning
▶ When formwork is assembled and then lifted for installation, establish safety measures (installing braces and tag lines, etc.) to prevent overturning

187.재해개요: Around December 2018, at the OO apartment new construction site, while the victim was tidying up inside the 1st basement PIT of Building 116, wall formwork that had been temporarily leaned in place toppled over and crushed him, resulting in death.
187.재해유발요인: During tidying-up work inside a basement level, wall formwork that had been temporarily leaned toppled over and the victim was crushed
187.위험성감소대책:
▶ Maintain a safe angle and install braces or supports when partially resting materials in place
▶ Mark passages at major parts of passages and remove obstacles
▶ If obstacle removal is difficult, secure braces and anti-slip timbers, etc.

188.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO extension construction site, during lifting and placement work of water-barrier wall formwork with a mobile crane, an installed beam formwork toppled over, and the victim, who was guiding the crane equipment on the 1st floor, could not evade it and was crushed under the formwork, resulting in death.
188.재해유발요인: With no large-formwork assembly drawing prepared and no overturn-prevention measures taken, while guiding the equipment during hoisting and placement of drop-wall beam formwork by crane, the drop-wall beam formwork overturned due to eccentric load and the worker was crushed
188.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling walls, beams, formwork, etc., take overturning prevention measures such as installing bracing supports to withstand work loads and other external forces that occur
▶ When lifting hanging-wall beam formwork, remove the rigging after installing support braces that can withstand horizontal forces generated by upper work loads, etc.

189.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the OO multi-family housing new construction site, while an attempt was being made to lift FRP slab formwork (so-called 'con-panel') stacked on a sloped roof slab, the formwork lost balance and collapsed, and the victim, who was located on the sloped roof, fell to the floor below together with the FRP formwork (height: approx. 13m) and died; a fellow worker was struck by the falling materials and injured.
189.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, while hoisting slab formwork (FRP) stacked on a sloped roof slab, the worker lost balance and fell together with the formwork (FRP)
189.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy objects (5kg or more), mark the center of gravity and use two-line rigging to prevent loss of balance
▶ Install working platforms and guardrails in places with fall and tipping hazards

190.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the OO commercial-residential complex new construction site under construction by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was moving from the 4th floor onto the top of a formwork beam, when he fell 12m together with a euro form to the 1st-floor concrete floor below and died.
190.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, while carrying a Euro form from the lower floor and moving onto the top of the formwork beam, the worker lost balance and fell to the concrete floor together with the Euro form
190.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install working platforms such as steel pipe scaffolds and mobile scaffolds for formwork assembly work
▶ Implement fall prevention measures such as installing safety harness anchorage facilities and wearing safety harnesses to prevent falls

191.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO General Construction Co., Ltd. OO new construction site, in order to install a formwork beam, two victims were fixing the formwork beam on top of the beam, when the plywood fixing part fractured and the formwork beam fell approximately 3.4m to the floor below; of the two victims, one died and one was injured, and one victim who had been below was struck by the falling beam formwork and injured.

▶ Provide safety harnesses and install safety harness anchorage facilities for workers frequently working at heights of 2m or more

192.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO water and sewage facility expansion project site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, an employee of the prime contractor, was moving along the horizontal members of the shores, on top of the system shores installed for reservoir slab concrete pouring, in order to transport working platforms, when he lost his balance and fell to the floor (H≒5.1m) and died.
192.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, on top of the system shore installed for slab concrete pouring, while moving along the shore horizontal members for working platform transport work, the worker lost balance and fell
192.위험성감소대책:

▶ When installing working platforms on top of shores, install fall-prevention nets, etc. to prevent fall hazards
▶ When working in places with fall risk, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

193.재해개요: Around November 2017, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO new construction site, the victim (form carpenter) was carrying a ladder (aluminum, H-type (12 rungs, 4m)) for 1st-floor wall formwork assembly work in Building OO and was passing through a vehicle passage section, when a sudden strong wind toppled wall formwork (euro form, size: 15m×3.45m, weight: 1.7ton) over, and the victim was crushed under the wall formwork and died.
193.재해유발요인: With no large-formwork assembly drawing prepared and no overturn-prevention measures taken, while guiding the equipment during hoisting and placement of drop-wall beam formwork by crane, the drop-wall beam formwork overturned due to eccentric load and the worker was crushed
193.위험성감소대책:

▶ When lifting hanging-wall beam formwork, remove the rigging after installing support braces that can withstand horizontal forces generated by upper work loads, etc.

194.재해개요: Around May 2018, at a detached house site built by OO Construction, the victim was on the 1st-tier working platform of interior scaffolding (height 2m), turning around to receive a euro form from a co-worker on the 1st floor, when he missed his footing with his left foot and fell approximately 2m to the concrete floor below and died.

195.위험성감소대책:

196.재해개요: Around October 2018, at a private detached house new construction site, the victim (form carpenter), an employee of a reinforced-concrete work subcontractor, finished installing the 2nd-floor beam side formwork and was waiting on the beam formwork above the front door, when he lost his balance and fell to the 1st floor below (H≒2.7m), and his chest was pierced by a protruding vertical rebar (L=13cm), resulting in death.
196.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, while nailing plywood joints on the beam soffit formwork, the worker lost balance and fell, and his chest was punctured by a vertical rebar protruding from the floor
196.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install working platforms such as steel pipe scaffolds and mobile scaffolds for formwork assembly work
▶ Implement fall prevention measures such as installing safety harness anchorage facilities and wearing safety harnesses to prevent falls

197.재해개요: Around March 2019, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. multi-family housing new construction site, the victim (form carpenter), in order to install 1st-floor beam formwork, was receiving beam bottom panels (plywood) from a worker below and performing installation work, when he fell approximately 2.5 meters to the concrete floor slab below and died.
197.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, while turning around on the scaffold working platform to receive Euro forms passed up from the lower-level floor, the worker missed a step with the left foot and fell
197.위험성감소대책:

198.재해개요: Around November 2020, at the OO underground parking lot building construction site under construction by OO Construction Co., Ltd., two victims (form carpenters) had fixed the 1st-basement beam formwork to the column formwork and were installing safety harness anchorage facilities, when, in the process of hoisting the tower crane hook block, the lifting sling belt caught on the beam formwork fixing hardware, and the two victims working on top of the beam formwork fell together with the beam formwork approximately 4.0m to the floor below (the 2nd basement floor concrete surface) and were injured.
198.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, after fixing beam formwork to column formwork, during safety harness anchorage installation work, in the process of hoisting the tower crane hook block, the lifting sling belt caught on the beam formwork fixing hardware and the worker working on top of the beam formwork fell
198.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement fall prevention measures such as installing safety harness anchorage facilities and wearing safety harnesses to prevent falls
▶ For tower crane work, assign to each tower crane a worker and a signal duty person who has completed signal training

199.재해개요: The victim, an employee of reinforced-concrete work subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd., was performing installation work of the formwork for a roof-level slab beam (width×depth=500×900mm, L=4.6m), when he lost his balance and toppled over; holding onto the beam side formwork trying not to fall, he nevertheless fell to the 8th floor below (H=3.3m), and the beam side formwork subsequently fell and struck the victim, resulting in death.
199.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, while nailing plywood joints on the beam soffit formwork, the worker lost balance and fell, and his chest was punctured by a vertical rebar protruding from the floor
199.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install working platforms such as steel pipe scaffolds and mobile scaffolds for formwork assembly work
▶ Implement fall prevention measures such as installing safety harness anchorage facilities and wearing safety harnesses to prevent falls

200.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO factory new construction site, the victim, an employee of a subcontractor, was assembling concrete retaining wall formwork for the office building, when the 2nd-tier exterior formwork of the retaining wall (20m×2.4m, approx. 1.2TON) toppled forward toward where the victim was located, and he was crushed under the formwork and died.
200.재해유발요인: With no assembly drawing based on structural review prepared for formwork assembly and no formwork overturn-prevention measures taken, during concrete retaining wall formwork assembly work, the retaining wall exterior formwork toppled onto the front of the worker, crushing him
200.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing formwork, install braces or supports of sturdy structure so it does not overturn due to self-weight or external forces 
▶ When assembling wall formwork, conduct structural review of the structure for horizontal loads from self-weight, wind loads, work loads, etc., then prepare an assembly drawing including member material, spacing, and fixing methods 
▶ When assembling formwork, implement overturning prevention measures such as installing ties, braces, or supports

201.재해개요: Around October 2016, at a mixed-use residential facility new construction site, the victim, who was hanging on the 1st-basement column forms (formwork) performing flat-tie and pin fixing work, fell to the floor and died.
201.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, while hanging onto basement-level column formwork and fixing flat ties and pins, the worker fell to the floor
201.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with fall risk such as work on top of columns, install platforms and guardrails, etc. using mobile scaffolds, etc.
▶ When working in fall-risk places such as formwork assembly work, implement fall protection measures such as installing fall-prevention nets and guardrails and wearing safety harnesses
▶ If guardrails, etc. must be temporarily dismantled, install fall-prevention nets between the scaffold and the building

202.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the OO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., while a victim belonging to a subcontractor was performing formwork on the first basement level, the brace of a temporarily erected column formwork came loose, and the upper part of the toppling column formwork struck the back of the victim's neck, resulting in death.
202.재해유발요인: Without suspending it from lifting equipment and without firmly installing braces, during basement-level formwork carpentry, a temporarily erected column formwork toppled over as the brace came off, striking the worker on the back of the neck
202.위험성감소대책:
▶ Take necessary measures such as suspending column formwork from lifting equipment so it does not overturn, then installing braces of sturdy structure on undeformed members before working
▶ Check members where braces are installed for damage in advance and firmly fix them with wedges, nails, etc. so they do not come off

203.재해개요: Around May 2017, at a baseball stadium construction site built by OO Civil Engineering Co., Ltd., two victims were assembling a backscreen wall formwork (14m×8m) on an external scaffold when the formwork overturned, and they were crushed under the overturning formwork.
203.재해유발요인: With no assembly drawing based on structural review prepared for formwork assembly and no formwork overturn-prevention measures taken, during concrete retaining wall formwork assembly work, the retaining wall exterior formwork toppled onto the front of the worker, crushing him
203.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing formwork, install braces or supports of sturdy structure so it does not overturn due to self-weight or external forces 
▶ When assembling wall formwork, conduct structural review of the structure for horizontal loads from self-weight, wind loads, work loads, etc., then prepare an assembly drawing including member material, spacing, and fixing methods 
▶ When assembling formwork, implement overturning prevention measures such as installing ties, braces, or supports

204.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO detached house new construction site, two victims were installing wall formwork on the left side when the wall formwork (height 2.4m, weight approx. 114kg) toppled over and fell on the victims.
204.재해유발요인: With no assembly drawing based on structural review prepared for formwork assembly and no formwork overturn-prevention measures taken, during concrete retaining wall formwork assembly work, the retaining wall exterior formwork toppled onto the front of the worker, crushing him
204.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing formwork, install braces or supports of sturdy structure so it does not overturn due to self-weight or external forces

▶ When assembling formwork, implement overturning prevention measures such as installing ties, braces, or supports

205.재해개요: Around July 2018, at the OO public health center relocation new construction site, the victim was stepping down from the top of a wall formwork (1st-floor medicine warehouse section) toward the bottom of a beam formwork (1st-floor office section) located 120cm below, when he lost his balance and fell approximately 3.6m onto the concrete floor at ground level, resulting in death.
205.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, while climbing down from wall formwork to the bottom of beam formwork, the worker slipped, lost balance, and fell to the floor
205.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with fall risk such as work on top of columns, install platforms and guardrails, etc. using mobile scaffolds, etc.
▶ When working in fall-risk places such as formwork assembly work, implement fall protection measures such as installing fall-prevention nets and guardrails and wearing safety harnesses
▶ If guardrails, etc. must be temporarily dismantled, install fall-prevention nets between the scaffold and the building

206.재해개요: Around March 2019, at a hazard-zone improvement project site, the victim was installing inner wall formwork of a BOX bridge when the wall formwork (height 2.3M, width 10M, weight approx. 845kg) toppled over, striking the victim's chest and other parts, resulting in death.
206.재해유발요인: With no assembly drawing based on structural review prepared for formwork assembly and no formwork overturn-prevention measures taken, during concrete retaining wall formwork assembly work, the retaining wall exterior formwork toppled onto the front of the worker, crushing him
206.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing formwork, install braces or supports of sturdy structure so it does not overturn due to self-weight or external forces 
▶ When assembling wall formwork, conduct structural review of the structure for horizontal loads from self-weight, wind loads, work loads, etc., then prepare an assembly drawing including member material, spacing, and fixing methods
