▶ In sections with fall risk, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or work after wearing a safety harness

240.재해개요: Around June 2020, at the OO public housing construction project site built by OOOO Co., Ltd. and OOO Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor was working on the topmost working platform of a gang form for dismantling the parapet (L=10m, H=42cm) formwork on the rooftop floor of apartment Building OO, when the gang form (2.3-ton, 10.6m×3.2m) detached from the exterior wall, and the victim fell down together with the gang form (H≒30m), resulting in death.
240.재해유발요인: With safety measures for gang form work not observed, during gang form dismantling work on the rooftop level, the gang form detached from the exterior wall and the worker fell
240.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling and lifting gang forms, suspend the gang form from lifting equipment before working
▶ Comply with not removing supporting or fixing hardware in advance before suspending from lifting equipment 
▶ In sections with fall risk, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or work after wearing a safety harness

241.재해개요: Around August 2020, at the OO tunnel construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor, in the process of dismantling a circular steel formwork of a pier, lost his balance the moment he removed a bolt while on a vertical ladder attached to the circular steel formwork, and fell approximately 9.6m to the ground, resulting in death.
241.재해유발요인: With safety measures for gang form work not observed, during gang form dismantling work on the rooftop level, the gang form detached from the exterior wall and the worker fell
241.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling and lifting gang forms, suspend the gang form from lifting equipment before working
▶ Comply with not removing supporting or fixing hardware in advance before suspending from lifting equipment 
▶ In sections with fall risk, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or work after wearing a safety harness

242.재해개요: Around September 2020, at the OO construction site, a victim belonging to a subcontractor was dismantling protective-wall formwork when he fell approximately 17m to the ground and died.
242.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, during partial formwork dismantling work, the worker lost balance and fell
242.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working on uneven places such as sloped rocks or moss, install working platforms by methods such as scaffold assembly
▶ In sections with fall risk, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or work after wearing a safety harness

243.재해개요: Around May 2016, at the OO multi-family house site, the victim was lifting a large exterior-wall formwork (5,010mm x 3,200mm) from the 3rd above-ground floor to the 4th above-ground floor when he was crushed under the overturning large formwork, and his head was punctured by a vertical rebar protruding from the 4th-floor slab, resulting in death.
243.재해유발요인: With poor heavy-load handling work methods, while hoisting large exterior wall formwork from an above-ground floor to the upper floor, the worker was crushed by the overturning large formwork and his head was punctured by a vertical rebar protruding from the upper-floor slab
243.위험성감소대책:
▶ For heavy-object lifting work, secure safety factors (rates) by rigging type and review rigging methods and rigging safety to ensure stability
▶ Prohibit use of defective materials when assembling large formwork panels

244.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the OO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a bundle of euro forms (60 sheets) for 2nd-floor formwork was being lifted and transported with a mobile crane (50t) from the roadside on the 1st floor, rigged with belt rope slings at two points, when one euro form (10kg) at the top corner of the bundle fell from a height of approximately 4m and struck the side of the face of the victim, who was standing and resting about 2m away after organizing materials such as supports, resulting in death.
244.재해유발요인: With no falling-object prevention measures taken, while transporting a bundle of Euro forms for formwork with a mobile crane, the Euro forms fell and struck the worker
244.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before lifting materials, control all worker activity and access along the load path in advance
▶ Firmly secure lifted loads using lifting bags, etc. to prevent detachment and separation of the load
▶ Use material lifting boxes

245.재해개요: Around June 2017, at the OO site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was engaged in lifting and unloading a steel formwork when the fiber lifting rope broke, and the victim was crushed under the falling steel formwork and died.
245.재해유발요인: With poor management of lifting materials, during hoisting and unloading of steel formwork, the lifting fiber rope broke, the steel formwork fell, and the worker was subsequently crushed
245.위험성감소대책:
▶ Inspect lifting fiber ropes before work and use within the permissible lifting load
▶ Prohibit use of excavators, which are vehicle-type construction machinery, for purposes other than their main use

246.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the OO new construction site, the victim was standing on top of the beam bottom formwork to install beam formwork on the 1st above-ground floor, assisting in lifting the beam side-panel formwork, when he lost his balance and fell to the 1st above-ground floor (H≒2.85m), resulting in death.
246.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, standing on top of the beam soffit formwork to install above-ground beam formwork, while assisting the hoisting of the beam side-panel formwork, the worker lost balance and fell
246.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall-risk places, install working platforms and install fall-prevention nets
▶ If fall-prevention net installation is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

247.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the OOOO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., two victims were on top of a beam formwork hoisted by tower crane for installation on the second basement level, releasing the hoisting rope, when the crane rose while the rope was not fully released; the suspended beam formwork tilted, and they lost their balance and fell to the floor (H=3.9m), sustaining injuries (requiring 3 or more months of medical care).
247.재해유발요인: For basement beam formwork installation, while releasing the hoisting rope on top of beam formwork hoisted by tower crane, the crane rose with the rope not fully released, tilting the suspended beam formwork, and the worker lost balance and fell
247.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement fall prevention measures such as installing safety harness anchorage facilities and wearing safety harnesses to prevent falls
▶ For tower crane work, assign to each tower crane a worker and a signal duty person who has completed signal training

248.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the OO apartment site of OOO Co., Ltd., the victim was performing surface-finishing work on the lowest tier (5th tier) of a gang-form working platform when the welded part of the steel support under the working platform detached, the platform opened, and the victim fell from the 4th-floor height (H=12.6m) to the ground and died.
248.재해유발요인: With inadequate checking for deformation and damage of steel supports such as working platforms, during surface-finishing work at the lowest level of the gang form working platform, the welds of the steel supports under the platform came off, the platform opened, and the worker fell
248.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall-risk places, install working platforms and install fall-prevention nets
▶ If fall-prevention net installation is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Before work, check steel supports for deformation, damage, etc. and inspect for abnormalities

249.재해개요: Around May 2017, at an apartment new construction work, the victim was on the 4th above-ground floor, holding and pulling a guide rope to receive a member being lifted and transported by tower crane, when the round sling suddenly broke and the member fell, striking the victim's head, shoulders, etc., resulting in death.
249.재해유발요인: While pulling the guide rope to receive and lower an R.C.S form rail member hoisted and transported by tower crane, the round sling broke, the rail member fell, and then struck the worker
249.위험성감소대책:
▶ During rigging work, install separate cushioning materials at contact points between fiber ropes, etc. and the four corners of materials to prevent cutting or damage
▶ For tower crane work, prepare a work plan and work in accordance with the work plan
▶ Control worker access to falling-hazard areas during heavy-object handling work such as material lifting

250.재해개요: Around January 2018, at the OO new construction site being built by OOO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor, in order to dismantle a G.C.S form (K-06) installed on the exterior of the 44th above-ground floor of Building OO, hung the G.C.S form (K-06) on the tower crane's wire rope, dismantled the members fixed to the wall, moved to the previously installed G.C.S form (K-07) on the left, and was signaling the tower crane operator by radio, when the moving G.C.S form (K-06) collided with the G.C.S form (K-07) on which the victim was standing; the previously installed G.C.S form (K-07) tilted to one side, and the victim, having lost his balance, fell to the ground-floor level (H≒125m) and died.
250.재해유발요인: With no safety measures for platform-integrated formwork taken, after dismantling a G.C.S form installed on the exterior of an above-ground floor, the worker moved to the G.C.S form installed on the left and, while signaling with the tower crane operator, the dismantled form collided with the form the worker was standing on, tilting it, and the worker lost balance and fell
250.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails in places where workers may fall such as the ends of working platforms installed on G.C.S forms, and if guardrails, etc. must be temporarily dismantled for work purposes, install safety nets
▶ When workers are made to wear safety harnesses for work in high places, install safety harness anchorage facilities, etc. where harnesses can be safely attached and used

251.재해개요: Around January 2018, at the OO officetel new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., during gang-form lifting work above the 15th above-ground floor slab, the victim was holding the gang-form securing rope when a sudden gust of wind blew the gang form; the victim, unable to let go of the securing rope, fell to the ground (H≒41m) and died.
251.재해유발요인: With no heavy-load handling work plan prepared, during gang form hoisting work, a gust of wind pushed the unfixed gang form outward from the apartment structural face; part of the worker's body caught on the gang form fixing rope and was dragged along, and the worker fell
251.위험성감소대책:
▶ When handling heavy objects such as gang forms, establish safety measures to prevent unexpected fall accidents due to gusts, etc., and proceed with work according to the plan
▶ Firmly fasten and install gang form fixing wire ropes and fixing lugs before carrying out work
▶ When working in places with fall risk such as gang form lifting work, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

252.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO block site built by OO Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor was engaged in gang-form lifting work when a gust of wind blew and the unsecured gang form swung outward beyond the apartment frame face; part of the victim's body was caught by the gang-form securing rope and dragged along, and he fell to the ground-floor level and died.
252.재해유발요인: With no heavy-load handling work plan prepared, during gang form hoisting work, a gust of wind pushed the unfixed gang form outward from the apartment structural face; part of the worker's body caught on the gang form fixing rope and was dragged along, and the worker fell
252.위험성감소대책:
▶ When handling heavy objects such as gang forms, establish safety measures to prevent unexpected fall accidents due to gusts, etc., and proceed with work according to the plan
▶ Firmly fasten and install gang form fixing wire ropes and fixing lugs before carrying out work
▶ When working in places with fall risk such as gang form lifting work, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

253.재해개요: Around June 2018, at the OO officetel new construction site being built by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a reinforced-concrete work subcontractor, in the process of lifting the internal gang form of the tower parking structure from the 16th to the 17th floor, was performing fine adjustment (raising) work with a chain block on the topmost working platform of the gang form in order to install the gang-form lower fixing bolts, when the welded joint between the vertical and horizontal members welded to the gang-form lifting lug fractured, and the victim fell together with the gang form (H≒63m) and died.
253.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken during gang form hoisting, on an above-ground floor, while making fine adjustments (lifting) with a chain block on the topmost gang form working platform to install the gang form lower fixing bolts, the weld between the vertical and horizontal members welded to the gang form lifting lug fractured, and the gang form and the worker fell
253.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before gang form lifting work, inspect the welding condition of connections and the normal operating condition of turnbuckles
▶ When lifting gang forms, give and implement work instructions such as minimizing interference with adjacent gang forms, etc.

254.재해개요: Around April 2019, at the OO new construction site being built by OO Industry Co., Ltd., the victim, a gang-form lifting worker belonging to a subcontractor, was engaged in lifting a gang form, installed on the exterior of the 7th above-ground floor about 36m above the ground, up to the 8th floor when he fell to the ground-floor level and died.
254.재해유발요인: With no caught-in prevention measures taken, on an above-ground floor, to identify the cause of abnormal noise from an inclined belt conveyor, the worker removed the protective cover of the running conveyor and, during inspection, the worker's left arm was caught between the belt and the drum
254.위험성감소대책:
▶ Stop operation during conveyor maintenance and inspection work
▶ Prohibit unauthorized removal of tension maintenance device protective covers

255.재해개요: Around April 2019, at the OO residential-commercial complex new construction site being built by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., two victims belonging to a subcontractor, in order to raise a gang form installed inside the mechanical parking structure on the 7th above-ground floor, climbed onto the gang-form working platform without the gang form being slung to the tower crane, and while dismantling the lower fixing bolts supporting the gang form, they fell together with the gang form to the floor of the third basement level (H≒35.8m); one died and one was injured.
255.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, to raise a gang form installed inside an above-ground floor, the worker climbed onto the gang form working platform without slinging it to the tower crane and, while dismantling the lower fixing bolts supporting the gang form, fell to the floor together with the gang form
255.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall-risk places, install working platforms and install fall-prevention nets
▶ If fall-prevention net installation is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

256.재해개요: Around June 2019, at a residential-type lodging facility new construction site being built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor was engaged in raising the inner-wall gang form of the parking tower on the 12th floor when an adjacent gang form detached from the parking tower inner wall, and the victim, who was standing by on that gang form's working platform, fell together with the gang form to the parking tower floor (H≒43m) and died.
256.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken during gang form hoisting, during gang form raising work on the inner wall of an above-ground parking tower, an adjacent gang form detached from the parking tower inner wall, and the worker standing by on that gang form working platform fell
256.위험성감소대책:
▶ When only some anchor bolts are fixed, comply with installing overturn-prevention wire ropes so that gang form stability is not degraded by self-weight, work/impact, wind loads, etc. 
▶ When assembling and dismantling gang forms, frequently inspect supporting or fixing bolts for abnormalities and immediately replace them if abnormalities are found
▶ When assembling and dismantling gang forms, firmly install and fasten anchor bolts before work

257.재해개요: Around May 2016, at the OO center new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., concrete was poured into a parapet formwork widened by 10cm (H=5.3m, L=6.8m) at the rooftop edge, and the victim was leveling the top surface from an external scaffold when the parapet toppled outward from the building, and the victim fell onto the rooftop of an adjacent building (H=13.5m) and died.
257.재해유발요인: After pouring concrete into the parapet formwork, while the worker was screeding the top from the external scaffold, the parapet toppled outward from the building and the worker fell
257.위험성감소대책:
▶ Assemble formwork conforming to design drawings and conduct safety evaluation 
▶ Install wall tie hardware for fixing external scaffolds
▶ Thorough supervision such as checking formwork deformation and displacement

258.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO new construction site (a building with 1 basement level and 6 above-ground floors), during concrete pouring of the 6th-floor slab, the victim (form carpenter), in order to reinforce the wall formwork on the stairwell side, was stepping from the slab edge onto a horizontal member supporting the wall formwork when he lost his balance and fell inside the winding staircase of the stairwell down to the first basement level (H≒21m), resulting in death.
258.재해유발요인: While stepping up onto a formwork-supporting horizontal member at the slab edge for wall formwork reinforcement work, the worker lost balance and fell
258.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling and repairing formwork at heights of 2m or more, install working platforms through assembly of scaffolds, etc.
▶ Install fall-prevention nets in fall-risk places such as internal openings of spiral stairs
▶ For work at heights of 2m or more, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

259.재해개요: In October 2017, at the OO church new construction site, during concrete pouring of a 1st-floor wall (length 6m, height 3.8m, thickness 20cm), the wall formwork collapsed, and the victim, who was working on the working platform of a double-row scaffold outside the wall, was crushed under the collapsing formwork and died (presumed).
259.재해유발요인: With a risk of collapse due to eccentric load and inadequate collapse-prevention measures, during wall concrete pouring, the wall formwork collapsed and the worker working on the working platform was crushed
259.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement formwork collapse prevention measures such as reviewing eccentric loads during pouring 
▶ Inspect formwork support materials for material defects 
▶ Install braces and guy lines in a structurally safe manner

260.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the block fabrication yard of the OO Co., Ltd. beach coastal maintenance project site, two victims (a form carpenter and a pump truck operator) were pouring concrete on a working platform on top of formwork when the formwork suddenly tilted and overturned, and in the process they fell to the ground and were injured.
260.재해유발요인: While the worker was pouring concrete on the upper working platform of a submerged-block AI formwork, concrete leaked out, the formwork suddenly tilted and overturned, and in the process the worker fell to the ground
260.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install braces and ties so formwork withstands external forces and does not overturn
▶ Assign a watcher during concrete pouring work; if abnormalities such as formwork deformation, settlement, or concrete leakage occur, stop work and evacuate workers

261.재해개요: Around January 2021, at about 11:10, at the OO apartment housing new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., during concrete pouring of the ramp wall at the basement parking entry section of Building 105, the formwork collapsed; of the two victims belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim (form worker) who was below the collapsed section died, and the victim (concrete placer) who was on the scaffold fell and was injured.
261.재해유발요인: With an assembly drawing arbitrarily prepared using materials without structural review, during concrete pouring of the ramp wall at the underground parking entrance section, the formwork collapsed
261.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing shores for concrete pouring, install shores in compliance with the installation methods per the assembly drawing
▶ Prohibit concentrated pouring to prevent eccentricity during concrete pouring
▶ Conduct structural review in advance when changing shore installation to suit site conditions
▶ When constructing formwork shores, install reinforcement to resist horizontal displacement and check whether yokes/joists are installed on center lines
▶ Use safety-certified shores

262.재해개요: Around January 2021, at the OO new construction work, while moving on the 15th-floor gang form for exterior wall plastering work, the victim fell through an opening where the working platform had been dismantled and dropped onto the 3rd-floor falling-object prevention net (H ≒ 29m), resulting in death.
262.재해유발요인: While performing plastering/surface-finishing work on the gang form working platform or moving between work locations, the worker fell through an opening in the working platform where no cover was installed
262.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in places where workers may fall, install covers of sufficient strength and mark them as openings
▶ Prohibit entry of persons other than the workers concerned into places that may pose hazards
▶ If installing guardrails, etc. at openings is difficult, have workers wear safety harnesses and install safety harness anchorage facilities

263.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO construction work, the victim was moving to the outside of the building through a window opening for electrical wire-pulling work when a steel pipe of a large formwork panel installed on the 5th above-ground floor exterior wall came loose and fell (approx. 14.4m), striking the victim on the head, resulting in death.
263.재해유발요인: While moving to the building exterior for electrical wiring work on the external meter box, a steel pipe detached and fell from a large formwork panel installed on the 5th-floor exterior wall, striking the worker
263.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement falling-object hazard prevention measures such as falling-object prevention nets, protective shelves, and no-entry zone designation
▶ Install dedicated safe passages for workers

264.재해개요: Around June 2021, at a road opening construction site, while anchor bolts were being fastened to a steel pier formwork, the steel formwork overturned, crushing those underneath; one died and one was injured.
264.재해유발요인: While a formwork installation worker was fastening set anchor bolts to steel pier formwork, the steel formwork overturned and the worker was crushed under the steel formwork
264.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing formwork, take overturning prevention measures by installing braces using wire ropes or single-pipe scaffolds, etc. to withstand the formwork's self-weight and other external forces
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a detailed work plan including safety measures to prevent overturning hazards (splitting formwork assembly into two, pouring concrete in two stages, work sequence and methods, etc.), and communicate the contents to workers before carrying out work

265.재해개요: Around January 2018, at a double-track railway construction site, during rigging work to strip a coping steel formwork, the steel formwork detached from the exterior wall and struck the working platform below; one worker fell 13m to the ground and died, and one worker was struck by a member and injured.
265.재해유발요인: With the coping steel formwork not suspended, the connecting hardware was dismantled and the formwork detached from the exterior wall, striking the pier-band working platform below, and the worker fell
265.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit removal of supporting or connecting hardware before formwork is suspended from lifting equipment
▶ For work handling heavy objects such as coping formwork, designate a work commander and have them direct the work

266.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO construction work, an industrial water pipe (L=9.1m) loaded on a truck was being lifted and unloaded to the ground using an excavator when a lifting-chain component (connecting link) failed under the load and broke; the pipe fell and struck the head of the victim below, resulting in death.
266.재해유발요인: After connecting a lifting chain to the excavator boom and hanging hooks on both ends of an industrial water pipe, during hoisting and unloading, the connect ring failed under the load and broke, the pipe fell, and the victim below was struck
266.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy objects, comply with rigging safety rules considering the safe load values according to sling rope angles
▶ Conduct pre-inspection for deformation of lifting hangers
▶ Use machinery and equipment suitable for material lifting

267.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OO construction work, a portable toilet located on the 1st-tier strut of the earth-retaining temporary structure was being hoisted by crane when the hoisted load swung and struck the victim nearby, who then fell approximately 20m to the excavation surface and died.
267.재해유발요인: During hoisting work using a mobile crane on top of the earth-retaining temporary structure, the hoisted load swung and the victim (performing rigging work) within the working radius was struck by the load and then fell
267.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during heavy-object handling work
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan

268.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO construction work, the victim was operating an excavator (0.8㎥) and moving on the apron of a river weir body in order to break part of the weir, when one of the excavator's shoes (crawler tracks) slipped at the edge of the apron and the excavator overturned; the operator's cab was submerged in the water, and the victim drowned and died.
268.재해유발요인: While moving on the stilling basin to break part of a river weir, the excavator's crawler tracks slid at the edge and the excavator overturned, and the victim was submerged in the water and drowned
268.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing weir demolition work in rivers using construction machinery such as excavators, inspect conditions such as water depth, terrain, and ground, and establish plans for work routes and methods accordingly
▶ When performing weir demolition work in rivers using construction machinery such as excavators, in preparation for cases where the underwater terrain cannot be identified due to muddy water, etc., mark the working radius with elevation differences in advance using webbing straps, and take measures so the operator can check via rearview mirrors, rear cameras, etc.

269.재해개요: Around December 2013, at the OO construction work, the victim collided with the bucket of an excavator that was excavating, fell to the excavation bottom about 2m deep, and died.
269.재해유발요인: During work, the worker was struck by the bucket of an excavator swinging its boom, and then fell to the excavation bottom
269.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during work with vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Establish plans for work routes and methods when moving vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ During vehicle-type construction machinery work, secure operator visibility by checking rear camera operation, adjusting rearview mirror angles, etc.

270.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO construction work, after pipeline burial work using an excavator, the moment the boom was rotated to relocate, the victim nearby was struck on the head by the excavator boom and died.
270.재해유발요인: During work, the worker was struck on the head by the boom of an excavator swinging to move
270.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during work with vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Establish plans for work routes and methods when moving vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ During vehicle-type construction machinery work, secure operator visibility by checking rear camera operation, adjusting rearview mirror angles, etc.

271.재해개요: Around November 2017, at the OO construction work, an excavator was moving on the excavation slope for water supply pipe joining when it overturned, and the victim, who was preparing for work below, was caught by the excavator blade and died.
271.재해유발요인: While the excavator was moving on the excavation slope, it overturned and the victim working below was caught by the excavator blade
271.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement measures such as assigning spotters and preventing ground settlement to prevent overturning of vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Conduct pre-survey of the terrain, ground, and stratum conditions of the workplace

272.재해개요: Around March 2019, at the OO construction work, the victim was cleaning a road when he was run over by the wheels of an excavator traveling for excavation work, resulting in death.
272.재해유발요인: During work, the worker was struck by a reversing excavator and then run over by its rear wheel
272.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during work with vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Establish plans for work routes and methods when moving vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ During vehicle-type construction machinery work, secure operator visibility by checking rear camera operation, adjusting rearview mirror angles, etc.

273.재해개요: Around March 2020, at the OO construction work, the victim was operating an excavator and moving when the excavator overturned, and he was caught between the excavator and the surface of a farm road (concrete-paved road) and died.
273.재해유발요인: While driving an excavator, it overturned and the operator was caught between the excavator and the farm road surface
273.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement measures such as assigning spotters and preventing ground settlement to prevent overturning of vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Conduct pre-survey of the terrain, ground, and stratum conditions of the workplace

314.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during vehicle-type construction machinery work
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan
▶ When lifting heavy objects, avoid single-line rigging and comply with safe heavy-object handling methods (two-line rigging)

315.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OO factory new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim, who was performing pile driver signaling duties 2~3m from an auxiliary pile, was crushed and died when, after the pile driver operator had placed the auxiliary pile (follower) on top of a PHC pile pre-driven into the ground and performed pile driving, and was then lifting the auxiliary pile with the pile driver and setting it down on the ground, the fiber belt fastened to the auxiliary pile broke and the pile toppled over onto him.
315.재해유발요인: After pile driving, while hoisting an auxiliary pile with the pile driver, the fastened fiber belt broke, and the pile toppled over and crushed the worker
315.위험성감소대책:
▶ Frequently inspect the condition of rigging materials during work and keep spares so damaged ones are replaced immediately 
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan

316.재해개요: Around June 2019, at the OO hotel new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., during work to remove a previously delivered pile driver leader to a stockyard, the leader was being transported with the auxiliary hook of a cargo crane (5t) hooked to the leader's climbing trap (ladder), when the welded part of the climbing trap fractured and the leader fell (H ≒ 3m), striking the chest of the victim (pile driving helper), resulting in death.
316.재해유발요인: To remove the pile driver from the site, the cargo crane's auxiliary hook was hung on the climbing rungs of the pile driver leader for transport; the weld of the climbing rungs fractured, and the leader fell and struck the worker
316.위험성감소대책:
▶ Improve work methods so that hooks are not attached to weak points such as climbing traps during crane work
▶ During crane work, control worker access and perform work so the lifted load does not pass over workers' heads
▶ Comply with the operating manual when transporting pile drivers

317.재해개요: Around October 2019, at the OO reconstruction apartment new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., while a drilling rig anti-overturn steel plate was being transported and set down using an excavator, a drilling rig moving for CIP work collided with the excavator, and the steel plate, hung on a lifting hook without a safety latch, came off the hook, and the victim (common laborer) was pinned and died.
317.재해유발요인: While moving foundation pile materials using an excavator, the wire rope came off the hook and the worker was struck by a steel plate
317.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during vehicle-type construction machinery work
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan
▶ When lifting heavy objects, avoid single-line rigging and comply with safe heavy-object handling methods (two-line rigging)

318.재해개요: Around October 2019, at a pile work site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (welder) was engaged in mobile crane transport and assembly work when the boom overturned and he was pinned, resulting in death.
318.재해유발요인: During mobile crane assembly work, the boom lost its center of gravity due to the weight of the sheave assembly and hook block, and overturned, resulting in crushing
318.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with the equipment operating manual when assembling and dismantling mobile crane booms
▶ During heavy-object handling work, implement safety measures such as installing safety blocks and supports to prevent overturning and pinching hazards
▶ Assign a work commander and have skilled workers experienced in crane boom assembly work perform the work

319.재해개요: Around August 2020, at a construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., during PHC pile transport and mobile crane relocation, the boom toppled over, and the victim (welder), a worker, was struck by the boom and died.
319.재해유발요인: While transporting PHC piles using a mobile crane, the ground subsided, the mobile crane boom toppled over, and the worker was struck
319.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during vehicle-type construction machinery work
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan
▶ When lifting heavy objects, avoid single-line rigging and comply with safe heavy-object handling methods (two-line rigging)

320.재해개요: Around October 2020, at a happiness housing construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (truck driver) was unloading accessories of a drilling rig (construction equipment for earth-retaining work) from a 25-ton cargo truck when he was crushed by a screw (length approx. 6.4m, weight approx. 700kg) that rolled off the truck's cargo bed (height approx. 1.4m), resulting in death.
320.재해유발요인: While unloading drilling rig components from a cargo truck, the worker was crushed by a screw auger falling from the truck bed
320.위험성감소대책:
▶ Assign a work commander and prohibit entry of persons other than workers during vehicle-type material handling machinery work
▶ During unloading work, prohibit entry into falling-hazard places and install fences

321.재해개요: Around February 2021, at the housing redevelopment maintenance project site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim (work-team leader) belonging to subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd. was engaged in inspection and maintenance of the pile driver's wire drum when the pile driver operator raised the pile driver leader, and at the moment the wire rope wound onto the drum, the victim was caught between the drum and the wire rope and died.
321.재해유발요인: While inspecting the pile driver's wire drum, the moment the pile driver leader was raised and the wire rope wound onto the drum, the worker was caught between the drum and the wire rope
321.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with the operating manual during pile driver inspection and maintenance work
▶ Work after implementing safety measures according to the work sequence
▶ Assign a work commander and have experienced skilled workers perform pile driver inspection and maintenance work

322.재해개요: Around March 2021, at a sports center construction site, the victim was loosening bolts at the bottom of the connection (leader) in order to dismantle and remove a pile driver used for inserting earth-retaining piles, when the connection buckled, and the falling leader crushed the victim, resulting in death.
322.재해유발요인: To dismantle and remove the pile driver used for pile insertion, while loosening bolts under the connection, the connection buckled and the worker was crushed by the falling leader
322.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before pile driving, use accessories free of damage, wear, deformation, and corrosion, and conduct regular inspections to check for abnormalities
▶ Assign a work commander when repairing vehicle-type construction machinery (pile drivers, etc.) or attaching and removing attachments
▶ Comply with the operating manual when assembling and dismantling pile drivers

323.재해개요: Around October 2021, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site, an excavator operator, with the bucket attached in the direction opposite to its excavation orientation and without a safety pin, for the purpose of pouring concrete into a CIP casing, was connecting a funnel pipe to the casing when the bucket fell and struck the head of the victim working below, resulting in death.
323.재해유발요인: For concrete pouring inside the CIP casing, with the bucket fastened without a safety pin in the direction opposite to its excavation orientation, while connecting a funnel pipe to the casing, the bucket fell off
323.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during vehicle-type construction machinery work
▶ Check that the excavator bucket detachment-prevention safety pin is fastened and secured
▶ Prohibit directly entering the working radius with falling hazards to work

324.재해개요: Around February 2016, at the OO construction site, a victim (scaffolder) belonging to a subcontractor was replacing the auger header of drilling rig No. 2 for pile drilling work within the site, when a boulder lodged in the casing drive motor section fell and struck the victim, resulting in death.
324.재해유발요인: While replacing the auger header of the drilling rig, a boulder lodged in the casing drive motor section fell and struck the worker
324.위험성감소대책:
▶ Nets or protective shelves against falling objects need to be installed
▶ When removing loose rocks and residual soil at high positions, check for workers below before working
▶ Remove falling-object hazard factors in advance and install protective shelves
▶ Remove soil inside and outside the lower auger in advance, or separate the casing and perform repair work on the ground

325.재해개요: Around February 2017, the victim (air compressor operator), while behind a truck loaded with an air compressor for CIP drilling work located on the road next to the entrance of an officetel new construction site, was caught between the truck and a cargo crane reversing to secure the site access road, and died.
325.재해유발요인: The worker was caught between a truck parked loaded with an air compressor for CIP drilling work and a cargo crane reversing to secure the site access road
325.위험성감소대책:
▶ When moving vehicle-type construction machinery within the work area, assign signalmen or spotters to move it safely
▶ Install rear detection devices for reversing of vehicle-type construction machinery

326.재해개요: Around September 2017, at an officetel new construction site, a victim (scaffolder) belonging to a subcontractor was performing drilling rig auxiliary work at a material stockyard when he collided with an excavator transporting materials nearby, and the victim's chest was run over by the excavator's wheel, resulting in death.
326.재해유발요인: While performing drilling rig support work at the material yard, the victim was struck by an excavator transporting materials nearby and run over by the excavator's wheel
326.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters in places where vehicle-type construction machinery and workers may collide
▶ When using an excavator, use the equipment for purposes suited to its intended use

327.재해개요: Around February 2019, at the education-research and neighborhood living facility new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., OOO (drilling rig owner and operator) belonging to a subcontractor was performing ground drilling and H-Beam insertion work using a drilling rig, when an accessory fitting (W≒20kg) attached to the top of the drilling rig leader detached and free-fell to the ground, striking the head of the victim (the subcontractor's managing director), who was directing the work, resulting in death.
327.재해유발요인: While drilling the ground and inserting an H-beam using a drilling rig, an attached fitting on the upper part of the drilling rig leader detached and fell to the ground, striking the worker's head
327.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign a work commander to prevent detachment and falling of heavy objects
▶ Secure stability to prevent construction machinery from overturning or collapsing, such as inspecting welding conditions after assembly
▶ Before work, inspect the machinery used for abnormalities and implement hazard and risk prevention measures

328.재해개요: In August 2019, at a railway roadbed new construction site being built by OO Co., Ltd., the screw of a drilling rig was dismantled and suspended from the hoisting device (wire rope) to be set down on the ground, when the suspended screw rotated horizontally and struck the abdomen of the victim standing nearby, resulting in death.
328.재해유발요인: While dismantling the drilling rig's screw and lowering it to the ground suspended from the hoisting device (wire rope), the upper part of the screw suspended from the chain rotated around the part touching the ground and struck the abdomen of the victim standing nearby
328.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign a work commander to prevent detachment and falling of heavy objects
▶  Before work, inspect machinery for abnormalities and implement hazard and risk prevention measures

329.재해개요: Around October 2019, at the power plant construction site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim (welder) belonging to a pile work subcontractor was performing repair welding on the lower part of a drilling rig casing when a large gravel stone fell onto the victim's safety helmet, causing a severe impact to his head, and he died.
329.재해유발요인: While replacing the auger header of the drilling rig, a boulder lodged in the casing drive motor section fell and struck the worker
329.위험성감소대책:
▶ Nets or protective shelves against falling objects need to be installed
▶ When removing loose rocks and residual soil at high positions, check for workers below before working
▶ Remove falling-object hazard factors in advance and install protective shelves
▶ Remove soil inside and outside the lower auger in advance, or separate the casing and perform repair work on the ground

330.재해개요: Around June 2020, at the OO Co., Ltd. complex facility construction site, a victim belonging to subcontractor OO Co., Ltd. was struck by a pile driver casing motor cable that detached during CIP pile work, resulting in death.
330.재해유발요인: While drilling the ground and inserting an H-beam using a drilling rig, an attached fitting on the upper part of the drilling rig leader detached and fell to the ground, striking the worker's head
330.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign a work commander to prevent detachment and falling of heavy objects
▶ Secure stability to prevent construction machinery from overturning or collapsing, such as inspecting welding conditions after assembly
▶ Before work, inspect the machinery used for abnormalities and implement hazard and risk prevention measures

331.재해개요: Around February 2016, at an apartment new construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (pile worker), in order to dismantle the topmost screw [antenna screw, 1st-stage screw] of a pile driver, dismantled the screw connecting pin from the top of the casing motor, and while the raised screw motor and casing motor were being lowered to the ground simultaneously, the victim, who was on top of the casing motor, was caught between the screw motor and the casing motor and died.
331.재해유발요인: To dismantle the pile driver's screw, after removing the screw connecting pin on top of the casing motor, while simultaneously lowering the raised screw motor and casing motor to the ground, the victim on top of the casing motor was caught between the screw motor and the casing motor
331.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare an equipment dismantling work plan and share the contents with workers before carrying out work
▶ Implement safety measures such as attaching and operating surveillance cameras below the screw motor area to check worker movement into pinch-hazard zones
▶ Prevent hazards from unexpected descent of the casing motor by installing safety props and safety blocks

332.재해개요: Around March 2016, at an apartment new construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim was engaged in ground assembly of a pile driver leader when the leader support stand toppled over, and the victim was caught between the leader support stand and the leader member, resulting in death.
332.재해유발요인: During ground assembly of the pile driver leader, the leader support stand toppled over and the victim was caught between the leader support stand and the leader member
332.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install the leader support after checking the installation condition of joist materials on reclaimed ground
▶ When assembling the pile driver leader on the ground, prevent ground settlement using base plates, blocking, etc. in preparation for overturning, etc., then install the leader support
▶ Implement safety measures such as attaching and operating surveillance cameras below the screw motor area to check worker movement into pinch-hazard zones
▶ Prevent hazards from unexpected descent of the casing motor by installing safety props and safety blocks

333.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO Co., Ltd. bridge installation work site, during steel pipe pile driving, an auxiliary hammer was lifted onto the top of a steel pipe pile and was being fastened when the auxiliary hammer toppled over, and a victim (pile driving assistant) belonging to a subcontractor, who was assisting the work, was struck by the auxiliary hammer and died.
333.재해유발요인: During steel pipe pile driving, while the auxiliary hammer was hoisted onto the top of the steel pipe pile and being fastened, the auxiliary hammer toppled over and struck the worker
333.위험성감소대책:
▶ Since the wire rope rigging of the auxiliary hammer is fixed to the pile driver hook, check that a hook safety latch is installed to prevent overturning before performing work
▶ Prohibit entry of workers not directly related to the work into the working radius during pile driving
▶ Provide safety helmets within the working radius and check wearing status

334.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the OO Co., Ltd. electric railway roadbed new construction site, while drilling work was in progress with a pile driver, soil got on the cab window, and the victim was cleaning the window when a sudden rise of the auger caused by an in-hole explosion caught part of the victim's body in the slackened wire rope; as the auger then descended again, the wire rope was pulled taut, severing part of the victim's body and resulting in death.
334.재해유발요인: While cleaning the pile driver cab window, an in-hole explosion caused the auger to rise suddenly; part of the worker's body became entangled in the slackened wire rope, and as the auger descended again, part of the body was severed
334.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform maintenance and inspection of equipment used before work
▶ When construction machinery abnormalities occur, stop operation of the machinery before performing maintenance and inspection
▶ If abnormal situations occur during pile driving, such as wire rope slackening, prohibit worker entry into hazardous places

335.재해개요: Around January 2017, at a neighborhood living facility and multi-family house new construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., in order to mount a shock absorber (an auger accessory of the pile driver) between the pile driver's upper auger and the screw, the shock absorber was tied with a belt sling and hoisted up (H≒5.0m), and while the victim was working standing on the casing motor (lower auger) below the shock absorber, the suspended shock absorber fell and struck the victim below, resulting in death.
335.재해유발요인: While the worker was mounting a shock absorber between the pile driver's screw motor and screw, the shock absorber's belt sling came loose, and the shock absorber fell and struck the worker below
335.위험성감소대책:
▶ To prevent belt slings from coming off the hook, use ones equipped with loops, etc. at both ends and use one-line or two-line rigging methods
▶ Prohibit worker entry during work with risk of being struck by objects

336.재해개요: Around March 2017, at a river environment development work site, a victim (repairman) belonging to subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd. climbed onto the upper part of a pile driver leader laid on the ground in order to cut a wire rope tangled in the pile driver pulley, and during the cutting work the bolts at the leader joint fractured, and he fell from the upper part of the leader to the ground (H≒6.5m) and died.
336.재해유발요인: While the worker climbed onto the top of a pile driver leader laid on the ground and performed cutting work, the bolts at the leader joint fractured and the worker fell from the top of the leader to the ground
336.위험성감소대책:
▶ Inspect equipment before work
▶ Install working platforms of safe structure when working in fall-risk places
▶ Install fall-prevention guardrails and safety harness anchorage facilities

337.재해개요: Around July 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. research facility new construction site, the victim, a pile driving helper, during casing extraction, approached to tidy up the auger-screw hoisting wire, which had lost tension and was drooping on the ground around the hoist drum, when the wire lying on the ground was suddenly pulled taut and struck (impacted) the victim's neck, resulting in death.
337.재해유발요인: During pile casing extraction, the auger screw hoisting wire lost tension and hung slack on the ground around the hoist drum; the moment the victim approached to tidy it, the wire lying on the ground was suddenly pulled taut and struck the victim's neck
337.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform maintenance and inspection of equipment used before work
▶ When construction machinery abnormalities occur, stop operation of the machinery before performing maintenance and inspection
▶ If abnormal situations occur during pile driving, such as wire rope slackening, prohibit worker entry into hazardous places

338.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (pile worker), after inserting a PHC pile (L:22m), was removing soil covering the pile head when the drop hammer lifting wire rope broke at the top of the pile driver leader, and the drop hammer fell (fall height≒2.5m); the victim, who was below the drop hammer, was crushed under the drop hammer (weight≒6.2-ton) and died.
338.재해유발요인: After PHC pile insertion, while removing the soil covering the pile head, the drop hammer hoisting wire rope broke at the top of the pile driver leader, and the drop hammer fell and crushed the worker
338.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform maintenance and inspection of equipment used frequently
▶ Inspect wire rope condition during drilling rig lifting work
▶ Control worker access to prevent detachment and falling of heavy objects

339.재해개요: Around January 2018, at an apartment housing new construction site, the victim (pile driver operator) was about to perform ground drilling work to install PHC (concrete) piles when the pile driver began to tip over; he jumped from the operator's seat to evacuate, but was struck by the toppling pile driver body and other parts and died (presumed).
339.재해유발요인: To set the exact position for PHC pile drilling work, while moving the pile driver back and forth and rotating it left and right on a steel plate, the pile driver began to tip over; the operator jumped from the cab to escape but was struck by the overturning pile driver body
339.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct pre-survey of the terrain and ground conditions of the work site before work using vehicle-type construction machinery such as pile drivers
▶ Implement differential ground settlement prevention measures during work using vehicle-type construction machinery such as pile drivers

340.재해개요: Around May 2018, at the OO site being built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (welder), a worker belonging to subcontractor OO Co., Ltd., was performing flame-cutting work to dismantle a screen (approx. 1.5-ton) installed to prevent soil scattering during pile driving, when the screen collapsed, and he was pinned between the screen and a supporting beam, resulting in death.
340.재해유발요인: While performing flame-cutting work to dismantle a screen for preventing soil scattering during pile driving, the screen collapsed and the worker was crushed between the screen and the supporting beam
340.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work such as equipment assembly and dismantling, work after taking measures to prevent accidents such as falling objects, falls, and pinching
▶ Prohibit entry of workers not directly related to the work into the working radius during pile driving
▶ Provide safety helmets within the working radius and check wearing status

341.재해개요: Around August 2018, at a neighborhood living facility new construction work, the victim (work-team leader), a PHC pile worker, lost his footing while inspecting equipment on top of the generator at the rear of a pile driver, and fell onto the pile driver's crawler tracks (H≒3.6m), resulting in death.
341.재해유발요인: The worker climbed onto the pile driver's lower motor and, after finishing applying grease (lubricant) to the guide rail, fell onto the steel plate on the ground while climbing down
341.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install working platforms of safe structure when working in fall-risk places
▶ Install fall-prevention guardrails and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ When inspecting equipment, stop machine operation and cut off power before conducting inspection

342.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OO apartment housing new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim (pile driving worker) belonging to a pile work subcontractor was waiting near a pile driver when the wire rope (diameter 22mm) lifting the hammer suddenly broke at the topmost position of the leader, and the broken end of the wire rope flew down and struck the victim's head, resulting in death.
342.재해유발요인: After pile driving, while hoisting an auxiliary pile with the pile driver, the fastened fiber belt broke, and the pile toppled over and crushed the worker
342.위험성감소대책:
▶ Frequently inspect the condition of rigging materials during work and keep spares so damaged ones are replaced immediately 
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan

343.재해개요: Around November 2018, at the OO new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim (common laborer) belonging to a subcontractor climbed onto the lower motor of a pile driver, and having finished applying grease (lubricant) to the guide rail, was about to come down when he fell approximately 4.5m onto the steel plate on the ground and died.
343.재해유발요인: The worker climbed onto the pile driver's lower motor and, after finishing applying grease (lubricant) to the guide rail, fell onto the steel plate on the ground while climbing down
343.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install working platforms of safe structure when working in fall-risk places
▶ Install fall-prevention guardrails and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ When inspecting equipment, stop machine operation and cut off power before conducting inspection

344.재해개요: Around March 2019, at the OO expressway site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to subcontractor OO Co., Ltd. was installing sheet piles for pier (P1) construction when the hook of the pile driver's auxiliary crane slipped out, and the vibro hammer fell (H≒12m), striking the head of the victim below, resulting in death.
344.재해유발요인: During sheet pile installation work for pier construction, the weld of the nut fixing the hook of the pile driver's auxiliary crane came off, and the worker was struck by the falling vibro hammer
344.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during vehicle-type construction machinery work
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan
▶ When lifting heavy objects, avoid single-line rigging and comply with safe heavy-object handling methods (two-line rigging)

345.재해개요: Around March 2019, at the OO new construction site of OO Construction, the victim (work-team leader) was disconnecting the power cable of the upper drilling unit control box located on the upper part of a pile driver, when the pile driver operator operated the pile driver boom, and at the moment the wire rope wound onto the drum, the victim's right leg was caught between the drum and the wire rope and severed, resulting in death.
345.재해유발요인: While inspecting the pile driver's wire drum, the moment the pile driver leader was raised and the wire rope wound onto the drum, the worker was caught between the drum and the wire rope
345.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with the operating manual during pile driver inspection and maintenance work
▶ Work after implementing safety measures according to the work sequence
▶ Assign a work commander and have experienced skilled workers perform pile driver inspection and maintenance work

346.재해개요: Around May 2019, at the OO Co., Ltd. construction site, the victim (RCD worker) was using a mobile crane to coil and arrange the oscillator-driving hydraulic hose on top of the equipment, when the wire rope suspending the weight of the overwinding-prevention device hanging from the crane boom broke, and the weight fell to the ground (approx. 40m), striking the victim's head and resulting in death (presumed).
346.재해유발요인: While tidying the oscillator hydraulic hoses using a mobile crane, the wire rope suspending the weight of the over-winding prevention device hung on the mobile crane boom broke, and the weight fell to the ground
346.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform maintenance and inspection of equipment used frequently
▶ Inspect wire rope condition during mobile crane lifting work
▶ Control worker access to prevent detachment and falling of heavy objects

347.재해개요: Around October 2020, at a logistics center new construction work of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (pile worker), belonging to pile work subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd., after PHC pile driving, measured the rebound to verify pile bearing capacity and was raising the drop hammer when the shackle pin came out, and the bearing swivel fastened to the shackle fell from a height of approximately 8m, striking the victim's head and resulting in death.
347.재해유발요인: After PHC pile driving, rebound measurement was taken to check pile bearing capacity; while lifting the drop hammer, the shackle pin came out and the bearing swivel fastened to the shackle fell and struck the worker
347.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pile driving, use accessories free of damage, wear, deformation, and corrosion 
▶ When driving piles or measuring rebound, use correct methods so twisting does not occur in shackles, wire ropes, etc.

348.재해개요: Around February 2021, at the OO new construction site being built by OO Co., Ltd., worker OOO of OO Construction Machinery, which had an equipment lease contract with subcontractor OO Industry Co., Ltd., was engaged in earth-retaining temporary facility work (C.I.P work) when a casing extracted by a pile driver struck the victim's chest, resulting in death.
348.재해유발요인: While inserting a casing for CIP installation using a pile driver, soil and water filled in the extracted casing discharged, causing the casing to sway and strike the victim's chest
348.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access to prevent detachment and falling of heavy objects
▶ Prepare a vehicle-type construction machinery work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan

349.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the ○○ small stream maintenance work site, two victims boarded a 2-ton dump truck, loaded backfill soil at a temporary soil stockyard, moved to the top edge of a retaining wall at the upstream point of the Gojuk small stream, and were raising the cargo bed to backfill the stream bed when the dump truck fell 3.12m to the stream bed below, injuring both victims.
349.재해유발요인: While a dump truck was entering the soil unloading area, the soil at the edge of the unloading area subsided, the truck overturned, and the driver or a nearby worker was crushed
349.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement measures such as assigning spotters and preventing settlement to prevent overturning of vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Always wear protective equipment such as seat belts during dump truck unloading work to prevent emergencies such as vehicle overturning
▶ For soil unloading work, assign spotters and carry out work according to their instructions

422.재해유발요인: While unloading a bundle of steel pipes using a mobile crane, the crane's auxiliary winch wire rope broke and the steel pipes fell onto the worker
422.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly install safety devices (wire rope, etc.) and check their operating condition before starting work 
▶ Install and adjust the over-winding prevention device before work so it operates normally
▶ Conduct thorough periodic safety inspections of the mobile crane
▶ During unloading work, control worker entry so that the load being lifted does not pass over workers' heads

423.재해개요: Around August 2016, on the 2nd floor of the factory building at the OO Center construction site, while the victim was operating a forklift (in reverse), the forklift mast got caught on a horizontal member of the system scaffold; in the process of stepping on the mast post and head guard to dismantle the horizontal member, the victim lost balance and slipped, inadvertently actuating the mast operating lever (tilt lever) at the forklift driver's seat, and was crushed between the mast and the front of the forklift body and died.
423.재해유발요인: While operating (reversing) a forklift, the operator misoperated the tilt lever in the forklift cab and was caught between the cab and the mast
423.위험성감소대책:
▶ When the operator of vehicle-type material handling machinery such as a forklift leaves the operating position, stop the forklift and remove the ignition key to prevent unexpected travel and malfunction
▶ Use vehicle-type material handling machinery only for its main purposes such as transporting, loading, and unloading cargo
▶ For work at height such as system scaffold dismantling, work on a working platform using a mobile scaffold, aerial work platform, etc.

424.재해개요: Around December 2017, while the victim was lifting steel scaffold pipes (4m, 75EA, about 750kg) that had been stacked after scaffold dismantling, using a cargo crane (rated 3.5t), the ground under the outrigger on the right side of the vehicle (the material lifting direction) subsided, and the victim was caught between the overturning vehicle and the adjacently stacked materials (tiles) and died.
424.재해유발요인: After setting the outriggers of the cargo crane on the ground, while hoisting a bundle of steel scaffold pipes, the ground under an outrigger subsided and the worker was caught between the overturning crane and the materials
424.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with a mobile crane, conduct a preliminary inspection of the ground condition of the work location before work
▶ For work with ground subsidence risk, implement subsidence prevention measures by installing pads and cribbing

425.재해개요: Around November 2018, at a neighborhood living facility and housing new construction site built by OO Construction, while a bundle of steel pipes (weighing 347kg) was being unloaded using a truck-mounted mobile crane, the crane's auxiliary winch wire rope (ø10) broke, and the victim, who was passing under the unloading work zone, was struck by the falling bundle of steel pipes and died.
425.재해유발요인: While unloading a bundle of steel pipes using a mobile crane, the crane's auxiliary winch wire rope broke and the steel pipes fell onto the worker
425.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly install safety devices (wire rope, etc.) and check their operating condition before starting work 
▶ Install and adjust the over-winding prevention device before work so it operates normally
▶ Conduct thorough periodic safety inspections of the mobile crane
▶ During unloading work, control worker entry so that the load being lifted does not pass over workers' heads

426.재해개요: Around November 2020, at OO Construction's urban-type residential housing new construction project, the victim, on the 1st floor above ground, was struck by materials that fell (H≒20m) during the lifting work of system scaffold materials and died.
426.재해유발요인: While unloading a bundle of steel pipes using a mobile crane, the crane's auxiliary winch wire rope broke and the steel pipes fell onto the worker
426.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly install safety devices (wire rope, etc.) and check their operating condition before starting work 
▶ Install and adjust the over-winding prevention device before work so it operates normally
▶ Conduct thorough periodic safety inspections of the mobile crane
▶ During unloading work, control worker entry so that the load being lifted does not pass over workers' heads

427.재해개요: Around August 2016, at a bank new construction site, a victim belonging to a subcontractor was transporting mobile frame scaffold members (vertical frames) when he collided with a reversing tire roller and was crushed and died. This was a fatal accident.
427.재해유발요인: With visibility not secured, a nearby worker was run over by a reversing vehicle-type construction machine
427.위험성감소대책:
▶ When the operator leaves the driver's seat of vehicle-type material handling machinery, securely engage the parking brake and install wheel chocks
▶ Before work using vehicle-type construction machinery, inspect the vehicle's braking system for any malfunction in advance
▶ When parking on a slope, use the hand (parking) brake and foot brake together
▶ If vehicle-type material handling machinery rolls down a slope, prohibit recklessly blocking the front of the vehicle by manpower

428.재해개요: At an expressway construction site, in order to relocate the power receiving panel installed at the tunnel entrance to the pedestrian evacuation gallery inside the tunnel, a victim belonging to the tunnel work subcontractor loaded the electrical panel (VCB panel, 1.8m×0.9m×2.7m, W=500kg) and transformer onto a truck-mounted crane, moved them to the pedestrian evacuation gallery inside the tunnel (travel distance L=500m), and unloaded them; then, to move the electrical panel again to its final installation position, a fork attachment was fitted to an excavator, and the moment the panel was lifted, it lost balance and toppled over, crushing the victim who was standing beside it, and he died.
428.재해유발요인: To move an electrical panel, fork attachments were mounted on an excavator; while lifting the panel, it lost balance and toppled over, crushing the victim standing beside it
428.위험성감소대책:
▶ Use work methods and equipment suitable for material transport
▶ When transporting materials, review the securing method and confirm the secured condition before proceeding

429.재해개요: Around August 2020, at a site preparation construction site, while the victim was riding up in a loader bucket to cover the motor on top of the crusher conveyor with a tarpaulin, he was crushed between the end of the conveyor working platform and the loader bucket and died.
429.재해유발요인: While the worker was climbing up riding the loader bucket to cover the drive motor located on top of the crusher conveyor with a waste rubber belt, he slipped and was caught between the conveyor working platform edge and the loader bucket
429.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install a passage allowing workers to move to the upper working platform in sections where maintenance work is frequently performed, such as crusher conveyor drive motors
▶ Prohibit use of vehicle-type construction machinery (loader) for purposes other than intended (such as riding in the bucket)

430.재해개요: Around February 2016, at a church new construction site, while two victims were fabricating slab beam formwork on the 2nd basement level, materials (for formwork fabrication, 1.9 tons) being lifted by tower crane suddenly fell from a height of about 9m above the accident point, striking the victims; one died and one was injured.
430.재해유발요인: While lifting timber for formwork fabrication and other materials with a tower crane, the unsecured load fell.
430.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing hazardous or dangerous machinery and equipment such as tower cranes, use them after obtaining safety certification
▶ During crane work, control worker access in advance to prevent hazards from falling objects
▶ When working with cranes, etc., inspect mechanical conditions such as the reducer before work

431.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO Construction knowledge industry center new construction site, while the victim was moving toward the end of the main jib to prepare for connecting the tower crane lifting hook, the working platform at the front left part of the main jib detached from the jib, and the victim fell together with the platform from a height of about 50m and died.
431.재해유발요인: While working on the jib work platform for tower crane installation, the work platform came off and the worker fell
431.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at the jib end for tower crane installation, check whether the fixing bolts of the jib work platform are engaged
▶ For tower crane installation work with high fall risk, double safety-hook engagement is recommended

432.재해개요: Around April 2016, at an apartment housing construction site, while the victim was lifting materials on the 2nd-level working platform of the cage in preparation for tower crane mast climbing work, the unfixed working platform tilted forward, and the victim lost balance and fell about 10m below and died.
432.재해유발요인: While moving onto the cage platform for tower crane telescoping work, the worker lost balance and fell
432.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct safety training including matters on fall and accident prevention such as safety harness attachment
▶ For tower crane installation work with high fall risk, double safety-hook engagement is recommended
▶ Thoroughly inspect the connection and fixing condition of the telescoping cage working platform

433.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO Construction residential-commercial apartment new construction site, while the victim and two others were lowering the telescopic cage of the tower crane (a preliminary task for tower crane dismantling), the climbing shoe came off the mast hook (presumed) and the cage dropped; the victim, who was working on the cage working platform, fell to the mechanical parking garage floor (H=75m) and died.
433.재해유발요인: During tower crane dismantling work, the climbing shoe came off, the telescopic cage descended, and the worker fell
433.위험성감소대책:
▶ During telescopic lowering work for tower crane dismantling, thoroughly inspect the mounting condition of the climbing shoes and mast hooks
▶ During tower crane installation and dismantling work, verify that the work is performed by qualified personnel

434.재해개요: Around September 2016, at an apartment construction site, while the victim was moving to install the telescoping cage platform of the tower crane, he lost balance and fell about 12M onto the concrete floor below and died.
434.재해유발요인: While moving onto the cage platform for tower crane telescoping work, the worker lost balance and fell
434.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct safety training including matters on fall and accident prevention such as safety harness attachment
▶ For tower crane installation work with high fall risk, double safety-hook engagement is recommended
▶ Thoroughly inspect the connection and fixing condition of the telescoping cage working platform

435.재해개요: Around September 2016, at an apartment housing site built by OO Construction, during tower crane dismantling work, the moment the counter jib was lifted with a mobile crane and the connection between the counter jib and tower head was being dismantled, the counter jib suddenly detached from the tower head and tilted, and the victim who was working was crushed and died.
435.재해유발요인: While dismantling the tower crane's counter jib, the front of the jib lifted and the worker was caught between the jib front and the ladder safety cage
435.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling a tower crane, properly extract the socket pin connecting the counter jib and tower head so the fixing plate does not move, or before removing the socket pin, tie the counter jib and tower head together with a chain block or similar to prevent detachment
▶ When dismantling a tower crane, review appropriate rigging positions to maintain balance of the counter jib

436.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO University dormitory new construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., while the victim was in the site office (container) installed next to the site, the tower crane overturned due to a typhoon, and the victim was crushed under the mast of the overturned tower crane and died.
436.재해유발요인: While waiting in the site office, the worker was crushed by an overturning tower crane
436.위험성감소대책:
▶ When adverse weather conditions such as a typhoon occur, release the tower crane's slewing brake
▶ When adverse weather conditions such as a typhoon are forecast, take measures to distribute the stress on fastening bolts, such as dismantling the mast and installing wire ropes and dedicated support frames

437.재해개요: Around November 2016, at an apartment construction site, during tower crane dismantling work, the victim was in the outdoor unit room of a 12th-floor unit hooking a winch onto a fiber rope that was fixed at the 15th floor and lowered down, in order to dismantle the tower crane bracing, when he fell and died.
437.재해유발요인: For tower crane bracing dismantling work, while climbing over the guardrail from inside the building to hang a winch on a fiber rope, the worker fell
437.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling tower crane bracing, install fall-prevention nets on the floors below the bracing dismantling section to prevent worker falls and falling objects
▶ When working in locations with fall hazards such as the edge of an outdoor unit room in the building, ensure work is performed with the safety harness attached

438.재해개요: Around November 2016, at a residential-commercial new construction site, while the victim was fixing a guardrail on a mast that had been lifted for tower crane mast extension work, the ladder inside the mast detached, and two victims fell to the ground together with the ladder (H≒15m) and died.
438.재해유발요인: During tower crane telescoping work, the ladder installed inside the mast came off and the worker fell to the ground
438.위험성감소대책:
▶ Inspect the condition of connection hardware at the joints between the mast and internal ladder (safety harness anchorage) and review installation drawings
▶ Prohibit use of the mast internal ladder as a safety harness anchorage and install separate safety harness anchorage facilities

439.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the OO dock loading wharf, in order to dismantle a crane (self-weight 2.7ton), the victim hooked a sling belt to an excavator to support the crane, and the moment he removed the last bolt of the mounting base, the center of gravity shifted to one side; as the crane boom direction went down and the post direction came up, the victim's chest was crushed between the enclosure of the crane's operating generator and the lower part of the post, and he died.
439.재해유발요인: While dismantling the tower crane's counter jib, the front of the jib lifted and the worker was caught between the jib front and the ladder safety cage
439.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling a tower crane, properly extract the socket pin connecting the counter jib and tower head so the fixing plate does not move, or before removing the socket pin, tie the counter jib and tower head together with a chain block or similar to prevent detachment
▶ When dismantling a tower crane, review appropriate rigging positions to maintain balance of the counter jib

440.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO Construction new construction site at lot OO, during dismantling of a tower crane (unmanned, 2.9Ton), after the main jib had been dismantled, in order to dismantle the counter jib, lifting lines using a mobile crane (200ton) were attached to the four lifting lugs of the counter jib, and with the tie bars and connecting pins all dismantled, the victim was moving toward the end of the counter jib to install a guide rope when the counter jib tilted vertically, and he fell to the ground (H≒30m) and died.
440.재해유발요인: While dismantling the tower crane's counter jib, the counter jib tilted vertically and the worker moving toward the end fell to the ground
440.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling the counter jib, install rigging on the lifting lugs considering the counter jib's center of gravity, and prohibit removing connection pins when the center of gravity is not balanced
▶ When dismantling the counter jib, prohibit workers from working arbitrarily and perform the work in compliance with the manual, such as installation and dismantling methods according to the tower crane's specifications

441.재해개요: Around May 2017, on a tower crane at an apartment housing new construction site, while five victims were performing tower crane telescoping work, the tower crane mast overturned and the victims fell (H≒50m); three died and two were injured.
441.재해유발요인: During tower crane telescoping work, the mast overturned and the worker fell
441.위험성감소대책:
▶ When manufacturing or replacing major tower crane parts such as auxiliary poles, review whether dimensions, shape, and performance equal to or better than the original manufacturer's are secured
▶ For tower crane installation work with high fall risk, double safety-hook engagement is recommended
