442.재해개요: Around October 2017, at an apartment construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., during tower crane dismantling work, the upper structure of the tower crane collapsed and the victims fell (H≒64m); three died and two were injured.
442.재해유발요인: During dismantling of the tower crane's telescopic cage, the upper structure lost balance and the main shoe came off, causing the tower crane to collapse
442.위험성감소대책:
▶ During telescopic cage lowering work, fully seat the main shoes to the inside of the climbing plates to prevent main shoe detachment
▶ During telescopic cage lowering work, check the main shoe detachment-prevention brackets for deformation and damage
▶ During telescopic cage lowering work, inspect the cage-turntable connection for aging, poor welding, etc.

443.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OO Construction agricultural and fishery products distribution center new construction site, while seven victims were performing telescoping (climbing) work on the 14th mast section of a tower crane (40 tons), the tower crane jib lost balance and the upper structure above the 11th mast section toppled over; three died and four were injured.
443.재해유발요인: During tower crane telescoping work, the jib lost balance and the mast upper structure overturned, causing a fall
443.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with the manual for installation and assembly methods according to the tower crane's specifications and conduct related training
▶ During tower crane telescoping work, thoroughly engage the slider cross locking device

444.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OO Construction apartment housing new construction site, while five victims were raising the telescopic cage of a tower crane (14 tons, L-type), the support shoe came off and the raised telescopic cage dropped 3m; the impact damaged the working platform and guardrail attached to the telescopic cage, and one person on the working platform fell about 70m and died, while four were injured.
444.재해유발요인: During tower crane dismantling work, the climbing shoe came off, the telescopic cage descended, and the worker fell
444.위험성감소대책:
▶ During telescopic lowering work for tower crane dismantling, thoroughly inspect the mounting condition of the climbing shoes and mast hooks
▶ During tower crane installation and dismantling work, verify that the work is performed by qualified personnel

445.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OO factory gantry crane electrical repair and renovation work site, in order to replace the aged electrical equipment of a gantry crane (20 tons), the victim climbed onto the gantry crane installed in the outdoor work area and, sitting with a coworker on the girder (width 50cm) arranging the traversing trolley wire rail, lost balance and toppled backward, falling about 11m to the ground below and died.
445.재해유발요인: While moving onto the cage platform for tower crane telescoping work, the worker lost balance and fell
445.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct safety training including matters on fall and accident prevention such as safety harness attachment
▶ For tower crane installation work with high fall risk, double safety-hook engagement is recommended
▶ Thoroughly inspect the connection and fixing condition of the telescoping cage working platform

446.재해개요: Around January 2019, at the company building new construction site built by OO Construction, while the victim was performing tower operation work at the vertical ladder position inside the mast for tower crane climbing (telescoping), during the retraction of the cage hydraulic cylinder, the shoe support (bearing support) came off the mast toward the victim, striking him, and he died.
446.재해유발요인: While operating the remote control for tower crane telescoping from the ladder position inside the mast, the shoe support came off and struck the victim
446.위험성감소대책:
▶ During tower crane telescoping work, apply the manufacturer's method as a priority over visual adjustment as the means of maintaining balance
▶ During tower crane telescoping work, reinforce with shoe support claws of a structure similar to the seating form of the hydraulic cylinder and mast to prevent shoe support detachment
▶ Install an anemometer on the tower crane and frequently check external wind speed
▶ Verify qualification requirements such as workers' licenses during tower crane installation, use, and dismantling

447.재해개요: Around January 2020, at the company building and research institute new construction site being built by OO Construction, while the main jib was being lifted with a mobile crane (330 tons) for tower crane dismantling work, the upper structure above the turntable collapsed under the weight of the counterweight (about 8.5 tons), and three victims working on top fell to the 1st floor above ground (about 40m); two died, and one, left hanging from the structure by his safety harness, was injured.
447.재해유발요인: During tower crane dismantling work, the structure above the turntable collapsed and the worker fell
447.위험성감소대책:
▶During tower crane dismantling work, dismantle the counterweight first, then perform main jib dismantling work
▶During tower crane dismantling work, inspect the secure bolt fastening condition of connections between members

448.재해개요: Around June 2020, at a national rental housing construction site, while the victim was installing the working platform of a tower crane telescoping cage, the working platform flipped over and he fell about 22m and died.
448.재해유발요인: While raising the front frame of a luffing tower crane's tower head with a mobile crane to connect it to the rear frame of the tower head, the fiber rope connecting the tower head front frame and the mobile crane broke, and the worker was crushed by the falling tower head front frame
448.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting materials, use an appropriate rigging method suited to the material and shape of the lifted object
▶ For work with fall risk, implement fall prevention measures such as fall-prevention nets and working platforms
▶ Establish an appropriate signal system between workers and the operator

449.재해개요: Around March 2021, within a knowledge industry center new construction site, during the 7th mast climbing operation of a newly installed tower crane, the upper structure of the tower crane (operator's cab, main jib, counter jib, etc.) collapsed; one victim fell from the operator's cab (H≒43m) and died, and one victim engaged in the installation was injured.
449.재해유발요인: During the 7th mast climbing operation of the tower crane, the tower crane upper structure (cab, main jib, counter jib, etc.) collapsed and the operator riding in the cab fell together with it
449.위험성감소대책:
▶ During tower crane telescoping work, check the fixing condition of the support shoes and lugs and whether safety pins are engaged
▶ Verify that workers have been trained in and are familiar with installation and assembly methods according to the specifications of the tower crane in use on site
▶ Implement fall hazard prevention measures such as checking workers' safety harness wearing and attachment status

450.재해개요: Around June 2021, at an apartment construction site built by OO Construction, during the work of lifting the front frame of the tower head (weighing about 2.8ton) of a luffing-type tower crane from the ground with a mobile crane (51ton) to connect it to the rear frame of the tower head, the fiber rope connecting the tower head front frame and the mobile crane broke, and the victim was crushed under the falling tower head front frame and died.
450.재해유발요인: While raising the front frame of a luffing tower crane's tower head with a mobile crane to connect it to the rear frame of the tower head, the fiber rope connecting the tower head front frame and the mobile crane broke, and the worker was crushed by the falling tower head front frame
450.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting materials, use an appropriate rigging method suited to the material and shape of the lifted object
▶ For work with fall risk, implement fall prevention measures such as fall-prevention nets and working platforms
▶ Establish an appropriate signal system between workers and the operator

451.재해개요: Around June 2021, at an officetel new construction site being built by OO Construction, while the victim was dismantling the wall bracing of a tower crane (luffing type), he fell to the 1st floor (H≒20m) ground and died.
451.재해유발요인: The victim, from a tower crane dismantling company, fell to the ground-level first floor while dismantling the wall bracing of a (luffing) tower crane
451.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling tower crane bracing, install fall-prevention nets on the floors below the bracing dismantling section to prevent worker falls and falling objects
▶ When working in locations with fall hazards such as building edges, ensure work is performed with the safety harness attached

452.재해개요: Around August 2021, at a housing redevelopment improvement project site, after installing the tower crane cat head, the victim dismantled the mobile crane rigging and was climbing down a ladder when he slipped at the end of the ladder and fell about 21m to the concrete ground below and died.
452.재해유발요인: After installing the tower crane cat head, having released the mobile crane rigging, while climbing down the access ladder, the worker slipped at the end of the ladder and fell
452.위험성감소대책:
▶ For tower crane installation work with high fall risk, double safety-hook engagement is recommended
▶ During tower crane installation and dismantling work, verify that the work is performed by qualified personnel

453.재해개요: Around January 2016, at a dust collection equipment installation work site inside the OO factory, while the victim was extending the auxiliary boom of a mobile crane, he was loosening the side connecting pin without the connecting pin between the main boom end and the auxiliary boom fastened, and fell together with the auxiliary boom 3m onto the concrete floor below and died.
453.재해유발요인: During auxiliary boom extension, the side connecting pin was released while the connecting pins were not fastened, causing the auxiliary boom to fall
453.위험성감소대책:
▶ When extending the auxiliary boom, thoroughly engage the connection pins between the main boom end and auxiliary boom
▶ Conduct special safety and health training before work and comply with performing work after deploying a supervisor

454.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO Construction combined heat and power plant construction site, during unloading work of desulfurization equipment materials, the turntable bolts of the mobile crane broke, and victim 1 was crushed under the overturning boom and died, while victim 2 (the operator) was injured.
454.재해유발요인: After hoisting a utility pole with a mobile crane, during loading, the boom broke and fell, striking the worker
454.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy loads, establish worker exclusion zones in locations at risk of falling objects
▶ Immediately stop work when cracks or similar caused by repeated loads are identified by visual inspection before work
▶ Conduct thorough periodic safety inspections of the mobile crane

455.재해개요: Around April 2019, at the OO workplace, during assembly work of a mobile crane (700-ton hydraulic luffing jib crane) for pre-shipment inspection, before the operation of lifting a crane member [luffing fly jib], the jib raising operation was carried out without removing the fixing pin that should have been dismantled; the moment the lug to which the pin was fastened could not withstand the load and broke, the jib dropped, and the victim, who was performing assembly work on top of the crane member, fell about 2.25m to the ground below due to the impact and vibration of the falling jib and died.
455.재해유발요인: During assembly work for pre-delivery inspection of a mobile crane, a lug fractured, the jib fell, and the worker consequently fell
455.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with fall hazards, implement safety protection measures such as installing fall-protection nets, guardrails, and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ When assembling a mobile crane, work in accordance with the assembly manual

456.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the OO building construction site built by OO, while material lifting work was being performed with a mobile tower crane, the ground under the outrigger supporting the crane subsided and the equipment overturned; in the process of it striking the ground, the operator was thrown out, and the victim, who was observing as a trainee behind the driver's seat inside the cab, was crushed and died.
456.재해유발요인: While performing material hoisting work with a mobile tower crane, the ground under the outrigger supporting the crane subsided and the equipment overturned
456.위험성감소대책:
▶ When setting up a mobile crane, inspect and confirm the ground condition of the work location before starting work in accordance with equipment precautions
▶ If the ground condition is poor, install support timbers, steel plates, etc. to secure sufficient bearing capacity before starting work

457.재해개요: Around October 2019, within the OO Construction workplace, while the victim was detaching the counterweight (weight=4.87ton) installed at the rear of the operator's cab for the rental of a crawler crane (80ton), the counterweight slipped and fell (height≒2m), striking the victim, who died.
457.재해유발요인: While detaching (dismantling) the counterweight installed behind the crawler crane cab, the counterweight slipped and fell, striking the worker
457.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing work such as lifting heavy loads, prepare a heavy-load handling work plan and proceed with work according to the plan
▶ When dismantling heavy loads, establish worker exclusion zones in locations at risk of falling objects

458.재해개요: Around December 2019, at OO Construction's recycling center treatment facility installation work site, while the victim was dismantling the electric wires of the overwinding prevention device installed on the auxiliary boom in order to remove a 55-ton crane (crawler crane) from the site, a coworker working nearby dismantled the wire rope fixed to the main boom, whereupon the auxiliary boom support toppled toward the victim, striking his head and other parts, and he died.
458.재해유발요인: While dismantling the wiring of the over-winding prevention device installed on the auxiliary boom, after releasing the rope fixed to the main boom, the auxiliary boom support toppled over and struck the victim's head
458.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling vehicle-type construction machinery, conduct a preliminary survey of the equipment specifications, dismantling manual, etc., then establish a dismantling plan including dismantling methods and sequence
▶ For hazardous work such as crane dismantling, implement measures prohibiting worker access within the working radius, and establish a signal system among workers, the operator, and the signalman

459.재해개요: Around July 2020, at a T.T.P fabrication site for breakwater repair and reinforcement, after performing wire rope rigging work, the victim was evacuating when he was crushed between a T.T.P being lifted by crane and a T.T.P placed on the ground and died.
459.재해유발요인: After completing wire rope rigging work, while the worker was moving to another area, the crane operator did not see the worker, and the worker was caught between the T.T.P (tetrapod) being hoisted and a previously placed T.T.P (tetrapod)
459.위험성감소대책:
▶ When workers perform tasks close to equipment, deploy a spotter so that work proceeds in a safe condition
▶ When using construction machinery in locations with possible equipment contact and a high likelihood of blind spots, prohibit worker entry and deploy a spotter
▶ When performing work such as lifting heavy loads, prepare a heavy-load handling work plan and proceed with work according to the plan

460.재해개요: Around July 2020, at a sports complex facility new construction site, the victim stepped on the outrigger of a cargo crane to climb onto the cargo bed, when the outrigger retracted, and the victim's left leg was caught between the outrigger and the cargo bed, and he died.
460.재해유발요인: While the worker attempted to climb onto the cargo bed stepping on the cargo crane outrigger, the outrigger retracted and the worker's left leg was caught between the outrigger and the cargo bed
460.위험성감소대책:
▶ When climbing onto the cargo bed for unloading or similar work, use an access ladder
▶ Prohibit approach near operating equipment and moving parts

461.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO site, on the 3rd basement level, while the victim was directly operating a forklift (2.98ton) and working with a wooden pallet to organize ready-mixed mortar materials for masonry, his face was crushed between the forklift and a jack support* (H=3.0m, Ф=140mm), and he died.
461.재해유발요인: While transporting materials using a forklift, with visibility not secured, the worker was caught between the materials and the forklift
461.위험성감소대책:
▶ Deploy a spotter to guide vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Implement contact prevention measures against equipment such as installing rear cameras
▶ Secure forward visibility when loading cargo on forklift forks

462.재해개요: Around July 2016, at the OO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was watching forklift towing work near the accident point when he was struck by the overturning forklift and died.
462.재해유발요인: While towing a forklift using a concrete pump truck, the victim watching the towing work was struck by the overturning forklift
462.위험성감소대책:
▶ Restrict use other than the main purpose (arrange for a dedicated tow truck to tow the forklift)
▶ During hazardous work, prohibit all workers, including nearby managers, from approaching within the working radius

463.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OO new construction site, while the victim was crossing the temporary road (width: 8m) on the south side of building 119 to attend the afternoon T.B.M (Tool Box Meeting), he was run over by the right wheel of a forklift (8ton) in operation and died.
463.재해유발요인: Construction machinery (excavator, forklift) operating within the site failed to notice the victim moving about and collided with him
463.위험성감소대책:
▶ Deploy a spotter to guide vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Implement contact prevention measures against equipment such as installing rear cameras
▶ Install a safe passage for workers to move separately from vehicle-type construction machinery travel routes

464.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the storage yard behind the OO office, the victim was helping a coworker replace the rear wheel of a dump truck, with an air compressor operating for the dump truck maintenance, when the rear section of the air receiver tank, which had been overpressurized, ruptured; the compressed air struck the adjacent cargo bed, and a tool box loaded on the cargo bed flew off and struck the victim, who died.
464.재해유발요인: During dump truck maintenance, while replacing the truck's rear wheel using an air compressor, the air compressor burst, striking the nearby cargo bed, and a toolbox on the bed flew off and struck the victim
464.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install a pressure relief device (safety valve) on the air compressor
▶ Prohibit access within the hazardous work radius

465.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO hotel new construction site, while waste was being transported by forklift from the 3rd basement level to the ground, the operator failed to notice the victim, who was performing duct insulation work in the ramp section of the 2nd basement level, and the victim was struck by the forklift forks and died.
465.재해유발요인: While transporting waste from the basement to the ground, the operator failed to notice the victim performing duct insulation work on the basement level while driving and struck the victim with the forklift forks
465.위험성감소대책:
▶ Deploy a spotter to guide vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Secure forward visibility when loading cargo on forklift forks

466.재해개요: Around October 2017, on the levee access road (farm road) within a local river improvement project site, a victim belonging to a subcontractor was controlling the entry of general vehicles along the travel route of dump trucks when he was run over by a reversing dump truck and died.
466.재해유발요인: While the worker was controlling the entry of general vehicles on the dump truck's travel route, he was struck by a reversing dump truck
466.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control workers or deploy a spotter when using vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Implement contact prevention measures against equipment such as installing rear cameras

467.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO development and access road construction site, a victim belonging to OO, the turf planting contractor, was riding a small dump truck (1 ton) along the management road (asphalt concrete pavement, width 2.8m, downhill grade about 22%) to move to the work zone, when the vehicle left the road and plunged down a slope about 15m below, and he died.
467.재해유발요인: While multiple workers rode divided between the dump truck cab and the external cargo bed moving within the site, the vehicle veered off a steep sloped road and fell down the slope
467.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prohibit riding on vehicle-type construction machinery anywhere other than the operator's seat

468.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO development construction site, the victim was operating an excavator and returning to land after relocating the anchor of a dredger, when the excavator overturned into a previously dredged section and became submerged in water (h≒4m), and he drowned.
468.재해유발요인: Within the reclamation site, an excavator moving from the sea in the dredging area to land overturned and was submerged in the water, resulting in drowning
468.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan when using vehicle-type material handling machinery
▶ Deploy a spotter and move to locations free of scouring, etc.
▶ Implement overturning prevention measures such as access-prohibited signs in sections with overturning hazard factors

469.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO equipment depot, during the dismantling of a crawler crane (320 tons), the victim, who was signaling from the luffing mast of the crawler crane being dismantled, died when the luffing mast being lifted by the crawler crane used for dismantling work (80 tons) suddenly dropped.
469.재해유발요인: During dismantling work of a crawler crane (320t), a luffing mast being hoisted by the dismantling crane (80t) fell due to crane misoperation, and the worker was caught between the luffing masts
469.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan when using vehicle-type material handling machinery
▶ Verify the qualifications of construction machinery operators

470.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OO apartment housing construction site, while the victim was performing snow removal work on top of the underground parking lot, he was run over by the wheels of a reversing excavator and died.
470.재해유발요인: Construction machinery (excavator, forklift) operating within the site failed to notice the victim moving about and collided with him
470.위험성감소대책:
▶ Deploy a spotter to guide vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Implement contact prevention measures against equipment such as installing rear cameras
▶ Install a safe passage for workers to move separately from vehicle-type construction machinery travel routes

471.재해개요: Around June 2018, within the OO crane depot, while the victim was operating a mobile crane (176 ton) to lift a counterweight (24 ton) loaded on a trailer bed, the mobile crane overturned; the operator's cab was wedged onto the top of the trailer bed, and the victim inside the cab was crushed and died.
471.재해유발요인: While hoisting a counterweight on a trailer bed using a mobile crane, the mobile crane overturned, the cab was wedged onto the top of the trailer bed, and the worker inside the cab was crushed
471.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan when using vehicle-type material handling machinery
▶ Review the allowable lifting load during mobile crane lifting work

472.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OO improvement project construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., while the victim was inspecting the underside of the cargo bed of a farm transport vehicle with the bed raised, the bed, on which no safety prop (support) had been installed, descended unexpectedly, and the victim was caught between the vehicle body and the cargo bed and died.
472.재해유발요인: With the cargo bed of a power tiller truck raised, while inspecting under the bed, the bed, which had no safety prop installed, suddenly descended and the worker was caught between the chassis and the bed
472.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement safety measures during inspection and repair work of vehicle-type material handling machinery
▶ When workers work in unusual locations such as mountainous terrain, conduct a safety inspection before work

473.재해개요: Around July 2019, at the OO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., during the work of removing waste from the inner floor of a landscaping retaining wall (concrete) to the outside using an excavator, the victim lost consciousness and collapsed at the retaining wall adjacent to the excavator, and died.
473.재해유발요인: While removing waste to the outside using an excavator, the worker was crushed between the excavator and a retaining wall
473.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker entry into the work area when using vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Deploy a spotter to guide vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Implement contact prevention measures against equipment such as installing rear cameras

474.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the OO new construction site, the victim inserted a pallet onto the forklift forks, climbed on top of it, and with the mast raised (height about 4m), was fitting plastic protective caps onto the wires fixing the glass greenhouse ceiling screen, when he lost balance and fell from a height of about 4m and died.
474.재해유발요인: While working on wires for fixing a ceiling screen on top of forklift forks, the victim lost balance and fell to the floor
474.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prohibit workers from riding on any position of a forklift other than the operator's seat

475.재해개요: Around October 2019, at the OO new construction site, during the installation work of a 470-ton mobile crane, the end of the jib, which was at a height of 2.5 meters above ground, fell to the ground, striking two workers who were performing jib extension work on the jib, resulting in injuries requiring more than 3 months of medical care.
475.재해유발요인: During mobile crane installation work, the tip of the jib fell to the ground, striking a worker who was performing jib extension work on top of the jib
475.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly check the equipment for fractures, etc. through daily inspection of the mobile crane
▶ Control entry of workers other than those engaged in the work

476.재해개요: Around January 2020, a victim belonging to the OO environmental improvement project parked a 1-ton truck and, the moment he got out of the vehicle, the vehicle began moving forward down the sloped road; while attempting actions such as grabbing the steering wheel to stop the vehicle, he fell over and was run over by the advancing vehicle and died.
476.재해유발요인: When a parked vehicle (1-ton truck) started moving forward on a sloped road, the victim grabbed the steering wheel to stop it, fell over, and was crushed under the vehicle
476.위험성감소대책:
▶ Apply the brake or install wheel chocks when leaving the operating position
▶ When stopping on a sloped road surface, securely immobilize the vehicle before leaving

477.재해개요: Around June 2020, at the OO construction site, the victim went under a crawler crane (150ton) boom that had been lowered horizontally to the ground to adjust the boom length and was removing a fixing pin when the boom descended, crushing the victim, who died.
477.재해유발요인: While removing fixing bolts after entering under a boom that had been lowered horizontally to adjust the crawler crane boom length, the boom descended and crushed the worker
477.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety supports or safety blocks during crawler crane dismantling work
▶ Establish signal methods for crawler crane work and signal to the operator and workers

478.재해개요: Around July 2020, at the OO new construction site, the victim was operating a forklift on a ramp, lifting a hoisting box to dispose of waste, and while reversing and turning, the forklift overturned and the victim was crushed and died.
478.재해유발요인: While reversing and turning with a lifting container raised to carry out waste, the forklift overturned and crushed the victim
478.위험성감소대책:
▶ When loading heavy loads, load considering the position of the center of gravity so the load does not lean to one side
▶ When using vehicle-type material handling machinery, the operator shall wear a seat belt and personal protective equipment

479.재해개요: Around September 2020, during detailed design of the OO relocation work, for a geological survey, the victim was transporting materials with a transport vehicle (a modified form combining a cultivator engine and a combine transmission), when, on a slope (11°), due to an operating error or the like, the transport vehicle moved backward, and the victim was crushed under the transport vehicle and died.
479.재해유발요인: A transport vehicle (modified vehicle) carrying materials on a sloped road reversed due to unskilled driving, and the victim who was nearby was crushed under the transport vehicle
479.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prepare and comply with a safe operation manual for vehicle-type construction machinery

480.재해개요: Around October 2020, at the OO construction site, the victim went under the connection section for crawler crane (200ton) boom extension; of the total four connecting pins (upper and lower), he first removed one lower connecting pin, and the moment he removed the remaining lower connecting pin, the connection section buckled downward and descended, crushing the victim below, who died.
480.재해유발요인: While removing the top boom connecting pins for crawler crane boom extension, the moment one lower connecting pin was removed, the connection bent downward and descended, crushing the worker below
480.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety supports or safety blocks during crawler crane dismantling work
▶ Establish signal methods for crawler crane work and signal to the operator and workers

481.재해개요: Around November 2020, at the OO road construction site, the victim was directing traffic on a closed road (2 lanes, lanes 2-3) for the smooth passage of general vehicles in operation, for the construction of a road soundproof wall, when he was struck by a dump truck of unknown origin entering lanes 2 and 3 from lane 4 and died.
481.재해유발요인: While directing traffic for smooth passage during road soundproof wall construction, the victim was struck by a dump truck
481.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan when using vehicle-type material handling machinery
▶ Install a sturdy and sufficiently sized barrier or protective block around the traffic signalman

482.재해개요: In a steeply inclined tunnel (grade 12.5%), the victim, the driver of the dump truck involved in the accident, overtook a coworker's dump truck ahead of him at high speed with hazard lights on and drove down; due to a mechanical defect in the vehicle's brakes, without any trace of attempting to stop (skid marks), it collided with a dump truck coming up the inclined tunnel, and he died.
482.재해유발요인: Due to a mechanical defect of the vehicle (brake malfunction), it failed to stop and collided with the vehicle ahead
482.위험성감소대책: ▶ Conduct systematic inspection and maintenance such as periodic inspections of vehicle-type construction machinery

483.재해개요: Around March 2016, at the auxiliary material (slag conditioner) dumping work area inside OO Steel, in order to perform auxiliary material dumping work, the victim climbed onto the top of the vehicle cargo bed and was removing the packing cover when he lost balance and fell to the ground (H≒3.2m) and died.
483.재해유발요인: While removing the tarpaulin cover on top of a vehicle cargo bed, the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
483.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work handling heavy objects such as packaging covers, work in teams of two
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

484.재해개요: Around May 2016, at the obstruction demolition work site (section 2) of a residential environment improvement project, while the victim was installing a temporary dustproof net (length 68m × height 10m) for the demolition of obstruction houses in zone 17, the brakes of a water spray truck (12ton) parked adjacent released, and it collided with him, and he died.
484.재해유발요인: Due to defective brakes on a parked vehicle, the vehicle moved and collided with the victim
484.위험성감소대책:
▶ When leaving the driver's seat after stopping or parking construction vehicles such as water trucks on a slope, take measures to prevent sudden vehicle movement, such as applying the hand and air brakes and installing wheel chocks
▶ When construction vehicles such as water trucks enter the site, inspect the vehicle for aging, brake operation, etc. before allowing entry

485.재해개요: Around August 2016, three workers belonging to the OO association finished weeding work and were traveling by vehicle to another site via a temporary road, when the 1-ton truck carrying the workers rolled down a 100m slope beside the road (presumed careless driving); the driver was injured, and the two passengers died.
485.재해유발요인: A truck moving to another site via a temporary road rolled down a slope due to the driver's carelessness
485.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prepare and comply with a safe operation manual for vehicle-type construction machinery

486.재해개요: Around December 2016, on the front lot of building O within the OO urban-type residential housing new construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a dump truck belonging to OO Civil Engineering Co., Ltd. was reversing and failed to notice the victim, who was moving about for site completion cleaning and surrounding tidying work, and collided with him, and he died.
486.재해유발요인: While controlling general vehicles during road work such as paving and maintenance, the victim was struck by a moving vehicle
486.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement traffic control measures in road maintenance work sections
▶ Install safety fences around the work area and no-jaywalking signs, etc.
▶ Secure sufficient safety distance from the work space when closing lanes

487.재해개요: Around June 2017, at the repair work site for one bridge in the OO area built by OO Co., Ltd., after completing the replacement of the expansion joint of the OO bridge, the victim was collecting the lane-closure rubber cones (at 5m intervals) installed over about 85m on the bridge deck, when he was run over by a reversing 1-ton truck (a vehicle for traffic control and equipment transport) and died.
487.재해유발요인: While controlling general vehicles during road work such as paving and maintenance, the victim was struck by a moving vehicle
487.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement traffic control measures in road maintenance work sections
▶ Install safety fences around the work area and no-jaywalking signs, etc.
▶ Secure sufficient safety distance from the work space when closing lanes

488.재해개요: Around June 2017, at the OO paved road repair work site, the victim was replacing a temporary lane marker that had come off in a section where road paving had been completed, when he was struck by a passing general vehicle (passenger car) and died.
488.재해유발요인: While controlling general vehicles during road work such as paving and maintenance, the victim was struck by a moving vehicle
488.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement traffic control measures in road maintenance work sections
▶ Install safety fences around the work area and no-jaywalking signs, etc.
▶ Secure sufficient safety distance from the work space when closing lanes

489.재해개요: Around July 2017, at the OO site at OO wharf, the victim hung about 10 empty sacks (90*90*110) on the boom hook of a backhoe (06W) and was moving to the storage yard, when the backhoe operator, whose forward view was blocked by the sacks, failed to see the victim walking along the port road and ran over him, and he died.
489.재해유발요인: While moving with numerous empty sacks hung on the excavator boom hook, the sacks blocked the forward view, and the excavator failed to see the victim walking and collided with him
489.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan for vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Secure forward visibility when loading cargo using the excavator boom

490.재해개요: Around October 2017, within the OO construction site, the victim was performing train operation monitoring duty for weeding work around the tracks; when a freight train approached in the up-track direction, he was instructing a coworker moving on the tracks to evacuate when he was struck by a train running in the down-track direction and died.
490.재해유발요인: While crossing the tracks during train operation monitoring duty, the victim was struck by an operating train
490.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a system to share train operation information for the work section and give advance notice when trains approach
▶ Have the train operation safety manager install and carry a train approach warning app

491.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO improvement construction site, the victim was dismantling the bolts of the steel plate (sole plate) installed at the position in contact with the bridge bearing at the OO bridge pier (point P2 NO.1), when, needing materials (timber) to support the steel plate (sole plate), he was crossing the expressway (pier P1 → pier P2) and collided with a vehicle entering the expressway interchange and died.
491.재해유발요인: While controlling general vehicles during road work such as paving and maintenance, the victim was struck by a moving vehicle
491.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement traffic control measures in road maintenance work sections
▶ Install safety fences around the work area and no-jaywalking signs, etc.
▶ Secure sufficient safety distance from the work space when closing lanes

492.재해개요: Around May 2018, at the neighborhood living facility and knowledge industry center new construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was performing waste material tidying work (formwork connecting pins, etc.) and cleaning work on the 1st basement level and the parking lot ramp, when a forklift that was attempting to move materials in reverse on the parking lot ramp slope slid and rolled down, colliding with the victim, and he died.
492.재해유발요인: While organizing waste materials, a forklift attempting to move materials in reverse on a ramp slipped and rolled down, colliding with the victim
492.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan when using vehicle-type material handling machinery
▶ Verify the qualifications of construction machinery operators

493.재해개요: Around December 2018, the victim finished bus stop sign reinforcement work and was moving to a vehicle parked nearby when he collided with a general vehicle (passenger car) traveling in the direction of OO and died.
493.재해유발요인: While controlling general vehicles during road work such as paving and maintenance, the victim was struck by a moving vehicle
493.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement traffic control measures in road maintenance work sections
▶ Install safety fences around the work area and no-jaywalking signs, etc.
▶ Secure sufficient safety distance from the work space when closing lanes

494.재해개요: Around December 2019, at the OO soundproof facility installation work site, in order to determine the ground condition by driving in an H-beam, the victim was holding the H-beam when the breaker (about 800kg) fixed to the excavator boom fell; as the victim tried to dodge it, he lost balance, and was pierced between his left lower back and side by remaining rebar of an existing structure on the ground, and died.
494.재해유발요인: At a soundproofing facility installation site, when the breaker fixed to the excavator boom fell, the victim tried to avoid it, lost balance, and was punctured in the waist and side by residual rebar of the existing structure
494.위험성감소대책:
▶ Engage the retaining pin fixing the breaker to the excavator connecting device
▶ Control worker entry when there is a risk of falling objects

495.재해개요: Around February 2020, at the OO knowledge industry center construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a safety watchman belonging to a subcontractor was on a safety patrol when he was run over by the wheels of a dump truck reversing for soil removal and died.
495.재해유발요인: While controlling general vehicles during road work such as paving and maintenance, the victim was struck by a moving vehicle
495.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement traffic control measures in road maintenance work sections
▶ Install safety fences around the work area and no-jaywalking signs, etc.
▶ Secure sufficient safety distance from the work space when closing lanes

496.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the OO improvement construction site, the victim was cleaning the road around the loading of road debris and the excavation work when he was run over by the wheels of a reversing excavator and died.
496.재해유발요인: While cleaning around the excavation work area, the victim was crushed under the wheels of a reversing excavator
496.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan for vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Control worker entry and deploy a spotter in locations at risk of collision with the excavator

497.재해개요: Around June 2020, at the national highway route OO soundproof wall construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to the lane-marking subcontractor had finished lane-marking work and was walking along the lane rolling a distance measuring wheel to check the work quantity, when he was run over by a sign car (work protection vehicle) reversing behind him and died.
497.재해유발요인: While controlling general vehicles during road work such as paving and maintenance, the victim was struck by a moving vehicle
497.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement traffic control measures in road maintenance work sections
▶ Install safety fences around the work area and no-jaywalking signs, etc.
▶ Secure sufficient safety distance from the work space when closing lanes

498.재해개요: Around June 2020, the victim parked a TMA vehicle (a vehicle fitted with an impact attenuator) in lane 1 of an expressway for a field survey of expressway maintenance work and was performing traffic blocking and guidance, when an SUV traveling at high speed in lane 1 rear-ended the TMA vehicle, and the struck TMA vehicle ran over the victim, who died.
498.재해유발요인: While controlling general vehicles during road work such as paving and maintenance, the victim was struck by a moving vehicle
498.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement traffic control measures in road maintenance work sections
▶ Install safety fences around the work area and no-jaywalking signs, etc.
▶ Secure sufficient safety distance from the work space when closing lanes

499.재해개요: Around August 2020, at the "2020 OO pavement joint replacement" work site, a victim belonging to OO Construction Ltd. was riding in the cargo bed of a high-pressure washing truck (1TON truck) traveling at 20km/h, when the hat the victim was wearing was blown off by the wind and fell; the victim fell from the high-pressure washing truck (1TON truck), and the back of his head struck the concrete floor, and he died.
499.재해유발요인: While riding on the cargo bed of a high-pressure washing truck, the victim reached for his hat and fell from the truck
499.위험성감소대책:
▶ Restrict workers from riding in the cargo bed of trucks
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

500.재해개요: Around August 2020, during routine trackside grass-cutting work, the victim, who was performing train operation monitoring duty, was crossing the tracks when he was struck by a locomotive proceeding in long-hood-forward operation and died.
500.재해유발요인: While crossing the tracks during train operation monitoring duty, the victim was struck by an operating train
500.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a system to share train operation information for the work section and give advance notice when trains approach
▶ Have the train operation safety manager install and carry a train approach warning app

501.재해개요: Around October 2020, at the OO facility site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was performing the work of transporting fly ash discharged from the incinerator (2 ton bags, about 0.4 tons) out of the site using a forklift; in the process of loading the ton bags containing the fly ash onto the waste removal vehicle (roll-off box), the forklift overturned, and he was crushed against the side of the forklift and died.
501.재해유발요인: In the process of loading materials onto a waste removal vehicle using a forklift for carrying out materials, the forklift overturned and the operator was caught
501.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan when using vehicle-type material handling machinery
▶ Verify the qualifications of construction machinery operators

502.재해개요: Around April 2021, at the OO Logistics Co., Ltd. work area within the OO wharf, the victim was performing the work of stuffing cargo (coils) into containers and was moving within the work area when he was struck by an exiting vehicle (25 tons, trailer) and died.
502.재해유발요인: While controlling general vehicles during road work such as paving and maintenance, the victim was struck by a moving vehicle
502.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement traffic control measures in road maintenance work sections
▶ Install safety fences around the work area and no-jaywalking signs, etc.
▶ Secure sufficient safety distance from the work space when closing lanes

503.재해개요: Around May 2021, at a complex cultural center new construction site, the victim was working on top of the 4th tier of earth-retaining shoring struts, fixing the discharge hose of an underground water pump, when, due to the shaking of the hose during discharge and the like, he lost balance and fell about 6.0m to the concrete floor of the 3rd basement level below and died.
503.재해유발요인: While working on top of a strut beam without wearing a safety harness, the victim lost balance and fell
503.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement fall prevention measures such as safety nets or safety harness use in locations with fall hazards
▶ Provide personal protective equipment such as safety helmets and safety harnesses and supervise wearing
▶ Install barriers, etc. to prevent unauthorized worker entry into fall hazard locations

504.재해개요: Around September 2021, at the OOO apartment construction site, a victim belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd., the incidental civil works subcontractor, was cleaning the catch basin of a circular waterway pipe within the complex, when he was run over by a truck that had finished unloading shrubs and was moving forward, and he died.
504.재해유발요인: A transport vehicle (modified vehicle) carrying materials on a sloped road reversed due to unskilled driving, and the victim who was nearby was crushed under the transport vehicle
504.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prepare and comply with a safe operation manual for vehicle-type construction machinery

505.재해개요: At the ○○ ready-mixed concrete plant, the victim parked a loader at the top of a ramp and was pouring coolant into the radiator at the rear of the equipment, when the loader rolled down the ramp (L≒23m) and the victim was run over by the right rear wheel and died.
505.재해유발요인: A loader parked on a ramp rolled down, crushing the victim who was filling coolant
505.위험성감소대책: ▶ When the operator leaves the driver's seat of vehicle-type material handling machinery, securely engage the parking brake and install wheel chocks

506.재해개요: Around March 2016, at the OO new construction site, in the process of transporting a table form (3.3m × 1.8m, H ≒ 3.0m, about 400kgf) with a forklift and unloading it on the floor for beam formwork assembly, the table form carried on the forklift forks tilted and toppled over while being unloaded, striking another table form already installed on the floor; the struck table form fell onto the victim, who was doing formwork, and the victim was crushed under the table form and died.
506.재해유발요인: With worker access to the hazardous area uncontrolled, a table form being unloaded on forklift forks for beam formwork assembly tilted and toppled, striking a table form previously installed on the floor, which toppled and crushed the worker
506.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy loads such as table forms, secure them to lifting and unloading equipment using belts, etc. before work
▶ When lifting heavy loads, identify the maximum load capacity and maximum fork spacing of the vehicle-type material handling machinery and work with suitable equipment
▶ When working with construction equipment such as forklifts, control worker entry into collision hazard locations

507.재해개요: Around January 2017, at the OO Construction neighborhood living facility new construction site, while a tower jib crane (maximum rated load 2.9 tons) was being used to transport a bundle of euro forms (1,418kg) stacked on the elevator pit working platform on the 4th floor above ground to the rooftop floor, the jib suddenly snapped and fell onto the parapet formwork on the rooftop floor; the victim, who was installing parapet formwork nearby, received a severe impact to the chest and other parts of his body from the damaged formwork and died.
507.재해유발요인: While transporting a bundle of euro forms to the rooftop floor, the jib fractured and the bundle fell onto the rooftop parapet formwork, striking a worker who was installing the parapet formwork
507.위험성감소대책:
▶ For fixing pins and split pins installed on the crane jib, comply with using standard products manufactured according to safety certification documents, or materials and parts with equal or better performance, to prevent detachment
▶ Structural parts shall maintain rigidity so that significant deformation does not occur
▶ A person who leases a tower jib crane to others shall inspect the machinery in advance and perform repair immediately upon finding any abnormality

508.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO school new construction site, two victims were on top of a beam form lifted by tower crane for the installation of 3rd-floor beam formwork of the school building, dismantling the lifting rope, when, due to an operating error of the tower crane, the beam form suspended from the lifting rope tilted and swayed; they lost balance and fell about 3 meters to the floor below and were injured (requiring more than 3 months of medical care).
508.재해유발요인: While dismantling the lifting rope on top of a beam formwork hoisted by tower crane, the worker lost balance due to a tower crane operation error and fell
508.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with lifting machinery, select consistent signal methods appropriate to the work progress and mutually confirm them
▶ For work at heights of 2m or more with fall risk, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear a safety harness

509.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OOO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd., after performing layout marking work on the ground floor of building OO, rode down a construction lift and was moving from the lift boarding area to the warehouse in front of building OO, when he was run over by a moving bulldozer and died.
509.재해유발요인: With inadequate measures to prevent worker access within the vehicle-type construction machinery work zone, the victim was crushed by a moving bulldozer while walking to the warehouse
509.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit worker entry into locations with collision risk when working with vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Remove obstacles from vehicle-type construction machinery travel routes and secure operator visibility
▶ Check vehicle traffic and deploy a spotter when entering construction machinery travel routes

510.재해개요: Around October 2018, at the OO new construction site, the overwinding prevention device attached to the boom end of a mobile crane performing material lifting work detached and flew off for an unclear reason, striking the head and chest of the victim, who was performing beam formwork assembly work on the 1st floor above ground, and he died.
510.재해유발요인: With no pre-inspection of the equipment in use, the overwinding prevention device attached to the boom tip of a mobile crane performing material lifting work detached and flew off due to deterioration or other causes, striking the worker's head
510.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before construction machinery work, thoroughly verify sufficient strength and check for abnormalities of major structural fastening bolts
▶ Prohibit worker entry beneath the lifting path in material lifting sections

511.재해개요: Around December 2018, at the OO apartment housing new construction site being built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., two victims belonging to a subcontractor (OO Construction) were on floor O of building O; in order to install exterior wall formwork, immediately after stripping the exterior wall formwork (euro form assembly, dimensions 10.5m * 2.8m, weight 1 ton) used on the floor below for lifting work using two electric chain blocks (lifting capacity 1 ton), the left lifting attachment point of the exterior wall formwork detached and the exterior wall formwork tilted to the left; the impact caused the right electric chain block (height 4m, weight 25kg) to topple to the left, colliding with the victims; one died and one was injured.
511.재해유발요인: With no heavy-load handling plan prepared, immediately after stripping the exterior wall formwork, the left lifting hook part of the exterior wall formwork detached, and the impact of the exterior wall formwork tilting to the left caused the right electric chain block to topple to the left, striking the worker
511.위험성감소대책:
▶ For heavy loads such as exterior wall formwork, integrate the formwork and hoist using a mobile crane
▶ Perform work considering the allowable tensile strength of the euroform angles for the total formwork weight 
▶ To lift 1-ton formwork, reinforce the attachment points to secure sufficient tensile strength before work

512.재해개요: Around January 2020, at the OO industrial center new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., the connecting pin of the main jib of a tower crane that was lifting a bundle of shore materials came out; the buckled jib fell onto the boom of a concrete pump truck and struck the victim (a concrete placement worker), who was performing concrete pouring work below (on the parking ramp floor of the 1st floor above ground), and he died.
512.재해유발요인: With simultaneous work above and below in the heavy-load lifting zone, while lifting a bundle of shore materials, the connecting pin of the tower crane main jib detached, and the bent jib fell onto the boom of a concrete pump truck, striking a worker who was pouring concrete below
512.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using equipment such as tower cranes, inspect and manage major structural parts such as the main jib before use
▶ Prohibit worker entry beneath the hoisting path when working with a tower crane

513.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the OO drainage channel installation work site, a victim belonging to OO Development Co., Ltd. was loading formwork onto a 1ton cargo truck when, on the sloped road, the 1ton cargo truck rolled forward; the victim tried to block it from in front of the 1ton cargo truck and was crushed and died.
513.재해유발요인: With no measures taken when the machine operator left the driver's seat, while loading formwork onto a cargo truck (1 ton), the cargo truck (1 ton) rolled forward down the sloped road and crushed the worker
513.위험성감소대책:
▶ When the operator leaves the driver's seat of vehicle-type material handling machinery, securely engage the parking brake and install wheel chocks
▶ If vehicle-type material handling machinery rolls down a slope, prohibit recklessly blocking the front of the vehicle by manpower

514.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the 00 extension construction site being built by 00 Construction Co., Ltd., two victims belonging to a subcontractor finished fixing work on top of a beam form lifted by mobile crane for the installation of 2nd-floor beam formwork; after separating the sling belt and shackle, as the mobile crane was being raised, the sling belt hanging from the hook caught on a hanger hook for fixing square timber attached to one side of the lifted beam form, causing the form to flip over, and they fell together with the 2nd-floor beam form to the 1st-floor ground (H≒3.0m); one died and one was injured.
514.재해유발요인: With the work sequence not followed (no heavy-load handling plan prepared), after lifting a floor beam formwork and separating the sling belt and shackle, while the mobile crane was rising, the sling belt caught on a hanger hook for fixing square timber attached to one side of the lifted beam formwork, flipping the formwork, and the worker fell together with the formwork
514.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during vehicle-type construction machinery work
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan
▶ When lifting heavy objects, avoid single-line rigging and comply with safe heavy-object handling methods (two-line rigging)

515.재해개요: Around May 2016, at the neighborhood living facility new construction site of OOOO Co., Ltd., in the process of moving materials (gang form fixing bolts, weight about 350kg) contained in a 1-ton sack with a crane (unmanned, 2.9Ton), the lifting loop of the sack connected to the shackle came undone and the sack fell from a height of about 2m, striking the victim, who died.
515.재해유발요인: With poor heavy-load handling methods, while lifting materials contained in a 1-ton sack using a crane, the lifting loop of the sack connected to the shackle came loose, and the load fell and struck the worker
515.위험성감소대책:
▶ When transporting heavy loads such as steel bolt materials, use steel-fabricated lifting boxes and prohibit overloading
▶ Control worker entry in advance during heavy-load handling work such as material lifting with a crane

516.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO resort new construction site, a victim belonging to the tower crane rental company was working with a belt-type safety harness hooked to the railing of the trolley work platform (drive mechanism maintenance cage) on the tower crane jib in order to check the installation condition of the tower crane, when he lost balance and fell from the platform.
516.재해유발요인: With no safety measures for the gang form implemented, during gang form lifting, a worker waiting on an adjacent gang form fell due to the collision and impact between gang forms
516.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement measures prohibiting worker entry within the hazard range during gang form lifting work
▶ Install guardrails at gang form corners, edge openings, etc. to prevent worker falls
▶ Instruct workers to attach safety harnesses and verify compliance

517.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor was on the 1st-tier working platform of the gang form cage, which was not attached to the tower crane lifting rope, for the gang form climbing work on the exterior wall of the elevator machine room on the 2nd rooftop level of building OO; while sequentially dismantling all of the fixing hardware (anchor bolts) between the gang form and the concrete wall, the gang form detached from the exterior wall, and he fell together with the gang form about 43m to the concrete ground below and died.
517.재해유발요인: With no fall prevention measures implemented, while sequentially dismantling the fixing hardware between the gang form and the concrete wall from the gang form cage working platform for the gang form lifting work on the exterior wall of the rooftop elevator machine room, the gang form detached from the exterior wall and the worker fell
517.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing gang form raising work, suspend the gang form from lifting equipment before proceeding with dismantling of the fixing hardware between the gang form and the concrete wall and slab
▶ Comply with not dismantling supports or fixing hardware in advance before suspending from lifting equipment 
▶ For work handling heavy loads such as gang forms, designate a work supervisor and have that person direct the work

518.재해개요: Around August 2017, at the rebar storage yard within the OO access road improvement work site, rebar was lifted with an excavator, and the moment it rotated (slewed) 90° to the left to load the rebar onto a truck, the excavator lost balance and toppled over; the rebar bundle struck the head of a victim belonging to a subcontractor, who was waiting beside the truck to help load the rebar onto the truck, and he died.
518.재해유발요인: While loading and unloading rebar with an excavator without considering ground conditions and working radius when lifting heavy loads, the excavator lost balance and toppled over, striking the worker
518.위험성감소대책:
▶ Consider construction machinery specifications, performance, working radius, weight of lifted objects, etc.
▶ When lifting heavy loads using an excavator, perform work in compliance with the rated lifting load chart, such as removing the bucket
▶ When performing vehicle-type construction machinery work above an excavation slope, control worker entry below the slope, deploy a signalman, and use guide ropes

519.재해개요: Around April 2018, at the OO apartment new construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor loaded rebar (D10mm, 3.76ton) onto a forklift and was turning left on a sloped temporary road when the forklift began to lose balance and topple; as he got off the forklift and was evacuating, the forklift toppled over and he was crushed under the falling rebar and died.
519.재해유발요인: While driving on a sloped temporary road with rebar loaded on a forklift, the forklift lost balance and toppled over, and the rebar fell onto the worker
519.위험성감소대책:
▶ When operating a forklift for transport, supervise so that only persons licensed as construction machinery operators under the Construction Machinery Management Act operate it
▶ When performing work using a forklift, deploy an equipment spotter if there is a risk of the forklift overturning and endangering workers

520.재해개요: Around August 2018, at the OO disaster risk zone improvement project site built by OO Development Co., Ltd., while rebar was being lowered to the bottom of an excavated slope (H=4.5m) using an excavator, the excavator lost balance, tilted forward, and slid down; a victim belonging to a subcontractor, who was at the bottom of the slope, was struck by the excavator bucket and died.
520.재해유발요인: While loading and unloading rebar with an excavator without considering ground conditions and working radius when lifting heavy loads, the excavator lost balance and toppled over, striking the worker
520.위험성감소대책:
▶ Consider construction machinery specifications, performance, working radius, weight of lifted objects, etc.
▶ When lifting heavy loads using an excavator, perform work in compliance with the rated lifting load chart, such as removing the bucket
▶ When performing vehicle-type construction machinery work above an excavation slope, control worker entry below the slope, deploy a signalman, and use guide ropes

521.재해개요: Around May 2019, at a detached house new construction site, a victim belonging to a subcontractor found it difficult to unload rebar for foundation work by himself, so he asked the excavator operator working at the construction site to unload the rebar loaded on a cargo truck with the excavator bucket; the moment the rebar on the truck was pulled, the victim, who was holding onto the rebar to keep his balance, was caught up with the falling rebar and fell below into a drainage channel (height: about 1.15m), where he was crushed under the rebar (1,114kg) and died.
521.재해유발요인: While unloading rebar loaded on a truck with an excavator, the worker holding the rebar was caught by the rebar and fell
521.위험성감소대책:
▶For divisible heavy loads such as rebar, divide into small units during unloading work
▶Secure the working radius and confirm worker safety before starting work, control worker access within the working radius, and deploy a spotter

522.재해개요: Around July 2019, at the OO housing reconstruction improvement project site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was passing by a location where rebar was being unloaded from a 25-ton cargo truck by forklift, when rebar fell from the cargo truck, striking the victim's head and lower body, and he died.
522.재해유발요인: While unloading rebar from a cargo truck with a forklift, rebar fell from the cargo truck and struck the head and lower body of a passing worker
522.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery for heavy-load lifting, coordinate and comply with signals between workers and the signalman before work
▶ Control entry of workers other than those involved during cargo unloading work using a forklift

523.재해개요: Around July 2017, at the OOO Plaza new construction site being built by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., while the victim was transporting 2 bundles of rebar (about 2 tons, L=10m) with a mobile crane (55 tons) at the outdoor material storage yard, the wire rope broke on the inner side of the wire rope end-fitting section of the crane's auxiliary hook, and the rebar bundle being transported fell onto the victim's abdomen, and he died.
523.재해유발요인: While lifting rebar with a mobile crane without inspecting the auxiliary hook's wire rope for deformation, the wire rope broke and the worker was struck by the rebar bundle
523.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety devices (wire rope, etc.) and check their operating condition before starting work
▶ When working with a crane, control workers in the lower section so heavy loads do not pass over workers' heads
▶ Use auxiliary ropes to guide the lifting when loading with a crane

524.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO park development construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., during the work of lifting rebar onto the 2nd-floor slab of the crematorium using a truck-mounted mobile crane, the auxiliary winch wire rope (Ø14mm) broke, and the victim, who was under the lifted rebar bundle, was struck by the rebar bundle and died.
524.재해유발요인: While lifting rebar with a mobile crane without inspecting the auxiliary hook's wire rope for deformation, the wire rope broke and the worker was struck by the rebar bundle
524.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety devices (wire rope, etc.) and check their operating condition before starting work
▶ When working with a crane, control workers in the lower section so heavy loads do not pass over workers' heads
▶ Use auxiliary ropes to guide the lifting when loading with a crane

525.재해개요: Around February 2020, at the OO Co., Ltd. new construction site, while a rebar bundle (about 1.7 tons) was being lifted using a tower crane (L-type, unmanned), the luffing rope and auxiliary rope broke; along with the descent of the main jib, the rebar bundle fell onto the victim, a reinforced concrete subcontractor worker who was below, and he died.
525.재해유발요인: While lifting a rebar bundle using a tower crane without controlling worker access, the luffing rope and auxiliary rope broke and the rebar bundle fell onto the worker
525.위험성감소대책:
▶ Improve fixing methods such as securing and sag prevention of auxiliary ropes so that the crane main jib operates normally and no problems occur in device functions
▶ Restrict installation of terminal block supports, etc. that may interfere with ropes
▶ When working with a crane, control worker entry so that the load being lifted does not pass over workers' heads

526.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the OO nursing facility new construction site built by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was performing auxiliary work (rigging, etc.) to move a rebar bundle (Φ10mm+Φ13mm, about 1.4 tons) stacked on the 1st-floor terrace of building 3 to the 2nd-floor slab of building 2 with a mobile crane (20 tons), when the mobile crane, unable to withstand the load, overturned; the rebar bundle fell and rebounded, striking the victim's face (around the eyes), and he died.
526.재해유발요인: During rebar rigging work to move a rebar bundle with a mobile crane, the mobile crane, which exceeded its rated load, could not withstand the load and overturned, and the rebar bundle struck the worker
526.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit work with loads exceeding the rated load according to the working radius by jib angle and the rebar weight
▶ Comply with vertical lifting so that the hook and the lifted object's center of gravity align, preventing sudden working-radius increase and added impact loads
▶ Designate consistent signal methods and perform signaling during heavy-load transport work using lifting machinery

527.재해개요: Around May 2020, at the OO outer ring road construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a worker belonging to a subcontractor hooked a sling belt (L=1.9m, B=75mm) in a U shape onto one side of a rebar bundle for underground roadway wall assembly (?32mm, L=7.85m, 40 bars, 1.96ton) lying stacked on the ground (concrete floor) at a point about 1.5m inward from the end, in order to lift it; while it was being lifted with a mobile crane (25ton) (H≒2.5m) and moved or adjusted, the sling belt suddenly slipped off and the rebar bundle fell, striking the head of the victim below, and he died.
527.재해유발요인: Without firmly securing the load, a sling belt was hung in a U shape on one side of a rebar bundle and lifted and moved by mobile crane; the sling belt slipped off, and the rebar bundle fell and struck the worker below
527.위험성감소대책:
▶ When hoisting lifted objects, comply with wrapping sling belts and securely fixing with shackles, etc. before hoisting
▶ During lifting work, deploy a work supervisor and a dedicated signalman so the lifted object is not positioned over or passing over workers' heads

528.재해개요: Around July 2020, at the OO new construction site built by OO Corporation, a rebar bundle (D13×8m, 120 bars, 955.2kg) stacked on the 1st-floor work area floor was bound with fiber rope (belt sling) and hooked to the hook attached to the excavator quick coupler for lifting to the top of the 2nd-floor deck plate, when one side of the fiber rope (belt sling) came off the hook and the rebar bundle spilled out, striking the victim below, and he died.
528.재해유발요인: While lifting a rebar bundle hung on a hook attached to the excavator quick coupler, one side of the rope on the hook detached, and the rebar bundle spilled out and struck the worker
528.위험성감소대책:
▶ For rebar lifting work, use equipment suited to lifting machinery purposes such as mobile cranes
▶ Before lifting work, check the quick coupler, etc. for abnormalities and take immediate action if any abnormality is found

529.재해개요: Around August 2021, at the material intake opening (3rd basement level) of the OO annex new construction site being built by OO Industry Co., Ltd., the victim was struck by a falling object from 14m above (a wall rebar mesh, size: 6m x 7m, weight: 1.3-1.4ton) being transported through the material intake opening, and died.
529.재해유발요인: While transporting a wall rebar cage through the material entry opening using a mobile crane, the wall rebar cage came loose, fell, and struck the victim
529.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting materials with a mobile crane, inspect and address the attachment of the hook detachment-prevention device, the connection condition with the lifted object, etc.
▶ Control entry within the mobile crane's working radius, and ensure heavy loads do not pass over workers' heads

530.재해개요: Around January 2016, at the OO Co., Ltd. apartment new construction site, a victim (day laborer) belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd., the structural work subcontractor, collided with the rear of a reversing ready-mixed concrete truck and was crushed under the vehicle's rear wheels and died.
530.재해유발요인: With no worker access control in place, the worker collided with the rear of a reversing ready-mixed concrete truck and was crushed
530.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit worker entry into hazard zones and secure safe passages to ensure travel routes for ready-mix concrete trucks
▶ Install stoppers, etc. to maintain approach limit distances preventing collision and crushing between equipment
▶ Control worker entry and guide vehicle-type construction machinery through spotter deployment

531.재해개요: Around June 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO factory new construction site, the victim (a pump truck operator) climbed on top of a concrete pump truck and was preparing for concrete pouring, when his head was struck by the discharge outlet (steel) of the concrete pump truck's flexible hose, and he fell to the ground (H≒1.3m) and died.
531.재해유발요인: While climbing on top of a concrete pump truck to prepare for concrete pouring, the pressure of the concrete pump truck's flexible hose was released, and the victim was struck on the head by the discharge outlet (steel) of the violently swinging hose and fell to the ground
531.위험성감소대책: ▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, prepare a work plan covering work methods, inspection, and work procedures for the machinery

532.재해개요: Around July 2017, at the OO C.C development construction site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim (driver), an owner-operator affiliated with OO Co., Ltd., was driving a concrete mixer truck to pour concrete for the pipe protection work of the drainage channel around hole 5 of the site, when the truck overturned on a slope, and he was crushed inside the driver's cab and died.
532.재해유발요인: While driving a concrete mixer truck for pouring concrete for drainage pipe protection work, the truck overturned on a ramp where the ground surface was slippery due to rain, and the victim was pinned inside the driver's cab
532.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct regular inspection and maintenance of vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Immediately stop operation when vehicle-type construction machinery operation is unsafe due to rain, adverse weather, etc.

533.재해개요: Around October 2017, on OOOO Road (asphalt-paved road, width: 8m, grade: about 4°) [near the OO Co., Ltd. Gwanjeo-dong neighborhood living facility new construction site], the victim (a concrete pump truck driver) parked the concrete pump truck with the engine running, got out of the vehicle, and was about to operate the outrigger attached to the rear passenger side under the vehicle to fix it to the ground, when the vehicle rolled down the sloped road (about 10m); as he attempted to board on the passenger side to apply the parking brake, the vehicle collided with a truck parked on the opposite side, and he was crushed between the passenger door and the vehicle body and died.
533.재해유발요인: After parking the concrete pump truck with the engine running and getting out of the vehicle to operate the outriggers, the vehicle rolled down the sloped road (approx. 10 m); while boarding through the passenger side to apply the parking brake, the vehicle collided with a truck parked on the opposite side, and the victim was caught between the passenger door and the vehicle body
533.위험성감소대책:
▶ Inspect the vehicle's brakes, clutch, etc. in advance before starting work
▶ Immediately repair upon finding abnormalities or take other necessary measures

534.재해개요: Around December 2017, a victim (pump truck operator) belonging to OO Construction Machinery was performing a pre-check of the pump truck at the OO site to pour concrete with the pump truck; an abnormality occurred in the compressor and shaft, and while repairing the P.T.O, the pneumatic hose of the braking system came off and the vehicle brakes released, and he was crushed by the moving pump truck and died (presumed).
534.재해유발요인: During pre-inspection of the pump truck for concrete pouring, an abnormality occurred in the compressor and shaft; while repairing the PTO, the pneumatic hose of the braking system came off, the vehicle brakes released, and the victim was crushed by the moving pump truck
534.위험성감소대책: ▶ When repairing vehicle-type construction machinery such as pump trucks or attaching and removing accessory devices, designate a person to direct the work and deploy a work supervisor who directs the work and determines the work sequence

535.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OO bridge site of the OO national highway construction project, the victim (a construction section manager) was directing rebar placement work prior to concrete pouring of the OO bridge upper slab, when a pump truck waiting in the rear for the concrete pouring moved toward the bridge, and the victim was struck by the pump truck and died.
535.재해유발요인: While directing rebar placement work before pouring the upper slab concrete, a pump truck waiting at the rear for concrete pouring suddenly moved toward the bridge and collided with the victim
535.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prevent sudden travel and runaway of vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Prohibit worker entry and deploy a spotter in locations where workers risk being struck by contact with operating vehicle-type construction machinery

536.재해개요: Around October 2018, at the OO site, a ready-mixed concrete truck arrived at the work location to pour concrete for a side gutter structure; with the foot brake and parking brake applied, as the driver was getting out of the driver's seat, the ready-mixed concrete truck rolled back about 3m, and the victim, who was passing by, was crushed under the rear wheel on the driver's side and died.
536.재해유발요인: A concrete mixer truck waiting for concrete pouring slid due to a braking system failure, crushing the worker
536.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with vehicle-type construction machinery, have the supervisor inspect the functions of brakes, clutch, etc. before work
▶ When waiting aboard vehicle-type construction machinery on a slope, prevent slipping by engaging the side brake and installing wheel chocks

537.재해개요: Around November 2018, at the outdoor parking lot concrete work site during the OO new construction, the victim (a concrete mixer truck operator) was operating the chute of a concrete mixer truck reversing toward the pump truck hopper for concrete pouring of the outdoor parking lot, when he was caught between it and the pump truck hopper and died.
537.재해유발요인: While operating the chute of a concrete truck reversing toward the pump truck hopper for concrete pouring, the victim was caught between the truck and the pump truck hopper
537.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter within the hazard zone to prohibit worker entry and guide the machinery
▶ Install stoppers of safe structure to maintain approach limit distances, preventing collision and crushing between equipment
▶ Secure safe passages for workers to move separately from vehicle-type construction machinery travel routes

538.재해개요: Around January 2019, at the OO Co., Ltd. apartment housing project site, a concrete mixer truck in transit failed to climb a ramp and slid backward, and the vehicle overturned to the right side of the ramp; of two victims (form carpenters) belonging to subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd. who were installing formwork nearby, one was directly crushed under the vehicle and died, and one was injured.
538.재해유발요인: A ready-mixed concrete truck failed to climb a ramp while moving and rolled backward, crushing a worker who was working nearby
538.위험성감소대책:
▶ When stopping vehicle-type construction machinery such as ready-mix concrete trucks on a slope, engage the foot and side brakes and install wheel chocks to prevent rolling
▶ When working with vehicle-type construction machinery, prohibit worker entry and deploy a spotter in locations at risk of contact or collision
