▶ When the road adjoins the work site, implement worker protection measures such as barriers

539.재해개요: Around January 2020, at an officetel new construction site, after completion of rooftop concrete pouring, the victim was dismantling the concrete delivery pipe installed inside the elevator pit at the slab edge at the 18th-floor elevator entrance, when the rope connected to the delivery pipe came undone, and he fell together with the delivery pipe into the pit down to the 1st basement level (H: about 55m) and died.
539.재해유발요인: While dismantling a concrete delivery pipe installed inside the elevator pit, the rope connected to the delivery pipe came loose and the victim fell together with the delivery pipe
539.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with fall prevention measures such as covers and guardrails in fall hazard sections such as openings
▶ Provide safety harnesses before work and manage attachment status

540.재해개요: Around November 2020, at the OO Co., Ltd. factory new construction site, a concrete mixer truck belonging to OO Enterprise Co., Ltd., waiting to pour waterproof concrete for the freezer warehouse floor on the 1st floor of the meat processing factory building, slid down the site entrance ramp due to a braking system malfunction (presumed) and crashed into the security office at the entrance of the existing OO Co., Ltd. factory, striking the victim (a security guard) belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd. who was working inside, and he died.
540.재해유발요인: A concrete mixer truck waiting for concrete pouring slid due to a braking system failure, crushing the worker
540.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with vehicle-type construction machinery, have the supervisor inspect the functions of brakes, clutch, etc. before work
▶ When waiting aboard vehicle-type construction machinery on a slope, prevent slipping by engaging the side brake and installing wheel chocks

541.재해개요: Around November 2020, at the OO Co., Ltd. apartment housing new construction site, the victim, together with a coworker, loaded a concrete distributor onto a 5-ton cargo truck with a forklift; in the process of removing it from the site, he lost his balance at the right side gate of the cargo truck bed and fell to the ground (height about 154cm) and died.
541.재해유발요인: In the process of loading a concrete distributor onto a cargo truck with a forklift and carrying it out without dismantling the delivery pipe attached to the bottom, the center of gravity was off and the distributor swayed, causing the worker on the cargo bed to lose balance and fall from the right side gate of the truck bed to the ground
541.위험성감소대책:
▶ When loading a concrete distributor onto a cargo truck for removal, prohibit approach from the right side where the truck bed gate is closed, and when moving from the bed to the ground, open the bed gate before moving
▶ When loading heavy loads of 100kg or more onto a cargo truck, dismantle the delivery pipe under the concrete distributor before loading

542.재해개요: In 2020, at the OO Co., Ltd. residential-commercial new construction site, during the climbing operation of the C.P.B equipment for concrete pouring installed at building 101, the C.P.B mast support member (lower support pin) installed on the 9th floor came off, and the equipment body (total length 20m, self-weight about 17.3 tons) dropped about 4.6m; one victim, who was moving on the 11th floor above ground for firefighting electrical box installation work, was crushed by the fallen C.P.B member and died, and three victims, who were performing C.P.B climbing work and material tidying work on the 11th and 9th floors respectively, were injured.
542.재해유발요인: During the raising operation of C.P.B equipment for concrete pouring, the C.P.B mast support member (lower support pin) came out, and the equipment body fell onto the worker
542.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare and comply with a work plan to prevent C.P.B falling
▶ When dismantling the floor frame after mast raising work, always install a cover fabricated to fit the opening size
▶ If dismantling the floor frame is difficult, install guardrails, covers, or a fall-protection net below

543.재해개요: Around March 2016, at an apartment parking lot slab concrete pouring work site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (a scaffolder) belonging to OO General Construction Co., Ltd. was holding the end hose attached to the end of the pump truck boom and pouring concrete, when the ground under the pump truck's left outrigger subsided; the outrigger slipped off the blocking, the pump truck boom sagged downward and came down on the victim, and he died.
543.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, the ground under the pump truck outrigger subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the pump truck boom struck the worker
543.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, conduct a preliminary survey of ground and stratum conditions and secure bearing capacity by methods such as compaction
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, install support pads under outrigger contact points, etc. to prevent overturning due to outrigger damage
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter to control worker access within the working radius

544.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OO tunnel access road construction site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim (pump truck operator) belonging to OO Pump Truck Co., Ltd., the concrete pump truck rental company for OO Construction Co., Ltd., the structural work subcontractor, was performing maintenance work on the concrete pump truck hopper on top of the underground roadway deck plates for the concrete pouring work of the underground roadway foundation (block 7 section), when he was struck by and then crushed between a concrete mixer truck reversing toward the rear of the pump truck, and died.
544.재해유발요인: With no worker access control in place, during maintenance work on the concrete pump truck hopper, the victim collided with a concrete mixer truck reversing toward the rear of the pump truck and was crushed between them
544.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit worker entry into hazard zones and secure safe passages to ensure travel routes for ready-mix concrete trucks
▶ Install stoppers, etc. to maintain approach limit distances preventing collision and crushing between equipment
▶ Control worker entry and guide vehicle-type construction machinery through spotter deployment

545.재해개요: Around January 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. apartment site, the victim went under a pump truck that was pouring concrete on the underground parking lot slab, performed water cleaning with a high-pressure washer, and was coming out with the high-pressure hose when his clothes became entangled in the joint connected to the engine rotating at high speed, and he died.
545.재해유발요인: After entering under a pump truck pouring concrete on the underground parking lot slab, washing with a high-pressure water sprayer, and coming out with the high-pressure hose, the victim's clothes were wound around the high-speed rotating joint connected to the engine, and he died
545.위험성감소대책:
▶ Deploy a spotter and supervisor or install fences and signs to prohibit worker entry beneath the pump truck where the joint connected to the engine rotates at high speed
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, inform workers before work of the type, travel route, work method, etc. and the work sequence and methods

546.재해개요: Around January 2017, at a multi-family housing new construction site, during L-shaped retaining wall foundation concrete pouring, the ground under the front right outrigger of the pump truck collapsed, and the victim was struck on the head by the boom of the toppling pump truck and died.
546.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, the ground under the pump truck outrigger subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the pump truck boom struck the worker
546.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, conduct a preliminary survey of ground and stratum conditions and secure bearing capacity by methods such as compaction
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, install support pads under outrigger contact points, etc. to prevent overturning due to outrigger damage
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter to control worker access within the working radius

547.재해개요: Around April 2017, at a neighborhood living facility site preparation work site built by OO Construction, the victim (a carpenter) was holding the hose attached to the end of the concrete pump truck boom and pouring foundation concrete for a retaining wall (H=2.0m), when the ground under the outrigger at the front right of the concrete pump truck subsided and the blocking broke; the concrete pump truck tilted, and the victim was struck by the concrete pump truck boom and then crushed, and died.
547.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, the ground under the pump truck outrigger subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the pump truck boom struck the worker
547.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, conduct a preliminary survey of ground and stratum conditions and secure bearing capacity by methods such as compaction
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, install support pads under outrigger contact points, etc. to prevent overturning due to outrigger damage
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter to control worker access within the working radius

548.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OO Road improvement project site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim (a formwork carpenter) belonging to OO Co., Ltd. was pouring lean concrete using a concrete pump truck when the ground subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the victim was struck by the descending boom and died.
548.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, the ground under the pump truck outrigger subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the pump truck boom struck the worker
548.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, conduct a preliminary survey of ground and stratum conditions and secure bearing capacity by methods such as compaction
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, install support pads under outrigger contact points, etc. to prevent overturning due to outrigger damage
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter to control worker access within the working radius

549.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO farm reconstruction work site, the victim was holding the end hose installed on the pump truck boom and pouring concrete for the pig house slurry pit retaining wall, when the concrete ground under the outrigger on the driver's side of the pump truck collapsed; the pump truck boom lurched downward, and the end hose struck the victim's face, and he died.
549.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, the ground under the pump truck outrigger subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the pump truck boom struck the worker
549.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, conduct a preliminary survey of ground and stratum conditions and secure bearing capacity by methods such as compaction
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, install support pads under outrigger contact points, etc. to prevent overturning due to outrigger damage
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter to control worker access within the working radius

550.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO new construction site being built by OO Co., Ltd., victim 1 (a placement worker) and victim 2 (a placement worker), workers belonging to subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd., were holding the hose attached to the end of the concrete pump truck boom and pouring concrete for the 1st basement slab of building 116, when the ground under the outrigger at the front left of the concrete pump truck subsided and the support blocking broke; the concrete pump truck tilted and they were struck by the pump truck boom; victim 1 died and victim 2 was injured.
550.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, the ground under the pump truck outrigger subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the pump truck boom struck the worker
550.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, conduct a preliminary survey of ground and stratum conditions and secure bearing capacity by methods such as compaction
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, install support pads under outrigger contact points, etc. to prevent overturning due to outrigger damage
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter to control worker access within the working radius

551.재해개요: Around November 2018, at the OO Co., Ltd. housing redevelopment improvement project site, a victim belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd., the structural work subcontractor, was guiding the ready-mixed concrete trucks waiting for the foundation concrete pouring work of building 119, when he was crushed by a ready-mixed concrete truck reversing between building 116 and tower crane no. 2, and died.
551.재해유발요인: While guiding a ready-mixed concrete truck waiting for concrete pouring work, the worker was crushed by the reversing ready-mixed concrete truck
551.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter within the hazard zone to prohibit worker entry and guide the machinery
▶ Install stoppers of safe structure to maintain approach limit distances, preventing collision and crushing between equipment
▶ Secure safe passages for workers to move separately from vehicle-type construction machinery travel routes

552.재해개요: Around December 2018, at the OO solar power plant energy storage system (ESS) foundation work site built by OO Co., Ltd., a victim (a concrete placement worker) belonging to a subcontractor was preparing for concrete pouring work when the delivery pipe of the concrete pump truck became blocked; the moment he released the clip bolts for the delivery pipe replacement work, the blocked concrete suddenly burst out, striking the victim's head, and he died.
552.재해유발요인: While preparing for concrete pouring work, the delivery pipe of the concrete pump truck was clogged; the moment the clip bolts were released for pipe replacement, the blocked concrete burst out and struck the worker
552.위험성감소대책:
▶ When concrete pouring work stops due to a clogged concrete delivery pipe, suspend work and perform repair
▶ In locations at risk of being struck by ejected concrete, provide and wear personal protective equipment appropriate to the work content

553.재해개요: Around December 2018, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. double-track railway construction site, the victim (a pump truck operator) was guiding a reversing concrete mixer truck at the rear of the pump truck set up for the lining concrete pouring work inside OO adit #1, when he was caught between the reversing mixer truck and the pump truck and died.
553.재해유발요인: While guiding a ready-mixed concrete truck waiting for concrete pouring work, the worker was crushed by the reversing ready-mixed concrete truck
553.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter within the hazard zone to prohibit worker entry and guide the machinery
▶ Install stoppers of safe structure to maintain approach limit distances, preventing collision and crushing between equipment
▶ Secure safe passages for workers to move separately from vehicle-type construction machinery travel routes

554.재해개요: Around May 2019, at a general industrial complex development project, the victim (a placement worker) was pouring concrete for a channel wall on a cut slope, when, due to ground subsidence, the concrete pump truck outrigger footing sank into the ground; simultaneously, the front of the pump truck tilted forward, and he was struck on the head by the boom tip, which descended momentarily, and died.
554.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, the ground under the pump truck outrigger subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the pump truck boom struck the worker
554.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, conduct a preliminary survey of ground and stratum conditions and secure bearing capacity by methods such as compaction
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, install support pads under outrigger contact points, etc. to prevent overturning due to outrigger damage
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter to control worker access within the working radius

555.재해개요: Around October 2019, at the production building construction phase 1 work site being built by OO Co., Ltd., a victim (a placement worker) belonging to a subcontractor was holding the end hose of a concrete pump truck (40ton) and pouring lean concrete for the mat foundation slab, when the ground under the pump truck's rear right outrigger subsided; the pump truck tilted and he was struck by the descending boom (5th section) and died.
555.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, the ground under the pump truck outrigger subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the pump truck boom struck the worker
555.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, conduct a preliminary survey of ground and stratum conditions and secure bearing capacity by methods such as compaction
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, install support pads under outrigger contact points, etc. to prevent overturning due to outrigger damage
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter to control worker access within the working radius

556.재해개요: Around June 2020, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site built by OO, after completing lean concrete pouring using a concrete pump truck, the moment the boom was being folded (the accident occurred while folding the 3rd of the total 4 sections), the rod of the hydraulic cylinder underwent shear failure and broke; the boom lost restraint and swung open forward, striking the victim (a plasterer), and he died.
556.재해유발요인: The moment the pump truck boom was being folded after completing the blinding concrete pour, the hydraulic cylinder rod underwent shear failure and broke, and the boom, losing restraint, swung open forward and struck the victim
556.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit worker entry into hazard zones
▶ Control worker entry and guide vehicle-type construction machinery through spotter deployment

557.재해개요: Around November 2020, at a cultural experience center development project site, the victim (a concrete worker) was pouring foundation concrete when the concrete pump truck outrigger sank into the ground, and he was crushed by the boom tip, which descended momentarily, and died.
557.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, the ground under the pump truck outrigger subsided, the pump truck tilted, and the pump truck boom struck the worker
557.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, conduct a preliminary survey of ground and stratum conditions and secure bearing capacity by methods such as compaction
▶ For pouring work using a concrete pump truck, install support pads under outrigger contact points, etc. to prevent overturning due to outrigger damage
▶ When using vehicle-type construction machinery, deploy a spotter to control worker access within the working radius

558.재해개요: Around March 2021, at the OO Center new construction site being built by OO Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to OO Co., Ltd., the reinforced concrete subcontractor, was pouring concrete for a composite wall on the 4th basement level, when the connection between the 1st and 2nd boom sections of the concrete pump truck installed on top of the deck plates broke and the boom collapsed; the impact caused the hose connected to the boom end to whip around, striking the victim, and he died.
558.재해유발요인: During basement double-wall concrete pouring, the connection between the 1st and 2nd boom sections of the concrete pump truck installed on top of the deck plates fractured, the boom collapsed, and the hose connected to the boom tip swung and struck the victim
558.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with a concrete pump truck, comply with outrigger extension lengths and perform after reviewing boom angle and pouring working radius
▶ When working with vehicle-type construction machinery, comply with the maximum working load to prevent the risk of destruction of working devices such as the boom and arm
▶ To prevent ground subsidence during concrete pump truck use, secure outrigger support area considering the allowable ground bearing capacity, and secure sufficient contact area with steel plates under the outriggers before work

559.재해개요: Around October 2021, at the OO Co., Ltd. irrigation and drainage channel improvement project site, a victim (driver) belonging to OO Heavy Equipment arrived at the concrete pouring site, parked the concrete mixer truck on a ramp (grade 8.25˚), and during the concrete pouring work, the truck slid due to a braking system malfunction, and he was run over by the wheels and died.
559.재해유발요인: A concrete mixer truck waiting for concrete pouring slid due to a braking system failure, crushing the worker
559.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with vehicle-type construction machinery, have the supervisor inspect the functions of brakes, clutch, etc. before work
▶ When waiting aboard vehicle-type construction machinery on a slope, prevent slipping by engaging the side brake and installing wheel chocks

560.재해개요: Around October 2021, at the OO Co., Ltd. new construction site for semiconductor manufacturing facilities at the OO Co., Ltd. OO factory, a victim (a concrete pump truck operator) belonging to Top Heavy Equipment, a supplier to OO Construction Co., Ltd., the reinforced concrete work subcontractor, climbed the steps of a concrete mixer truck after the completion of mortar pouring to recover the residual mortar remaining inside the pump truck piping into the mixer truck; while he was working, the pump truck rubber hose inserted into the mixer truck hopper suddenly whipped and flew up into the air, striking the victim, and he fell from a height of 2.6m and died.
560.재해유발요인: After finishing pouring, the concrete pump truck operator climbed the mixer truck steps to recover the residual mortar remaining inside the pump truck piping into the concrete mixer truck; while working, the pump truck rubber hose inserted into the mixer truck hopper suddenly whipped and sprang into the air, striking the victim, who fell
560.위험성감소대책:
▶ Immediately stop work and check the condition when the concrete pump truck hose suddenly sways
▶ Prohibit work in unstable postures such as standing on mixer truck steps
▶ Prohibit worker entry and deploy a spotter in locations around the concrete pump truck where workers risk being struck

561.재해개요: Around March 2016, at the OO factory new construction site built by OO, the victim was waiting on a steel beam to assemble wall bracing, when the wall bracing lifted by a mobile crane (25 tons) recoiled and struck the victim, and he fell to the 1st-floor ground (height≒7.5m) and died.
561.재해유발요인: While waiting on a steel beam to assemble wall bracing, the wall bracing lifted by mobile crane sprang loose and struck the worker
561.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at height to install wall bracing on steel beams, implement fall prevention measures such as installing fall-protection nets and using aerial work platforms
▶ When working in fall hazard locations, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ When separating wall bracing stuck in steel members, perform the work manually using levers, etc. to prevent spring-back

562.재해개요: Around April 2018, at the OO Co., Ltd. rest area installation and yard paving site built by OO Architecture, while a 1-ton truck loaded with leftover materials to be removed after the rest area installation work was being moved, the victim, who was on the cargo bed with the loaded materials, fell off and was simultaneously crushed under the falling materials and died.
562.재해유발요인: While moving a 1-ton truck loaded with leftover materials to be carried out after rest area installation work, the unsecured materials loaded on the truck slid, and the victim who was riding on the cargo bed fell together with them under the truck
562.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prohibit workers from riding in truck cargo beds

563.재해개요: Around August 2016, during the fabrication of an H-beam to be installed at the OO neighborhood living facility new construction, after completing welding of the front side of the H-beam, in the process of hooking and flipping it over with a haka (hook bar) to weld the rear side, the haka could not be pulled out, and the victim was struck in the face by the 185cm-long haka and died (presumed).
563.재해유발요인: During H-beam fabrication work, after completing welding of the front side of the H-beam, in the process of flipping it over with a beam clamp (haka) to weld the rear side, the clamp could not be removed and struck the worker's face
563.위험성감소대책:
▶ During H-beam welding and lifting work there are hazards such as falling objects and being struck, and there is a possibility of being struck during work such as flipping heavy loads using a hook bar, so wear personal protective equipment
▶ Prevent human injury by using vehicle-mounted construction machinery such as lifts and cranes when lifting heavy loads

564.재해개요: Around August 2019, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO logistics center factory extension construction site, a victim (a steel erector) belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd., the steel work subcontractor, was installing the auxiliary boom of a mobile crane (45 tons) outside the factory building for steel member lifting work, when the auxiliary boom (L=9m) supported on the main boom came off and fell, coming down on the victim, who was crushed and died.
564.재해유발요인: During installation of a mobile crane auxiliary boom for steel member lifting work, a problem occurred in the auxiliary boom installation process rather than a mechanical defect, and the auxiliary boom supported on the main boom came off and fell onto the worker
564.위험성감소대책: ▶ When starting operation of machinery for attaching a mobile crane auxiliary boom, if workers may be endangered, verify in advance necessary matters such as worker placement and training, work methods, and protective devices, then take measures necessary to prevent hazards

565.재해개요: Around May 2020, at the OO factory new construction site, during crane girder assembly work, a mobile crane (45ton) toppled over; the crane girder (about 7.7ton) struck an aerial work platform, and as the aerial work platform (platform height about 11m) toppled over, the victim on board struck the ground and died.
565.재해유발요인: During crane girder assembly work, the overload prevention device of the mobile crane did not operate; exceeding the allowable load, the mobile crane toppled over, the crane girder struck the aerial work platform, the aerial work platform toppled over, and the worker fell
565.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using a mobile crane, adjust and inspect in advance so that the overload prevention device, etc. operate normally
▶ Perform work from positions where lifting is possible considering the mobile crane's operating range
▶ When using a mobile crane, secure ground bearing capacity in advance by methods such as ground compaction, and inspect outrigger condition

566.재해개요: Around February 2017, at the OO new construction, inside the underground parking lot on the 2nd basement level, while operating a forklift to transport cement blocks for masonry, the victim was caught between an underground parking lot column and the forklift and died.
566.재해유발요인: While a worker without forklift operating qualifications was driving a forklift to transport masonry materials, he was caught between a parking lot column and the forklift
566.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly verify forklift operators' qualifications (license under the Construction Machinery Management Act) and prohibit operation by unqualified persons
▶ Deploy a spotter during vehicle-type material handling machinery work or movement and implement access control measures within the working radius

567.재해개요: Around June 2019, at the OO redevelopment construction, in order to move ready-mixed mortar, with the mortar lifted on a forklift, the victim parked it on a ramp, got off, and was looking for a stacking location, when he noticed the forklift rolling backward and tried to stop it, and was run over by the forklift front wheel and died.
567.재해유발요인: After stopping a forklift on a ramp with Remitar (pre-mixed mortar) lifted, while looking for a stacking location, the forklift rolled backward and the victim was caught under the forklift's front wheel
567.위험성감소대책:
▶ When parking or stopping a forklift, park or stop in a flat, designated area, then fully lower the forks to the ground
▶ Comply with deploying a guiding person during work using vehicle-type material handling machinery, etc. 
▶ When starting work, ensure workers recognize signals according to the signal method

568.재해개요: Around October 2020, on the rooftop at the OO development construction, while the victim was performing material binding and signaling duties for the removal of materials, the moment the crane lifted the materials, the materials swung wildly and the victim was left hanging onto them; in that state he collided with the exterior wall of the elevator machine room and died.
568.재해유발요인: While performing material rigging and signaling duties for carrying materials out from the rooftop, the moment the crane lifted the materials, the worker clung to the violently swinging load and, in that state, collided with the exterior wall of the elevator machine room
568.위험성감소대책:
▶ Deploy a dedicated signalman during heavy-load handling work using a crane and inform related workers of consistent signal methods
▶ When lifting materials with a crane, identify the material's center of gravity before hoisting the lifted object to prevent material swinging, etc.
▶ Control worker entry beneath the work area when lifting heavy loads with a crane

569.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO new construction, in order to repair the block wall of the neighboring building damaged by the demolition and dismantling work of the existing building (block removal, laying, and plastering), the victim stood on the bucket of an excavator (bucket capacity: 0.2㎥) and was moving to the work location, when he lost balance and fell to the 1st-floor ground (H≒2.4M) and died.
569.재해유발요인: While riding in an excavator bucket to move for block wall repair work, the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
569.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit use of the excavator other than its main purpose (no worker riding)
▶ Install and comply with using working platforms suitable for the work height (scaffold, mobile scaffold, aerial work platform, etc.)
▶ Install a safe work passage for moving to the work location

570.재해개요: In November 2020, at the OO new construction, during wall masonry work in the 1st-floor AD (Air Duct) section, in the process of moving on top (H=1.8m) of a pallet (1.1m× 1.1m, wooden) on the forks of a forklift (3ton, for brick lifting) positioned close to the AD (Air Duct) section, the victim lost balance and fell inside the AD (Air Duct, 2.1m×1.07m) to the 1st basement floor (H=7.8m) and died.
570.재해유발요인: While transporting masonry materials for flower bed construction at the edge of a ventilation opening with no cover installed, the worker lost balance and fell through the opening
570.위험성감소대책:
▶ At openings with fall risk, firmly install guardrails or covers, etc. with a structure of sufficient strength
▶ When installing opening covers, install them firmly so they do not flip over or fall off, and take necessary measures to prevent fall hazards such as marking them as openings
▶ If installing fall-prevention nets or guardrails is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and supervise so that work is done after fastening safety harnesses

571.재해개요: Around April 2021, at the OO new construction, while performing masonry mortar jointing work on the fence of the building across from the site, the victim collided with a general vehicle that was backing out and turning from the ground-level parking lot of the adjacent apartment, and was caught between the vehicle and the fence and died.
571.재해유발요인: While performing exterior wall masonry mortar jointing work, the victim was hit by a general vehicle that reversed out of the adjacent ground-level parking lot and was turning, and was caught between the vehicle and the fence wall
571.위험성감소대책:
▶ When there is a risk of collision with construction machinery or general vehicles at the work location, implement access control measures or deploy a spotter
▶ Partition the work section and install construction information (progress) signs

572.재해개요: Around February 2017, at the OO new construction, while riding a gondola and performing exterior wall plastering work (assisting) on the 9th floor of the building (rear side), the victim, Jeong Gwan-seop, lost his balance and fell between the gondola and the building (H≒30m) and died.
572.재해유발요인: While performing exterior wall plastering work aboard a gondola, the victim lost balance and fell from the front of the gondola where no guardrail was installed
572.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly install guardrails on the front of the gondola
▶ During gondola work, thoroughly install lifelines and wear and connect safety harnesses

573.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the "commercial-residential building remodeling (rooftop waterproofing) work" site, the victim (a laborer) was performing lifting work (single-line rigging) with a mobile crane to transport a water tank from the 3rd-floor rooftop of the building, when the lifted water tank swung and struck the victim; he lost balance and fell to the concrete ground (H≒12.5m) and died.
573.재해유발요인: During lifting work (single-line rigging) with a mobile crane to transport a water tank from the rooftop, the lifted water tank swung and struck the victim, who lost balance and fell to the concrete floor at ground level
573.위험성감소대책:
▶ When handling heavy loads using vehicle-type material handling machinery, direct work methods appropriate to the heavy-load handling method and the specifications and capacity of the lifting equipment
▶ When working with vehicle-type material handling machinery, prohibit worker entry to prevent collision with cargo being transported

574.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO new construction, a box of tile materials (40.5kg, 120×60cm) for the finishing work of the elevator and corridor exterior walls on the 2nd basement level was bound with a lifting belt and hooked to a winch (electric hoist) for lifting work to the 5th floor above ground, when the lifting belt came off the hook of the winch (electric hoist, 250kg) and the box of tile materials fell, striking the victim, who died.
574.재해유발요인: While lifting materials (tile boxes) upward with an electric hoist, the lifting belt came off the winch hook, and the falling materials struck a worker who was working below
574.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting materials using an electric hoist, etc., check the installation of the hook detachment-prevention device and the lifting belt attachment condition
▶ When lifting materials using an electric hoist, etc., implement measures prohibiting worker entry within the working radius

575.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO apartment construction site, the victim (a forklift operator) unloaded terrazzo tile materials with a forklift and was reversing when the rear wheels dropped into an excavated area (depth about 50cm) where backfilling had not been completed after manhole installation, and he was crushed under the overturned forklift and died.
575.재해유발요인: After unloading tile materials with a forklift, while reversing, the forklift fell into a manhole excavation area and overturned, crushing the victim
575.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using construction machinery such as forklifts, implement safety measures such as ground leveling (installing steel plates and plywood, soil filling, etc.) and clearing the surrounding environment to prevent equipment overturning or rolling due to ground conditions within work passages (slopes, puddles, materials, etc.)
▶ When using construction machinery such as forklifts, deploy a separate spotter to prepare for safety accidents

576.재해개요: Around July 2016, at the installation work site for an eave roof for rain protection over the OO dormitory stairs, the victim boarded a mobile crane man basket to apply anti-rust paint to the welded parts of the eave roof supports; the moment the jib was raised and slewed toward the work location, the man basket detached from the jib bracket, and he fell to the ground (H≒14m) and died.
576.재해유발요인: After boarding a crane man-riding platform to apply anti-rust paint to the welded parts of roof supports, the moment the crane swung toward the work location, the platform detached from the jib bracket and fell to the ground
576.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using construction machinery such as mobile cranes, prohibit use other than the original purpose
▶ When a riding platform is unavoidably attached to a mobile crane, check the connection pin engagement between the riding platform and the underside of the jib bracket, and check the outriggers and safety devices for abnormalities before starting work
▶ For work at height with fall risk, attach load sensing devices, moment sensing devices, etc. and use an aerial work platform with a work platform attached so workers do not ride on the crane to work

577.재해개요: Around December 2017, before the installation work of steel grating for a drainage channel, the victim (Jeon Du-seong), in order to move to the drainage channel work location, entered from outside through a temporary entrance (opening) in the soundproof wall that had been arbitrarily detached and opened, and while on the signal cable duct, was jumping across the 1.9m-wide drainage channel perpendicular to the tracks when he was struck by an electric train running on the up line and died. This was a fatal accident.
577.재해유발요인: While moving to the work location through a temporary opening rather than the designated work passage, the victim was struck by an operating train
577.위험성감소대책:
▶ Secure work passages allowing workers to move safely
▶ Implement entry prohibition measures for operating railway tracks and thoroughly train workers
▶ Deploy a signalman or train watchman when working near operating railways
▶ Provide personal protective equipment and safety portable items (train-watch radio, whistle, alarm, flashlight) and check wearing status

578.재해개요: Around July 2016, on the central road in front of building 102 at the OO Co., Ltd. OO apartment new construction site, a stack of gypsum board materials being unloaded by forklift fell onto the victim (a stone work foreman) who was passing by, and he died.
578.재해유발요인: During unloading work using a forklift at a cargo truck bed, the moment the forklift forcibly lifted materials with the forks not fully inserted under the materials, the forklift overturned and struck the victim passing behind the cargo truck
578.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a work plan for material handling machinery in advance and implement measures such as prohibiting worker approach in cargo falling hazard sections
▶ If the loading condition is poor before cargo unloading and unloading with a forklift is difficult, avoid forced unloading and review other unloading methods such as cranes

579.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO bridge repair work site, a victim (a general laborer) belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd. was performing unloading and transport work with sacks containing abrasive material suspended from the forklift forks, when the forklift overturned and his neck was crushed against the forklift head guard, and he died.
579.재해유발요인: With a material sack hung on the forklift forks and the forks raised, the moment the forklift reversed and turned, eccentric loading occurred and the forklift overturned, and the victim's neck was caught in the forklift head guard
579.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before vehicle-type material handling machinery work, inspect the ground and environmental conditions of the work section through a preliminary survey and work plan establishment
▶ During vehicle-type material handling machinery work, check the operator's seat belt wearing, license possession, etc.

580.재해개요: Around July 2018, at the OO new construction site of OO General Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was performing material unloading and transport work on the carriage of a moving lift (a so-called ladder truck) installed near the 9th-floor windows, when he lost balance and fell about 25.7m onto the working platform on the 2nd level of the external scaffold below and died.
580.재해유발요인: While performing painting work on a ladder truck, the upper guardrail of the aerial work platform came off, and the worker lost balance and fell
580.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit use of moving-service ladder trucks other than their intended purpose
▶ Prohibit workers from riding on moving-service ladder trucks

581.재해개요: Around August 2018, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO factory extension construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., two panel installers were standing on the wall-fixing steel frame, holding a wall urethane panel (length 9m × width 1m, thickness 75mm, weight 125kg) rigged crosswise with two lines to a mobile crane, and fitting it into the groove between panels, when the lifting hook (rebar D10, L=25cm, J-shaped) of one rigging line on the panel came off; the panel lurched and swung toward the other rigging line, and the remaining hook immediately came off as well; the panel fell to the ground (9m) and then toppled to the left, striking the face and chest of the victim (a panel installer), who was preparing panel lifting on the ground, and he died.
581.재해유발요인: During mobile crane work, in the process of lifting materials rigged to a hook without a safety latch, the materials came off the hook and fell, striking the victim
581.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before work, select equipment placement sections and plan rigging methods for heavy-load handling through a preliminary survey and work plan establishment
▶ When lifting materials with a crane in situations with poor visibility, establish an appropriate signal system in advance
▶ When lifting materials, install detachment-prevention devices such as hook safety latches and check normal operation, and have the supervisor inspect the connection condition with the lifted object before lifting
▶ When lifting materials with a crane, use an appropriate rigging method according to the shape and material characteristics of the lifted object
▶ During lifting work, implement measures prohibiting worker entry within the working radius where lifted objects may fall

582.재해개요: Around April 2020, a victim belonging to OO Co., Ltd. drove a 4.5-ton truck to deliver insulation materials to the Gajwa manure treatment facility expansion work site; after arriving, while performing unloading work on top of the truck's load (insulation materials), he lost balance and fell about 2m to the ground and died.
582.재해유발요인: During material unloading work on top of a truck cargo bed, the materials the victim was standing on tilted, and he lost balance and fell to the ground
582.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a work plan in advance for vehicle-type material handling machinery
▶ Prohibit reckless climbing onto cargo beds or materials during material unloading, and if boarding is unavoidable, take fall prevention measures such as installing safety harness anchorage facilities before boarding
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment wearing status

583.재해개요: Around May 2019, at a new construction (livestock barn) site being built directly by an individual, the victim, a vehicle driver belonging to the roofing material (color steel sheet) supplier, was helping with the unloading work of the barn roofing materials when he fell to the concrete floor together with the roofing materials (H: about 1.02m) and died.
583.재해유발요인: During material unloading work on top of a truck cargo bed, the victim missed his footing and fell
583.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a work plan in advance for vehicle-type material handling machinery
▶ Prohibit reckless climbing onto cargo beds or materials during material unloading, and if boarding is unavoidable, take fall prevention measures such as installing safety harness anchorage facilities before boarding
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment wearing status

584.재해개요: Around December 2015, at an automobile-related facility new construction site being built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (a panel assembler) was performing panel installation work with three coworkers on the upper roof (height: about 7.6m), when his left wrist became entangled in the rope used for panel lifting; he was momentarily dragged up by the mobile crane and then fell to the ground (height: about 9.6m) and died.
584.재해유발요인: While working on a roof, the victim's wrist became wound in a lifting rope and he was momentarily dragged up by the mobile crane, then fell to the ground
584.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a work plan before work and build a signal system between the operator and signalman so communication is possible at any time
▶ Install safety facilities to prevent worker falls before work such as lifting at high locations 
▶ For lifting work at high locations, apply safe work methods per the established work plan to suit site conditions, and perform work considering weather conditions
▶ When lifting materials using fiber ropes, implement measures preventing snagging on the body, clothing, etc.

585.재해개요: In January 2016, at a rowhouse rooftop sandwich panel installation work site, two victims boarded a work platform connected to the boom head of a cargo crane for flashing work, the finishing work of the sandwich panel installation; while the work platform on the cargo crane boom head was ascending, at a height of 11m, the boom head and work platform separated, and they fell together with the work platform; one died and one was injured.
585.재해유발요인: While raising a work platform (man-riding equipment) connected and installed on a mobile crane, the boom head and the platform separated because the platform's anti-detachment pin was not fastened, and the victim fell together with it
585.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before deploying construction machinery such as mobile cranes, check inspection certificates, etc. to verify any illegal modification
▶ When attaching a riding platform to a mobile crane, check the connection pin engagement between the riding platform and the underside of the jib bracket, and check the outriggers and safety devices for abnormalities before starting work
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities at a separate location within the work space, not on the work platform, and supervise so workers can attach safety harnesses during work
▶ Use aerial work platforms that have received safety certification and safety inspection whenever possible

586.재해개요: Around May 2016, at the OO installation work site built by OO, the victim, together with a coworker on an aerial work platform, was lifting a urethane panel with a mobile crane for panel installation, when, due to insufficient clamping force of the vise grips attached to both sides of the panel, the panel fell onto the aerial work platform, striking the victim, who then secondarily fell from the aerial work platform (H≒6.3m) to the 1st-floor ground and died.
586.재해유발요인: While lifting materials with a mobile crane, the load came loose due to poor rigging and fell, striking the victim aboard an aerial work platform, who then fell to the ground
586.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before lifting finishing materials such as panels using a mobile crane, establish a work plan and select and use appropriate lifting tools
▶ Conduct special training for related workers on rigging methods, prohibition of vise-grip plier use, etc.
▶ During mobile crane lifting work, implement access prohibition measures in sections where lifted objects may fall, and supervise so that work does not overlap with other work types
▶ Install guardrails on the platform of the aerial work platform and implement fall prevention measures such as worker safety harness attachment

587.재해개요: Around November 2016, at a logistics center new construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was installing panels and window frames on the 2nd-floor exterior wall, and in the process of moving sideways a work platform hoisted with sling belts using a cargo crane, the victim came off the work platform and fell to the exterior ground on the 1st floor (height about 7.3m) and died.
587.재해유발요인: While installing exterior panels from a work platform lifted by crane, the platform swayed and the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
587.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work at height, replace unstable work methods using lifting machinery and proceed with work after deploying aerial work platforms, etc.
▶ Provide safety harnesses to workers for work at height and supervise wearing

588.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO factory export-side line relocation mixer section 2nd-floor extension construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim boarded an excavator bucket (0.6m3) and rose to a height of about 1.6m, and while drilling into the wall, he lost balance and fell to the ground (h≒1.6m) and died.
588.재해유발요인: While riding in an excavator bucket performing wall drilling work, the victim lost balance due to work vibration and fell to the ground
588.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using an excavator, prohibit workers from riding in or working from the bucket, and when work at height is required, install aerial work platforms, mobile scaffolds, etc. for the work
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

589.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO Co., Ltd. interior repair work site, four workers boarded a mobile crane man basket to perform roof panel waterproofing (silicone) work; while the jib was being raised to move to the work location, the man basket detached from the jib bracket and fell to the ground (H≒13m); three died and one was injured.
589.재해유발요인: While raising a work platform (man-riding equipment) connected and installed on a mobile crane, the boom head and the platform separated because the platform's anti-detachment pin was not fastened, and the victim fell together with it
589.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before deploying construction machinery such as mobile cranes, check inspection certificates, etc. to verify any illegal modification
▶ When attaching a riding platform to a mobile crane, check the connection pin engagement between the riding platform and the underside of the jib bracket, and check the outriggers and safety devices for abnormalities before starting work
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities at a separate location within the work space, not on the work platform, and supervise so workers can attach safety harnesses during work
▶ Use aerial work platforms that have received safety certification and safety inspection whenever possible

590.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO building storage yard, in order to load utility poles onto the bed of a mobile crane, the victim bound the middle section of 2 utility poles (744kg) stacked on the yard floor with wire rope (single-line rigging), hooked it to the mobile crane hook, then stepped back 3M and was watching the poles being lifted, when the crane's lifting wire rope (?8mm) severed; the pole, standing at 60°, toppled toward the victim, and he was struck on the head by the end of the pole and died.
590.재해유발요인: During lifting work with a mobile crane with a utility pole tied with wire rope, the wire rope could not withstand the load and broke, and the utility pole came loose and struck the worker
590.위험성감소대책:
▶ When setting down a load being lifted, remove wire ropes, etc. only when no tension is applied
▶ Before work, check lifting equipment and lifting ropes for defects and perform function inspections

591.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the OO construction, the victim was operating an excavator down a slope (grade about 32°) when the excavator overturned and he was crushed under the excavator and died.
591.재해유발요인: While the excavator was moving on stairs (a ramp), it overturned and the excavator operator (or a worker) was crushed
591.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit excavator movement onto steep slopes and sharp turns (refer to the equipment specification chart)
▶ The operator shall wear a seat belt and work with the cab door closed

592.재해개요: Around May 2017, at a security light installation work site, the victim was lifting a utility pole with a truck-mounted mobile crane to load it, when the boom broke and fell, striking the victim, and he died.
592.재해유발요인: After hoisting a utility pole with a mobile crane, during loading, the boom broke and fell, striking the worker
592.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy loads, establish worker exclusion zones in locations at risk of falling objects
▶ Immediately stop work when cracks or similar caused by repeated loads are identified by visual inspection before work
▶ Conduct thorough periodic safety inspections of the mobile crane

593.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OO construction, the victim was moving toward the rear of an excavator when he was caught between the rotating rear of the excavator body and a concrete structure and died.
593.재해유발요인: While moving to remove work cables, the victim was crushed between the excavator and a structure due to the excavator's rotation
593.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with crushing hazards, implement measures prohibiting worker entry within the hazardous working radius by establishing worker work zones
▶ Implement safety measures by inspecting rear camera operation before excavator work

594.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the OO construction, the victim and others laid a messenger wire on the road surface for cable road-crossing work and were holding the messenger wire at the median strip and road shoulder, when the messenger wire caught on a traveling 1-ton vehicle; one person fell over and was injured, and one person was struck by a following vehicle and died.
594.재해유발요인: While supporting a messenger wire for cable road-crossing work, the messenger wire was caught by a 1-ton vehicle, and the workers holding the wire fell over — one fell off the road, and one was struck by a following vehicle
594.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with vehicle collision risk, implement safety protection measures such as controlling worker activity and movement on vehicle travel routes and deploying a spotter
▶ Prohibit vehicle traffic and access within the work range during messenger wire work
    - Establish plans such as vehicle movement routes after checking in advance for interference within the working radius

595.재해개요: Around January 2019, at the OO construction, the victim climbed onto an excavator bucket and was fixing flexible conduit to a utility pole, when the bucket detached and he fell to the ground (H≒5m) and died.
595.재해유발요인: After climbing onto an excavator bucket and performing flexible conduit fixing work on a utility pole, the bucket detached and the victim fell to the ground together with it
595.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit use of construction machinery other than its purpose (the excavator bucket is not for riding)
▶ Use construction machinery suited to the purpose - aerial work platform (truck-mounted)
▶ Engage the quick coupler or detachment-prevention pin on the excavator

596.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the OO construction, the victim was moving along the side of the tracks toward the work location when he was struck from behind by an approaching electric train (K485) and died.
596.재해유발요인: At a construction site for partial removal of aged optical cable and new optical cable installation, after a meeting for work coordination ended, while returning to the work point along the side of the tracks, the victim was struck by an electric train (K485) approaching from behind
596.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work adjacent to tracks, proceed with night work when there is no train movement as a principle
▶ When daytime work is unavoidable, implement collision prevention measures by restricting work during train passage and deploying a train watchman

597.재해개요: Around February 2021, at the OO construction, during utility pole installation work, the boom of the mobile crane lifting the utility pole broke, and the victim was struck by the falling load (utility pole) and died.
597.재해유발요인: During utility pole installation for power supply, the boom of the mobile crane lifting the pole broke and fell, striking the victim
597.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using a mobile crane, adjust and inspect in advance so that the overload prevention device, etc. operate normally
▶ When performing lifting work with a mobile crane, perform work within a range not exceeding the critical load value
▶ Deploy a dedicated signalman during heavy-load handling work using a crane and inform related workers of consistent signal methods
▶ Control worker entry beneath the work area when lifting heavy loads with a crane

598.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO safety clearance securing work site, the victim was at the material storage yard putting tower assembly bolts (M15×60) into sacks, when, right beside him, a tower main leg member (L=8m, 500kg) being lifted with wire rope (Ø16mm) hooked to an excavator quick coupler hook fell (H≒6m) and struck the victim.
598.재해유발요인: While lifting a transmission tower main post member with an excavator, the wire rope came off and the tower main post member fell
598.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement access prohibition measures within the excavator working radius and deploy a signalman
▶ Secure safety measures during hoisting work with an excavator
  - Prepare a heavy-load lifting plan
  - Install a hook safety latch
  - Verify the excavator's lifting capacity (excavator specification chart)
