▶ Install safety devices on the lower work platform to prevent collision with bridge structures
▶ Provide safety harnesses and install safety harness anchorage facilities when using aerial work platforms

674.재해개요: In November 2019, at a pedestrian overpass installation site, the victim was on an aerial work platform doing lower-section painting repair work when a bus approaching the aerial work platform work zone collided with it, and he fell 4.6 m to the ground below, resulting in death.
674.재해유발요인: While a worker aboard an aerial work platform was performing paint repair work under a steel bridge, an approaching bus collided with the platform, and the worker fell to the road surface
674.위험성감소대책:
▶ Wear a safety harness in preparation for falls from the aerial work platform
▶ Provide safety harnesses and install safety harness anchorage facilities when using aerial work platforms

675.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the OO tunnel of the OO roadbed construction project constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, belonging to a lining work subcontractor, was moving toward the tunnel end-point entrance when he was struck by a reversing truck and died.
675.재해유발요인: At a site with no worker safety passage installed, a worker moving toward the tunnel end-point entrance was contacted by a reversing truck
675.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safe passages for workers around and inside the work site
▶ Control worker entry and deploy a spotter to prevent contact with vehicle-type construction machinery

676.재해개요: Around September 2019, during tunnel construction work, the victim was coupling mine cars used for muck removal when his head was caught between the mine cars and he died.
676.재해유발요인: After finishing unloading a battery car (in-tunnel storage battery locomotive) inside the tunnel and moving toward the vertical shaft, the battery car the worker himself had been operating moved, and he was caught between the steel wheel under the transport bogie and the rail
676.위험성감소대책:
▶ When the battery car operator leaves the driver's seat, implement runaway prevention measures such as securely engaging the brake
▶ When loading materials on the battery car, confirm the secured condition before moving
▶ Inspect the vehicle's braking system for abnormalities in advance before work

677.재해개요: Around September 2018, at a metro railway construction site, the victim was doing rebar oxygen cutting work when he was run over by the rear crawler track of an excavator and died.
677.재해유발요인: With visibility not secured, a nearby worker was run over by a reversing vehicle-type construction machine
677.위험성감소대책:
▶ When workers perform work close to construction machinery, assign spotters so work proceeds under safe conditions
▶ Prohibit worker entry and assign spotters when using construction machinery in places with contact potential and high blind-spot potential
▶ Separate worker and equipment routes during construction equipment work
▶ Attach cameras, or rear sensors and alarm devices, etc. notifying worker approach to the rear
▶ Conduct safety inspection before vehicle-type construction machinery work and check protective devices such as rear cameras

678.재해개요: Around June 2020, at a power cable tunnel work site, the victim was moving toward the vertical shaft when he was caught between the lower steel wheel of the transport cart he was operating and the rail, and died.
678.재해유발요인: After finishing unloading a battery car (in-tunnel storage battery locomotive) inside the tunnel and moving toward the vertical shaft, the battery car the worker himself had been operating moved, and he was caught between the steel wheel under the transport bogie and the rail
678.위험성감소대책:
▶ When the battery car operator leaves the driver's seat, implement runaway prevention measures such as securely engaging the brake
▶ When loading materials on the battery car, confirm the secured condition before moving
▶ Inspect the vehicle's braking system for abnormalities in advance before work

679.재해개요: Around August 2017, at a sewage pipe maintenance work site, the victim was doing vehicle guidance work when he was caught between material being lifted and a truck bed and died.
679.재해유발요인: While guiding the loading of sheet piles stacked on the ground from atop the cargo bed, the victim was caught between the lifted sheet pile and the cargo compartment partition wall, then fell to the ground
679.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during heavy-object handling work
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan

680.재해개요: Around November 2017, at a complex building new construction site, the victim was dismantling a Cross Beam (H-section steel) used to reinforce temporary struts on the ground-floor slab when, while the dismantled Cross Beam from the 1st floor was being lowered suspended on a rope at the basement 2nd floor ramp, the rope broke and the beam struck him, resulting in death.
680.재해유발요인: While dismantling a cross beam for temporary strut reinforcement using a damaged rope, the dismantled cross beam being lowered on the rope broke loose when the rope snapped and struck the worker
680.위험성감소대책:
▶ Check the condition of equipment to be used for heavy-load hoisting work in advance before use
▶ Prohibit use of or replace severely damaged or corroded fiber ropes, etc.

681.재해개요: Around March 2016, at the materials storage yard of the OO construction project of OO Enterprise Co., Ltd., the victim, a civil temporary-works installer belonging to a subcontractor, placed a corner pile on top of a wedge pile and was lowering his head to grab the detached lifting hook when the corner pile toppled over onto him, and he was caught between previously stacked sheet piles and died.
681.재해유발요인: After placing a corner pile on top of a wedge pile and while grabbing the released lifting hook, the corner pile toppled over onto the worker, crushing him between the sheet piles
681.위험성감소대책:
▶ Stack materials according to material stacking standards and constantly inspect the stacking condition 
▶ Prohibit entering and working directly within a working radius with crushing hazards

682.재해개요: Around January 2018, at an apartment building new construction site, the victim was signaling PHC pile unloading work in front of a payloader when, during the pile unloading work, he fell between piles rolling on the support timbers, and his face was caught and crushed between the piles, resulting in death.
682.재해유발요인: A worker signaling PHC pile unloading work fell between a pile rolling on the support blocks and another pile during pile unloading, and his face was caught between the piles
682.위험성감소대책:
▶ For ceiling work, perform with appropriate work methods, installing suitable working platforms such as scaffolds and aerial work platforms 
▶ Conduct a preliminary survey of the structure to be demolished before work 
▶ Prepare and comply with a work plan including drawings of the demolition method and sequence, and methods for temporary facilities, protective facilities, ventilation facilities, and water spraying and fire prevention facilities

683.재해개요: Around January 2021, at the OO apartment building new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., while a worker was moving a PHC pile to the service hole, the wire rope rigging of the PHC pile slipped out, and the victim (form carpenter), who was doing formwork for a nearby tower crane foundation, was crushed under the pile and died.
683.재해유발요인: While moving foundation pile materials using an excavator, the wire rope came off the hook and the worker was struck by a steel plate
683.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access and assign spotters during vehicle-type construction machinery work
▶ When handling heavy objects, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor to work in accordance with the work plan
▶ When lifting heavy objects, avoid single-line rigging and comply with safe heavy-object handling methods (two-line rigging)

684.재해개요: Around November 2017, at a sewage pipe maintenance work site constructed by OO Construction, the victim, a signalman controlling external vehicle traffic at the site, was passing around the side and behind an excavator (02) that was doing backfilling and road surface grading when his legs were run over by the right rear wheel of the reversing excavator, resulting in death.
684.재해유발요인: With visibility not secured, a nearby worker was run over by a reversing vehicle-type construction machine
684.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with vehicle-type construction machinery, assign spotters and control personnel within the working radius 
▶ Attach sensors detectable by the operator and install alarm equipment for vehicle reversing

685.재해개요: Around December 2016, at a metro railway construction site constructed by OO Construction, the victim was lifting a strut using an excavator (0.6 m3) with a beam clamp (haka) on a single line when the strut struck the center pile, detached from the beam clamp, and fell, crushing the victim, who was holding the strut, resulting in death.
685.재해유발요인: While lifting a strut suspended by a beam clamp (haka) with a single line using an excavator, the strut struck the center pile and came off the beam clamp (haka), falling and crushing the worker who was holding the strut
685.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with the heavy-load handling work plan and lift struts with two-line rigging for installation 
▶ Install lifting lugs on the strut for lifting, install guide ropes, and work as far away from workers as possible
▶ Improve strut lifting work methods, such as lifting using shackles on the strut (flange), etc.

686.재해개요: Around March 2020, at an apartment new construction site, the victim was installing permanent anchor PC panels when the support prop behind a panel broke and the panel toppled over, crushing him to death.
686.재해유발요인: During PC retaining wall panel installation, an unsecured PC panel toppled over and crushed the worker
686.위험성감소대책:
▶ When temporarily placing P.C panels, prohibit work beneath unfixed panels or implement overturning prevention measures such as temporary fixing
▶ Use construction methods with secured safety (such as preceding aggregate backfilling)
▶ When transporting and installing heavy loads, prepare a work plan and perform work according to the plan

687.재해개요: Around July 2020, the victim (OOO), belonging to OOOO Co., Ltd., was installing steel plates on the upper surface of an excavated section for dump truck passage at the water supply connection pipeline work site of a neighborhood living facility construction project when the sling belt binding the steel plate to the excavator broke, and he was crushed under the steel plate and died.
687.재해유발요인: While installing steel plates over the excavation section for dump truck passage, the sling belt securing the steel plate to the excavator broke, and the victim was crushed under the steel plate
687.위험성감소대책:
▶ Check sling belts for deterioration before work and replace immediately if unusable
▶ When hoisting lifted objects, comply with wrapping sling belts and securely fixing with shackles, etc. before hoisting
▶ During lifting work, deploy a work supervisor and a dedicated signalman so the lifted object is not positioned over or passing over workers' heads

688.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OOOO drainage channel maintenance work site located in OO-eup, OO City, OOOO Province, the victim, who was installing concrete waterway pipes (size: 1500B, length: 2 m), was attaching a rigging sling belt to lift a waterway pipe stacked on top of the existing earthen drainage channel when the pipe slipped and toppled over, and the victim's chest was crushed between the edge of the concrete-paved road and the waterway pipe, resulting in death. This was a fatal accident.
688.재해유발요인: While loading steel pipes lifted by a crane onto a vehicle, the steel pipes, unstably stacked in 3 tiers, collapsed and the victim was crushed under the steel pipes.
688.위험성감소대책:
▶ When stockpiling materials, stack them on flat ground and take rolling prevention measures
▶ Use wedges, etc. to secure hume pipes on slopes
▶ Prohibit excessive stacking of steel pipes such as three or more tiers

689.재해개요: Around January 2019, at the "OOOO development project" site located in OO-myeon, OO City, OOO Province, OOO, a directly employed worker, fixed a sling belt to a concrete manhole (1.2 x 1.2 x 1 m, 2.4 tons) for drainage pipeline installation work, hooked it to an excavator hook, and was dragging and moving it when the manhole fell down below the excavated slope of the drainage pipeline (H=1.3 m) and struck the head of the victim, who was doing ground leveling work below the excavation face, resulting in death. This was a fatal accident.
689.재해유발요인: While hanging a sling belt on a manhole and pulling and moving it using an excavator, the manhole fell down the excavation slope and crushed a worker below
689.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy loads, comply with the excavator's rated load and prohibit excessive heavy-load lifting
▶ Control worker entry into the work area when using vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Deploy a spotter to guide vehicle-type construction machinery

690.재해개요: Around October 2019, at an apartment construction site constructed by OOOO Co., Ltd., located in OO-dong, OO City, OOO Province, the victim, belonging to OOOO Co., Ltd., was installing a sewage manhole structure when the P.E (Poly-Ethylene) rope connected to the excavator hook broke, and the falling sewage manhole structure struck him in the chest, resulting in death. This was a fatal accident.
690.재해유발요인: During manhole lifting and installation work with an excavator, the lifting rigging broke and the victim was struck by the falling manhole
690.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install barriers, etc. to prevent unauthorized worker entry into fall hazard locations
▶ Install worker movement passages or safe passages such as temporary stairs for moving to pipe-laying locations

691.재해개요: Around February 2021, at the "OOOO establishment project" site located in OO-myeon, OO County, OOO Province, a worker belonging to OO Co., Ltd. was performing a leak test (air pressure test) after installing a water supply pipe (D=200 mm) when he was struck (in the face) by a leak-test connection pipe section dislodged by the internal pipe pressure (about 0.7 MPa), resulting in death. This was a fatal accident.
691.재해유발요인: While performing a leak test (air pressure test) after installing a water supply pipe, the victim was struck by the leak-test connection pipe section that was ejected by internal pipe pressure
691.위험성감소대책:
▶ Assign a supervisor to conduct safety inspections of machinery, tools, or facilities and check for abnormalities
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment appropriate to the situation in preparation for sudden rupture during pipeline internal pressurization

692.재해개요: Around January 2016, at the OO machinery and equipment demolition work site, the victim dismantled the fixing bolts installed on an overhead crane runway beam (H-700x300x13x24) and was moving to the location where the hoisting equipment was installed when he lost his balance and fell to the ground-level concrete floor (H of about 8.94 m), resulting in death.
692.재해유발요인: The victim, who was not wearing a safety harness, lost balance while moving on top of a steel beam and fell to the ground
692.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

693.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO demolition site, the victim was moving along the top of a steel beam (width 20 cm) on the 3rd floor during demolition work when he lost his balance and fell about 8 m to the ground floor below, resulting in death.
693.재해유발요인: The victim, who was not wearing a safety harness, lost balance while moving on top of a steel beam and fell to the ground
693.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

694.재해개요: Around January 2017, at the OO demolition work site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., while a crusher-mounted excavator (0.8 m3, 21.0 ton) was demolishing stairwell walls from the 1st floor slab, the 1st floor slab, unable to withstand the dead load and work load of the excavator and demolition debris, collapsed down to the basement 2nd floor, and the victim, who was doing water spraying work on the 1st floor, was buried and died.
694.재해유발요인: During demolition work, the slab collapsed due to impact or the load of waste materials, and the worker fell and was crushed
694.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct a structural review, then establish a work plan including appropriate demolition methods and sequence
▶ Reinforce with jack supports below the working floor, installing a structurally sufficient number of jack supports at appropriate locations
▶ Establish a demolition plan after reviewing the stability of the building, such as cracks, concrete strength, rebar arrangement, and degree of aging

695.재해개요: Around February 2017, at the OO work site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., during work to demolish interior facilities remaining in a store that had ceased operation, sparks from torch cutting work spread to combustible materials, causing a fire, and the victim died.
695.재해유발요인: During demolition of interior facilities, sparks from flame-cutting work spread to nearby combustible materials, causing a fire
695.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement fire prevention measures such as placing fire extinguishers, installing spark-prevention covers, and organizing and removing combustible materials
▶ Keep firefighting equipment on hand and frequently inspect its operation

696.재해개요: Around February 2017, at the OO demolition site, during work to lower power cables from an overhead crane inspection walkway to the factory floor using a forklift and synthetic fiber rope, the victim was struck below the head by the end of a power cable that was swinging due to recoil, resulting in death.
696.재해유발요인: While walking at a demolition work site, the victim was struck by demolition debris falling from above
696.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly organize and tidy the site, such as removing obstacles from worker movement passages
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

697.재해개요: Around November 2017, at the OO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., during demolition work on a 2nd-floor masonry wall inside a prayer house, the victim was crushed under the toppling masonry wall and died.
697.재해유발요인: During wall demolition work, a masonry wall toppled over and crushed the victim
697.위험성감소대책:
▶ Identify in advance the members and structures already fixed (walls, etc.)
▶ Prohibit worker entry within the working radius
▶ Perform crushing work sequentially from top to bottom

698.재해개요: Around March 2018, inside Building B at the OO demolition work site, the victim, after torch-cutting a steel column with oxygen-LPG, was moving toward the outside of the building when he was crushed under the collapsing steel structure and died.
698.재해유발요인: At a demolition site, after flame-cutting a steel column with oxygen-LPG, while moving to the outside of the building, the victim was crushed by the collapsing steel structure
698.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prepare a work plan including the demolition method and sequence considering the structure's shape, weight, etc.

699.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO demolition work site, the victim, after checking the work status to see how far the 3rd-floor demolition work had progressed, was coming down the stairs when he was struck by masonry blocks, which were demolition debris, resulting in death.
699.재해유발요인: While walking at a demolition work site, the victim was struck by demolition debris falling from above
699.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly organize and tidy the site, such as removing obstacles from worker movement passages
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

700.재해개요: Around April 2018, part of the upper wall of a building structure (block wall) fell, and the victim, who was doing clearing work below, was crushed under the collapsing temporary building and died.
700.재해유발요인: During wall demolition work, a masonry wall toppled over and crushed the victim
700.위험성감소대책:
▶ Identify in advance the members and structures already fixed (walls, etc.)
▶ Prohibit worker entry within the working radius
▶ Perform crushing work sequentially from top to bottom

701.재해개요: Around July 2018, at the OO demolition work site, the victim was resting outside a masonry wall of the factory building when part of the masonry wall, which was connected to the steel ceiling truss of the factory building, toppled over, and he was crushed under the masonry wall and died.
701.재해유발요인: During wall demolition work, a masonry wall toppled over and crushed the victim
701.위험성감소대책:
▶ Identify in advance the members and structures already fixed (walls, etc.)
▶ Prohibit worker entry within the working radius
▶ Perform crushing work sequentially from top to bottom

702.재해개요: Around August 2018, at the OO steel tower demolition site, the victim was dismantling a steel column when, the moment the last bolt at the joint was removed, the upper and lower column bases suddenly spread apart, his safety harness U-hook slipped out through the gap, and he fell 10 m to the ground below, resulting in death.
702.재해유발요인: At a communication tower demolition site, during joint bolt dismantling work for tower demolition, the moment the last bolt was removed, the upper and lower column bases spread apart, and the U-hook safety lanyard slipped through the gap, and the victim fell to the ground
702.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-protection nets and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Prepare a steel frame demolition work plan

703.재해개요: Around November 2019, at the OO factory demolition work site, the victim was cutting the handrail on top of the girder of a gantry crane placed on the ground, for its dismantling and removal, when he fell 3 m below and died.
703.재해유발요인: While installing exterior panels from a work platform lifted by crane, the platform swayed and the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
703.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work at height, replace unstable work methods using lifting machinery and proceed with work after deploying aerial work platforms, etc.
▶ Provide safety harnesses to workers for work at height and supervise wearing

704.재해개요: Around May 2020, at the OO ancillary work site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., while previously installed ceiling urethane panels were being dismantled from inside the 1st-floor ceiling for elevator installation inside the factory, a portion of a urethane panel (L of about 30 cm) was cut, and two victims fell simultaneously, together with the panel that had lost its anchorage, to the 1st-floor concrete floor (H of about 6.0 m), sustaining injuries requiring more than 3 months of medical care.
704.재해유발요인: During roof demolition work, while dismantling and transporting dismantled materials, the roof panel the victim was standing on was damaged and gave way, and he fell to the ground
704.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install a roof ladder fabricated with sufficient strength and specifications
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets
▶ Review the appropriateness of work methods, such as using aerial work platforms and mobile scaffolds

705.재해개요: Around July 2020, at the OO new construction site, six victims were dismantling the severely deteriorated (corroded) 2nd-floor slab rebar when the formwork shores, unable to withstand the load of the rebar stacked on the slab formwork, collapsed, and they fell to the 1st floor (about 3.6 m), sustaining injuries requiring more than 3 months of medical care.
705.재해유발요인: While dismantling rebar of an aged floor slab, the formwork shores could not withstand the load of the rebar stacked on the formwork and collapsed, and the victim fell to the ground
705.위험성감소대책:
▶ When resuming construction on structures where work has been suspended for a long period, conduct a safety assessment of the facilities
▶ When assembling formwork shores, thoroughly fix the top and bottom and take reinforcement measures such as assembling diagonal members

706.재해개요: Around August 2020, at the OO major repair work site, the victim was on the upper working platform of a mobile scaffold doing torch cutting work on a purlin (purlin: a member connecting roof trusses, serving as a support for roofing materials) (C-section steel) when the cut purlin bent and struck the mobile scaffold, and with the impact he lost his balance and fell to the (concrete) floor (H of about 6.0 m), resulting in death.
706.재해유발요인: While flame-cutting C-channel steel for purlins on top of a mobile scaffold, the cut steel member bent and struck the mobile scaffold; the impact caused the victim to lose balance and fall to the ground
706.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement overturning prevention measures such as installing mobile scaffold outriggers and guardrails
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

707.재해개요: Around August 2020, at the OO demolition work site, the victim had climbed onto the steel roof frame of a factory and was demolishing exterior wall sandwich panels when he lost his balance and fell to the ground-level concrete floor (h of about 7.0 m), resulting in death.
707.재해유발요인: The victim, who was not wearing a safety harness, lost balance while moving on top of a steel beam and fell to the ground
707.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

708.재해개요: Around November 2020, at the OO factory new construction site, the victim, in order to dismantle an incorrectly installed steel column of an external stairwell (length: 13 m, weight: 800 kg), climbed onto the upper bracket of the column (height: 12 m, width: 150 mm) and was performing rigging work with a mobile crane (25-ton, hydraulic) (fastening the shackle of a belt sling) when the steel column toppled over; he lost his balance and fell about 12 m to the floor below, resulting in death.
708.재해유발요인: While climbing onto the upper bracket of a steel column to perform mobile crane rigging work for dismantling the column, the steel column, which had no anti-overturning measures, toppled over, and the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
708.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement measures to prevent overturning hazards of steel column structures
▶ Use methods such as assembling scaffolds or using aerial work platforms

709.재해개요: Around February 2021, at an apartment construction site of OO Construction, H-Beams were brought in for temporary fence installation, and while they were being unloaded from a cargo truck with a forklift, the stacked H-Beams fell, crushing two nearby victims; 1 died and 1 was injured.
709.재해유발요인: While unloading H-beam materials with a forklift for temporary fence installation, the stacked materials collapsed and fell onto a nearby worker
709.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control workers within the material handling working radius
▶ When working with vehicle-type material handling machinery, prepare a work plan and designate a work supervisor

710.재해개요: Around October 2021, at the OO new construction site, the victim, belonging to OO Co., Ltd., a temporary fence installation and dismantling subcontractor, was cutting the 6th H-beam (126 kg, 6 m) that day using a gas cutter for temporary fence removal when the beam toppled toward him, resulting in death.
710.재해유발요인: While cutting an H-beam with a gas cutter for temporary fence demolition, the beam toppled over toward the victim
710.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform flame-cutting work considering member recoil conditions, etc.
▶ When dismantling H-beams, implement overturning prevention measures considering the steel structure's self-weight, surrounding vibration, impact, etc.

711.재해개요: Around January 2017, at a lodging facility new construction site, in order to perform telescoping work on a tower crane (2.9 t, unmanned), a steel toolbox (1 m x 0.5 m x 0.6 m) was being lifted by the tower crane from the ground outside the building when the steel toolbox slipped out of the web slings (2-leg choke) and fell onto the victim below, striking his head and resulting in death.
711.재해유발요인: While lifting materials with a tower crane, the materials fell due to incomplete fastening between the materials and the sling belt, striking ground workers on the head and elsewhere
711.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly inspect the fastening condition between materials and sling belts during lifting work
▶ Implement accident prevention measures during lifting work, such as deploying a signalman, designating a work supervisor, and controlling worker entry

712.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO apartment new construction site, during hoisting of a concrete-placing hopper by tower crane for rooftop level and retaining wall concrete pouring, the victim, who was waiting on the rooftop level, failed to notice the descending concrete-placing hopper and was crushed between the bottom of the descending hopper and the top of the truss-support retaining wall, resulting in death.
712.재해유발요인: During lifting work of a concrete pouring hopper with a tower crane, a worker failed to notice the hopper and was crushed between the bottom of the hopper and the top of the truss support
712.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with a tower crane, perform work in compliance with the hopper capacity
▶ During tower crane work, deploy a signalman and use horn signals to prevent falling of the load being lifted
▶ Control worker entry beneath the working radius during tower crane lifting

713.재해개요: Around February 2016, the victim was attaching tape to products inside a shot-blasting factory when he was caught between a product being brought in by a forklift (7-ton) and a product already being worked on, and died.
713.재해유발요인: While transporting materials using a forklift, with visibility not secured, the worker was caught between the materials and the forklift
713.위험성감소대책:
▶ Deploy a spotter to guide vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Implement contact prevention measures against equipment such as installing rear cameras
▶ Secure forward visibility when loading cargo on forklift forks

714.재해개요: Around December 2015, at the sewage sludge treatment facility in the OO sewage treatment plant, the victim, a welder, during repair work on dryer unit B, attached a chain to the reducer on the left side of the dryer and was rotating the shaft in order to perform welding and cutting work on the shaft section inside the dryer when the drive chain broke, and a chain part (pin link) flew off and struck the victim's head, resulting in death.
714.재해유발요인: Piping and mechanical equipment chains installed above fell and broke due to deterioration, crushing and striking the victim working below
714.위험성감소대책:
▶ Workers placed within the hazard zone and no work supervisor deployed
▶ Perform work after securing sufficient tensile strength of the chain used according to the work content

715.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO equipment work site, the victim was doing waste material cleanup work (placing waste into vinyl sacks) on the 2nd-floor ceiling of the factory building when the ceiling broke and he fell 6.0 m to the stairwell floor below, resulting in death.
715.재해유발요인: While cleaning up waste materials on the factory building ceiling, the ceiling material broke and the victim fell to the floor together with the ceiling material
715.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing cleaning work on top of weak ceiling finishing materials, there is a fall hazard, so implement safety protection measures such as installing fall-protection nets and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ When working and moving on top of weak ceiling finishing materials, install appropriate lighting fixtures so workers do not misstep or trip

716.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the "OO factory" site constructed by OO, while the inside of the tubes of a dehydration heat exchanger (Glycol Dehydrator Reboiler) was being cleaned with high-pressure water, the spin part of the spray nozzle (lance) came off, and the spray nozzle was flung out of the tube by the water pressure, striking the victim's neck and resulting in death.
716.재해유발요인: During cleaning work with high-pressure water inside mechanical equipment, the nozzle was flung off by water pressure, striking the victim, who then fell over
716.위험성감소대책: ▶ Thoroughly maintain aged equipment in use and manage materials

717.재해개요: Around August 2016, at a bridge under-deck reinforcement work area, the victim (welder), belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd., was at the edge of a support member that had been transported by excavator and placed on a foundation structure, using a claw-type nail puller as a lever to move the lower horizontal member of the support, when the support toppled over and rotated, striking the victim and resulting in death.
717.재해유발요인: While moving the horizontal member at the bottom of a support frame for bridge underside reinforcement, the support frame toppled over and rotated, striking the victim
717.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a heavy-load handling work plan and designate a work supervisor
▶ Review sling belt connection points and movement methods to prevent material overturning

718.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OO Co., Ltd. steel tower inspection and repair work site, the victim was climbing the steel tower to clean the insulators at the end of the tower arm when he lost his balance and fell to the ground (H=10 m), resulting in death.
718.재해유발요인: While climbing a transmission tower on which no vertical lifeline rope was installed to clean the insulators at the end of the tower arm, the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
718.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities (vertical lifeline, fall arrester, Key Lock)
▶ Install a fall-prevention net beneath the steel tower

719.재해개요: Around January 2017, at the OO site, the victim was doing sludge removal (carry-out) work inside a tank for OO cleaning work at the OO factory when the over-cut sludge face collapsed, and he was buried under the sludge pile and died.
719.재해유발요인: While carrying out sludge from inside a tank for cleaning work, an over-cut sludge face collapsed, and the victim was buried in the sludge pile
719.위험성감소대책: ▶ Perform work safely so that sludge falling hazards do not arise from over-excavation

720.재해개요: Around June 2017, at the OO public rental housing construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., worker OOO, belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd., was carrying garbage out of the building from a scaffold working platform on the 4th floor when he was struck by a rebar (D10, length 2.4 m) that fell from the 8th floor, resulting in death.
720.재해유발요인: While carrying garbage out of the building on a scaffold working platform, the victim was struck by rebar falling from above
720.위험성감소대책:
▶ Measures to prevent hazards from falling objects
▶ Install storage boxes to prevent material dislodgement

721.재해개요: Around October 2018, at the OO new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim, belonging to a pre-completion cleaning company, collapsed on the living room floor around the island table inside an apartment unit and died.
721.재해유발요인: During pre-completion cleaning, the victim was found collapsed near the kitchen island table
721.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at high locations, install safe working platforms such as sawhorse scaffolds and perform the work
▶ Avoid ladder use during furniture cleaning work

722.재해개요: Around May 2020, at an interior work site for the relocation of OO, in the vestibule in front of the elevator, while floor protection paper was being tidied, a marble stone slab that had been stood against the wall toppled onto the victim, causing injury.
722.재해유발요인: In the process of tidying the floor protection sheets in front of the elevator, marble slabs leaning against the wall toppled over and struck the victim
722.위험성감소대책: ▶ Implement overturning prevention measures so that materials, etc. do not fall over

723.재해개요: Around March 2021, at an insulation work area, the victim was doing urethane spray foaming work on the upper slope of a tank for insulation work on an LPG tank block when the hook of the fiber rope of his work belt slipped out of the pulley block hook, and he fell from a height of about 22 m.
723.재해유발요인: During urethane spray foaming work on the sloped top of an LPG tank, the hook of the fiber rope of the work belt being worn slipped out of the pulley block hook, and the victim fell to the ground
723.위험성감소대책: ▶ Inspect safety harnesses and accessory equipment for abnormalities before starting work

724.재해개요: Around December 2021, at the storage yard of the OO work site constructed by OO, the victim was moving materials when a bundle of timber stacked in two tiers behind him (length 3.8 m, diameter 15 cm, 48 pieces of timber, weight about 1.3 tons) collapsed toward him, and he was crushed under the fallen timber and died.
724.재해유발요인: While moving materials, an overloaded bundle of lumber behind the victim toppled toward him and crushed him
724.위험성감소대책:
▶ When stockpiling materials, install chocks, wedges, etc. to prevent rolling off
▶ When stockpiling materials, arrange so that the load is evenly distributed

725.재해개요: Around June 2018, at the multi-unit house new construction site of OO Industry Co., Ltd., the victim was moving on the 3rd floor when he lost his balance and fell over, and was impaled on vertical rebar (wall) and died.
725.재해유발요인: With no protective measures against puncture by protruding rebar in place, while moving on the slab top floor, the worker stumbled, lost balance, fell over, and was impaled on vertical rebar (wall)
725.위험성감소대책:
▶ Secure safe passages, such as installing walkway platforms, so workers do not trip or slip at the work site
▶ Implement puncture protection measures such as installing rebar protective caps

726.재해개요: Around October 2018, at the OO redevelopment project new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, who had been placing a PC half slab onto a beam on the 1st floor (X11~X12, Y7~Y8), removed the lifting chain and was moving toward the center of the slab when the half slab fell off the beam, and he fell to the basement 1st floor (H=3.5 m), resulting in death.
726.재해유발요인: With no fall hazard prevention measures during PC structure assembly, after placing a PC half slab on a beam from the floor and dismantling the lifting chain, while moving to the center of the slab, the bearing length was too short due to construction tolerances and the half slab fell off the beam, causing the worker to fall
726.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling PC structures, check and adjust construction tolerances before work to prevent falling hazards
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses to prevent falls

727.재해개요: Around April 2017, at the OO officetel new construction site, one sheet of temporary site fencing (W550 x H6000 mm, 13 kg) was detached by wind and fell toward the victim, who was doing formwork in the basement 2nd-floor stairwell; the victim was struck by it and fell from the basement 2nd floor to the basement 3rd floor (H of about 4.95 m), resulting in death.
727.재해유발요인: With the temporary fence poorly secured, one sheet of the site temporary fence detached in the wind and struck a worker doing formwork on the basement stairwell, after which the worker fell
727.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing temporary fences, install using steel pipes, clamps, etc. to prevent material dislodgement
▶ For work with fall hazards, implement safety protection measures such as safety nets, guardrails, and safety harness anchorage facilities

728.재해개요: Around February 2018, at the OO Co., Ltd. work site constructed by an individual, the victim was moving on top of the steel frame for deck plate laying and welding work when he lost his balance and fell about 5.8 m to the floor below, resulting in death.
728.재해유발요인: With no fall prevention measures implemented, while moving on top of the steel frame for deck plate laying and welding work, the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
728.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with fall hazards, install fall-protection nets and guardrails or work after wearing a safety harness
▶ Install in compliance with guardrail installation standards and have the supervisor verify

729.재해개요: Around June 2021, the victim was standing on the topmost horizontal member of system shores in the basement 4th-floor mechanical parking area (H of about 8.75 m), transferring bolster members, when, the moment he received a piece of material and turned his body, he fell about 7.3 m to the concrete floor below and died.
729.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, while hanging onto basement-level column formwork and fixing flat ties and pins, the worker fell to the floor
729.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with fall risk such as work on top of columns, install platforms and guardrails, etc. using mobile scaffolds, etc.
▶ When working in fall-risk places such as formwork assembly work, implement fall protection measures such as installing fall-prevention nets and guardrails and wearing safety harnesses
▶ If guardrails, etc. must be temporarily dismantled, install fall-prevention nets between the scaffold and the building

730.재해개요: Around December 2015, at the OO high-speed railway site, two victims belonging to a subcontractor were dismantling the shores under the PC slab of the air duct (a passage used to circulate underground air) of a cross-adit tunnel connecting a vertical shaft and the main tunnel when the upper PC slab collapsed and buried them; 1 died and 1 was injured.
730.재해유발요인: With the concrete curing period not observed, while dismantling shores under the PC slab of the air duct (a passage for circulating underground air) of the cross-adit tunnel connecting the vertical shaft and the main tunnel, the PC slab above collapsed and crushed the victim
730.위험성감소대책:
▶ During shore dismantling work, proceed after structural reinforcement such as jack support installation to prevent slab collapse
▶ During shore dismantling work, review information such as the slab structure in advance and establish appropriate work methods before proceeding

731.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO detached house remodeling work site, the victim was removing the steel pipe shores supporting the underside of a concrete staircase poured one week earlier, for formwork dismantling work, when the staircase (H of about 3.6 m), whose curing was not complete, collapsed, and the victim's lower body was crushed underneath, resulting in death.
731.재해유발요인: With the concrete curing period not observed, while removing steel pipe shores supporting the underside of a concrete staircase for formwork dismantling work, the staircase, whose curing was not complete, collapsed and crushed the victim
731.위험성감소대책:
▶ During shore dismantling work, proceed after structural reinforcement such as jack support installation to prevent concrete collapse
▶ During shore dismantling work, review information such as the concrete structure in advance and establish appropriate work methods before proceeding
▶ Comply with the concrete curing period during shore dismantling work

732.재해개요: Around September 2020, at the OO site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, belonging to a subcontractor, was dismantling formwork on the external stairs of the 3rd floor of the practice building when steel members (4 H-section steels, L=9.2 m, total weight 3.3 tons) being lifted to the 3rd floor by mobile crane fell, and a vertical rebar (diameter 25 mm, L of about 1.5 m), bending under the impact, struck him on the head, resulting in death.
732.재해유발요인: With no falling object prevention measures implemented, during formwork dismantling work on the exterior stairs of a ground floor, a steel member being lifted to the same floor by mobile crane fell, and the impact bent vertical rebar, which struck the worker's head
732.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker entry in advance when lifting steel members with a mobile crane
▶ Deploy a work-control signalman during steel member lifting work in preparation for falling objects

733.재해개요: Around July 2016, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site constructed by OO Development Co., Ltd., the moment the victim stepped on a rebar bundle previously stacked on a gang form working platform serving as the passage to the pit on the 12th floor, the rebar bundle collapsed, and he fell 47 m to the concrete floor below, resulting in death.
733.재해유발요인: While stepping over a rebar bundle stacked on a gang form working platform being used as a passageway, the rebar bundle collapsed and the worker fell
733.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting materials, secure heavy-load stacking positions by work section considering the load the working platform can bear
▶ Install safety nets within every 10m of vertical distance from the working surface

734.재해개요: Around July 2016, at the OO cathedral new construction site, while a cargo truck driver was manually unloading rebar (1 bundle, D10 mm, L=8 m, 940 kg) from the truck bed, the victim, who was passing by the driver's seat, was struck on the head by the end of the falling rebar bundle, resulting in death.
734.재해유발요인: During unloading work at a truck cargo bed, unsecured cargo spilled and struck the worker
734.위험성감소대책:
▶ When stacking heavy materials such as rebar, stack on support plates with no risk of collapse, or stack within the maximum permissible load
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities for fall prevention measures and wear safety harnesses

735.재해개요: Around February 2016, on the 2nd floor, the top floor of Building OO at the OO officetel new construction site, the victim, belonging to a subcontractor, was signaling a rebar bundle being transported by tower crane when one side of the rebar carrier slipped out of the sling belt, and the rebar bundle loaded on the carrier struck the victim, resulting in death.
735.재해유발요인: While signaling a rebar bundle being transported by tower crane, one side of the rebar carrier came off the sling belt, and the rebar bundle loaded on the carrier struck the worker
735.위험성감소대책:
▶ When transporting rebar bundles with a tower crane, take safety measures so that the rebar bundle being transported does not pass over heads
▶ Verify before work that the work method and carrier are appropriate when performing work such as transporting rebar bundles with a tower crane 
▶ When handling heavy loads such as rebar bundles, prepare a plan for transport and other work and instruct that work be performed according to that plan

736.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the entrance of the OO apartment building new construction site, the victim, in order to lift and move a delivered rebar bundle into the site, rigged a crane to the steel wire at one end of the rebar bundle and lifted it, placed blocking under the rebar bundle, and was moving toward the end of the bundle when the bound steel wire came loose and the rebar bundle fell onto his head (h of about 1.7 m), resulting in death.
736.재해유발요인: While lifting a rebar bundle with a crane after tying the wire at one end of the bundle, the tied wire came loose and the rebar bundle fell onto the worker
736.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy loads, review work methods such as the heavy-load handling method and lifting equipment specifications
▶ Deploy a dedicated signalman and inform workers of consistent signal methods
▶ Control worker entry beneath the work when lifting heavy loads

737.재해개요: Around April 2017, at the OO hospital new construction site being built by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., while a rebar bundle (about 800 kg) fastened with fiber ropes (2-leg rigging) was being transported to the 8th floor using a crane (50-ton), one of the fiber ropes fastened at the edge slipped off, the center of gravity of the rebar bundle tilted, and about 400 kg of rebar fell at once, striking the victim directly below and resulting in death.
737.재해유발요인: While transporting a rebar bundle using a crane, the fiber rope fastened at the edge slipped off, the rebar bundle's center of gravity tilted, and it struck the worker
737.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker entry by establishing exclusion zones with safety fences, safety signs, etc. in falling-object hazard locations
▶ When fabricating rebar carriers, firmly fix the working platforms and square timbers
▶ When lifting carriers, insert sling belts sufficiently into the lower inner layer to secure the center of gravity

738.재해개요: Around November 2017, at the OOOO new construction site being built by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was sitting on a rebar bundle taking a rest at the 1st-floor rebar storage yard when a square timber (8 cm x 5 cm x 2,550 cm, about 9 kg) fell from the 4th floor (H of about 14.5 m) and struck him on the head, resulting in death.
738.재해유발요인: During formwork dismantling work on a ground floor, a piece of square timber fell and struck a worker resting at the rebar storage yard
738.위험성감소대책:
▶ When there is a risk of material falling due to formwork dismantling work, install falling-object prevention nets, vertical protection nets, or protective shelves
▶ Prohibit entry of workers other than related workers into the work site
▶ Install appropriate rest facilities

739.재해개요: Around April 2018, at a residential-commercial building new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., at the rebar fabrication yard on the left side of the 1st floor, the victim was stacking rebar loaded on a rebar fabrication workbench toward the transport rail attached to the workbench and lowering it onto the rail when the rebar slid down the rail, the workbench overturned together with it, and the stacked rebar fell onto the victim, crushing him to death.
739.재해유발요인: In the process of lowering stacked rebar onto rails, the rebar slid down the rails, overturning together with the work platform, and the stacked rebar came down on the worker
739.위험성감소대책:
▶ During rebar processing, fix the workbench to the floor in a stable form to prevent rebar overturning on top of the workbench
▶ To reinforce the rebar processing workbench, reinforce the ground such as lean concrete pouring under the workbench, install anchors between the vertical members and lower floor, install stoppers to prevent rebar rolling in the transport rail direction, and install lower supports for transport rails

740.재해개요: Around July 2021, at the OOOO new construction site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., a single rebar (length about 2 m / weight about 1.9 kg) fell to the ground from a height of about 62 m from the 20th-floor slab rebar placement work zone of Building OO, penetrating the safety helmet and head of the victim, a subcontractor worker who was walking to the site office after lunch, resulting in death.
740.재해유발요인: In the upper-floor slab rebar placement work zone, a single rebar fell to the ground and struck a worker
740.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker entry by establishing exclusion zones with safety fences, safety signs, etc. in falling-object hazard locations
▶ During rebar processing, fix to the floor in a stable form to prevent rebar falling

741.재해개요: Around March 2015, at the OO bridge installation work site, two victims, rebar workers, were assembling vertical rebar for an abutment when the vertical rebar, losing horizontal resistance due to strong wind and the rebar's own weight, toppled over and crushed them; 1 died and 1 was injured.
741.재해유발요인: During vertical rebar assembly work on a bridge abutment, the vertical rebar lost horizontal resistance due to strong wind, the rebar's own weight, and other factors, toppled over, and crushed the victim
741.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare and comply with a work plan to secure overturning stability before work
▶ Install braces or supports of sturdy structure so that assembled rebar can withstand external forces or does not fall over

742.재해개요: Around June 2017, at the foundation rebar placement location of the OO logistics center new construction site, during rebar reinforcement work to support the upper rebar, the upper rebar shifted to one side and collapsed, and two workers working between the lower and upper rebar were caught; 1 died and 1 was injured.
742.재해유발요인: During rebar reinforcement work to support the upper rebar, the upper rebar shifted to one side and collapsed, and the worker working between the upper and lower rebar layers was crushed
742.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare and comply with a work plan including safety measures when handling heavy loads
▶ When installing rebar for inclined supports, install in two directions, X and Y rows
▶ Designate a work supervisor when handling heavy loads such as rebar

743.재해개요: Around September 2020, in the pump station area of a natural disaster risk improvement district maintenance project site constructed by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, belonging to a subcontractor, was climbing over installed wall rebar during wing-wall rebar placement work when the inner side of his right thigh was pierced by vertical rebar protruding from the top of the wall, resulting in death.
743.재해유발요인: In the process of wall rebar placement work for a wing wall, while stepping over installed wall rebar, the victim was punctured in the inner right thigh by vertical rebar protruding from the top of the wall
743.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install protective caps on protruding vertical rebar within movement passages and work sections and implement access control measures around them
▶ For on-site work, install safe passages leading to the work site or within the work site

744.재해개요: Around February 2021, at the river disaster prevention project site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, belonging to a subcontractor, was assembling column rebar for a bridge pier (steel-composite rahmen bridge) when he was crushed under toppling vertical rebar; he was injured and subsequently died.
744.재해유발요인: During wall and column rebar placement, the rebar toppled over because no braces were installed, crushing the worker
744.위험성감소대책:
▶ During wall rebar construction, implement rebar overturning prevention measures such as installing braces to maintain a stable form
▶ Implement reinforcement measures such as installing supports to prevent vertical rebar overturning
▶ During vertical rebar assembly work, ensure thorough direction and supervision by the supervisor to prevent overturning accidents

745.재해개요: Around June 2021, at the OO logistics center new construction site, the victim was doing PC slab and PC beam rebar placement work in section 8 on the 2nd floor and was moving to fetch additional rebar material when the wall rebar of stairwell No. 6, which was being installed, toppled toward him, and he was caught and crushed, resulting in death.
745.재해유발요인: During wall and column rebar placement, the rebar toppled over because no braces were installed, crushing the worker
745.위험성감소대책:
▶ During wall rebar construction, implement rebar overturning prevention measures such as installing braces to maintain a stable form
▶ Implement reinforcement measures such as installing supports to prevent vertical rebar overturning
▶ During vertical rebar assembly work, ensure thorough direction and supervision by the supervisor to prevent overturning accidents

746.재해개요: Around August 2021, at a complex facility new construction site, the victim, belonging to OO Co., Ltd., and a fellow worker were installing PC slabs on the 7th floor of the logistics center new construction site when the crawler crane operator, who had received a hoist-up signal by radio while the rigging fastened to the PC slab had not been completely detached, raised the crane, and the victim, who was standing on the PC slab, lost his balance and fell to the 6th floor of the logistics warehouse, resulting in death.
746.재해유발요인: During PC slab installation work, with the rigging fastened to the PC slab not fully dismantled, the crawler crane operator received a raising signal via radio and raised the crane, and the victim standing on the PC slab lost balance and fell
746.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish work methods, signals, etc. for the load being lifted and prohibit arbitrary operation by the equipment operator
▶ During crawler crane work, deploy a signalman and use horn signals to prevent falling of the load being lifted

747.재해개요: Around December 2015, at the OO new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (concrete placement worker), belonging to subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd., after pouring pad concrete in the basement 2nd-floor electrical room, was cleaning the inside of the piping when he tripped over a flexible concrete-placing hose, hit his head on the floor, and died.
747.재해유발요인: During pipe interior cleaning work after pouring the electrical room pad concrete, the victim tripped over a flexible hose for concrete pouring, fell, and hit his head on the floor
747.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pipe internal cleaning work, prepare and comply with a work plan including the work sequence and work methods for equipment and machinery use
▶ Firmly fix the flexible hose so it does not move, designate worker access control zones, and deploy a signalman

748.재해개요: Around February 2016, at the coal handling facility installation work site of OO Co., Ltd., in the belt conveyor gallery section, a coal transfer facility between thermal power units 8 and 9, nine subcontractor workers were pouring floor concrete when the deck plate, unable to support the upper load, collapsed downward, and two workers who were pouring concrete at that spot fell 60 m to the ground below and died.
748.재해유발요인: During deck plate concrete pouring work, the deck plate collapsed (structural instability, poor work methods, etc.)
748.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing major members such as steel beams supporting deck plates, verify in advance the use, quality, and joining methods when joints occur
▶ Prohibit concentrated pouring to prevent eccentricity during concrete pouring
▶ Deploy a watcher to monitor deck plate deformation and displacement during concrete pouring work

749.재해개요: Around May 2016, at the apartment new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (concrete worker), belonging to subcontractor OO Civil Engineering Co., Ltd., was climbing over assembled wall rebar for compaction work during the 13th-floor slab and wall concrete pouring of Building 102 when he lost his balance and fell over, and his perineum was pierced by the assembled rebar, resulting in death.
749.재해유발요인: With no travel passage available, while stepping over assembled wall rebar for compaction work in slab and wall concrete pouring, the victim lost balance, fell over, and was impaled on the assembled rebar
749.위험성감소대책:
▶ During concrete pouring work with puncture hazards, install work passages on the side without assembled rebar
▶ When there is a puncture hazard due to protruding rebar, install protective caps on rebar protrusions 
▶ When working in locations with fall hazards, install working platforms and safety nets

750.재해개요: In June 2017, at the OO Industrial Complex OO district development site, the victim (carpenter), belonging to subcontractor OO Co., Ltd., was preparing to start the engine of a motorized vibrator on the formwork working platform of a J-type gutter to assist with J-type gutter pouring on the support facility lot when the concrete pump truck's hose lurched and swung, striking the victim; he fell through the guardrail and was impaled on rebar placed on the ground, resulting in death.
750.재해유발요인: While preparing to start the engine of a motorized vibrator on a side-ditch formwork working platform, the concrete pump truck hose whipped and swung, striking the victim, who fell through the gap in the guardrail
750.위험성감소대책:
▶ During concrete pouring work with puncture hazards, install work passages on the side without assembled rebar
▶ When there is a puncture hazard due to protruding rebar, install protective caps on rebar protrusions 
▶ When working in locations with fall hazards, install working platforms and safety nets

751.재해개요: Around April 2019, at the factory new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., ten workers including the victim (plasterer) were pouring 1st-floor concrete when the embed-plate bolt weld between the beam and the retaining wall fractured at two small (steel) beams supporting the slab, and the beams and slab tilted to one side and collapsed; six workers slid down and fell from a height of 6.5 m and were injured (4 requiring more than 3 months of medical care).
751.재해유발요인: While pouring floor concrete, the embed plate bolt weld points fractured at two small beams supporting the slab, the slab tilted to one side, and the worker fell
751.위험성감소대책:
▶ When welding steel members, verify possession of welding-related certification, and after welding conduct inspection in the presence of the main contractor, subcontractor, and supervision
▶ When constructing steel structures on which deck plates are installed, implement overturning prevention measures considering the steel structure's self-weight, upper loading, and vibration and impact from concrete pouring

752.재해개요: Around November 2019, at a warehouse facility new construction site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., two victims (rebar worker, form carpenter), workers belonging to subcontractor OO Co., Ltd., were doing concrete pouring work on the rooftop slab of the warehouse building when the deck plate detached from the steel frame, and they fell to the 2nd floor (H of about 7 m) and were injured.
752.재해유발요인: During deck plate concrete pouring work, the deck plate collapsed (structural instability, poor work methods, etc.)
752.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before concrete pouring work, inspect and repair formwork deformation, displacement, etc.
▶ The bearing length at both ends of deck plates shall be 50mm or more, and comply with welding methods and spacing

753.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the OO site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (concrete worker), belonging to reinforced-concrete subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd., was dismantling the fixing hardware of an oxygen-injection cap in order to clean the inside of the concrete-placing piping when the internal pressure of the piping burst out, and he was struck by the oxygen-injection cap, resulting in death.
753.재해유발요인: After inserting a sponge ball to clean the inside of a concrete delivery pipe and connecting the pipe to an oxygen cylinder for pressurization, the sponge ball became stuck inside the pipe; while releasing the fixing hardware of the oxygen injection cap, the internal pipe pressure burst out and the victim was struck by the oxygen injection cap
753.위험성감소대책:
▶ During cleaning work of concrete pipes, etc., take measures to release compressed gas before work so that accidents do not occur from compressed gas discharge
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

754.재해개요: Around September 2020, on the mid-level slab of the mechanical parking garage at the residential and office facility new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., two victims were pouring concrete when the deck plate collapsed, and they fell about 46.5 meters to the basement 2nd floor inside the parking pit, resulting in death.
754.재해유발요인: During deck plate concrete pouring work, the deck plate collapsed (structural instability, poor work methods, etc.)
754.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing major members such as steel beams supporting deck plates, verify in advance the use, quality, and joining methods when joints occur
▶ Prohibit concentrated pouring to prevent eccentricity during concrete pouring
▶ Deploy a watcher to monitor deck plate deformation and displacement during concrete pouring work

755.재해개요: Around February 2021, at the OO new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., during 1st-floor concrete pouring, the upper slab (deck plate: 8.1 m x 10.3 m, 3 spans) collapsed, falling onto two victims who were refueling a hot-air blower used for concrete curing on the 1st floor, causing injuries.
755.재해유발요인: During deck plate concrete pouring work, the deck plate collapsed (structural instability, poor work methods, etc.)
755.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing major members such as steel beams supporting deck plates, verify in advance the use, quality, and joining methods when joints occur
▶ Prohibit concentrated pouring to prevent eccentricity during concrete pouring
▶ Deploy a watcher to monitor deck plate deformation and displacement during concrete pouring work

756.재해개요: Around February 2021, at the OO new construction site being built by OO Co., Ltd., during basement 1st-floor parking lot floor slab pouring work, the deck plate collapsed, and five pouring workers fell (H of about 3.5 m); all were injured.
756.재해유발요인: During deck plate concrete pouring work, the deck plate collapsed (structural instability, poor work methods, etc.)

757.재해개요: Around September 2021, at the OO new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., three victims belonging to reinforced-concrete subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd. were pouring 1st-floor slab concrete when the slab collapsed, and they fell about 8.5 m to the basement 1st floor together with the deck plate and beams; 2 died and 1 was injured.
757.재해유발요인: During deck plate concrete pouring work, the deck plate collapsed (structural instability, poor work methods, etc.)

▶ Deploy a watcher to monitor deck plate deformation and displacement during concrete pouring work

758.재해개요: Around October 2021, at a housing redevelopment project site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim, belonging to reinforced-concrete subcontractor OO Co., Ltd., was pouring 4th-floor slab concrete in Building 110 when he lost his balance and sat down backward, and his buttocks area was pierced by a protruding vertical wall-splice rebar (D10, height about 38 cm) beside him, resulting in death.
758.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, with the area to step on not visible, the victim, assisting with the electric compactor, lost balance and was impaled on the placed rebar
758.위험성감소대책:
▶ During concrete pouring work with puncture hazards, install work passages on the side without assembled rebar
▶ When there is a puncture hazard due to protruding rebar, install protective caps on rebar protrusions 
▶ When working in locations with fall hazards, install working platforms and safety nets

759.재해개요: Around October 2015, on a road near the OO factory new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame worker) loaded steel materials onto a trailer at a storage yard near the site and was riding in the trailer bed while moving to the construction site when the steel materials loaded in the trailer bed fell onto the road together with the victim and crushed him, resulting in death.
759.재해유발요인: With poor measures to prevent the falling of steel materials, while riding in the trailer bed together with loaded steel materials en route to the construction site, the steel members and the victim fell onto the road together, and the members came down on top of the victim, crushing him
759.위험성감소대책: ▶ When loading cargo on a trailer, secure the cargo with ropes, etc. so it does not come loose, in order to prevent hazards from cargo collapse or falling

760.재해개요: Around December 2015, at the OO golf course ceiling net repair work site, the victim (rigger) was installing a vertical net at the top of a steel structure column together with a fellow worker when he lost his footing and fell about 35 m to the ground below, resulting in death (presumed).
760.재해유발요인: While installing a vertical net on top of a steel structure column together with a fellow worker, the victim lost his footing and fell approximately 35 m to the ground below
760.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall hazard locations, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ For bolt tightening work at steel frame work sites, work after installing safe working platforms such as hanging scaffolds

761.재해개요: Around September 2016, at an apartment new construction site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim, a form carpenter belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd., which had been subcontracted for structural work, was on top of a deck plate (600 x 2,400 x 2.1) assisting in lowering materials loaded on forklift forks onto the deck plate when the forklift crossed from the basement 1st-floor concrete floor onto the deck plate, and the deck plate collapsed; the victim fell to the basement 2nd floor together with the forklift and was crushed under the forklift, resulting in death.
761.재해유발요인: A forklift passed over the concrete floor into a section where only deck plates were installed; the deck plates collapsed, and the worker fell together with them and was crushed by the forklift
761.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish travel route and work method plans for transport work using forklifts
▶ Prohibit unsafe work such as operating vehicle-type material handling machinery up to edges with fall hazards
▶ Deploy a spotter at hazardous locations during material transport work using vehicle-type material handling machinery

762.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO new construction site being built by OO Enterprise, a directly employed worker (common laborer) was unloading steel members brought in from outside onto the 1st floor of the site when a steel member (H-350x175x7x11, L of about 7.3 m, 362 kg) loaded on the cargo truck bed fell to the 1st floor, striking the victim, who was standing near the cargo truck, resulting in death.
762.재해유발요인: While unloading steel members to the ground, the moment the steel member in the center of the cargo truck bed was lifted, the steel members loaded at the end fell to the ground
762.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with vehicle-type material handling machinery, control entry to travel routes and install safe passages to prevent worker contact
▶ To prevent falling of stacked steel members, stack them away from edges and install falling-object nets

763.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO extension work site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim was climbing over a guardrail installed on the 1st floor to move onto a steel beam when he fell to the basement 1st floor (about 6.7 m), resulting in death.
763.재해유발요인: While climbing over the installed guardrail to move onto a steel beam, the worker fell to the ground
763.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing a passage to the steel erection work area, install openable guardrails in the passage section so workers can open the guardrail and move onto the steel beam with the safety harness attached
▶ Implement fall prevention measures such as installing fall-protection nets at working platform edges

764.재해개요: Around July 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. factory new construction site constructed by OO, while steel materials were being unloaded from a truck crane bed, the moment the victim grabbed a steel material (H-beam) on the truck crane bed to climb up, the H-beam, whose binding rope had been released, fell, and at the same time he lost his balance and fell to the ground, resulting in death.
764.재해유발요인: In the process of unloading steel materials from a truck crane cargo bed, the moment the worker tried to climb up holding an H-beam on the cargo bed, the H-beam fell with its lashing rope untied, and at the same time the worker lost balance and fell
764.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work unloading unit cargo weighing 100kg or more from vehicle-type material handling machinery, dismantle heavy loads in sequence while they remain tightly bound top and bottom, and workers shall use steps or platforms allowing safe movement on the truck bed
▶ When loading cargo on trucks, load within the maximum load capacity

765.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO factory expansion civil and building work site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., while a steel beam was being hoisted (lowered) by a mobile crane (50 ton), the steel beam fell and struck the brim of the safety helmet of the victim, who was on the 3rd floor communicating by radio to position the steel beam for assembly; the victim lost his balance and fell to the 2nd floor together with the steel beam (H of about 10 m), resulting in death.
765.재해유발요인: While performing steel beam lifting work with a mobile crane using single-line rigging, the steel material fell, striking a worker who was on the radio on the 3rd floor, who then fell
765.위험성감소대책:
▶ For heavy-load hoisting work, review rigging methods, rigging tools, and work methods
▶ For steel beam work, assemble the lower part using aerial work platforms, etc.
▶ For work on top of steel beams, install safety nets below so as not to exceed 10m from the working surface

766.재해개요: Around April 2018, at the OO factory tent work site, during hoisting of a pipe structure for tent installation with a cargo crane, the hoisted pipe structure began to swing and struck the victim, who fell about 4.6 m down a retaining-wall floor slope, resulting in death.
766.재해유발요인: While lifting a steel structure with a cargo crane, the swaying steel structure collided with the worker, who then fell
766.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guide ropes during hoisting work to prevent rotation or swinging of the hoisted object in advance
▶ During hoisting work, review the shape of the hoisted object and the appropriateness of the rigging accordingly
▶ During hoisting work, raise the hoisted object to a certain height from the ground and recheck the rigging condition

767.재해개요: Around October 2018, at the sewage sludge treatment facility building work site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame worker), belonging to subcontractor OO Co., Ltd., was carrying material (C-section steel) and moving along the top of the steel frame to install a parapet on the upper steel frame when he lost his balance and fell 11 m to the ground below, resulting in death.
767.재해유발요인: At a site where no safety net was installed under the steel structure, while moving on top of the steel frame without fastening a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell
767.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses to prevent falls when moving on top of steel beams
▶ Attach the safety harness to prevent falls when moving using access ladders
▶ When fall-protection net installation is difficult due to mobile crane boom interference, etc., install safety harness anchorage facilities on the ground before steel assembly work, then lift and assemble, and attach safety harnesses at the top for work

768.재해개요: Around August 2019, at an apartment model house installation site, the victim (panel assembler), belonging to OO Co., Ltd., was stacking bundles of roof sandwich panels lifted by mobile crane onto the steel roof of the model house when work was suspended due to rain; while moving along a steel roof girder (width 350 mm, H-section = 350*175*7*11) to come down to the ground, he lost his balance, slipped, and fell from the steel roof girder to the 2nd-floor slab (H of about 7 m), resulting in death.
768.재해유발요인: At a site where no safety net was installed under the steel structure, while moving on top of the steel frame without fastening a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell

▶ Attach the safety harness to prevent falls when moving using access ladders
▶ When fall-protection net installation is difficult due to mobile crane boom interference, etc., install safety harness anchorage facilities on the ground before steel assembly work, then lift and assemble, and attach safety harnesses at the top for work

769.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the rooftop screen fence installation work site of OO Co., Ltd., during base-frame work on steel members for installing (attaching) a colored steel-sheet fence, an H-section steel member bound with a fiber belt sling for material transport on a mobile crane fell and struck the victim, resulting in death.
769.재해유발요인: During base work on steel members for installing a color steel sheet fence, a steel member tied with single-line rigging to a mobile crane's material transport belt sling caught on a bracket and fell onto the worker
769.위험성감소대책:
▶ When there is a falling hazard during steel member transport, establish worker exclusion zones and control worker entry
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment
▶ When transporting long members such as steel members, the one-line rigging method poses falling hazards if the member catches on or strikes other objects, so use the two-line rigging method

770.재해개요: Around November 2019, at the OO gymnasium renovation site, the victim (common laborer), belonging to OO Co., Ltd., climbed onto a steel column (diameter 508, L=7.5 m, 2.02 tons) loaded on a trailer and was preparing for unloading when, the moment the trailer driver released the chain block, the steel column lost its center of gravity; the steel column and the victim fell from the end of the trailer to the ground (H=1.54 m), after which the steel column rolled over and crushed the victim's face, resulting in death.
770.재해유발요인: While climbing onto steel columns loaded on a trailer to prepare for unloading, the moment the trailer driver released the chain block, the steel columns lost their center of gravity and collapsed, falling together with the worker
770.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform steel column unloading work after implementing safety measures
▶ Perform work after wearing the provided personal protective equipment

771.재해개요: Around January 2016, at the OO new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame worker), who was doing steel assembly work on a parking tower inside the building, was moving along the top of a steel beam when he lost his balance and fell about 35 m onto steel materials stacked on the ground 1st floor, resulting in death.
771.재해유발요인: At a site where no safety net was installed under the steel structure, while moving on top of the steel frame without fastening a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell
771.위험성감소대책:

▶ Attach the safety harness to prevent falls when moving using access ladders
▶ When fall-protection net installation is difficult due to mobile crane boom interference, etc., install safety harness anchorage facilities on the ground before steel assembly work, then lift and assemble, and attach safety harnesses at the top for work

772.재해개요: Around March 2016, at an installation site for a slag-process dust collector and hot-air equipment, during steel column erection work using a crane, an improvised heavy-object handling device, unable to withstand the hoisting load, fractured, and the steel column toppled over; the victim's face was caught between members stacked on the ground, resulting in death.
772.재해유발요인: During steel column erection work using a crane, an improvised heavy-load handling device could not withstand the lifting load and fractured; the steel column toppled over and the worker was caught between members stacked on the ground
772.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy loads such as steel frames, use handling gear such as shackles with a safety factor secured through safety testing
▶ Install vertical climbing ways on steel columns and use an aerial work platform truck to release rigging gear

773.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO work site, the victim fell to the ground while assembling roof steel members and died.
773.재해유발요인: While working on top of a steel structure with no fall protection measures in place, the worker fell
773.위험성감소대책:
