▶ Supervise workers' wearing of personal protective equipment

774.재해개요: Around April 2016, on a front roof steel truss beam of the OO factory, the victim (steel frame worker) was tying steel members with a sling on top of the roof steel truss beam in order to assemble a steel member (parapet girth) when he fell from the truss beam and died.

777.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO factory new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was standing on a previously assembled steel beam for purlin installation work and was reaching to grab a purlin member when he lost his balance and fell about 9 m to the ground below, resulting in death.

778.재해개요: Around July 2016, at the OO extension work site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame worker) was removing protective tape from the beam-connection bracket installation area of a steel column unloaded on site when the 10 m long steel column (weight about 4.5 tons) tilted over, and he was caught between the ground and the steel column, resulting in death.
778.재해유발요인: While removing protective tape from the beam connection bracket installation area of a steel column, the resulting eccentricity acted as an overturning moment, the steel column tilted, and the worker was crushed between the ground and the steel column
778.위험성감소대책:

▶ When laying steel columns at an angle, perform work with three-point support using two brackets
▶ When lifting steel columns to the floor, secure ground bearing capacity by leveling the ground surface

779.재해개요: Around July 2016, at a warehouse expansion work site, the victim (rack installer), belonging to a subcontractor, was doing bolt assembly work at the top of a rack in order to connect the roof-level truss to the top of the rack when he lost his balance and fell to the ground (H of about 30 m), resulting in death.
779.재해유발요인: While working on top of a steel structure with no fall protection measures in place, the worker fell

782.위험성감소대책:

783.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the OO high school new construction site constructed by OO, the victim (steel frame worker), belonging to subcontractor OO Co., Ltd., was dismantling a lifting shackle on the flange of a steel beam temporarily placed on a concrete wall of the multipurpose auditorium stage preparation room when he lost his balance, lost his footing, and fell to the multipurpose auditorium floor (height about 10.9 m), resulting in death.

784.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the 154 kV OO substation civil and building work site, the victim (steel frame worker) was doing steel bracing assembly work in the air-duct room on the 3rd floor when he lost his footing and fell about 12 m to the 1st floor below, resulting in death.
784.재해유발요인: During steel bracing assembly work in the air duct room, a worker not wearing a safety harness lost his footing and fell
784.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working on steel structures, install safety harness anchorage facilities to which safety harnesses can be attached
▶ Thorough performance of supervisor duties

785.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO parking lot, the victims, belonging to OO Co., Ltd., were installing an outdoor event steel structure together with colleagues in preparation for the operation of the OO snow sledding festival when the steel structure toppled over; 1 died and 1 was injured.
785.재해유발요인: During steel structure installation work using poor methods, such as omitted and unsecured wall bracing installation and delayed roof bracing construction, the steel structure toppled over
785.위험성감소대책: ▶ Comply with design documents and construction specifications when installing structures

786.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO factory new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame worker) climbed onto the factory roof steel, rigged roof materials (C-section steel bundles) stacked on the roof steel to a mobile crane (25-ton), and was moving to the next work location when he fell to the concrete floor below the steel frame (H of about 9.0 m), resulting in death.

▶ If safety protection measures are difficult due to site conditions, install separate safety harness anchorage facilities

822.재해개요: Around June 2019, at the OO Co., Ltd. factory new construction site being built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame worker) was doing brace installation work on the 2nd-floor steel frame when he lost his balance and fell to the 1st floor (H of about 9 m), resulting in death.

823.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the OO factory new construction site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame worker) was on a roof steel beam (H-beam, width 20 cm) of main Building 1 receiving material (deck plates) being lifted by mobile crane when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor (H=6.2 m), resulting in death.
823.재해유발요인: With no safety facilities to prevent falls, such as safety harness anchorages, installed, while receiving materials being lifted by mobile crane on top of a roof steel beam, the worker lost balance and fell
823.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-prevention nets and safety harness anchorage facilities when working at fall-hazard locations such as deck plate work on top of steel frames
▶ When lifting deck plates using a crane, perform the work considering the space between steel beams
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

824.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the OO extension work site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the head of a steel-work sub-subcontractor and one worker were doing parapet (C-section steel) welding work on top of the roof steel (H-section steel, flange width=20 cm) when they fell about 5 m to the ground-level concrete floor below, resulting in death.

825.재해개요: Around November 2019, at the OO factory new construction site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim moved to the accident location to fix the ends of 3rd-floor deck plates to the exterior perimeter steel beam, and during welding preparation work he lost his balance and fell from a 3rd-floor opening about 11.6 m to the exterior ground at ground 1st-floor level, resulting in death.
825.재해유발요인: With no safety harness anchorage installed, during deck plate installation work, the worker lost balance and fell from the deck plate edge or opening
825.위험성감소대책:
▶ During deck plate installation work, take protective measures such as guardrails, fences, vertical fall-prevention nets, or covers in fall-risk places such as passage ends and openings
▶ If installing guardrails, etc. is difficult, install fall-prevention nets
▶ During deck plate installation and rebar placement work, install working platforms, etc. on workplace passages to prevent workers from losing their footing
▶ To prevent accidents such as deck plates being blown away or falling due to wind, install them so they rest at least 50mm on both sides of the beam top, tack-weld immediately after installing the first deck plate, and then tack-weld sequentially at intervals of no more than 60cm

826.재해개요: Around November 2019, at the OO Industry Co., Ltd. factory new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame worker), belonging to OO Co., Ltd., boarded an aerial work platform for factory roof steel assembly work and ascended to a height of about 7.3 m, then stepped out of the aerial work platform and was standing on a steel column to turn the hoisted roof steel when he was struck by the rotating roof steel and fell about 7.8 m to the concrete floor below, resulting in death.
826.재해유발요인: After boarding and raising an aerial work platform for roof steel assembly work, the worker got out of the platform and stood on the column steel; while standing there, he was struck by the rotating roof steel and fell
826.위험성감소대책:
▶ While the aerial work platform is raised, work within the platform or fasten a safety harness and work within the allowable working range
▶ When hoisting steel members for steel-structure roof assembly, work from a safe position using a guide rope
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

827.재해개요: In November 2019, at the OO factory new construction site, the victim, after assembling a steel beam to a steel column, in order to remove the clamp connected at the midpoint of the steel beam for lifting purposes, unhooked the safety harness hook that had been connected to a bracket bolt hole during bolt assembly work and moved onto the steel beam; while removing the clamp, he fell (H of about 15.5 m), resulting in death.

827.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses to prevent falls when moving on top of steel beams
▶ Attach the safety harness to prevent falls when moving using access ladders
▶ When fall-protection net installation is difficult due to mobile crane boom interference, etc., install safety harness anchorage facilities on the ground before steel assembly work, then lift and assemble, and attach safety harnesses at the top for work

At this time, the clamp attached to the hook of the belt sling being raised caught on the victim's clothing or struck his body (presumed), and he lost his balance and fell about 8 m to the 2nd floor below, resulting in death.
829.재해유발요인: After completing bolt tightening of roof steel members and dismantling the clamp connected to the mobile crane, while moving on top of the steel members, the clamp attached to the loop of the belt sling being raised struck the worker's body, and he lost balance and fell

▶ When handling heavy objects such as steel stair assembly, install safety nets, vertical fall-prevention nets, etc. to prevent falls and falling objects

▶ When lifting materials with a crane in situations with poor visibility, establish an appropriate signal system in advance
▶ When lifting materials, install detachment-prevention devices such as hook safety latches and check normal operation, and have the supervisor inspect the connection condition with the lifted object before lifting
▶ When lifting materials with a crane, use an appropriate rigging method according to the shape and material characteristics of the lifted object
▶ During lifting work, implement measures prohibiting worker entry within the working radius where lifted objects may fall

OO site, the victim (common laborer), in order to receive waste materials (panel pieces, etc.) from the top of a protective structure and set them down on the workplace floor, climbed an A-type ladder and grabbed a threaded rod when he received an electric shock, lost consciousness, fell about 1m from the ladder to the floor, and died
889.재해유발요인: With a temporary cable with damaged insulation in contact with the bottom of a ladder, the victim climbed the ladder, which was not firmly secured, to prepare for work; the moment he grabbed an all-thread bolt above to keep his balance, he was electrocuted and fell

▶ When using welders and other tools, install earth leakage circuit breakers to prevent electric shock accidents

890.재해유발요인: While installing finishing materials in an unstable posture in a narrow work space (under 1 m high) between the roof and the ceiling, the victim's center of gravity shifted forward and he fell
890.위험성감소대책:
▶ For high-place work such as ceiling panel installation inside buildings, implement safety protection measures such as fall-prevention nets and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

891.재해개요: Around August 2019, at the OO repair shop new construction site, the victim, on the 3rd-floor slab of the office building, was moving in order to weld interior partition panel support hardware to the pre-assembled slab rebar when his foot caught on rebar; he lost his balance and fell from the 3rd-floor slab edge (H=7.2m) and died
891.재해유발요인: While moving over the slab rebar for work, the victim's foot caught on the rebar and he fell from the slab edge where no guardrails were installed
891.위험성감소대책:
▶ Where there is a risk of missteps, such as rebar assembly or deck plate installation sections, install misstep-prevention nets or working platforms and guardrails on the workplace floor
▶ When installing guardrails, use metal pipes with a diameter of 2.7 cm or more or materials of greater strength, and install them in a structure capable of withstanding a load of 100 kg or more acting at the structurally weakest point in the weakest direction

892.재해개요: Around March 2020, at the OO demolition site, the victim (signalman), who was controlling the area below from outside the building to prevent accidents from waste thrown out during guest room demolition work, was struck by falling waste and died

892.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install falling-object protection facilities during demolition work and implement access control within the working radius
▶ Prohibit throwing demolition waste, tools, etc. out of the building
▶ Establish a work plan including demolition work sequence and method, and thoroughly supervise compliance

893.재해개요: Around October 2020, at the OO warehouse new construction site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (panel installer), while working (or moving) on a purlin to release the lifting gear (panel supports and sling belts) of a panel bundle transported to the steel roof, missed his footing and fell to the ground-floor concrete floor (height about 14.9m) and died
893.재해유발요인: While dismantling the rigging of a lifted load on top of a steel structure, the victim missed his footing and fell
893.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before work involving fall hazards such as material lifting, movement, and installation on top of steel structures, implement safety protection measures such as installing fall-prevention nets and safety harness anchorage facilities across all sections
▶ For work with fall hazards such as laying panels and other finishing materials on steel roofs, install safety harness anchorage facilities not only in the steel girder direction but also in the purlin direction so that safety harnesses can be fastened across the entire work range
▶ For demolition or installation of roofing and other finishing materials, review work methods that can minimize work on top of the steel structure by using aerial work platforms, tower-type stairs, etc.
▶ When demolishing or installing roofing materials on the roof, if working at the roof edge, install double-row scaffolds on the building exterior and provide guardrails and working platforms to prevent worker falls
▶ When installing exterior panels, if work is difficult because the fixing bolt positions are high, prohibit unsafe work behaviors such as unfastening the safety harness lanyard and moving, and resume work after ascending on an aerial work platform
▶ Prohibit working outside the aerial work platform without fastening a safety harness
▶ Before demolition or installation of roofing materials on the roof, review daily whether to suspend work according to weather conditions, and since aged finishing materials pose a slipping risk, ensure that non-slip safety shoes are worn
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' wearing of personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

▶ For finishing material removal work, plan the work in the order of removing finishing materials such as panels first and then removing supports, to prevent accidents such as unexpected falling of finishing materials

▶ Establish evacuation drills and an alarm operation system to respond immediately to emergencies
▶ Install alarm equipment or devices for rapid notification in emergencies

▶ Install and use safe working platforms to demolish the ceiling
   - Install and use safe working platforms such as mobile scaffolds and aerial work platforms (scissor type)
   - Workers fasten safety harnesses for high-place work at 2 m or more
▶ Prohibit using materials for fixing the ceiling as working platforms (unsafe behavior)
   - Prohibit fastening safety harnesses to hanger bolts, and prohibit working on top of ceiling materials and hardware such as M-BAR (unsafe behavior)

910.위험성감소대책:
▶ For materials at risk of rolling off, such as cable drums, implement fixing measures such as wedge fixing so they do not move
▶ Comply with ladder work safety guidelines when working with A-type ladders
   - Prohibit working on the top step of A-type ladders (unsafe work condition)
   - Install outriggers to prevent A-type ladder overturning
   - Take measures to prevent A-type ladder spreading (install and use hinge-type or latch-type latch hardware)
   - Implement ladder overturning-prevention measures by working in two-person teams
   - Workers fasten safety harnesses when working at heights of 2 m or more

▶ Implement worker access prohibition and control around the power cable drop zone

   - Pre-assemble on the ground, including installing safety harness anchorage equipment on horizontal members (arms)
▶ Workers on the tower's ascent/descent passages and on top of horizontal members (arms) work with safety harnesses fastened
▶ Install fall-prevention nets (inside the main legs) and falling-object prevention nets (outside the main legs) at every 10 m of height

913.재해개요: Around August 2017, at the OO cable car installation site, the victim, in order to replace the base and lowest unit post (L=2m) of the A-type support of the ropeway tower at the mountain summit, installed temporary struts (5) under the support, raised the support about 20mm, and was dismantling the lowest unit post when the temporary struts collapsed and the A-type support overturned, and he died
913.재해유발요인: After installing temporary struts for replacing the base and lowest unit post of a tower A-type support, during dismantling of the lowest unit post, the temporary struts collapsed, the post toppled over, and the worker was buried under it
913.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct a safety assessment before work to replace unit posts of steel tower supports
    - Review and verify lifting capacity in advance when lifting heavy objects such as steel tower posts
▶ Comply with safety standards during repair and maintenance work such as cable crane repairs
▶ Review and establish the work sequence and work plan in advance
    - Verify safety, including the installation position of temporary braces for the relevant post, and the unit post dismantling sequence
▶ Implement access prohibition measures for adjacent workers within the dismantling work area

914.재해개요: Around April 2016, during the OO project construction, the victim transported SP pipes to the 5th-floor ceiling area for fire-fighting pipe installation in the FAB BP (Back Plane) area and was loading them onto a material rack when the rack, having lost its bearing capacity, broke; about 55 loaded SP pipes (1,042.8kg) fell and struck the Blind Panel, a ceiling structure the victim was using as a makeshift platform, which collapsed, and he fell 15m to the floor together with the Blind Panel
914.재해유발요인: During material stacking and transport work on a material rack, the rack twisted and buckled, and the stacked piping fell, striking and collapsing the ceiling structure used as a working platform, and the workers fell to the floor together with the ceiling structure
914.위험성감소대책: ▶ Before material stacking work, comply with bracket installation that considers member thickness, material, stacking load, fixing method, etc. according to structural review

915.재해개요: Around October 2018, at a concrete batcher plant installation site, the victim used a mobile crane (50-ton) to unload batcher plant materials loaded on a cargo truck (5-ton) to the ground; while removing the shackle of the sling belt rigging, the silo support materials stacked in two tiers on the ground toppled toward the victim, and he was crushed under the materials and died
915.재해유발요인: While dismantling the shackle of a mobile crane sling belt rigging, the stacked materials suddenly toppled over and crushed the worker
915.위험성감소대책: ▶ When unloading materials, implement overturning-prevention measures such as installing support blocks so that materials do not overturn▶ Stack heavy objects with a high center of gravity horizontally

916.재해개요: Around October 2019, during OO maintenance and repair work, a pump (380kg) was being lifted with a hoist (2ton) using a fiber belt when the fiber belt broke and the pump fell and struck the victim
916.재해유발요인: During pump lifting work for maintenance and repair, the hoist fiber belt broke, resulting in a collision
916.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit worker access within the work range during lifting work
▶ Inspect the rigging condition before heavy-object lifting work
   - Check sling belts for damage and wire ropes for breakage
   - Review the lifting load according to the rigging method

917.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the new factory of OOOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO City, OO Province, the victim OOO, affiliated with OOOO, was performing work fixing the runway rail to an H-Beam (fastening clamps with bolts and nuts) on top of a 30-ton overhead crane when he lost his balance on top of the H-Beam and fell about 10m to the factory building floor below; he was transported to a nearby hospital but died. This was a fatal accident
917.재해유발요인: While fixing the runway rail to an H-beam on top of an overhead crane, the victim lost balance on top of the H-beam and fell
917.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit movement by means other than ladder passages and conduct related safety training
▶ Mark passages in sections leading into and out of the workplace
▶ Supervise workers' unsafe behavior

918.재해개요: Around January 2017, at the OO building parking tower remodeling construction site constructed by OOOO Co., Ltd., located in OO-dong, OO City, OO Province, the victim, affiliated with subcontractor OOOOO Co., Ltd., in order to move from the basement floor inside the parking tower to a lift located 2.45m above, was climbing onto a pallet (about 531kg) while holding it when the pallet dislodged toward him; he was struck by and crushed under the pallet and died. This was a fatal accident.
918.재해유발요인: While attempting to move upward holding a pallet inside a parking tower, the victim fell together with the dislodged pallet and was crushed
918.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit movement by means other than ladder passages and conduct related safety training
▶ Mark passages in sections leading into and out of the workplace
▶ Supervise workers' unsafe behavior

919.재해개요: Around April 2017, at the OO construction site located in OO-eup, OO County, OO City, constructed by OOOO, workers affiliated with OOOO, a sub-subcontractor of subcontractor OOOO Co., Ltd., were assembling a Tower Mast system (aka: Tower Lift System) for the installation of a Vessel (height 104.4m, 2090 tons) on the site; while pulling the G1 and G4 Stability Guys with hydraulic devices to adjust the verticality of the Tower Mast System, the connection between the Capping Beam and the Side Beam at the top of Tower "A" of the Tower Mast System fractured; Tower "A" toppled to the south, striking an existing piping line and causing a fire (Jet Fire), and Tower "B" struck an adjacent rest room, killing one victim who was resting and injuring four. This was the accident that occurred.
919.재해유발요인: During tower lift system assembly work, the beam connection at the top of the tower fractured, causing an overturn and the collapse of the rest area
919.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish work zones in installation work sections and restrict worker access
▶ Comply with measures to prevent hazards such as facility collapse and overturning

920.재해개요: Around August 2017, at the OOOO Co., Ltd. OOOO Units 1 and 2 secondary-side mechanical and electrical equipment maintenance work site located in OO-eup, OO County, OO City, the victim OOO, affiliated with OOOO Co., Ltd., together with three coworkers, was lifting the foam removal device of the OOOO circulating water drainage pipeline, with his safety harness hook connected to the grating above the manhole, when he fell into the manhole together with the grating (H≒7m estimated) and died (drowned). This was a fatal accident.
920.재해유발요인: While lifting a grating at the top of a manhole to remove a foam-removal device inside the manhole, the worker fell together with the grating
920.위험성감소대책:
▶ If subsequent construction does not follow continuously, close off resulting openings (sumps, etc.) using opening covers etc.
▶ When working near openings, implement fall-prevention measures such as installing guardrails

921.재해개요: Around August 2017, at a reactor installation work site inside the OO factory, the victim, after installing the reactor tank (factory equipment), for the work of covering the openings around the tank with checker plates, was installing reinforcement (channel steel, 75mm×40mm×4m) under the checker plate at the checker plate edge when he lost his balance and fell about 4m to the concrete floor below and died
921.재해유발요인: While working near a floor opening, the worker lost balance and fell through the floor opening
921.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails when working around floor openings
▶ If installation of guardrails is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

922.재해개요: Around April 2018, at the OOOO Co., Ltd. / OOOO new construction site located in OO-gu, OO City, the victim, affiliated with OOOO Co., Ltd., was riding on the platform of an aerial work platform when his body contacted the control lever of the aerial work platform; the platform suddenly rose and the victim's upper chest was caught between the platform's top guardrail and a heating pipe, and he died; this is the presumed accident
922.재해유발요인: While moving after boarding an aerial work platform, the worker collided with and was crushed against the guardrail due to the sudden rise of the platform
922.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install over-rise prevention devices as a crushing-prevention measure and comply with appropriate working height standards
▶ Comply with crushing-prevention measures by inspecting the over-rise prevention device before work

923.재해개요: Around June 2018, at the OOOO Co., Ltd. OO OOO mixed-use building new construction site located in OO-dong, OO-gu, OO City, OO Province, two victims climbed on top of a mechanical duct at a location where the duct interfered, in order to install supports for chilled/hot water piping, and were drilling into the ceiling when the hangers supporting the mechanical duct (unit length 3.0m) failed to bear the load and detached from the ceiling; the victims fell together with the duct (height about 3.5m) and both were injured. This was the accident.
923.재해유발요인: While drilling the ceiling after climbing on top of an equipment duct, the hanger supporting the equipment duct came off and the worker fell
923.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit movement by means other than ladder passages and conduct related safety training
▶ Mark passages in sections leading into and out of the workplace
▶ Supervise workers' unsafe behavior

924.재해개요: Around March 2021, inside a Water Quench Tower (distillation tower) at a plant site constructed by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-eup, OO City, OOO Province, the victim was installing a Support Beam (composed of assembled #1, #2, and #3 Pieces); with the bolts of the temporarily assembled #1 and #2 Pieces removed, at the moment he tried to connect Piece #3, which had been lifted with a chain block, Piece #2 overturned and Piece #3 (㉢-shaped, W x H x D = 9,220 x 862 x 160mm, t=12mm, 973kgf) overturned in a chain reaction; the victim's neck was caught between the overturned Piece #3 and the previously installed Support Beam, and he died. This was a fatal accident.
924.재해유발요인: Inside a Water Quench Tower (distillation tower), while the victim was installing a Support Beam, at the moment he attempted to connect the #3 Piece lifted by a chain block with the bolts of the temporarily assembled #1 and #2 Pieces removed, the #2 Piece overturned and the victim's neck was crushed between the #3 Piece, which overturned in a chain reaction, and the previously installed Support Beam
924.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifted members are temporarily assembled, fasten and support them with belts etc. to prevent overturning
▶ When performing work such as assembling members, perform the work within a range that can prevent hazards such as sudden overturning of the members

925.재해개요: Around July 2021, inside mechanical parking system Unit 3 of the OOOO building located in OO-gu, OO City, the victim, affiliated with OOOOOO Co., Ltd., was struck by a ratchet wrench that fell from above and died. This was a fatal accident.
925.재해유발요인: Inside a mechanical parking facility, the worker was struck by a ratchet wrench that fell from above
925.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly provide and wear personal protective equipment such as safety helmets
▶ Install storage boxes to prevent materials from coming loose

926.재해개요: Around March 2019, at the OOOO apartment located in OOO-gu, OO City, two workers affiliated with OOOO Co., Ltd. were replacing an aged elevator when the hook (carabiner) temporarily suspending the elevator car opened; the car fell from the 18th floor to the 1st-floor bottom, and the two workers working on top of the car fell with it and died
926.재해유발요인: During elevator replacement work, the hook (carabiner) temporarily suspending the elevator spread open and the worker fell together with the elevator
926.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before elevator dismantling work, review and establish a work plan for heavy-object handling etc., and review safe work methods such as selecting the elevator suspension structure and fastening method
▶ Lifting devices supporting heavy objects must have sufficient strength and be selected to suit the purpose; the supervisor must inspect the condition of ropes and their fastening and fixing status before suspending wire ropes etc., and order immediate replacement if abnormalities are found
▶ For lifting chains, the supervisor must, through visual inspection before work, prohibit the use of chains whose length exceeds the length at manufacture by more than 5%, whose link cross-sectional diameter has decreased by more than 10% of the link diameter at manufacture, or which are severely deformed
▶ Implement safety measures such as appointing a work director and prohibiting entry of persons other than the workers concerned

927.재해개요: Around May 2016, in a park improvement project, the victim, watching material unloading, sensed danger and tried to move away, but was caught between protruding rocks nearby and died
927.재해유발요인: Materials suspended from a helicopter rotated and struck a worker, who was caught between rocks
927.위험성감소대책:
▶ When handling heavy objects, evacuate workers outside the working radius so there is no risk of collision, crushing, etc. of nearby workers
▶ When the helicopter descends, have it descend to a safe location via signals from the signalman or radio communication

928.재해개요: Around August 2019, in an apartment complex new construction, the victim's chest was crushed by a landscaping stone that came off its connecting chain during landscaping stone installation work, and he died
928.재해유발요인: A landscaping stone came off the chain-connected rigging and toppled toward a worker, crushing him
928.위험성감소대책:
▶ When handling heavy objects such as landscaping stones, tie them securely or take measures so they can be supported to prevent overturning
▶ Control access so that workers cannot approach work sites with overturning hazards
▶ Perform work such as rigging removal with workers clear of the working radius

929.재해개요: Around January 2018, at a hazardous bridge reconstruction project site, while assembling rahmen bridge abutment walls and other elements, workers were pulling on rebar to correct the verticality of tilted rebar when the vertical rebar overturned and crushed them; two died
929.재해유발요인: While forcibly pulling rebar with a cargo-securing ratchet to correct the verticality of tilted rebar, the vertical rebar overturned in the transverse direction of the abutment axis
929.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with design documents when assembling abutment vertical rebar
▶ Prohibit unstable work such as forcibly pulling rebar to correct the verticality of the rebar
▶ Thorough direction and supervision by the supervisor to prevent overturning accidents during vertical rebar assembly work

930.재해개요: Around October 2021, at a tunnel work site of the OO beltway expansion project, while a steel formwork custom-made for tunnels was being moved with hydraulic jacks, when the excavator operator pulled the wire rope (used for securing the steel formwork) that connected the steel formwork lug to the excavator, the rope came off the lug and struck the victim, and he died
930.재해유발요인: While moving a steel tunnel formwork with a hydraulic jack, the wire rope connected to and used with an excavator came off the lug, and the wire rope struck the victim, resulting in death
930.위험성감소대책:
▶Inspect lifting equipment for defects and conduct inspections before work
▶Implement worker control measures according to the working radius before lifting work

931.재해개요: Around June 2017, at a railway construction site, the victims were installing an air-duct slab when the air-duct slab fell; one was crushed to death and one fell to his death
931.재해유발요인: While adjusting the position of air-duct slabs to place them on tunnel brackets, one air-duct slab fell from a height of 4 m; a worker fell and another worker below was crushed
931.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit improper work such as allowing workers to ride on the load when lifting heavy objects (if unavoidable, implement separate fall-prevention measures on the lifting machine etc., not on the load)
▶ When performing work such as lifting heavy objects, prepare a heavy-object handling work plan and proceed with the work according to the work plan

932.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the civil engineering work site of the cleaning section in the OO district, the victim was extracting a broken Semi-Shield machine and concrete pipeline when a cylindrical steel push rod ejected by hydraulic pressure struck his head, and he died
932.재해유발요인: During the extraction of a broken semi-shield machine and concrete pipeline, a worker was struck by a cylindrical steel push rod that was ejected by hydraulic pressure
932.위험성감소대책:
▶ When the hydraulic jack is too short and a steel pusher is attached to extend it, fasten the jack and pusher together with bolting, welding, etc. and check for eccentricity
▶ Prohibit worker entry into the relevant work section during semi-shield extraction work

933.재해개요: Around November 2016, at a neighborhood facility and detached house new construction site, the victim, after rebar placement work on the rooftop, was coming down the stairs to eat a morning snack when he missed his footing at the mid-landing of the ground floor and fell to the ground outside the retaining wall (height about 2.8m) and died
933.재해유발요인: While using a winch to lift cement bricks in a handcart through the 4th-floor material lifting opening and moving them into the building, the worker lost balance and fell through the opening
933.위험성감소대책:
▶ When bringing cement bricks for masonry work into each floor of the building through material-lifting openings, use construction lifting equipment such as highlanders and carry in small loads via the interior elevator
▶ Install guardrails etc. at the ends and openings of working platforms and passages with fall hazards
▶ Equip lifting machines used for hoisting work with safety latches to prevent the hook rigging from slipping off

934.재해개요: Around January 2020, at the OO apartment complex new construction site, the victim, having finished cleanup work such as material arrangement on the rooftop level, was coming down the internal stairs of the site when he lost his balance and fell, struck a structural element inside a unit, and died
934.재해유발요인: After cleaning work such as material tidying on the rooftop floor, while coming down an interior staircase without guardrails installed, the worker lost balance, fell over, and struck a structural member inside the unit
934.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement fall-protection measures such as installing guardrails at fall edges such as stairwells
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

935.재해개요: Around January 2016, at the OO mixed-use residential facility new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim fell through an opening in the stairwell during formwork assembly/dismantling work for the winding staircase on the 14th floor and died
935.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures taken, during basement floor slab formwork installation work, the worker fell through a slab opening
935.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with fall risk such as work on top of columns, install platforms and guardrails, etc. using mobile scaffolds, etc.
▶ When working in fall-risk places such as formwork assembly work, implement fall protection measures such as installing fall-prevention nets and guardrails and wearing safety harnesses
▶ If guardrails, etc. must be temporarily dismantled, install fall-prevention nets between the scaffold and the building

936.재해개요: Around September 2016, at a detached house new construction site, the victim, who was dismantling formwork shores under an external stair slab, was crushed under the collapsed stair slab structure and died
936.재해유발요인: While dismantling formwork shores without observing the concrete curing period, the structure collapsed and the worker was crushed
936.위험성감소대책:
▶ Dismantle formwork shores in compliance with the curing period after concrete pouring
▶ When dismantling formwork shores, dismantle partially while removing pipe supports sequentially to prevent accidents due to falling objects
▶ Strictly prohibit entry of workers other than those concerned into dismantling work areas

937.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim of subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd. was working at the stair landing to dismantle the landing formwork of the main stairwell on the 5th floor when he lost his balance and fell together with the formwork to the 4th-floor stairwell floor (H≒3~3.75m) and died
937.재해유발요인: With the working platform inadequately installed, during beam formwork dismantling work, the moment the worker stepped on formwork placed on top of square timbers, the formwork flipped over and the worker fell
937.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with fall risk, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or work after wearing a safety harness
▶ When installing working platforms, firmly secure them so they do not flip over or fall

938.재해개요: Around June 2019, at the OO building new construction site being constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a subcontractor victim, working alone on material arrangement/tidying or cleaning in the basement level 1 stairwell, lost his balance and fell to the basement level 1 stair landing (H≒2.0m) and died
938.재해유발요인: Without measures against hazards such as falling over or slipping, while tidying materials or cleaning in a basement stairwell, the worker lost balance and fell
938.위험성감소대책:
▶ In fall-hazard sections, install fall-protection nets and guardrails or work after wearing safety harnesses
▶ Keep workplace floors etc. in a safe and clean condition before performing work so there is no risk of tripping or slipping in the workplace

939.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OO construction site, the victim, resting after slab rebar assembly and transport work, fell through the stairwell opening (width 1m × length 2.6m) to the basement level 1 concrete floor about 3m below and died
939.재해유발요인: While working near a floor opening without guardrails installed, the worker fell
939.위험성감소대책:
▶ Where there is a risk of falling through openings such as material entry ports, install fall protection facilities such as guardrails or safety nets
▶ If installing guardrails or safety nets is difficult, provide safety harnesses and install safety harness anchorage facilities to which harnesses can be attached

940.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. mixed-use facility development site, the victim, a concrete worker, after finishing work (Finishing) on the 11th-floor concrete floor, was moving down to the 10th floor via the stair passage when he fell from the edge of a stair landing about 2.3m to the 10th-floor concrete floor and died
940.재해유발요인: While moving through a stair passage after concrete finishing work, the worker fell from the edge of a stair landing where the guardrails had been dismantled
940.위험성감소대책:
▶ If guardrails at stair and landing edges have been removed due to work interference etc., reinstall the guardrails after the relevant work is completed
▶ When working at fall-hazard locations, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

941.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO building new construction site, during installation of the steel stairs connecting the 1st and 2nd floors, the victim slipped at the edge of the 2nd-floor stair landing, lost his balance, and fell to the 1st floor (H≒4.5m)
941.재해유발요인: While coming down after completing steel frame assembly work, the worker fell from the edge of a stair landing where guardrails were not installed
941.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at fall-hazard locations, install guardrails and safety nets 
▶ If installation of guardrails is difficult, thoroughly implement fall-protection measures such as wearing safety harnesses

942.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO neighborhood facility new construction site, the victim, who had been assembling steel frame with the site manager, finished the day's work and was coming down when he fell from a 3rd-floor stair landing about 8m to the ground concrete floor and died
942.재해유발요인: While coming down after completing steel frame assembly work, the worker fell from the edge of a stair landing where guardrails were not installed
942.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at fall-hazard locations, install guardrails and safety nets 
▶ If installation of guardrails is difficult, thoroughly implement fall-protection measures such as wearing safety harnesses

943.재해개요: Around April 2021, at the OO model house demolition site, two day-labor victims were coming down from the 3rd floor to the 2nd floor of the model house for lunch when the steel stairs tilted, and they fell to the 2nd floor and were injured
943.재해유발요인: While coming down at a demolition site, the bolts connecting the stairs to the floor came off, the stairs tilted, and the worker fell
943.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at fall-hazard locations such as edge work, install guardrails and vertical fall-prevention nets
▶ If installation of guardrails is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

944.재해개요: Around July 2016, at the OO new construction, while carrying bags of Remital pre-mixed mortar (40kg) from the rooftop level to the 2nd floor, the victim missed his footing on the stairs and fell to the 2nd-floor stairs (about H≒2m), striking his head on the concrete floor, and died
944.재해유발요인: While carrying bags of ready-mixed mortar on the rooftop floor, the worker missed a step on stairs without guardrails installed and fell
944.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install guardrails at fall-hazard locations such as stair edges
▶ If guardrails must be removed for work, install safety nets or install safety harness anchorage facilities and work after fastening safety harnesses

945.재해개요: Around July 2019, in the OO remodeling construction, for plastering work, the victim carried sand in a carrying pack from the 1st floor to the 2nd-floor slab; before setting it down on the 2nd-floor slab, he tried to sit on the 2nd-floor slab parapet (h=64cm) when the weight of the pack (about 25kg) tipped his body backward, and he fell to the 1st floor (h=4.15m) with the pack still on his back and died
945.재해유발요인: Before setting down sand carried in an A-frame carrier onto the slab, the worker tried to sit on a railing (h=64 cm), but the weight of the carrier (about 25 kg) shifted his center of gravity backward and he fell to the floor (h=4.15 m) while still carrying it
945.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install guardrails at fall-hazard locations such as stair edges
▶  Rest after placing tools, materials, etc. in use down on the floor

946.재해개요: Around February 2019, in the OO major repair construction, in order to perform plastering work around the ground-floor windows, the victim completed work on the 2nd floor and was going down the stairs to the 1st floor when he missed a step and fell about 1.5M to the concrete floor and died
946.재해유발요인: While pouring and leveling mortar on a stair landing floor, the worker missed a step and fell from the stair edge where guardrails were not installed
946.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install guardrails at fall-hazard locations such as stair edges
▶ If guardrails must be removed for work, install safety nets or install safety harness anchorage facilities and work after fastening safety harnesses

947.재해개요: Around March 2016, at the OO new construction, while climbing the stairs to perform plastering work on the 2nd-floor stairwell walls, the victim lost his balance, fell over, and died
947.재해유발요인: While climbing the stairs for stairwell wall plastering work, the worker, wearing a safety helmet improperly, fell over and struck his head on the concrete stairwell floor and died
947.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install guardrails at fall-hazard locations such as stair edges
▶ Thoroughly wear personal protective equipment

948.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO extension construction, during mortar placement and leveling work on the 4th-floor stair landing floor, the victim missed a step at the edge of the landing and fell about 8.6m to the 2nd-floor stair landing floor and died
948.재해유발요인: While plastering and surface-finishing a stair landing, the worker missed a step and fell from the stair edge where guardrails were not installed
948.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install guardrails at fall-hazard locations such as stair edges
▶ If guardrails must be removed for work, install safety nets or install safety harness anchorage facilities and work after fastening safety harnesses

949.재해개요: Around December 2020, at the OO new construction, while performing plastering work on the stair end faces at the stair landing between the 3rd and 4th floors, the victim fell about 9.2M to the ground-floor bottom and died
949.재해유발요인: While plastering and surface-finishing a stair landing, the worker missed a step and fell from the stair edge where guardrails were not installed

960.재해개요: Around February 2020, at the interior work site of the OO church new construction, a victim (common laborer) affiliated with a metal work subcontractor was carrying materials to be installed on the ceiling of the 3rd-floor main chapel, using the stairs with a coworker, from the 5th floor down to the 3rd floor when he fell from a 3rd-floor stair edge (H≒10.2m) and died

961.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the OO construction, the victim was performing wiring work on the side wall of the 5th-floor stairwell; while pulling a cable backward, he lost his balance and fell from the edge of a stair landing (H≒2.5m) and died
961.재해유발요인: While pulling wires backward during wiring work on a stairwell side wall, the worker lost balance and fell from the edge of the stair landing

▶ Fix stairwell guardrails with dedicated hardware and install them in a structure capable of withstanding loads of 100 kg or more
▶ If guardrail installation is not possible, install vertical nets etc. to implement fall-safety measures

962.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO multi-family housing new construction site, in order to install range hood vent caps in the units, the victim was going up to the 2nd-floor stair landing with a coworker when he lost his balance and fell through a window frame opening 4.6m to the concrete floor below
962.재해유발요인: While installing working platforms for mechanical piping work, the worker fell through an opening

963.재해개요: Around November 2019, at the OO new construction, the victim, at the basement level 2 OO interior work area, checked the mechanical piping above the ceiling of an interior structure (slide) and, in the process of coming down the stairs, grabbed the top guardrail installed on the side of the stairs; the unfixed top guardrail detached and the victim fell together with it (H≒2.8m)
963.재해유발요인: After checking the mechanical piping in the ceiling above an interior structure (slide), while coming down the stairs, the worker grabbed the upper guardrail installed on the side of the stairs; the unfixed upper guardrail came off and the worker fell

▶ If there is a risk of workers falling while working or moving on stairs, install guardrails using materials of sufficient strength such as steel pipes
▶ If guardrail installation is difficult due to the work, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

964.재해개요: Around April 2019, in a walking trail railing repair project, the victim lost his balance during railing assembly and installation work, fell to the ground, and died
964.재해유발요인: During railing repair work on a coastal walkway, the worker lost balance and fell

▶ Thoroughly provide and wear personal protective equipment

965.재해개요: Around August 2020, at the OO improvement project site constructed by OO Civil Engineering & Construction, a subcontractor victim boarded a truck-mounted aerial work platform (aka "sky") and, after slope drilling work, when the aerial work platform would not move, was checking it when an impact was applied to the platform, causing the victim to fall about 15m and die
965.재해유발요인: While attempting to move from the roof to the ground using an aerial work platform, the platform that had been caught on the roof steel sheet broke away, and with that impact the worker lost balance and fell to the ground
965.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with an aerial work platform, if raising or lowering the platform is difficult because it is caught on structures such as roof steel sheets, the operator personally checks the situation in which the platform is caught before operating
▶ When working via an aerial work platform, thoroughly implement fall-prevention measures such as webbing straps and guardrails at the front

966.재해개요: Around July 2016, at a stadium new construction site, during the main stadium roof steel (Truss) work, the victim boarded the platform of a truck-mounted aerial work platform (vehicle) to install SEMALLOY Cable and was moving (Boom extended about 36m) when the turntable fastening bolts of the slewing unit fractured; the platform fell together with the Boom; one died and one was injured

966.위험성감소대책:
▶ Maintain sufficient strength of fastening bolts of major structural parts such as the boom swing section of the aerial work platform and thoroughly check for abnormalities
▶ Prohibit use exceeding the allowable working radius according to the aerial work platform's boom length, angle, etc.

967.재해개요: Around June 2017, at an apartment construction site, two victims boarded an aerial work platform (truck-mounted) for demolition of an existing apartment and were erecting scaffolding to install screening around the apartment when the boom of the aerial work platform buckled and they fell (H≒27m) and died
967.재해유발요인: While installing scaffolding around an apartment building from an aerial work platform, the boom of the aerial work platform buckled and the worker fell to the ground
967.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using an aerial work platform, prohibit extending the boom beyond the allowable working radius
▶ When using an aerial work platform, inspect whether the overload protection device is operating

968.재해개요: Around August 2019, at the OO demolition site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., two victims boarded a scissor-type aerial work platform to dismantle the lightweight steel frame at the ceiling of a material warehouse; during the raising operation, the victims' hands were caught between the steel frame and the top guardrail of the aerial work platform, resulting in injuries requiring more than three months of medical care
968.재해유발요인: While operating the aerial work platform to ascend for steel frame dismantling work, the victim's hand was caught between the steel frame and the guardrail
968.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety devices (over-rise prevention devices) when using aerial work platforms
▶ Exercise thorough caution to prevent accidents of being caught in or crushed by frames etc. during work

969.재해개요: Around January 2018, in a warehouse building inside the OO Co., Ltd. factory, two victims boarded the platform of an aerial work platform and were carrying out ceiling LED light replacement work when the turntable fixing bolts fractured and the boom fell; the two victims aboard fell about 10.5m to the floor; one died and one was injured
969.재해유발요인: Due to fracture of the turntable fixing bolts of the aerial work platform, the boom dropped and the worker fell
969.위험성감소대책:
▶ Verify normal operation through functional inspection of the aerial work platform's overload protection device before work
▶ Conduct regular inspections for abnormalities in each part of the aerial work platform

970.재해개요: Around March 2016, at the OO building construction site, the victim, together with one coworker, was loading demolition debris onto the platform of an aerial work platform (truck-mounted) through a 7th-floor window of the building when the boom extension wire rope of the platform broke and, at the same time, the boom retracted; the platform fell and collided with the 3rd-floor part of the building, and by the impact he fell about 29m to the ground and died
970.재해유발요인: While loading demolition debris (waste bricks, floor mortar) onto the platform of an aerial work platform, the boom extension rope fractured and the worker fell to the ground together with the platform
970.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using an aerial work platform, in principle prohibit loading and transporting materials etc. exceeding the vehicle's rated load on the platform; when materials must be transported, prioritize transport methods using vehicles and passages such as ladder trucks, building stairs, lifts, and elevators, and if the aerial work platform must unavoidably be used, divide the materials etc. into smaller loads and transport them within the rated load
▶ When using an aerial work platform, check the operation of the protective device controller and the power status

971.재해개요: Around January 2019, at an OO work site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., a truck-mounted aerial work platform (aka "sky") was about to descend when the platform guard caught on a vertical scaffold pipe of the Main Stack; the moment a coworker cut the scaffold pipe with a hand grinder, the platform lurched, and the victim on the platform fell about 35m to the floor and died
971.재해유발요인: During painting work on an aerial work platform, the upper guardrail of the platform came off and the worker lost balance and fell
971.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly install guardrails on aerial work platforms
▶ Thoroughly inspect protective devices such as the locking pins of aerial work platform guardrails
▶ Thoroughly provide and wear safety harnesses and safety helmets

972.재해개요: Around October 2019, in order to install runway crane rails in a factory, the victim boarded an aerial work platform and was moving with the platform raised when a wheel of the platform dropped into an uneven work surface (opening); the platform overturned and the victim fell to the floor below (height 7.2m) and died

972.위험성감소대책:

▶ When moving the aerial work platform, travel with the platform lowered to its lowest position
▶ Thoroughly manage safety helmet wearing

973.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO building, the victim, aboard an aerial work platform (truck-mounted), was installing an advertising banner on the 8th-floor exterior wall about 28 meters above ground when he fell and died
973.재해유발요인: While installing an advertising banner on a building exterior wall from an aerial work vehicle without guardrails installed, the worker lost balance and fell to the ground
973.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails on the aerial work platform's work platform (carrier)
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

974.재해개요: Around May 2019, at the OO repair work site, the victim was using an aerial work platform to remove rust from the steel beams of a fish farm when the platform rose and the victim was caught between the platform's guardrail and a ceiling steel beam and died

974.위험성감소대책: ▶ Engage safety devices (over-rise prevention devices) when using aerial work platforms

975.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO civil construction site, the victim, a rebar worker, was performing rigging and signaling work for lifting a rebar bundle (about 1 ton) when the slewing-unit bolts of a truck-mounted crane (15-ton) fractured; the falling boom struck the victim and he died, and the operator OOO fell from the operator's seat to the ground (H≒3M) and was injured
975.재해유발요인: While performing rigging and signaling work for lifting a bundle of rebar, the slewing-unit bolts of the crane fractured and the falling boom dropped onto a worker
975.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct pre-work inspections before work when renting hazardous machinery such as truck-mounted cranes
▶ Provide the lessee with written records of the machine's repairs, maintenance, and inspections
▶ When using cranes, work within the allowable lifting load by installing overload protection devices
▶ Conduct regular inspections of crane boom swing section fastening bolts

976.재해개요: Around August 2021, at the OO apartment complex new construction site, the victim aboard a scissor-type aerial work platform was performing column rebar assembly work (H: about 4.9M) with 11 vertical rebars (L:7.35m, about 246kg) leaned against the platform when the platform overturned and he fell to the floor and died
976.재해유발요인: While the victim, riding on a scissor-type aerial work platform, was assembling column rebar with a bundle of vertical rebar leaned against the platform, the platform overturned and he fell to the ground
976.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit loading heavy objects exceeding the allowable load of the aerial work platform
▶ When moving the aerial work platform, lower the platform to its lowest position, then check the travel route for uneven surfaces, obstacles, etc. before moving
▶ When working on an aerial work platform, work inside the platform and, when a safety harness is fastened, work within the possible range
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

977.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OO factory new construction site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (steel erector), standing on the mid-rail of an aerial work platform to retrieve leftover materials from the top of the steel frame, fell about 8.0m to the concrete floor below while working and died

977.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using an aerial work platform, take measures so that occupants do not leave the platform
▶ When working with an aerial work platform, install separate safety harness anchorage facilities (not the platform's guardrails) and manage safety harness wearing
▶ Install aerial work platform safety devices and maintain them in normal operating condition so work is performed within the allowable working range

978.재해개요: Around September 2015, at an internal factory repair work site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim, aboard an aerial work platform performing steel flashing finish work, fell to the workshop floor (H≒4.0) and died

978.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using an aerial work platform, take measures so that occupants do not leave the platform
▶ When working with an aerial work platform, install separate safety harness anchorage facilities (not the platform's guardrails) and manage safety harness wearing
▶ Install aerial work platform safety devices and maintain them in normal operating condition so work is performed within the allowable working range

979.재해개요: Around January 2017, at the OO factory new construction site of OO General Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was using an aerial work platform to dismantle the rigging of the roof steel when he fell to the ground-floor concrete floor (height about 10.2m) and died
979.재해유발요인: While on an aerial work platform, stepping on the platform guardrail to move onto a steel beam, the worker lost balance and fell
979.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing an aerial work platform, install interlocking control devices to prevent sudden movement
▶ When working with an aerial work platform, take measures so that workers board and exit the platform at a safe location
▶ When using an aerial work platform, install guardrails on all sides of the platform

980.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. factory new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, affiliated with a subcontractor, boarded an aerial work vehicle to perform steel member assembly work and was moving when the aerial work vehicle overturned; he fell about 4m to the concrete floor inside the factory building and died
980.재해유발요인: After boarding a scissor-type aerial work platform for steel member assembly work, while moving with the platform lowered to a height of about 4 m, the platform overturned and the worker fell to the ground
980.위험성감소대책:
▶ When moving the aerial work platform, lower the platform to its lowest position, then check the travel route for uneven surfaces, obstacles, etc. before moving
▶ When working on an aerial work platform, work inside the platform and, when a safety harness is fastened, work within the possible range
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

981.재해개요: Around August 2017, at the OO factory new construction site, the victim (panel installer) boarded an aerial work platform (scissor-type, rental) to install a rain gutter at the roof eaves at the rear of the building; with the platform raised, he climbed onto a steel beam and was moving along it when he fell about 7m to the concrete floor and died
981.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures such as wearing a safety harness, the worker fell while moving from an aerial work platform onto a steel structure
981.위험성감소대책:
▶ On steel beams with fall hazards, move with the safety harness attached to safety harness anchorage facilities or steel holes, etc.
▶ When ascending and descending steel structures, use safety harness anchorage facilities or safety blocks

982.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO factory extension construction site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (steel erector), affiliated with subcontractor OO Industry, was performing bolt fastening (temporary tightening) work on a 3rd-floor steel beam when he fell about 9.5m to the concrete floor and died
982.재해유발요인: While the victim, not wearing a safety harness, was performing bolt fastening (temporary tightening) work on a steel beam, he fell about 9.5 m onto the concrete floor below
982.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working on top of steel beams, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses to prevent falls
▶ When moving via access ladders, fasten safety harnesses to prevent falls
▶ If installation of fall-prevention nets is difficult due to mobile crane boom interference etc., install safety harness anchorage facilities on the ground before steel assembly work, then lift and assemble, and work at the top with safety harnesses fastened

983.재해개요: Around January 2019, at the OO construction site, the victim (steel erector), a directly employed worker, was performing member installation and adjustment work from the platform of an aerial work vehicle (truck-mounted) when he lost his balance and fell about 7m to the floor and died
983.재해유발요인: While installing and adjusting arcade members from the platform of an aerial work vehicle, the worker lost balance while moving inside the platform (cause unknown) and fell
983.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using an aerial work platform, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses to prevent falls
▶ When working with an aerial work platform, work only inside the platform or work within the range possible when a safety harness is fastened
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

984.재해개요: Around July 2019, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO new construction site, the victim (steel erector), affiliated with subcontractor OO Co., Ltd., boarded an aerial work platform and was performing final bolt tightening of 2nd-floor steel beams; while the platform was rising, his head was caught between a steel beam and the platform's guardrail, and he died
984.재해유발요인: While performing final bolt tightening on a steel beam from a scissor-type aerial work platform, as the platform rose, the worker's head was crushed between the steel beam and the platform guardrail
984.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using an aerial work platform, install over-rise prevention devices at 4 locations and perform work after securing effective height
▶Design the over-rise prevention device in a structure that cannot be arbitrarily manipulated because its adjustment method is simple, or use a structure that prevents platform over-rise by detecting pressure on the guardrail

985.재해개요: Around December 2019, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO new construction site, the victim (painter), aboard the platform of a truck-mounted aerial work platform, was applying fireproof paint to the upper steel structure of the packaging building (H≒40m) when the equipment overturned; the victim on the platform fell to the ground (H≒12m) and died
985.재해유발요인: While performing fireproof coating work on an upper steel structure from the platform of a truck-mounted aerial work platform, the platform overturned as work exceeded the allowable working radius, and the worker fell
985.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with use within the aerial work platform's allowable working radius 
▶ Install aerial work platform safety devices and maintain them in normal operating condition so work is performed within the allowable working range
▶ Inspect the installation status and operation of safety devices such as the overload protection device before aerial work platform work

986.재해개요: Around June 2020, at the OO livestock barn new construction site, the victim (welder), on a scissor-type aerial work platform, was about to step down to the ground using the platform's access step when he lost his balance and fell forward (H≒1.2m); his right chest was pierced by a vertical rebar (L=11.5cm) protruding from the top of a feed trough wall (H=60cm), and he died
986.재해유발요인: While stepping on the boarding step of the platform to come down to the ground from an aerial work platform, the worker slipped on the step or lost balance, fell, and was punctured by wall rebar
986.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with an aerial work platform, take measures so that workers board and exit the platform at a safe location
▶ When using boarding steps, take measures to comply with the three-point contact climbing method while facing the aerial work platform
▶ When using an aerial work platform, install guardrails on all sides of the platform

987.재해개요: Around June 2020, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site constructed by OO, the victim (steel erector), aboard an aerial work platform (scissor type), was positioning Purlins (C-channel: length 9.2m) that had been stacked on top of the roof steel structure when the platform suddenly moved backward about 0.8m for unknown reasons; he lost his balance and fell about 7.2m to the concrete floor and died
987.재해유발요인: While on an aerial work platform arranging purlins loaded on top of a roof steel structure, a part of the worker's body contacted the joystick, causing unintended operation and reverse movement, and the worker lost balance and fell
987.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing an aerial work platform, install interlocking control devices to prevent sudden movement
▶ When working with an aerial work platform, take measures so that workers board and exit the platform at a safe location
