▶ Implement measures restricting riding on conveyor belts
▶ Install an emergency stop device capable of stopping conveyor operation in an emergency

1090.재해개요: Around October 2018, at a waste-concrete crushing yard within an OO opening construction site, the victim, sensing an abnormality in the operation of the impact crusher, stopped the rotor, opened the cover, and was removing stuck raw stone (waste concrete) when he fell in between the Blow Bar and the impact Curtain, resulting in death.
1090.재해유발요인: While removing raw stone stuck in the rotor of a stone crusher, the worker fell in between the blow bar and the impact curtain
1090.위험성감소대책: ▶ Install passages allowing workers to move to upper working platforms in sections where maintenance work is frequently performed, such as crusher conveyor drive motors

1091.재해개요: Around April 2019, on the 2nd floor within an OO construction project site, the victim and a fellow worker removed the protective cover of an inclined belt conveyor while it was running to identify the cause of abnormal noise, and while inspecting it, the victim's left arm was caught and drawn in between the belt and the drum, resulting in death.
1091.재해유발요인: While the conveyor was in operation, during conveyor inspection and residue removal, the worker was caught in the conveyor belt
1091.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement hazard prevention measures for prime movers, rotating shafts, belts, etc.
▶ When cleaning conveyors etc., stop the operation of the machine before performing the work
▶ Install an emergency stop device capable of stopping conveyor operation in an emergency

1092.재해개요: Around December 2019, at an OO LNG installation site, while two victims were carrying an analyzer panel (about 100kgf), to be installed on the 1st floor inside the boiler building, laid down with its front facing downward and held from both sides, the incompletely fastened locking device released due to shaking and other movement, and the opened analyzer panel door caught the fingers of the two victims, causing injuries requiring 3 or more months of medical care.
1092.재해유발요인: While transporting an analyzer panel, the locking device was released by shaking, and the worker's fingers were caught in the opened panel door
1092.위험성감소대책:
▶ When transporting heavy mechanical equipment, implement heavy-object transport methods using appropriate auxiliary tools such as attaching handles or using work carts
▶ For unavoidable manual transport, implement measures to prevent doors from opening due to shaking

1093.재해개요: Around January 2016, in a 9th-floor corridor of an OOO complex facility construction site, the victim, belonging to a mechanical subcontractor, was cutting threads on the end of a metal pipe (L=100mm, D25mm) using a pipe machine when the clothing on the back of his left arm was drawn into the rear chuck of the pipe machine; his back was pressed against the rear chuck and the lower part of his top was pulled up to his chest, compressing his chest, and the victim died of respiratory failure.
1093.재해유발요인: During material processing work, part of the worker's clothing was drawn into a machine (pipe machine), causing chest compression
1093.위험성감소대책: ▶ When working with a pipe machine, install a cover on the rotating shaft before work so that clothing, gloves, etc. are not drawn into the rotating shaft

1094.재해개요: Around November 2016, at an OOOOO residential-commercial complex construction site, a work foreman of the contractor for the building's interior/exterior mechanical, electrical, and fire-protection work was fixing anchor bolts to a wall and connecting brackets for sprinkler pipe fixing work inside the mechanical parking garage when he was caught between a weight (counterweight) descending from above and a steel beam of the mechanical parking equipment, resulting in death.
1094.재해유발요인: While working inside a mechanical parking facility, the elevator operated and the worker was caught between the descending counterweight and the parking facility structure
1094.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside or near an elevator, stop elevator operation through measures such as cutting power and installing a locking device on the controls, and deploy a work director for the work 
▶ When two or more construction projects are carried out at the same location, appoint and deploy a safety and health coordinator

1095.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OOO Building parking tower construction site, a victim from the building's fire-protection contractor was welding fire-protection piping on an A-type ladder on basement level 1 of the parking tower when he was struck on the head by the elevator counterweight (4.3-ton, also called a weight) descending from above, resulting in death.
1095.재해유발요인: While working inside a mechanical parking facility, the elevator operated and the worker was struck by the descending counterweight
1095.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside or near an elevator, stop elevator operation through measures such as cutting power and installing a locking device on the controls, and deploy a work director for the work 
▶ When two or more construction projects are carried out at the same location, appoint and deploy a safety and health coordinator

1096.재해개요: Around September 2020, at an OO Plaza interior construction site, while the victim was installing a firewall in the elevator section on the 3rd floor, his chest was crushed between the counterweight descending due to elevator operation and the horizontal steel frame of the elevator wall, resulting in death.
1096.재해유발요인: While working on an elevator firewall from a portable ladder, with the upper body leaned into the elevator shaft to check the installation condition, the elevator operated and the worker was caught between the descending counterweight and the wall structure
1096.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside or near an elevator, stop elevator operation through measures such as cutting power and installing a locking device on the controls, and deploy a work director for the work 
▶ When two or more construction projects are carried out at the same location, appoint and deploy a safety and health coordinator

1097.재해개요: Around October 2021, at an OO construction site, while the victim and a fellow worker, aboard an aerial work platform outside the logistics building ramp, were working to install louvers on the 3rd floor, the welded face of the member on which a winch was mounted fractured, and the winch came loose and fell about 42 m, striking the victim and resulting in death.
1097.재해유발요인: During hoisting work using an electric winch, the welded joint of the member on which the winch was mounted fractured, and the worker was struck by the falling winch
1097.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with lifting machinery such as winches, install overload protection devices and inspect their normal operation
▶ Check for abnormalities such as defective welds at the welded joints of winch mounting members and take action
▶ During heavy-object hoisting work, control access within the working radius and deploy signalmen

1098.재해개요: Around February 2020, at a mechanical parking equipment construction site within a medical facility construction project, a victim (panel installer) belonging to the panel installation subcontractor was extinguishing a fire caused by scattered welding sparks inside the mechanical parking garage when he was caught between a descending counterweight and a steel member, resulting in death.
1098.재해유발요인: While working inside a mechanical parking facility, the elevator operated and the worker was caught between the descending counterweight and the parking facility structure
1098.위험성감소대책:
▶ When operating mechanical parking facility carriers, implement hazard prevention measures and establish a signal system
▶ Prohibit use of mechanical parking facilities for worker transport purposes
▶ Thoroughly prohibit worker access on the travel path of mechanical parking facility counterweights

1099.재해개요: Around February 2016, at OO construction work, while the victim was manually moving a transformer in an underground substation room, the transformer overturned and struck the victim, resulting in death.
1099.재해유발요인: The girder of an overhead crane moved toward a self-propelled aerial work platform performing column base work and collided with it; the self-propelled aerial work platform overturned out of the factory, and the worker on the platform overturned together with the platform
1099.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working with a post-type aerial work platform, deploy a spotter to prevent hazards such as overturning before performing the work
▶ When working with an overhead crane, establish safe signaling methods, and the operator operates the overhead crane according to those signals
▶ Provide safety harnesses and manage their wearing status when working inside the aerial work platform

1100.재해개요: Around March 2016, at a new construction site being built by OO Construction, in order to install exterior landscape lighting on the office building (9 stories above ground), the victim installed a RIG (a mountaineering descent device attached to a climbing rope) on a rope from the rooftop and was descending when the RIG detached from the rope, and he fell about 35 m to the 1st-floor ground and died.
1100.재해유발요인: To replace and install exterior LED landscape lighting on a building's outer wall, after attaching climbing descent equipment to a rope on the rooftop, while descending, the descent equipment came off the rope and the worker fell to the ground
1100.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safe working platforms before high-place work at 2 m or more, then perform the work
   - Use scaffolds, mobile frame scaffolds, sawhorse scaffolds, and aerial work platforms (scissor type)
▶ Prohibit workers' unsafe behavior during high-place work (stepping and working on places other than working platforms)
▶ If installation of working platforms is difficult, workers fasten safety harnesses

1101.재해개요: Around April 2018, at OO construction work, while the victim and others were conducting a current test using a multi-tester to install a meter for checking electric power consumption, an arc explosion occurred due to overcurrent, injuring three people.
1101.재해유발요인: While testing current with a multi-tester to install a meter in a substation room, an arc explosion occurred due to overcurrent, causing injury (burns)
1101.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing work with electric shock hazards, implement electric shock prevention measures using insulating protective equipment (AE-type safety helmet, insulating gloves, insulating shoes) and protective devices
▶ Comply with approach limit distances according to voltage when working near live lines
▶ Wear and comply with flame-retardant-treated work clothing or work clothing with flame-resistant performance to prevent burns from arc explosions

1102.재해개요: Around May 2020, at OO construction work, while the victim was performing lighting installation work on top of a livestock refrigerator, he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor (H≒2.86m), resulting in death.
1102.재해유발요인: During installation of light switch boxes, hood caps, lighting conduits, fire-fighting pipes, etc., the worker fell to the floor from a height of 2 m or more
1102.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safe working platforms for high-place work at 2 m or more, then work (install and use mobile scaffolds)
▶ Comply with safety rules when installing and using mobile scaffolds
   - Install guardrails at the top of the mobile scaffold
   - Install outriggers at the bottom to prevent overturning (4 points)
   - Workers on top of working platforms work after fastening safety harnesses
     => When fastening a safety harness to a mobile frame scaffold, fasten it considering the lowest fall point of the safety harness
     => When assembling two or more tiers of mobile frame scaffold at a height of 1.8 m per tier, fasten the safety harness to the frame scaffold
   - Verify the assembly condition of major structural parts when assembling mobile scaffolds (install bracing; prohibit installing working platforms on access ladder rungs)
   - When ascending or descending mobile scaffolds, install hatch platforms and use the access ladder on the inside
   - Prohibit workers' unsafe behavior (working while stepping on the top of the guardrail)

1103.재해개요: Around November 2021, at OO construction work, while the victim was installing a duct cover on top of a switchgear panel, he missed his footing and fell from the edge of the switchgear panel (H≒3m), resulting in death.
1103.재해유발요인: While installing a duct cover on top of a switchgear (cubicle), the worker fell from the edge
1103.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safe working platforms before high-place work at 2 m or more, then perform the work
   - Use scaffolds, mobile frame scaffolds, sawhorse scaffolds, and aerial work platforms (scissor type)
▶ Prohibit workers' unsafe behavior during high-place work (stepping and working on places other than working platforms)
▶ If installation of working platforms is difficult, workers fasten safety harnesses

1104.재해개요: Around December 2016, at an OO railway power facility installation and other works site, while the victim was operating an engine puller (winch, capacity: 7-ton) for laying extra-high-voltage (22.9kv) cable, a rope that came off a pulley struck the victim's face, and he fell from a tunnel drainage box (h=67㎝), hitting his head on the rail foundation concrete.
1104.재해유발요인: While operating a winch for cable laying work, the rope came off the pulley, striking the worker, who fell onto the rails
1104.위험성감소대책:
▶ Control worker access around the work area during cable pulling work
▶ Conduct functional inspection before using the winch (engine puller)
   - Check for rope displacement from the pulley, rope breakage, etc.
▶ Conduct a safety review of the cable laying work method before work, then perform the work

1105.재해개요: Around September 2020, at an OO transmission line relocation construction site for lines obstructing development, work was suspended due to rain, and while the victim was attaching a fall arrester to a vertical lifeline in order to descend from the tower arm to the ground, he fell onto the fall-protection net installed at the bottom of the tower (H≒26m).
1105.재해유발요인: While performing work at the top of a transmission tower, such as lightning arrester installation and replacement of compression dead-end clamps and jumper sockets, and while ascending and descending, the victim lost his footing and fell to the ground
1105.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before erecting the steel tower, pre-attach safety harness anchorage equipment to each member on the ground
   - Inspect the condition of main-leg step bolts and install safety ropes
   - Pre-assemble on the ground, including installing safety harness anchorage equipment on horizontal members (arms)
▶ Workers on the tower's ascent/descent passages and on top of horizontal members (arms) work with safety harnesses fastened
▶ Install fall-prevention nets (inside the main legs) and falling-object prevention nets (outside the main legs) at every 10 m of height

1106.재해개요: Around October 2020, at an OO transmission vulnerable-facility maintenance construction site, after the victim finished replacing transmission line fittings on a tower (154kV Guseo–Myeongjang T/L No.3) and was moving along a horizontal member to descend to the ground, he slipped and fell about 20 m to the ground below.
1106.재해유발요인: While performing work at the top of a transmission tower, such as lightning arrester installation and replacement of compression dead-end clamps and jumper sockets, and while ascending and descending, the victim lost his footing and fell to the ground
1106.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before erecting the steel tower, pre-attach safety harness anchorage equipment to each member on the ground
   - Inspect the condition of main-leg step bolts and install safety ropes
   - Pre-assemble on the ground, including installing safety harness anchorage equipment on horizontal members (arms)
▶ Workers on the tower's ascent/descent passages and on top of horizontal members (arms) work with safety harnesses fastened
▶ Install fall-prevention nets (inside the main legs) and falling-object prevention nets (outside the main legs) at every 10 m of height

1107.재해개요: Around February 2016, at an OO factory heat-exchanger replacement work area, while a plate heat exchanger (1,130㎜ × 529㎜, h = 1,740m, W≒971㎏) was being moved using a chain block (1.5-Ton), the victim was struck in the chest by the toppling plate heat exchanger.
1107.재해유발요인: While transporting a plate heat exchanger in a factory using a chain block for replacement, it overturned and struck the worker
1107.위험성감소대책: ▶ During erection work of materials or members with level differences, implement overturning-prevention measures by supporting them with lifting devices such as chain blocks and winches to prevent overturning

1108.재해개요: Around April 2016, at an OO planned preventive maintenance work (turbine, boiler, desulfurization facility) site, the victim entered the Under Bowl of Pulverizer F to perform cleaning work, and when the Pulverizer was started to check whether the connecting shaft between the motor and the reducer was operating normally, the rotating Scraper crushed him.
1108.재해유발요인: During cleaning work inside a turbine, the worker was crushed due to machine operation
1108.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with safety measures for machine maintenance, cleaning, and repair (LOTO)
   - Cut off power using locks on valve handles, electric switches, etc. (Lock out)
   - Attach tags to the locking devices to mark them (Tag out)
▶ Deploy watchers etc. after workers enter

1109.재해개요: Around July 2016, at OO Construction's high-speed railway roadbed construction site, while the victim was lowering a drainage pump to the bottom of a 50 m deep vertical shaft using a winch, the anchor of the winch fixed to the 1st-floor ground detached, the winch suddenly moved toward the victim at high speed, and from the impact of the collision with the moved winch (maximum weight≒200kg) he fell to the basement level 1 floor (Hmax≒5m) and died.
1109.재해유발요인: While transporting an aerial work platform with a winch, the set anchor securing the winch came off and the aerial work platform dropped
1109.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with fall-prevention measures such as installing safety harness anchorage facilities and working platforms
▶ Inspect the installation condition of set anchors before work

1110.재해개요: Around November 2016, at an OO school relocation switchgear installation construction site, while a transformer was being moved from 1st-floor stairs to the basement level, the anchor bolts fixing the transformer detached, and the victim was struck by and then crushed under the transformer.
1110.재해유발요인: While moving a transformer, the anchor bolts securing the transformer came off and the worker was crushed under the transformer
1110.위험성감소대책: ▶ During erection work of materials or members with level differences, implement overturning-prevention measures by supporting them with lifting devices such as chain blocks and winches to prevent overturning

1111.재해개요: Around November 2016, at a plant site, during work to move a heat exchanger into a building and install it, after it was unloaded by forklift to the basement level 1 material entry point, four workers installed heavy-load transport rollers (so-called dolly casters) at three points underneath and were pushing it manually when one dolly caster wheel caught on an uneven spot on the entry floor (under the entry shutter door) and came off, and the heat exchanger lost balance and toppled toward the victim.
1111.재해유발요인: While transporting materials using a heavy-load pulley cart, the materials toppled over and crushed the worker
1111.위험성감소대책:
▶ When transporting materials, take overturning-prevention measures such as placing the materials on flat platforms to prevent material overturning, then proceed with the work
▶ Prohibit entry of persons other than the workers concerned into the work section and control the surroundings, such as designating separate worker travel routes
▶ Prepare a heavy-object handling work plan and train the workers concerned on safe work methods through risk assessment of the transport method
▶ Provide workers with personal protective equipment and supervise its wearing status

1112.재해개요: Around March 2019, at an OO residential complex construction site, while the victim was bringing inward a deodorizing unit case, hoisted by an electric winch and rested on the pit-level edge of Building OO, the case suddenly slipped off the edge, and the victim, who was working, fell about 7.7 m to the 1st-floor concrete ground below.
1112.재해유발요인: At a mixed-use residential new construction site, while a deodorizing unit case was being lifted, resting on the edge of the pit level and being brought inward, the case suddenly slipped off the edge and the worker who was working fell
1112.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling structures with loads concentrated at the top such as bag filters, review installation conditions such as the number of fastened bolts and differences in support column lengths in advance, then establish a work plan
▶ When dismantling structures with loads concentrated at the top such as bag filters, install safety blocks, safety supports, etc. before lifting rigging work to prevent overturning

1113.재해개요: Around March 2019, at an OO fermentation tank and automation-linked synchronization construction site, while a pressure vessel (about 1.7-ton) lying on the floor was being raised upright using a chain block, the load chain of the chain block fractured, and the victim, working nearby, was struck by the toppling pressure vessel and then crushed under it.
1113.재해유발요인: While raising a pressure vessel lying on its side using a chain block, the chain fractured and the worker was crushed
1113.위험성감소대책: ▶ During erection work of materials or members with level differences, implement overturning-prevention measures by supporting them with lifting devices such as chain blocks and winches to prevent overturning

1114.재해개요: Around April 2019, at OO, while the victim was cutting the guide rail of the parking lift and hoisting it to ground level for front repair work on a mechanical parking garage, the hoist chain fractured and the cut guide rail fell (H≒23m) onto the parking pallet being used as a working platform (between basement levels 4 and 5), and the steel frame and pallet together fell to the basement floor (level 7) (H≒13.5m).
1114.재해유발요인: At a mechanical parking facility repair site, after cutting a lift guide rail and while hoisting it, the hoist chain fractured and the worker fell to the floor together with the falling guide rail
1114.위험성감소대책:
▶ Inspect whether the hoist's overwind prevention device is installed
▶ When using pallets as working platforms, install fall-prevention guardrails
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

1115.재해개요: Around August 2019, at an OO factory, while the victim was loosening the fixing bolts of the safety fence of an existing auto-forming machine in order to relocate the equipment and secure space for installing new equipment, the victim toppled over together with the safety fence and struck his head on the floor.
1115.재해유발요인: To secure space for new equipment installation, while loosening the fixing bolts of the safety fence of an existing auto-forming machine in order to relocate it, the worker fell over together with the safety fence and struck his head on the floor
1115.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before loosening the safety barrier bolts, dismantle the bolts while the barrier is suspended by crane rigging etc.
▶ Install additional braces to prevent overturning, then dismantle the bolts

1116.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the fire-protection work site of an officetel construction project built by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO City, the victim, a pipe fitter belonging to OOOO Co., Ltd., was performing piping work inside the parking tower when the carrier (transverse drive) rose and he was caught between the descending counterweight and a steel Girder, and died. This was a fatal accident.
1116.재해유발요인: During piping work inside a parking tower, the worker was crushed by the counterweight due to operation of the carrier
1116.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with measures to stop operation of carriers etc. during work
   - Prohibit operation while workers are inside the parking tower
   - Deploy attendants etc. at the operating section to prevent unauthorized operation

1117.재해개요: Around April 2017, at a neighborhood living facility construction site located in OO-dong, OO-gu, OO City, a victim belonging to a subcontractor was sitting on a storage rail near the 3rd-tier cart of the storage rack to perform parking equipment installation work on basement level 2, installing guide rollers under the cart, when he lost his balance and fell to the floor; he was taken to a hospital but died during treatment. This was a fatal accident. (H≒4.5m)
1117.재해유발요인: While sitting on the storage rail on the 2nd basement level to install a lower guide roller of a cart for parallel reciprocating parking equipment installation work, the worker lost balance and fell to the floor
1117.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing hangar and cart rail guide rollers, prohibit climbing onto the rails via ladders to work, and take measures so the work is done by installing mobile scaffolds
▶ When installing hangar and cart rail guide rollers, if installation of mobile scaffolds is difficult, implement fall-prevention measures such as installing separate safety harness anchorage facilities or installing safety nets

1118.재해개요: Around November 2017, at the OO Power Plant Unit 3 maintenance construction site, a victim belonging to a sub-subcontractor was replacing heat elements installed in the rotor inside the gas air heater (GAH) of the power boiler (Unit 3) when, in a situation where the rotor operated by a manual air valve had not fully stopped, his head was caught between the rotor and the lower structure, resulting in death.
1118.재해유발요인: At a thermal power plant maintenance site, during replacement of heating elements installed in the internal rotating body of a power boiler air preheater, with the rotating body operated by a manual air valve not fully stopped, the worker's head was caught between the rotating body and the lower structure
1118.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with safety measures for machine maintenance, cleaning, and repair (LOTO)
   - Cut off power using locks on valve handles, electric switches, etc. (Lock out)
   - Attach tags to the locking devices to mark them (Tag out)
▶ Deploy watchers etc. after workers enter

1119.재해개요: Around March 2018, at a fire-protection facility construction site on basement level 1 of the OOOO building located on OO-ro, OO City, the victim was moving downward holding the hangers (hanger bolts) of the lightweight steel ceiling frame in order to install insulation on the fire-protection water supply pipe when he fell, broke through the ceiling finish, and dropped about 8 m to the basement level 1 floor near the auditorium entrance, resulting in death.
1119.재해유발요인: While sitting on the storage rail on the 2nd basement level to install a lower guide roller of a cart for parallel reciprocating parking equipment installation work, the worker lost balance and fell to the floor
1119.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing hangar and cart rail guide rollers, prohibit climbing onto the rails via ladders to work, and take measures so the work is done by installing mobile scaffolds
▶ When installing hangar and cart rail guide rollers, if installation of mobile scaffolds is difficult, implement fall-prevention measures such as installing separate safety harness anchorage facilities or installing safety nets

1120.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO University OO College construction site built by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-gu, OO City, while two mechanical workers were manually moving and installing a hot-water storage tank in the basement level 2 mechanical room, the hot-water storage tank lost balance and toppled, striking one victim and resulting in death.
1120.재해유발요인: During moving and installation of a hot water storage tank, it overturned and crushed the worker
1120.위험성감소대책:
▶ When transporting equipment, install sturdy supports such as base plates and blocks to prevent overturning
▶ Verify the operation of the machinery through safety inspection before work

1121.재해개요: Around June 2018, at the OO-dong complex facility construction site of OOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-dong, OO-gu, OO City, a victim belonging to OOOOO set up a ladder on a pallet inside the parking tower and was performing conduit work to install lights on the wall when the wheeled pallet slid, and he fell about 9.1M down a vertical opening and died. This was a fatal accident.
1121.재해유발요인: While working on a pallet of mechanical parking equipment, the wheeled pallet slid and the worker fell
1121.위험성감소대책:
▶ Verify safety measures when using a pallet as a work boarding platform
   - Check the pallet's fixing status and install guardrails at pallet edges
   - If guardrail installation is not possible, workers fasten safety harnesses
▶ Install and demarcate safe passages when using internal passages of the parking facility
   - Workers fasten safety harnesses when climbing on steel frames such as rails

1122.재해개요: Around June 2018, at the OOOOO Smart Officetel construction site of OOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-eup, OO City, OO Province, the victim was moving along the internal work passage of the parking equipment to inspect materials for fire-protection piping work of the basement level 3 parking equipment when he fell 4.6 m below and died.
1122.재해유발요인: While moving along the internal work passage inside the parking equipment to inspect materials for piping work, the worker fell
1122.위험성감소대책:
▶ Verify safety measures when using a pallet as a work boarding platform
   - Check the pallet's fixing status and install guardrails at pallet edges
   - If guardrail installation is not possible, workers fasten safety harnesses
▶ Install and demarcate safe passages when using internal passages of the parking facility
   - Workers fasten safety harnesses when climbing on steel frames such as rails

1123.재해개요: Around July 2018, at the OOOO complex facility construction site being built by OOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in O-gu, OOO City, a worker belonging to a subcontractor was installing a riser smoke-control duct in the 20th-floor elevator hall and fixing the duct with screws when he lost his balance and fell into the interior of the duct (opening), dropping to the 3rd-floor elevator hall floor (H≒58.9m), resulting in death.
1123.재해유발요인: During riser installation work on a smoke-control duct, the worker fell through an opening inside the duct
1123.위험성감소대책:
▶ Verify safety measures when using a pallet as a work boarding platform
   - Check the pallet's fixing status and install guardrails at pallet edges
   - If guardrail installation is not possible, workers fasten safety harnesses
▶ Install and demarcate safe passages when using internal passages of the parking facility
   - Workers fasten safety harnesses when climbing on steel frames such as rails

   - Verify the assembly condition of major structural parts when assembling mobile scaffolds (install bracing; prohibit installing working platforms on access ladder rungs)

   - Prohibit workers' unsafe behavior (working while stepping on the top of the guardrail)

1146.재해개요: Around July 2016, at the OOOO construction site built by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-dong, OO-gu, OO City, two victims (mechanical equipment workers) belonging to the subcontractor OOOO Co., Ltd. were hoisting a rail (L-angle steel, 4.65m, about 110kg) with a winch from the top of a temporary work platform inside an automobile elevator for elevator rail installation work when the wire rope tied to the rail being hoisted came loose; after moving to a wall steel beam to re-tie it, the moment OOO lowered the temporary work platform, the rail leaning against the wall toppled, and OOO fell from the edge of the temporary work platform to the basement level 1 floor (H≒28m) and died, while OOO was struck by the toppling rail and fractured a finger. ▶ When installing automobile elevator rails, if materials such as rails are leaned against the temporary work platform, take overturning-prevention measures such as placing the materials on flat platforms to prevent material overturning that may occur when the temporary work platform moves up and down, then proceed with the work
▶ Provide workers with personal protective equipment and supervise its wearing status

▶ Inspect the elevator's condition before boarding, and if defects are found in protective devices etc., use it only after maintenance
▶ Train workers to prohibit arbitrary removal, disabling, etc. of elevator protective devices

1152.재해개요: Around December 2020, at the elevator replacement construction site of the OOOO building of OOOOOO Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to OOOOOO Co., Ltd. was performing dismantling work inside the elevator when the chain suspending the elevator in the machine room broke, the elevator dropped, and he fell (H≒22.9m) and died. 1152.재해유발요인: During dismantling of an existing elevator for elevator replacement, the chain (rigging rope, etc.) suspending the elevator broke and the worker fell together with the elevator
1152.위험성감소대책:

▶ Lifting devices supporting heavy objects must have sufficient strength and be selected to suit the purpose; the supervisor must inspect the condition of ropes and their fastening and fixing status before suspending wire ropes etc., and order immediate replacement if abnormalities are found
▶ For lifting chains, the supervisor must, through visual inspection before work, prohibit the use of chains whose length exceeds the length at manufacture by more than 5%, whose link cross-sectional diameter has decreased by more than 10% of the link diameter at manufacture, or which are severely deformed
▶ Implement safety measures such as appointing a work director and prohibiting entry of persons other than the workers concerned

1153.재해개요: Around January 2021, at the OOO elevator replacement construction site of OOO Co., Ltd. located in O-gu, OO City, OO Province, a victim belonging to the elevator replacement subcontractor was riding a temporary car inside the elevator hoistway, performing door hanger removal work (2nd floor above ground), when the rigging rope (sling belt) suspending the temporary car fractured, and he fell with the temporary car about 5 meters to the PIT floor below and died.
1153.재해유발요인: During dismantling of an existing elevator for elevator replacement, the chain (rigging rope, etc.) suspending the elevator broke and the worker fell together with the elevator
1153.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before elevator dismantling work, review and establish a work plan for heavy-object handling etc., and review safe work methods such as selecting the elevator suspension structure and fastening method
▶ Lifting devices supporting heavy objects must have sufficient strength and be selected to suit the purpose; the supervisor must inspect the condition of ropes and their fastening and fixing status before suspending wire ropes etc., and order immediate replacement if abnormalities are found
▶ For lifting chains, the supervisor must, through visual inspection before work, prohibit the use of chains whose length exceeds the length at manufacture by more than 5%, whose link cross-sectional diameter has decreased by more than 10% of the link diameter at manufacture, or which are severely deformed
▶ Implement safety measures such as appointing a work director and prohibiting entry of persons other than the workers concerned

1154.재해개요: Around January 2016, inside a 4th-floor hoistway within a remodeling construction site located in OO-dong, OO City, a victim belonging to a subcontractor was removing dumbwaiter guide rails with an oxygen cutter when he cut the suspension rope supporting the dumbwaiter counterweight, and the falling dumbwaiter counterweight struck his head, resulting in death.
1154.재해유발요인: While removing a dumbwaiter guide rail inside the hoistway, the worker cut the rope supporting the counterweight and was struck by the falling counterweight
1154.위험성감소대책:
▶ When demolishing a dumbwaiter, conduct a preliminary survey of hazards that may arise from the mechanical equipment or the work, then establish a work plan and proceed with the work
▶ When demolishing a dumbwaiter, recognize that a dumbwaiter has no separate emergency stop device and operates with the car and counterweight supported only by the suspension ropes, and improve the work to a safe method such as first cutting the suspension ropes to lower the car or counterweight, then removing the rails

1155.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OOOO OO Building elevator replacement construction site built by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-gu, OO City, worker OOO belonging to the subcontractor OO Co., Ltd. was removing wire ropes and rails on top of the elevator car located on the 14th floor when the chain of the hoist (5-ton) temporarily suspending the elevator fractured, and he fell to the elevator pit on basement level 1 and died.
1155.재해유발요인: While removing E/V ropes, rails, etc. from the top of the E/V car, the connecting chain link of the hoist suspending the temporary car fractured, and the worker fell to the PIT floor together with the car
1155.위험성감소대책:
▶ Supervise so that connecting chains with partially severed links are not used connected to the main chain
▶ For lifting chains, the supervisor must, through visual inspection before work, prohibit the use of chains whose length exceeds the length at manufacture by more than 5%, whose link cross-sectional diameter has decreased by more than 10% of the link diameter at manufacture, or which are severely deformed
▶ For work with fall hazards such as elevator installation and dismantling, implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' wearing of personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

1156.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the OOO escalator guide rail replacement construction site performed by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-gu, OO City, a victim belonging to a subcontractor (OOOO Co., Ltd.) was installing an escalator step chain, and while the chain sprocket of the escalator drive unit was operating to advance the step chain, his head was caught between the advancing step support and the rail support; he was rescued by the 119 rescue service and transported to a hospital but died during treatment.
1156.재해유발요인: During escalator step chain installation work, in the process of operating the drive chain sprocket to advance the step chain, the worker's head was crushed between the step support and the rail support
1156.위험성감소대책:
▶ When repairing or replacing escalators, prohibit machine operation while workers are inside
▶ When pulling the escalator step chain, perform the pulling work from outside, not inside
▶ When repairing or replacing escalators, if the machine must unavoidably be operated from inside, take measures so that the worker inside can operate the machine with a remote control

1157.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the freight elevator installation work area in the material preparation room within the OO factory extension construction site of OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-eup, OO City, OO Province, a victim belonging to OOOO Co., Ltd. was manually pulling up a wire rope and winding it onto a pulley from an H-beam between the 2nd and 3rd floors, in order to connect wire ropes to the upper and lower pulleys of the elevator cylinder, when he fell about 12 m to the concrete floor and died.
1157.재해유발요인: During elevator installation work, while manually raising a rope on an H-beam to connect a wire rope to the upper and lower pulleys of the elevator cylinder, the worker fell to the floor through the opening between the H-beam and the pulley
1157.위험성감소대책:
▶ During elevator installation work, at the work stage of installing wire rope on the pulley, prohibit unsafe work methods such as climbing onto H-BEAMs to work, and take measures to secure work safety by installing mobile scaffolds before proceeding with the work
▶ During elevator installation work, when performing work with fall hazards, perform the work with the safety harness attached to the climbing trap on the steel column
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' wearing of personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

1158.재해개요: Around June 2016, at road pavement work, the victim personally drove a vehicle loaded with an emulsion sprayer to the location, and the moment he disconnected the emulsion sprayer connecting pipe to fill asphalt emulsion, the connecting pipe sprang out under pressure and struck his head hard; from the impact he lost his balance and fell 1.2 m to the ground below, resulting in death.
1158.재해유발요인: On a transport vehicle spraying emulsion, at the moment the worker disconnected the connecting pipe from the drum container storing the emulsion, the connecting pipe sprang out due to residual air pressure inside, collided with the worker, and he fell
1158.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit use other than the intended purpose, such as arbitrarily converting a drum container for simple substance storage into a pressure vessel by injecting compressed air to apply pressure
▶ Wear protective equipment (safety helmet) in preparation for situations such as sudden rupture

1159.재해개요: Around June 2018, at OO expansion work, while square timber (30×30×3,600mm) was being fixed horizontally to a reinforced-earth concrete retaining wall using an air tacker to establish a finish surface for mortar plastering under the veranda exterior insulation (styrofoam), the body of the air tacker exploded, and the victim was struck by fragments of parts such as the cylinder, resulting in death.
1159.재해유발요인: While fixing square timber to a concrete retaining wall using a pneumatic nailer, the pneumatic nailer exploded and the worker was struck by fragments
1159.위험성감소대책: ▶ Inspect work tools, machinery, etc. for abnormalities and normal operation before and after work

1160.재해개요: Around December 2015, at an OOO natural gas power plant construction site, while the victim and a fellow worker were joining containers, a lug weld detached and the tensioned chain struck the victim's head and the fellow worker's left shoulder, and the victim died.
1160.재해유발요인: During container joining work, a lug weld came off due to defective welding, and the worker was struck by the tensioned chain
1160.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish and comply with a heavy-object handling work plan, and inform workers of its contents  
▶ During heavy-object hoisting work, implement access control measures within the working radius and deploy a work director
▶ Thoroughly check the lug welding condition before hoisting work

1161.재해개요: Around January 2018, within the OO factory of OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO City, OOO Province, a victim (OOO) belonging to OOOO Co., Ltd., together with two fellow workers, carried out replacement of the Main Seive, Wire, and Base Plate of Panel Lifter Unit 2 on the 7th floor and reinstallation of the safety fence, and while lowering tools and other items, the safety harness lanyard (double-lanyard type) worn on the victim's upper body was wound into the coupling of Panel Lifter Unit 1 located 1.5m away, severing his shoulder and hip areas and resulting in death.
1161.재해유발요인: After equipment maintenance on Panel Lifter No. 2, while lowering tools and other items, the victim's safety harness hook was drawn into and caught in the coupling of Panel Lifter No. 1
1161.위험성감소대책:
▶ Stop operation and cut power during elevator installation, maintenance, and repair work
▶ Supervise so that the panel lifter's upper protective devices etc. are not arbitrarily removed
▶ Implement safety measures such as appointing a work director and prohibiting entry of persons other than the workers concerned
▶ Provide workers with personal protective equipment and supervise its wearing status

1162.재해개요: Around December 2017, at road construction work, while the victim was fastening a guardrail at the edge of a reinforced-earth retaining wall, the guardrail post failed to withstand its own weight and the victim's body weight, and he fell 12 m to the ground and died.
1162.재해유발요인: While fastening a guardrail to a guardrail post at the edge of a retaining wall, the guardrail post could not withstand the self-weight of the guardrail and the victim's body weight, and the worker fell to the ground together with the guardrail
1162.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing guardrails on reinforced-earth retaining walls, if fixing conventional guardrails is difficult, install guardrails using dedicated brackets for reinforced-earth blocks
▶ Prohibit leaning on guardrail posts while the guardrail posts, horizontal members, etc. are not completely fixed

1163.재해개요: Around September 2018, at charcoal kiln installation work, while waterproofing work was underway at the back face of a reinforced-earth retaining wall, part of the wall (height about 2.7m) collapsed; one person was caught between the wall and stone masonry and died, and one person was struck by falling wall blocks and injured.
1163.재해유발요인: During reinforced-earth retaining wall construction, the reinforced-earth retaining wall collapsed and the worker was crushed
1163.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit placing heavy objects or soil near the top of retaining walls
▶ When excavating at locations close to structures such as retaining walls and concrete walls, implement hazard prevention measures such as reinforcing, relocating, or removing collapse risk factors
▶ Perform sufficient compaction and backfilling work and prohibit rushing the construction
▶ Conduct a preliminary survey of the ground around the retaining wall work and prepare a work plan

1164.재해개요: Around June 2019, at road expansion work, while a PC retaining wall panel was being installed, an unfixed PC panel toppled over — one person was crushed and died, and one person was injured while trying to hold the toppling PC panel.
1164.재해유발요인: During PC retaining wall panel installation, an unsecured PC panel toppled over and crushed the worker
1164.위험성감소대책:
▶ When temporarily placing P.C panels, prohibit work beneath unfixed panels or implement overturning prevention measures such as temporary fixing
▶ Use construction methods with secured safety (such as preceding aggregate backfilling)
▶ When transporting and installing heavy loads, prepare a work plan and perform work according to the plan

1165.재해개요: Around May 2020, at an aggregate production facility construction site, during reinforced-earth retaining wall work, the reinforced-earth retaining wall (6 tiers, height 3m) collapsed and crushed the victim, resulting in death.
1165.재해유발요인: During reinforced-earth retaining wall construction, the reinforced-earth retaining wall collapsed and the worker was crushed
1165.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit placing heavy objects or soil near the top of retaining walls
▶ When excavating at locations close to structures such as retaining walls and concrete walls, implement hazard prevention measures such as reinforcing, relocating, or removing collapse risk factors
▶ Perform sufficient compaction and backfilling work and prohibit rushing the construction
▶ Conduct a preliminary survey of the ground around the retaining wall work and prepare a work plan

1166.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OOO guided drainage channel construction site built by OOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-eup, OO County, OOO Province, site manager OOO of OOOO Co., Ltd. and executive director OOO of OOOO Co., Ltd. entered the existing waterway structure to conduct a preliminary survey of its interior before commencement of construction, and while descending a steep section (slope about 45 degrees) holding a PP rope (Poly Propylene Rope) fixed to the structure, OOO lost his grip on the PP rope and tumbled down the slope (about 20–30m); he was transported to a nearby hospital and died during treatment, and OOO struck the waterway structure and was injured. This was the accident.
1166.재해유발요인: While descending a steep section holding a PP rope for a preliminary survey inside an existing pipeline structure, the worker lost grip of the PP rope and fell
1166.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install barriers, etc. to prevent unauthorized worker entry into fall hazard locations
▶ Install worker movement passages or safe passages such as temporary stairs for moving to pipe-laying locations

1167.재해개요: Around June 2019, at the 'OOOO road improvement construction' site of OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO County, OOO Province, victim OOO had gone down into the excavation zone to install PE double-wall pipe when he was first struck and knocked down by a PE double-wall pipe being carried by an excavator; the startled excavator operator quickly set the PE double-wall pipe down on the excavation bottom, at which moment impact was applied to the fallen victim's head, chest, and other areas, and he was caught between the excavation slope and the pipe, resulting in death.
1167.재해유발요인: While transporting pipes with an excavator for pipe laying work, the excavator collided with a worker
1167.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing work transporting pipes to the bottom of an excavation with an excavator, apply two-line rigging to prevent the pipe from rotating or slipping out of the sling belt, and implement measures to prevent pipe rotation
▶ Deploy a work director and signalmen when handling heavy objects

1168.재해개요: Around June 2019, at the OOOO facility construction site of OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO County, OOO Province, during the operation of lowering a concrete structure fabricated on the ground (2.7×1.9×0.32m, about 4-ton) to the earth-retaining excavation bottom using an excavator — with rigging devices (shackle, fiber belt) attached to the lifting loop (thick steel wire — No. 6 annealed wire) — for steel pipe laying support work in the open-cut earth-retaining section, the lifting loop (No. 6 annealed wire) fractured, and the victim, who was leveling the floor below, was crushed under the concrete structure and died. This was a fatal accident.
1168.재해유발요인: While hoisting a prefabricated pipe foundation concrete block (2.7×1.9×0.32 m, about 4 tons), the lifting hook made of thick steel wire (No. 6 wire) fractured, the block fell, and a worker below was crushed
1168.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy loads, comply with the excavator's rated load and prohibit excessive heavy-load lifting
▶ Control worker entry into the work area when using vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Deploy a spotter to guide vehicle-type construction machinery

1169.재해개요: Around March 2016, for the extension of an OO factory building, while the victim was dismantling various electrical facilities installed on the ceiling, he fell from a building structure 4.4 m high and died.
1169.재해유발요인: While dismantling electrical equipment, stairs, etc., the worker lost balance and fell
1169.위험성감소대책:
▶ Take fall protection measures such as installing guardrails at fall edges such as openings
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

1170.재해개요: Around August 2016, at ground level of an OO demolition site, the victim, who was spraying water to prevent scattering dust from basement level 1 slab demolition work, fell to basement level 3 (H≒9.0m) together with concrete debris (about 1.5㎥) that slid due to the impact of basement demolition work, resulting in death.
1170.재해유발요인: During demolition work, the slab collapsed due to impact or the load of waste materials, and the worker fell and was crushed
1170.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct a structural review, then establish a work plan including appropriate demolition methods and sequence
▶ Reinforce with jack supports below the working floor, installing a structurally sufficient number of jack supports at appropriate locations
▶ Establish a demolition plan after reviewing the stability of the building, such as cracks, concrete strength, rebar arrangement, and degree of aging

1171.재해개요: Around October 2016, at an OO construction site, while the victim was giving signals for radar dome dismantling work, a radar dome member being removed by a truck-mounted mobile crane (cargo crane) struck the victim, and he fell from the rooftop of the weather station building to the ground (H=10.4m) and died.
1171.재해유발요인: During demolition work, demolition debris such as pipes and masonry walls fell and struck a worker
1171.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a work plan including dismantling sequence and support methods, then conduct related safety training
▶ Implement safety measures for dismantling work such as marking work zones, deploying signalmen, and access prohibition measures

1172.재해개요: Around June 2018, at an OO Co., Ltd. construction site, while the victim was clearing debris generated from masonry wall demolition near the demolition work area, the upper part of the masonry wall adjoining the ceiling fell onto the victim's upper body, resulting in death.
1172.재해유발요인: During demolition work, demolition debris such as pipes and masonry walls fell and struck a worker
1172.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a work plan including dismantling sequence and support methods, then conduct related safety training
▶ Implement safety measures for dismantling work such as marking work zones, deploying signalmen, and access prohibition measures

1173.재해개요: Around September 2019, at an OO site being built by OO Construction, while the victim was standing on top of a beam on the 9th floor dismantling an external steel staircase, he lost his balance and fell to the 9th-floor slab (H≒5.2m), resulting in death.
1173.재해유발요인: While dismantling electrical equipment, stairs, etc., the worker lost balance and fell
1173.위험성감소대책:
▶ Take fall protection measures such as installing guardrails at fall edges such as openings
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

1174.재해개요: Around August 2020, at the OO site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., while reinforced-concrete demolition debris was being cleared with an excavator, the victim, who was spraying water near the excavator (distance about 7m), was struck hard in the chest by a piece of debris (concrete lump, weight about 50kg) and died.
1174.재해유발요인: During demolition work, demolition debris such as pipes and masonry walls fell and struck a worker
1174.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a work plan including dismantling sequence and support methods, then conduct related safety training
▶ Implement safety measures for dismantling work such as marking work zones, deploying signalmen, and access prohibition measures

1175.재해개요: Around September 2020, at the OO reconstruction site of OO Co., Ltd., while dismantling work on an existing bridge was underway, the bridge slab collapsed, and the victim, who was releasing the wire rope of a demolition member under the bridge, was crushed under the collapsed structure and died.
1175.재해유발요인: During demolition work, the slab collapsed due to impact or the load of waste materials, and the worker fell and was crushed
1175.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct a structural review, then establish a work plan including appropriate demolition methods and sequence
▶ Reinforce with jack supports below the working floor, installing a structurally sufficient number of jack supports at appropriate locations
▶ Establish a demolition plan after reviewing the stability of the building, such as cracks, concrete strength, rebar arrangement, and degree of aging

1176.재해개요: Around December 2020, at an OO demolition site performed by OO, while the victim was sitting astride an L-shaped bent seawater pipe (W≒550kg, L≒7.4m) cutting the seawater pipe, the seawater pipe dropped and he fell with it to the ground (H≒3.6m), resulting in death.
1176.재해유발요인: During demolition work, demolition debris such as pipes and masonry walls fell and struck a worker
1176.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish a work plan including dismantling sequence and support methods, then conduct related safety training
▶ Implement safety measures for dismantling work such as marking work zones, deploying signalmen, and access prohibition measures

1177.재해개요: Around April 2021, at an OO demolition site being performed by OO Co., Ltd., the 3rd-floor slab, on which waste generated from demolition of the upper building had been piled, collapsed, and the victim, who was spraying water on the 3rd floor, was buried and died.
1177.재해유발요인: During demolition work, the slab collapsed due to impact or the load of waste materials, and the worker fell and was crushed
1177.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct a structural review, then establish a work plan including appropriate demolition methods and sequence
▶ Reinforce with jack supports below the working floor, installing a structurally sufficient number of jack supports at appropriate locations
▶ Establish a demolition plan after reviewing the stability of the building, such as cracks, concrete strength, rebar arrangement, and degree of aging

1178.재해개요: Around November 2021, at the OO multi-family housing construction site of OO General Construction Co., Ltd., while the victim was reinstalling a falling-object prevention net using dedicated supports, during replacement of the supports of the falling-object prevention net tied with wire rope, an eye bolt loosened and detached from the eye bolt–clamp connection, and he fell (H≒5.95m, 5th scaffold lift) and died.
1178.재해유발요인: A worker not wearing a safety harness, while dismantling some of the fastenings to remove a falling-object prevention net, lost balance due to the sudden fall of the falling-object prevention net and fell
1178.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with fall hazards, implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-protection nets
▶ Provide safety protective equipment (safety harness) before work and manage its fastening status
▶ When dismantling falling-object prevention nets, comply with a work method of dismantling sequentially from top to bottom

1179.재해개요: Around December 2021, at a bridge improvement construction site, while the victim, aboard a truck-mounted aerial work platform, was removing a falling-object prevention net under a bridge slab, part of the existing structure detached and fell together with the victim (height 4.7M), and the victim was crushed under the detached existing structure and died.
1179.재해유발요인: While removing a falling-object prevention net under a bridge slab from a truck-mounted aerial work platform, part of the existing structure came off and fell together with the victim, who was crushed by the detached structure
1179.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct a preliminary survey and prepare a work plan
▶ Conduct periodic measurements and implement reinforcement measures according to the measurement results

1180.재해개요: Around January 2016, at an OO refrigeration workplace, the victim fell from the carrier during trial operation of a newly installed vertical conveyor and died.
1180.재해유발요인: While riding in the carrier of a newly installed vertical conveyor during test operation, the worker fell off the carrier to the floor
1180.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prohibit riding on vehicle-type construction machinery anywhere other than the operator's seat

1181.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO repair construction site of the OO pedestrian overpass of OO Construction Co., Ltd., while the victim was putting waste materials into vinyl sacks on the interior floor of a landscape structure, one floor panel (1,150mm × 2,500mm, thickness 4mm, composite panel) suddenly detached, and he fell 6.6 m to the abutment protection floor below and died.
1181.재해유발요인: While tidying waste materials inside a bridge landscape facility, the flooring material suddenly came off and the worker fell to the ground
1181.위험성감소대책: ▶ Install safe passages and working platforms at fall-hazard locations

1182.재해개요: Around June 2019, at an OO construction site, three workers including the victim were involved: two were performing cleaning work on a temporary inclined shelf installed inside the 1st-floor elevator hoistway of lines 1 and 2 of Building 105 to catch debris falling from above, when the support timber holding the temporary inclined shelf collapsed, and two victims fell about 12.0m to the elevator pit level below and died.
1182.재해유발요인: While organizing site materials, the temporary platform the worker was standing on collapsed and the worker fell to the floor
1182.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install working platforms by assembling scaffolds in places with fall risk
▶ Install fall-prevention nets if working platform installation is difficult
▶ Provide and fasten safety harnesses 
▶ Mark opening covers installed on floors so they are identifiable

1183.재해개요: Around July 2019, at an OO factory, for shade canopy installation work, while the victim was covering the frame with the shade canopy from on top of the frame structure, he fell to the floor (H≒4.0m) and died.
1183.재해유발요인: While fixing tarpaulins, nets, etc. on top of a frame structure, the worker lost balance and fell to the ground
1183.위험성감소대책:
▶ Take fall protection measures such as installing guardrails at fall edges such as openings
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

1184.재해개요: Around January 2021, at an OO repair construction site, while the victim was fixing the side golf net and the floor golf net (working while stepping on and moving along wire ropes), he fell (H≒10m) and died.
1184.재해유발요인: While fixing tarpaulins, nets, etc. on top of a frame structure, the worker lost balance and fell to the ground
1184.위험성감소대책:
▶ Take fall protection measures such as installing guardrails at fall edges such as openings
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

1185.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OO construction site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim (PC assembler) belonging to OO Industry Co., Ltd. was adjusting the verticality of a PC column during PC assembly in the underground parking lot when the PC column toppled over and crushed him, resulting in death.
1185.재해유발요인: During PC column verticality adjustment work, rebar with insufficient embedment length (about 5 mm) in the PC column sleeve bent in the X-row direction, the cover concrete at the bottom of the PC column was destroyed, the PC column overturned, and the worker was crushed
1185.위험성감소대책:
▶ When handling heavy objects such as PC columns, install braces and supports to prevent hazards from overturning and crushing
▶ When assembling PC columns, proceed with verticality verification work while they are suspended from lifting equipment

1186.재해개요: Around April 2016, at OO plastering work, while coming down from a pile of bricks used as a platform after exterior wall plastering work, the victim missed his footing and fell from a height of about 0.9 m, resulting in death.
1186.재해유발요인: After exterior wall plastering work, while coming down from a pile of bricks used as a foothold, the worker missed a step and fell
1186.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install and use working platforms (scaffolds, aerial work platforms, etc.) appropriate for the work height
▶ Install work passages (access passages) for moving to the work location
▶ If installation of working platforms is difficult, take measures so that workers wear safety harnesses and install anchorage facilities etc. where safety harnesses can be attached and used

1187.재해개요: Around March 2021, at OO soundproof wall installation work, while plastering the upper part of the inclined back face of the box culvert retaining wall (BOX, 4.0m×4.5m×91.5m) under a bridge, the victim slipped and fell about 3.5 m to the ground below, resulting in death.
1187.재해유발요인: While plastering on the sloped back face of a culvert box retaining wall under a bridge, the worker lost balance at the slope edge, lost his footing, and fell to the ground
1187.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install and use working platforms (scaffolds, aerial work platforms, etc.) appropriate for the work height
▶ Install work passages (access passages) for moving to the work location
▶ If installation of working platforms is difficult, take measures so that workers wear safety harnesses and install anchorage facilities etc. where safety harnesses can be attached and used

1188.재해개요: Around September 2020, at an OO Tower leak defect-repair construction site, while the victim was removing and organizing waterproof sheets on the lower right wall of the building, a signboard base (110㎝×360㎝) that had been attached to the building's exterior wall toppled over and struck the victim's head, resulting in death.
1188.재해유발요인: While removing and tidying waterproof sheets at the bottom of a wall, vibration generated during the work caused a signboard structure, which had been unstably attached to the wall (with stones propped underneath due to damage to the signboard support), to topple over and strike the worker
1188.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing work such as floor concrete crushing around signboard bases with partially damaged square steel tube support structures, implement overturning-prevention measures through reconstruction or installation of supports so that the signboard bases etc. do not fall over
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

1189.재해개요: Around July 2016, at an OO Elementary School exterior painting work site, while the victim was cleaning with a high-pressure washer on top of the canopy over the main entrance, he fell about 3 m to the ground below and died.
1189.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, while cleaning with a high-pressure washer on top of the entrance canopy, the worker fell about 3 m to the ground below
1189.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly implement fall-prevention measures such as installing guardrails and fall-protection nets at fall-hazard locations
▶ If installation of guardrails is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and supervise so that work is performed after fastening safety harnesses

1190.재해개요: Around April 2020, at a building exterior painting work site, while the victim was painting the building's exterior wall using a suspended scaffold, the rooftop parapet (brick) to which the suspended scaffold rope was anchored broke, and the victim fell to the 1st-floor ground while seated on the work seat and was struck on the head by the broken falling bricks, resulting in death.
1190.재해유발요인: While painting a building's exterior wall using a suspended scaffold, the structure anchoring the suspended scaffold rope broke and the worker fell to the ground-floor level
1190.위험성감소대책:
▶ Tie suspended scaffold ropes to two or more solid anchorage points, such as rings embedded in concrete or the building's concrete or steel structures, so they do not come loose
▶ Install protective pads at corners where the hanging ropes contact the structure to prevent abrasion
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

1191.재해개요: Around January 2021, at the OOOOO paint shop main equipment construction site, during duct installation work, a victim belonging to a subcontractor had climbed on top of the BC (Base Coat) intermediate drying oven booth for signaling work when he fell to the 2nd-floor slab of the factory (H≒8.4m) and died.
1191.재해유발요인: While performing signaling work on top of a structure, the worker missed a step and fell from the structure edge where guardrails were not installed
1191.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with installing guardrails of sufficient strength when working at locations where workers may fall
▶ If installing guardrails etc. is difficult, install support ropes etc. as safety harness anchorage facilities

1192.재해개요: Around August 2019, at the OO villa remodeling construction site built by OO Construction, the victim (supervisor) was holding a steel railing (3.1m×1.05m) at a rear balcony window on the 2nd floor and leaning his body out to call a worker outside when the railing, which had been fixed to the concrete wall with screws, detached, and he fell with the railing about 3 m to the asphalt concrete pavement below and died.
1192.재해유발요인: While holding a steel railing on a balcony and leaning out of the window to call a co-worker, the anchorage of the deteriorated steel railing came off and the worker fell to the ground
1192.위험성감소대책:
▶ During remodeling and similar construction, inspect the installation condition of the existing building's aged railings, window frames, etc. before work
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

1193.재해개요: Around November 2018, at the Nohwa commercial-residential building construction site, the victim, after performing roof panel installation work, missed his footing at the edge of the 2nd-floor balcony and fell about 3.45 m to the concrete floor below and died.
1193.재해유발요인: While moving, the worker missed a step at the balcony edge and fell from the edge where guardrails were not installed
1193.위험성감소대책:
▶ When workers move or work in fall-risk places (slab edges, etc.), install working platforms at least 40cm wide such as by assembling external scaffolds, and firmly install fall-prevention safety facilities such as guardrails at edge sections
▶ When installing guardrails, use metal pipes with a diameter of at least 2.7cm or materials of greater strength, and install with a structure that can withstand a load of at least 100kg acting in the weakest direction at the structurally weakest point
▶ If installing working platforms and guardrails at slab edges, etc. is difficult, install fall-prevention nets or install safety harness anchorage facilities and manage safety harness fastening to prevent worker falls
▶ When work on the building exterior is needed, avoid working by leaning out from the inside, and supervise so that work is done using aerial work platforms or suspended scaffolds, etc.
▶ For finishing material removal work, plan the work in the order of removing finishing materials such as panels first and then removing supports, to prevent accidents such as unexpected falling of finishing materials

1194.재해개요: Around February 2020, at the OO Co., Ltd. factory roof gutter installation site, while the victim was moving along the top of a retaining wall to reach the roof gutter installation location, a capping block on top of the wall came loose, and the victim lost his balance and fell from a height of about 3 m to the factory building floor and died.
1194.재해유발요인: While moving on top of a retaining wall, the retaining wall block the worker was standing on came off and he fell to the ground
1194.위험성감소대책:
▶ When workers move or work in fall-risk places (slab edges, etc.), install working platforms at least 40cm wide such as by assembling external scaffolds, and firmly install fall-prevention safety facilities such as guardrails at edge sections
▶ When installing guardrails, use metal pipes with a diameter of at least 2.7cm or materials of greater strength, and install with a structure that can withstand a load of at least 100kg acting in the weakest direction at the structurally weakest point
▶ If installing working platforms and guardrails at slab edges, etc. is difficult, install fall-prevention nets or install safety harness anchorage facilities and manage safety harness fastening to prevent worker falls
▶ When work on the building exterior is needed, avoid working by leaning out from the inside, and supervise so that work is done using aerial work platforms or suspended scaffolds, etc.
▶ For finishing material removal work, plan the work in the order of removing finishing materials such as panels first and then removing supports, to prevent accidents such as unexpected falling of finishing materials

1195.재해개요: Around July 2020, while the victim was caulking joints of exterior metal panels on the right side of a building, he left the platform of the aerial work platform (truck-mounted type) and was working on top of a canopy when he fell (H≒5.2m) and died.
1195.재해유발요인: After leaving the aerial work platform, while working on top of a canopy, the worker missed a step and fell to the ground
1195.위험성감소대책:
▶ When workers move or work in fall-risk places (slab edges, etc.), install working platforms at least 40cm wide such as by assembling external scaffolds, and firmly install fall-prevention safety facilities such as guardrails at edge sections
▶ When installing guardrails, use metal pipes with a diameter of at least 2.7cm or materials of greater strength, and install with a structure that can withstand a load of at least 100kg acting in the weakest direction at the structurally weakest point
▶ If installing working platforms and guardrails at slab edges, etc. is difficult, install fall-prevention nets or install safety harness anchorage facilities and manage safety harness fastening to prevent worker falls
▶ When work on the building exterior is needed, avoid working by leaning out from the inside, and supervise so that work is done using aerial work platforms or suspended scaffolds, etc.
▶ For finishing material removal work, plan the work in the order of removing finishing materials such as panels first and then removing supports, to prevent accidents such as unexpected falling of finishing materials

1196.재해개요: Around December 2020, at OO construction work, while the victim was performing electrical wiring work for supply/exhaust fans, he lost his balance and fell to the 1st-floor ground (H≒3.1m), resulting in death.
1196.재해유발요인: During installation of light switch boxes, hood caps, lighting conduits, fire-fighting pipes, etc., the worker fell to the floor from a height of 2 m or more
1196.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safe working platforms for high-place work at 2 m or more, then work (install and use mobile scaffolds)
▶ Comply with safety rules when installing and using mobile scaffolds
   - Install guardrails at the top of the mobile scaffold
   - Install outriggers at the bottom to prevent overturning (4 points)
   - Workers on top of working platforms work after fastening safety harnesses
     => When fastening a safety harness to a mobile frame scaffold, fasten it considering the lowest fall point of the safety harness
     => When assembling two or more tiers of mobile frame scaffold at a height of 1.8 m per tier, fasten the safety harness to the frame scaffold
   - Verify the assembly condition of major structural parts when assembling mobile scaffolds (install bracing; prohibit installing working platforms on access ladder rungs)
   - When ascending or descending mobile scaffolds, install hatch platforms and use the access ladder on the inside
   - Prohibit workers' unsafe behavior (working while stepping on the top of the guardrail)

1197.재해개요: Around August 2019, at OO construction work, while the victim and another worker had climbed a streetlight and were replacing the arm, the streetlight lost its bearing capacity and toppled over, and they fell to the ground (H≒5m), injuring two people.
1197.재해유발요인: While climbing a streetlight to replace its arm, the streetlight lost its bearing capacity and toppled over, and the worker fell to the ground
1197.위험성감소대책: ▶ When climbing aged structures to work, conduct a safety assessment of the structure's safety, such as cracks and the condition of internal steel strands, before work, then implement measures to prevent falling over

1198.재해개요: Around March 2017, at OO construction work, after installing suspension clamps and other fittings on the lower arm of a transmission tower, the victim was attempting to move from the power line to the lower arm via the insulator string when he lost his balance and fell 26 m to the ground below and died.
1198.재해유발요인: While performing work at the top of a transmission tower, such as lightning arrester installation and replacement of compression dead-end clamps and jumper sockets, and while ascending and descending, the victim lost his footing and fell to the ground
1198.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before erecting the steel tower, pre-attach safety harness anchorage equipment to each member on the ground
   - Inspect the condition of main-leg step bolts and install safety ropes
   - Pre-assemble on the ground, including installing safety harness anchorage equipment on horizontal members (arms)
▶ Workers on the tower's ascent/descent passages and on top of horizontal members (arms) work with safety harnesses fastened
▶ Install fall-prevention nets (inside the main legs) and falling-object prevention nets (outside the main legs) at every 10 m of height

1199.재해개요: Around January 2021, at an OO extension construction site, a mixer — factory equipment loaded on a lifting shelf (hereinafter 'shelf') — was hoisted with a mobile crane, the shelf was set against the 3rd-floor slab of the factory and connected with ropes to factory columns (H-Beam) and other points to prevent swaying; the moment the victim climbed onto the shelf and released the fiber belts securing the mixer, the mixer resting on a cart moved suddenly, the shelf shook, the rope came loose, and at the same time the shelf separated from the slab; as a result, the victim lost his balance and fell about 13 m to the concrete floor below.
1199.재해유발요인: A mixer (factory equipment) loaded on a lifting shelf (hereinafter 'shelf') was lifted by a mobile crane, the shelf was placed against the 3rd-floor slab of the factory and connected with ropes to factory columns (H-Beam) to prevent shaking; at the moment the victim and two others climbed onto the shelf and were removing the fiber belts securing the mixer, the sudden movement of the mixer resting on a cart caused the shelf to shake, the ropes came loose, and the shelf slipped off the floor; as a result, the victim lost balance and fell onto the concrete floor below
1199.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit acts such as arbitrarily allowing workers to ride on places that are not boarding facilities
▶ For work with fall hazards, perform the work using aerial work platforms or mobile scaffolds
▶ Provide personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety harness) before work and manage its wearing status

1200.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OOOOOO Co., Ltd. / OOO installation construction site located in OO-myeon, OO County, OO City, while two victims, tower assemblers, were assembling the triangular-section steel trusses of the OOO (25 of a total of 27 already installed), the connection at the guy wire (Guy Wire) foundation of the OOO detached, and the wind measurement tower toppled over together with the two victims who were assembling the steel trusses, resulting in their deaths. This was the accident.
1200.재해유발요인: During assembly work on the triangular-section steel truss of a wind measurement tower, the connection at the guy-wire foundation of the tower came off, and the tower toppled over together with the worker
1200.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with assembly standards for the weathering tower's base connections
   - Comply with assembly standards according to the design drawings (perform temporary assembly according to the specifications)
   - Review the weathering tower's self-supporting capacity in advance and take additional reinforcement measures if necessary

1201.재해개요: Around February 2017, within OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-eup, OO City, OOO Province, a victim (OOO) belonging to the subcontractor OOOOOO was crushed under semiconductor equipment (AVI) that toppled over during equipment separation work; he was transported to a hospital but died. This was a fatal accident.
1201.재해유발요인: During equipment separation work, the worker was crushed by toppling semiconductor equipment
1201.위험성감소대책:
