▶ Prepare a dismantling work plan for equipment dismantling work
   - Verify information on the structure to be dismantled (drawings, structural review reports, etc.)
   - Dismantling sequence and dismantling method of the facility
   - Establish overturning-prevention measures and reinforcement measures during dismantling

1202.재해개요: Around July 2017, at the OO room equipment construction site of OO Co., Ltd.'s OO O workplace (Building T9), built by OOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-ri, OO-myeon, OO City, OOO City, a duct worker belonging to a subcontractor, using sandwich panels (t=5cm) — the ceiling finish of the OO room — as a platform, attached insulation to the joint (flange) of an air purification duct (800mm×500mm) and was applying aluminum taping to the duct side when one ceiling panel (2m×1m) he was standing on buckled and detached from the ceiling frame (T-bar), and he fell with the panel about 10 m to the concrete floor below and died. This was a fatal accident.
1202.재해유발요인: During electrical wiring and duct installation work on top of ceiling panels, the ceiling could not withstand the panel self-weight and work load and collapsed, and the worker fell with it
1202.위험성감소대책:
▶ When moving to the roof top, move safely using aerial work platforms (truck-mounted, scissor type) or fixed vertical ladders
   - Workers fasten safety harnesses when using fixed vertical ladders
▶ When moving on the roof top, install platforms of 60 cm or more to demarcate travel routes (establish a work plan in advance)
   - Install sturdy platforms on top of aged ceiling panels, color steel sheets, and skylights (sunlights)
▶ Prohibit overloading materials on the roof top
▶ Install guardrails at roof edges to implement fall-prevention measures at the edges
▶ Install fall-prevention nets below the roof before roof work, then perform the work
▶ Roof dismantling and repair workers work with safety harnesses fastened

1203.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO construction site of OO Co., Ltd., while a mobile ceiling work platform, suspended from support rails for ceiling electrical and fire-protection installation work, was being moved horizontally to the next work location, the right rail joint in the platform's direction of travel failed to withstand the platform's load and buckled, the platform support (Bogie) fastened to the rail came off the rail, and consequently the remaining three supports of the platform fractured; the victim on the platform fell with the platform about 14.6 m to the ground and died.
1203.재해유발요인: During horizontal movement of a mobile ceiling work platform, the support came off the rail, causing fracture of the support, and the worker fell to the ground
1203.위험성감소대책:
▶ Use mobile ceiling work platforms in compliance with the usage standards set by the manufacturer
▶ Comply with design standards when installing the platform support rails

1204.재해개요: Around December 2019, at the OOO Co., Ltd. workplace located in OO-gu, OO City, OOO Province, side plates of a 640-ton press brake were being moved and installed with a mobile crane for installation of the press brake, and the moment the rigging of a side plate was removed, the side plate toppled over and crushed two workers, resulting in their deaths.
1204.재해유발요인: While installing a side plate of a bending machine moved by a mobile crane for bending machine installation, at the moment the rigging on the side plate was removed, the side plate toppled over and crushed the worker
1204.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan for equipment installation work
   - Verify information on the installation target (drawings, structural review reports, etc.)
   - Installation sequence and method of the facility
   - Establish reinforcement measures such as overturning-prevention measures

1205.재해개요: Around March 2020, at the OO OOOO OOOO commercial building construction site located in OOO-dong, OO City, OOO Province, a victim belonging to a sub-subcontractor stepped on the guardrail of an aerial work platform (scissor type) and climbed onto a previously installed lower duct (installation height 6.3m) to install an upper duct (installation height 7.2m) in the 5th-floor cinema corridor; while performing measurement work with his safety harness hooked to a duct hanger, the duct hanger broke (threaded rod detached), the lower duct sagged downward, and he fell about 6.3m to the floor and died. This was a fatal accident.
1205.재해유발요인: To install an upper duct, the worker climbed onto a previously installed lower duct, attached his safety harness to a duct hanger, and was performing measurement work when a threaded rod came off, the duct hanger broke, the lower duct tilted, and he fell to the floor
1205.위험성감소대책:
▶ For HVAC duct installation work with fall hazards, implement fall-prevention measures such as sturdy working platforms and aerial work platforms
▶ If installation of working platforms is difficult, implement prevention measures such as installing safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Conduct a safety inspection before work to verify proper fastening of the threaded rods

1206.재해개요: Around September 2020, at the factory relocation repair construction site of OOOO Co., Ltd. located at OOO OO, OO-eup, OO City, two victims (male, employees) belonging to OOOO Co., Ltd. performed ventilation equipment (duct pipe) installation work above the ceiling of the LCD film processing shop and were moving to come down to the floor when a sandwich panel (EPS, 2,200×1,000×50) buckled and they fell about 2.8 m to the concrete floor below, resulting in injuries.
1206.재해유발요인: During electrical wiring and duct installation work on top of ceiling panels, the ceiling could not withstand the panel self-weight and work load and collapsed, and the worker fell with it
1206.위험성감소대책:
▶ When moving to the roof top, move safely using aerial work platforms (truck-mounted, scissor type) or fixed vertical ladders
   - Workers fasten safety harnesses when using fixed vertical ladders
▶ When moving on the roof top, install platforms of 60 cm or more to demarcate travel routes (establish a work plan in advance)
   - Install sturdy platforms on top of aged ceiling panels, color steel sheets, and skylights (sunlights)
▶ Prohibit overloading materials on the roof top
▶ Install guardrails at roof edges to implement fall-prevention measures at the edges
▶ Install fall-prevention nets below the roof before roof work, then perform the work
▶ Roof dismantling and repair workers work with safety harnesses fastened

1207.재해개요: Around February 2021, in the turbine building within the OOOOOO construction site located in OO City, OOO Province, a victim (OOO) belonging to OOOOO Co., Ltd. was lifting a grating installed in the 2nd floor using his safety harness hook when he fell 9.5m below together with the grating and died. This was a fatal accident.
1207.재해유발요인: While lifting a steel grating, the worker fell together with the grating
1207.위험성감소대책:
▶ Verify safety measures when using a pallet as a work boarding platform
   - Check the pallet's fixing status and install guardrails at pallet edges
   - If guardrail installation is not possible, workers fasten safety harnesses
▶ Install and demarcate safe passages when using internal passages of the parking facility
   - Workers fasten safety harnesses when climbing on steel frames such as rails

1208.재해개요: Around April 2018, at the OOOO parking lot fence reinforcement construction site located in OO-gu, OOO City, the victim, who was leveling the excavated ground for installation of an L-shaped fence, was crushed under a masonry wall (area: 4.68㎡), remaining after demolition of an existing house, when it toppled over; people nearby rescued him and he was transported to a hospital, but he died. This was a fatal accident.
1208.재해유발요인: While clearing the excavated floor for L-shaped fence installation, a masonry wall remaining after demolition of an existing house toppled over and crushed the worker underneath
1208.위험성감소대책:
▶ During excavation work, implement measures to prevent overturning hazards of adjacent structures (installing sturdy supports, etc.)
▶ When working close to aged fences, identify hazards from vibration, impact, etc. by conducting a preliminary survey

1209.재해개요: Around October 2017, at a road construction site, while the victim was performing defect-repair work on PC protective walls on a truck bed using an excavator, a PC protective wall fell from the bed and his lower body was crushed under it, resulting in death.
1209.재해유발요인: While unloading a truck using an excavator, materials shook from the impact and fell from the cargo bed, crushing a worker
1209.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using vehicle-type material handling machinery, prepare a work plan and perform work according to the plan
▶ Control worker entry into falling-object hazard areas during heavy-load handling work such as material lifting

1210.재해개요: Around May 2019, at a port development project site, while the victim was unloading materials, the materials caught on the side edge of the truck bed, and while removing them he was crushed under the materials and died.
1210.재해유발요인: While unloading PET MAT brought in for soft-ground improvement laying, the PET MAT caught on the cargo bed of the truck, and while the worker was removing the caught material, he was crushed by the PET MAT
1210.위험성감소대책:
▶ During unloading work, prohibit solo work by workers such as forcibly removing jammed materials manually
▶ During unloading work, prepare a work plan and perform the unloading work according to the work plan

1211.재해개요: In November 2019, at a railway roadbed construction site, when the victim leaned his body weight on a guardrail to move, the guardrail post detached and he fell 6 m to the farm road below and died.
1211.재해유발요인: The guardrail could not withstand the worker's body weight, the guardrail post came off, and the worker fell to the farm-road ground together with the guardrail materials
1211.위험성감소대책:
▶ Provide safety helmets and manage their wearing
▶ Control worker entry where there is a fall hazard
▶ Check the condition of guardrails before work and install them sturdily

1212.재해개요: Around June 2021, at a multi-family housing construction site, while the victim was leveling aggregate at the bottom of a fence, the excavation slope and the fence above collapsed, resulting in death.
1212.재해유발요인: While leveling aggregate at the bottom of an excavation below a fence, the excavation slope and the fence above collapsed
1212.위험성감소대책:
▶ For excavation faces adjacent to nearby structures, manage excavation slope collapse through periodic measurement
▶ If anomalies occur during excavation face measurement, immediately stop work, reinforce nearby slopes, and install shoring

1213.재해개요: Around November 2020, at a bridge repair construction site, after upper strand tensioning work was completed and while the victim was helping carry tools, the anchorage of an upper strand detached and struck his head, resulting in death.
1213.재해유발요인: The anchorage of the upper steel strand came off, and the detached anchorage or the connected steel bar struck the worker's head
1213.위험성감소대책: ▶ If there is a risk of the anchorage and steel rods detaching due to loads applied to the anchorage such as steel strand tension, conduct a safety assessment covering increased steel strand tension, reduced friction at the contact surface between the anchorage and concrete, etc.

1214.재해개요: Around September 2017, at a complex facility construction site, while the victim, a formwork carpenter, and three fellow workers were installing bands on 1st-floor column formwork, he fell from a point 3.5m high to the concrete floor and died during treatment at a hospital. This was a fatal accident.
1214.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, while installing column formwork bands, the worker lost balance and fell
1214.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as safety nets, guardrails, and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Provide and wear safety harnesses before work, with thorough checking of fastening status by the supervisor

1215.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the OO Plaza construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor was stacking formwork on a temporary material stacking platform above the basement level 1 material hoisting opening (2,000mm×7,400mm) when a shore installed under the 3rd-floor floor beam fell about 3.9 m through the material hoisting opening and struck the victim's head, resulting in death.
1215.재해유발요인: Without measures against falling-object hazards, while stacking formwork on a temporary material rack above the material lifting opening, a shore installed under a ground-floor beam fell and struck the worker's head
1215.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install falling-object prevention nets etc. for material-lifting openings
▶ If installation of falling-object prevention nets etc. is not possible, control worker access
▶ Thoroughly check the fixing condition of shores to the cap beams

1216.재해개요: Around January 2017, at the OO hotel construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim installed joists and plywood formwork on top of the system shores in the basement level 1 mechanical room, and while trying to come down or while moving to install slab formwork, he lost his balance and fell about 5.0m to the basement level 1 concrete floor below and died.
1216.재해유발요인: Without a movement passage secured to the formwork work area, after installing joists and plywood formwork on top of system shores, while coming down, the worker lost balance and fell
1216.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work on top of system shores with fall hazards, install safe passages such as mobile ladders or mobile scaffolds
▶ For work with fall hazards, implement safety protection measures such as safety nets, guardrails, and safety harness anchorage facilities

1217.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the OO sewage treatment plant construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor was installing the inner wall formwork of the 1st-floor wall of the sewage treatment plant and the upper Slab formwork when he fell about 7.35m to the concrete floor of the UMBR tank (upflow multi-layer bio reactor) below and died.
1217.재해유발요인: With working platforms for system shore installation poorly installed and not fixed, during installation of the inner wall formwork of the ground-level wall of a sewage treatment plant and the upper slab formwork, an unfixed working platform flipped over and the worker fell
1217.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing system shores, install working platforms tightly to prevent falls
▶ Fix working platforms to two or more supports so they do not flip over or come off
▶ When installing system shores, if there is a fall hazard, install fall-prevention nets or install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

1218.재해개요: Around July 2018, at the OO apartment construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor was working from a horizontal member of the system shores, fixing flat ties (Flat tie)* and wedge pins (Wedge pin)** to wall euro-forms, when he fell to the ground (H≒2.0m) and died.
1218.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, while fixing flat ties and wedge pins to wall euro-forms from a horizontal member of system shores, the worker lost balance and fell
1218.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work on top of system shores with fall hazards, install safe passages such as mobile ladders or mobile scaffolds
▶ For work with fall hazards, implement safety protection measures such as safety nets, guardrails, and safety harness anchorage facilities

1219.재해개요: Around August 2018, during flat-tie fastening work on wall formwork on basement level 1 of Building OO, a fellow worker found the victim collapsed on the floor, and he died at a hospital.
1219.재해유발요인: While standing and working on a horizontal member of system shores, the worker fell
1219.위험성감소대책:
▶ Keep the workplace surroundings tidy and install working platforms appropriate for the work
▶ Wear safety harnesses to prevent falling over or falls from height
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

1220.재해개요: Around August 2020, at the OO construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor was working from a steel pipe (D=48.6mm, L=4m) to perform the final fixing of wall formwork in the basement level 3 mechanical room when he lost his balance and fell about 2.5 m to the concrete floor below and died.
1220.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, while fixing flat ties and wedge pins to wall euro-forms from a horizontal member of system shores, the worker lost balance and fell
1220.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work on top of system shores with fall hazards, install safe passages such as mobile ladders or mobile scaffolds
▶ For work with fall hazards, implement safety protection measures such as safety nets, guardrails, and safety harness anchorage facilities

1221.재해개요: Around October 2019, at the OO construction site built by OOOO Co., Ltd., while dismantling work was being carried out on the system shores of the passage connecting sections 1 and 2 on the 10th floor, the victim fell about 4M to the 9th-floor slab below and died.
1221.재해유발요인: With the working platform inadequately installed, during beam formwork dismantling work, the moment the worker stepped on formwork placed on top of square timbers, the formwork flipped over and the worker fell
1221.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with fall risk, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or work after wearing a safety harness
▶ When installing working platforms, firmly secure them so they do not flip over or fall

1222.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. multi-family housing construction site, while 6th-floor exterior wall formwork was dismantled and being hoisted to the rooftop floor using winches, one winch support lost balance and toppled over, and victims were struck by the support — one died and one was injured.
1222.재해유발요인: Using deformed, corroded, and damaged formwork materials, while dismantling ground-level exterior wall formwork fixed to winches, one winch support lost balance and overturned, striking a worker; another worker fell due to the impact
1222.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit use of deformed, corroded, or damaged formwork materials
▶ Check the materials for use for deformation, damage, etc. before work and inspect for abnormalities
▶ When working at fall-hazard locations, install working platforms and fall-protection nets
▶ If installation of fall-protection nets is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

1223.재해개요: Around October 2020, at the OO site of OO Co., Ltd., while seven workers belonging to the subcontractor OO Development Co., Ltd. were placing slab concrete for facility B-1, the system shores failed to withstand their own weight, work loads, and other loads and collapsed, and the seven workers fell about 11.6 m to the floor below and were buried, resulting in injuries.
1223.재해유발요인: During slab concrete pouring, the system shores could not withstand the self-weight and work load and collapsed, and the worker fell to the floor and was buried
1223.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct structural review, prepare assembly drawings, and assemble and install in a sturdy structure
▶ For system shores, comply with detail drawings, such as installing bracing, so that displacement due to loads does not occur

1224.재해개요: Around November 2016, at an OO logistics warehouse construction site, eight workers including the victim (concrete placer) placed concrete in the morning as a first stage on the beams and valleys of the 3rd-floor (H=7.2m) slab laid with TU-Deck, and in the afternoon, during the second-stage concrete placement over the entire slab and beams, the Deck (12m×15m) plate and the system shores below suddenly collapsed; the Deck plate slab detached from the TU beams all at once and gave way, falling with the concrete 7.2 m to the 2nd-floor slab below, and eight workers were injured.
1224.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring over the entire slab and beams, the deck plate and lower system shores collapsed, and the deck plate slab detached from the beam and fell onto workers
1224.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using deck plates, conduct structural review, prepare assembly drawings, etc., and assemble and install in a sturdy structure
▶ For system shores, install bracing so that displacement due to loads does not occur

1225.재해개요: For lift dismantling work, while work was underway on top of the lift carrier (Cage) to remove mast (Mast) connecting bolts and load the masts onto the top of the carrier, the lift carrier over-rose onto a mast (#15) whose connecting bolts had already been removed, and the unsupported mast (#15) and the carrier fell together to the ground (H=23m); the two victims working on top of the carrier fell and died.
1225.재해유발요인: While working in the carrier for construction lift dismantling, the carrier over-rose into the previously stacked mast and dropped, and the worker fell
1225.위험성감소대책:
▶ During lift dismantling work, install safety harness anchorage facilities and thoroughly wear and fasten safety harnesses to prevent worker falls
▶ During lift dismantling work, install an overwind prevention device to prevent the hazard of the carrier over-rising and derailing
▶ When using and dismantling lifts, conduct training for workers on how to operate the control switches

1226.재해개요: Around February 2017, at a residential-commercial complex construction site, the victim was on top of a lift cage removing the lift wall ties installed at the 14th floor for construction lift dismantling work when he lost his balance and fell onto the falling-object prevention net at the 3rd floor (H≒38.0m), resulting in death.
1226.재해유발요인: While working on top of the cage for construction lift dismantling, the worker lost balance and fell
1226.위험성감소대책:
▶ During lift dismantling work, install safety harness anchorage facilities and thoroughly wear and fasten safety harnesses to prevent worker falls
▶ During lift dismantling work, install an overwind prevention device to prevent the hazard of the carrier over-rising and derailing
▶ During lift dismantling work, install guardrails across the front of the cage top

1227.재해개요: Around June 2018, at an OO regional housing association apartment construction site, the victim, using the roof plate of a construction lift carrier as a platform, was preparing to drill anchor bolt holes for fixing wall ties (Wall-Tie)＊ — extension work — when he lost his balance and fell, struck a wall tie at the 14th floor, and then fell again to the concrete floor below (H≒45m), resulting in death.
1227.재해유발요인: While working on the roof plate of the carrier for construction lift extension installation, the worker lost balance and fell
1227.위험성감소대책:
▶ During construction lift mast extension work, implement fall-prevention measures such as installing separate safety harness anchorage facilities and fastening safety harnesses
▶ During construction lift mast extension work, install guardrails across the front of the carrier's roof top

1228.재해개요: Around January 2019, at a livestock facility modernization project reconstruction site, the victim used a lift to get off at the 2nd floor to take measurements before installing external stairs for 2nd-floor access and internal pigpen partitions, then tried to reboard the lift, which was still rising toward the rooftop level (3rd floor), and his chest was caught between the lift carrier floor and the framed upper part of the doorway, resulting in death.
1228.재해유발요인: After getting off a construction lift, while attempting to re-board the still-ascending lift, the worker was crushed between the carrier and the frame above the entrance
1228.위험성감소대책:
▶ Verify whether safety certification of the construction lift has been carried out and take measures
▶ Check whether the names of the construction lift's operating switches and related information are labeled
▶ Install temporary stairs, etc., so that workers can move safely by means other than the construction lift

1229.재해개요: Around August 2019, at an OO Construction residential-commercial complex construction site, during dismantling of the mast of a construction lift, the mast collapsed due to premature removal of the mast connecting bolts, and the carrier, which was at the height of the 22nd floor, fell to the ground together with the mast; two victims working inside and on top of the carrier died and one victim was injured, and due to debris from the collapsed lift, one victim on the ground died and two victims were injured.
1229.재해유발요인: During construction lift dismantling work, collapse occurred due to premature removal of mast connection bolts
1229.위험성감소대책:
▶ During mast dismantling work, prohibit pre-removal or incomplete fastening of mast connection bolts
▶ Install separate safety harness anchorage facilities to prevent falls

1230.재해개요: Around September 2020, at an OO Construction apartment construction site, two victims, on top of the carrier positioned at 6th-floor height for construction lift dismantling, removed the mast connecting bolts and were raising the carrier by manual operation to load the removed mast when, due to over-rise of the carrier (presumed misoperation), the carrier fell with the already-dismantled mast about 18 m to the ground below, and both died.
1230.재해유발요인: After lift dismantling work, while the carrier was ascending for loading, the carrier over-rose and the worker fell to the ground together with the already-disconnected mast
1230.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement temporary safety device measures to prevent dislodgement due to over-hoisting
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and guardrails

1231.재해개요: Around December 2019, at a residential-commercial complex construction site being built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to a subcontractor put his head through the gap in the edge guardrail (between the top rail and mid rail) of the outdoor AC unit room (balcony) at the rear of the 4th floor in order to reinforce a damaged section of the waterproof curb on the room's floor, and while working, his head was caught between the descending lift carrier and the guardrail, resulting in death.
1231.재해유발요인: Without access-restriction measures and without a work supervisor assigned, while working with his head stuck through the gap in the guardrail (between the top rail and mid rail) at the edge of an outdoor AC unit room to reinforce a damaged waterproof curb on the floor at the rear of the ground level, the worker's head was caught between the descending lift carrier and the guardrail
1231.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in hazardous sections, perform work after eliminating risk factors such as stopping the machinery and equipment in use
▶ Assign a work supervisor and control worker access

1232.재해개요: Around February 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. apartment construction site, a victim (concrete placer) belonging to OO Construction Co., Ltd. was finishing the top surface of the parapet wall after concrete placement of the parapet wall on the piloti level of Building 101 when he was caught between the descending construction lift carrier (cage) and the parapet wall, resulting in death.
1232.재해유발요인: After pouring concrete for a parapet wall on the piloti level, while finishing the top surface of the parapet, the worker was caught between the descending construction lift carrier and the parapet wall
1232.위험성감소대책:
▶ Where there is a risk to workers entering as the construction lift carrier moves up and down, implement access prohibition measures such as installing barriers
▶ When barriers must unavoidably be removed, implement measures to cut off the power to the construction lift

1233.재해개요: Around December 2017, at OO construction, while materials for wet work were being transported from the 1st floor to the 2nd floor using a car lift, when a beeping sound came from below the rising car lift, the victim stuck his head out over the car lift wall to check below, and his head was caught between a rail bracket and a lift bracket, resulting in death.
1233.재해유발요인: While arbitrarily operating a construction lift whose installation had not been completed to transport plastering materials, a worker who stuck his head out to check the situation upon hearing an abnormal noise was caught between the rail bracket and the lift bracket of the moving lift
1233.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing installation, assembly, repair, or dismantling work on a construction lift, prohibit access by unauthorized personnel and install signs
▶ Install locking devices on the construction lift entrance and control panel (switches)
▶ Inform workers of the relevant details and, if necessary, cut off the power to prevent unauthorized operation of the construction lift

1234.재해개요: Around May 2019, at OO construction, during masonry transport work, the victim boarded a lift carrier that had stopped between the 8th and 9th floors, and while coming back down to the 8th floor, fell through the vertical opening (width 1,300mm X height 1,350mm) between the bottom of the lift carrier and the 8th-floor balcony slab (height≒22.0m), resulting in death.
1234.재해유발요인: Unaware of the malfunction of the construction lift, the worker boarded the lift for masonry transport work and, while descending, fell through the opening between the construction lift and the structure slab
1234.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly implement access prohibition measures when the construction lift breaks down
▶ Use construction lifts that conform to safety certification standards and safety inspection standards
▶ Establish a maintenance and breakdown response system for construction lifts

1235.재해개요: Around June 2016, at OO construction, after surface-finishing work inside the 16-story building, while tidying up and coming down, the victim fell from the construction lift entrance on the 14th floor to the 1st-floor ground (H≒36m) and died.
1235.재해유발요인: After finishing surface-finishing work, the worker boarded a construction lift to move, but when the lift stopped due to malfunction, he arbitrarily operated the lift, such as releasing the lock of the safety door, lost balance, and fell
1235.위험성감소대책:
▶ Since use in a broken or malfunctioning state poses an accident risk, implement measures prohibiting operation
▶ In an emergency (breakdown), prohibit uninformed actions and always request a specialist to handle it
▶ Provide special safety training for workers using the construction lift on the functions and use of lift safety devices, the characteristics and operating principles of the machinery and equipment, emergency response measures, etc.

1236.재해개요: Around January 2017, at OO construction, the victim boarded a lift for surface-finishing work inside units and was about to get off at the 5th floor when the lift carrier suddenly descended about 60cm; he lost his balance and fell over, and was caught between the lift carrier and the exterior wall of the structure, resulting in death.
1236.재해유발요인: While getting off a lift boarded for interior surface-finishing work, the lift carrier suddenly descended, and the worker lost balance, fell over, and was caught between the lift carrier and the structure's exterior wall
1236.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before work, conduct a safety inspection to confirm the normal operation of the lift's safety devices, brakes, and other functions
▶ When an abnormality is found during inspection, perform work only after immediate repair

1237.재해개요: Around November 2018, at the rooftop drainage urethane waterproofing and partial asphalt shingle waterproofing site of an OO apartment complex performed by OO Co., Ltd., a victim (waterproofing worker) belonging to OO Co., Ltd. boarded the carrier of a moving/furniture lift together with a fellow worker to waterproof the rooftop drainage of Building 301, and during ascent the carrier tilted, and he fell about 14 m onto the structure above the building entrance below and died.
1237.재해유발요인: While ascending in the carrier of a moving-cargo lift for rooftop drainage waterproofing, the carrier tilted and the worker fell
1237.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using an aerial work vehicle as a working platform, install guardrails on all four sides
▶ Prohibit workers from riding in the carrier when hoisting cargo using a household-moving lift
▶ When working in locations with a fall risk, provide and have workers wear protective equipment appropriate to the work conditions, such as safety helmets and safety harnesses

1238.재해개요: Around September 2016, at an OO Construction apartment construction site, while the victim was riding a construction lift, he fell through the opening between the building and the lift (height about 15 m) and died.
1238.재해유발요인: While ascending with the door of the lift carrier open, the auxiliary step opened and collided with the building's exterior wall, and the worker fell to the ground through the opening created between the building's exterior wall and the lift
1238.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before construction lift work, inspect the operation of the door interlock device (limit switch)
▶ When using the construction lift, provide special safety training on lift use to workers so that it is not used with the carrier door open

1239.재해개요: Around September 2021, at the oooo site complex development project, the victim, assigned to hoisting work for city gas piping materials, was using a lift when he fell from the 16th floor into the interior of the lift protective enclosure at the 1st floor and died.
1239.재해유발요인: While transporting materials using a construction lift, the worker arbitrarily opened the door due to lift malfunction and fell
1239.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using the construction lift, frequently inspect the operation of the emergency stop device, etc., and take necessary measures when abnormalities are found
▶ Provide special safety training for workers using the construction lift, including the lift's movement sequence, operating principles, safety device functions and use, etc.
▶ When using the construction lift, if the lift stops between floors, prohibit forcing the door open and entering the building interior; contact the lift manager and wait until appropriate measures are taken

1240.재해개요: Around September 2017, at an OOOO officetel construction site, while the victim was welding wall brackets (Wall Brackets) inside a parking tower, he was struck by the descending counterweight (Counter Weight) of a car lift and died.
1240.재해유발요인: While working inside a mechanical parking facility, the elevator operated and the worker was struck by the descending counterweight
1240.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside or near an elevator, stop elevator operation through measures such as cutting power and installing a locking device on the controls, and deploy a work director for the work 
▶ When two or more construction projects are carried out at the same location, appoint and deploy a safety and health coordinator

1241.재해개요: Around January 2018, at an OO regional housing association apartment construction site, the victim was riding a construction lift up to install floor interlayer sound insulation in a 17th-floor unit when the carrier suddenly stopped between the 11th and 12th floors; he opened the carrier door on the unit-interior side and was climbing down to the 11th floor when he lost his balance, slipped, and fell about 30 m to the floor inside the lift protective enclosure below and died.
1241.재해유발요인: While opening the safety door of a construction lift that had stopped during operation and moving into the building, the worker fell between the building and the hoistway
1241.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using the construction lift, frequently inspect the operation of the emergency stop device, etc., and take necessary measures when abnormalities are found
▶ Provide special training for workers using the construction lift, including the lift's movement sequence, operating principles, safety device functions and use, etc.
▶ When using the construction lift, if the lift stops between floors, prohibit forcing the door open and entering the building interior; contact the lift manager and wait until appropriate measures are taken

1242.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the construction lift of Building 103 within Section 1 of the OO Co., Ltd. apartment construction site, the victim (day laborer), who had stopped the lift between the 7th and 8th floors, was moving to the 7th-floor balcony of Building 103 when he fell to the ground (H≒19m) and died.
1242.재해유발요인: While opening the safety door of a construction lift that had stopped during operation and moving into the building, the worker fell between the building and the hoistway
1242.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using the construction lift, frequently inspect the operation of the emergency stop device, etc., and take necessary measures when abnormalities are found
▶ Provide special training for workers using the construction lift, including the lift's movement sequence, operating principles, safety device functions and use, etc.
▶ When using the construction lift, if the lift stops between floors, prohibit forcing the door open and entering the building interior; contact the lift manager and wait until appropriate measures are taken

1243.재해개요: Around January 2020, at the OO Co., Ltd. apartment construction site, while the victim was riding a construction lift at the 13th floor of Building 104, he fell through the opening between the building and the lift (height about 33 m) and died.
1243.재해유발요인: While forcibly boarding a construction lift without lowering the auxiliary step, the worker fell through the opening between the lift and the structure
1243.위험성감소대책:
▶ Provide special training for workers using the construction lift, including the lift's movement sequence, operating principles, safety device functions and use, etc.
▶ Install an auxiliary platform between the construction lift and the structure to prevent falls of workers passing into the building interior, and train workers to lower the auxiliary platform when passing

1244.재해개요: Around April 2017, at an apartment electrical work site built by OO Construction, while the victim was about to board a construction lift on the 18th floor, unaware that the carrier had risen to the floor above (19th floor), he moved backward pulling a handcart and fell from the 18th-floor edge onto the lift protective shelf (H≒47.6), resulting in death.
1244.재해유발요인: In the process of boarding a construction lift, due to a defective protective device on the lift, the worker did not notice that the carrier had risen and, while stepping backward, fell to the ground
1244.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before work, confirm the normal operation of the construction lift's interlock device through a safety inspection
▶ During work, implement measures prohibiting unauthorized operation of the construction lift by users

1245.재해개요: Around October 2017, a victim belonging to OOOOOOOO was dismantling the H-Beam supporting the travel rail of an overhead crane in order to relocate and install the overhead crane installed at a workplace within OOOO located in OO-gu, OO City, when he fell from the top plate of a table lift about 3.5m to the workshop floor below and died. This was a fatal accident.
1245.재해유발요인: While dismantling an H-Beam supporting the travel rail on top of a table lift for overhead crane relocation, the worker lost balance and fell
1245.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit the use of work tools, etc., for purposes other than their originally manufactured purpose
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, provide safety harnesses and manage their fastening status

1246.재해개요: Around August 2018, at the apartment construction site of OOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-dong, OOO-gu, OO City, a victim belonging to the electrical subcontractor OOOOOO Co., Ltd. was moving via the mechanical parking equipment to perform electrical connection work for fire-extinguishing equipment on basement level 2 when he fell about 2.5 m below.
1246.재해유발요인: While moving using mechanical parking equipment for electrical connection work on fire-fighting equipment, the worker fell to the ground
1246.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit the use of work tools, etc., for purposes other than their originally manufactured purpose
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, provide safety harnesses and manage their fastening status

1247.재해개요: Around March 2019, at the fire-protection work site within the OOO OOO-OOO office facility construction being built by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-dong, OO-gu, OO City, the victim was lifting a pipe for welding work on the transverse fire-protection pipe at the back of pallet tier 1 of the parking equipment; as the carrier was operated and rose, the counterweight (Counter Weight) descended simultaneously, and the victim, who was working below the counterweight, was caught between the counterweight and the steel frame, resulting in death. This was a fatal accident.
1247.재해유발요인: While transporting pipes for fire-fighting pipe welding, a worker was crushed between the steel frame and the counterweight due to the descent of the counterweight
1247.위험성감소대책:
▶ When operating a mechanical parking facility carrier, implement hazard prevention measures and establish a signal system
▶ Prohibit simultaneous work while operating a mechanical parking facility carrier

1248.재해개요: Around January 2020, at the OOO OOO-O residential-commercial complex construction site being built by OOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-gu, OO City, OOO, a worker belonging to the subcontractor OOOO Co., Ltd., was performing rail hoisting work at the top tier (29th tier) of the mechanical parking equipment steel structure when he lost his balance and fell to a steel girder at the 25th tier of the mechanical parking equipment (fall height (H≒11m)), resulting in death. This was a fatal accident.
1248.재해유발요인: While hoisting a rail at the topmost level of the steel structure of mechanical parking equipment, the worker lost balance and fell
1248.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit the use of work tools, etc., for purposes other than their originally manufactured purpose
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, provide safety harnesses and manage their fastening status

1249.재해개요: Around November 2015, at an OO factory clean room dismantling and installation construction site, the victim climbed on top of the clean room ceiling (sandwich panels) and was dismantling air ducts and ventilation devices when the ceiling gave way and he fell 2.8m to the clean room floor below and died.
1249.재해유발요인: While dismantling ducts and ventilation equipment after climbing above the ceiling, the ceiling gave way and the worker fell to the floor
1249.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prepare a work plan including dismantling methods and dismantling sequence drawings

1250.재해개요: Around January 2016, at the OO demolition site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., while the victim was dismantling the roof (slate + color steel sheet) of a rice mill, he slipped, the slate broke, and he fell about 7.2 m to the ground below and died.
1250.재해유발요인: During roof demolition work, while dismantling and transporting dismantled materials, the roof panel the victim was standing on was damaged and gave way, and he fell to the ground
1250.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install a roof ladder fabricated with sufficient strength and specifications
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets
▶ Review the appropriateness of work methods, such as using aerial work platforms and mobile scaffolds

1251.재해개요: Around May 2016, at the OO remodeling construction site, after dismantling 9 panels (7.7m x 1m, weight of about 80kg) from the warehouse building roof in order to lower them to the ground using an aerial work platform, the victim, together with one coworker on the roof, was manually carrying a separated panel when his foot slipped and he stepped on the slate beneath the panel; the slate fractured and the victim fell from the roof to the warehouse floor (height approx. 9.1m) and died.
1251.재해유발요인: During roof demolition work, while dismantling and transporting dismantled materials, the roof panel the victim was standing on was damaged and gave way, and he fell to the ground
1251.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install a roof ladder fabricated with sufficient strength and specifications
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets
▶ Review the appropriateness of work methods, such as using aerial work platforms and mobile scaffolds

1252.재해개요: Around May 2016, at the OO repair work site, the victim fell to the ground (H of about 7.4m) while dismantling roof skylights (sunlight panels) and died.
1252.재해유발요인: During roof demolition work, the deteriorated sunlight panel the worker was standing on fractured and he fell to the floor
1252.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling or installing roofing materials on a roof covered with aged or low-strength materials, implement safety protection measures such as installing roof ladders made of aluminum or steel with sufficient strength and specifications, installing fall-prevention nets, and installing safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ When dismantling or installing roofing materials on the roof, if there is a risk of slipping due to a lack of surface friction caused by weather or deterioration of the roofing material, have workers wear non-slip safety shoes
▶ When dismantling or installing roofing materials, review work methods that can minimize work on the roof, such as using aerial work platforms or tower-type stairs

1253.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO demolition work site, the victim climbed onto the first-floor roof and, while dismantling roof panels, lost his balance and fell 3.5m to the floor below and died.
1253.재해유발요인: During roof demolition work, while stepping over and moving, the worker lost balance and fell to the floor
1253.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

1254.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the OO demolition work site, the victim lost his balance while demolishing a wooden truss installed on top of the roof-level steel beams and fell to the first-floor ground (height 11.4m) and died.
1254.재해유발요인: While demolishing a wooden truss installed on top of a steel beam at the roof level, the worker lost balance and fell to the floor
1254.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets

▶ When dismantling or installing roofing materials, review work methods that can minimize work on the roof, such as using aerial work platforms or tower-type stairs

1343.위험성감소대책:
▶ When floor openings occur in roofs, etc., install steel safety covers (including opening markings) structured to withstand at least twice the weight of workers and materials, or take worker fall prevention measures such as installing guardrails and fall-prevention nets
▶ When installing guardrails, use metal pipes with a diameter of at least 2.7cm or materials of greater strength, and install with a structure that can withstand a load of at least 100kg acting in the weakest direction at the structurally weakest point
▶ When removing or installing roofing materials on the roof, work with particular caution in sections where roofing materials have not yet been installed, and train workers not to move into sections of weak materials
▶ When removing or installing roofing materials, review work methods that can minimize work on the roof, such as using aerial work platforms and tower-type stairs
▶ When proceeding with finishing or other work at openings, install safety harness anchorage facilities and inspect and supervise workers' safety harness fastening

1416.위험성감소대책:
▶ When floor openings occur in roofs, etc., install steel safety covers (including opening markings) structured to withstand at least twice the weight of workers and materials, or take worker fall prevention measures such as installing guardrails and fall-prevention nets
▶ When installing guardrails, use metal pipes with a diameter of at least 2.7cm or materials of greater strength, and install with a structure that can withstand a load of at least 100kg acting in the weakest direction at the structurally weakest point
▶ When removing or installing roofing materials on the roof, work with particular caution in sections where roofing materials have not yet been installed, and train workers not to move into sections of weak materials
▶ When removing or installing roofing materials, review work methods that can minimize work on the roof, such as using aerial work platforms and tower-type stairs
▶ When proceeding with finishing or other work at openings, install safety harness anchorage facilities and inspect and supervise workers' safety harness fastening

1542.재해개요: Around July 2019, at the OO construction drainage facility and disaster-prevention facility expansion work site, two victims were performing temporary electrical cable organizing work inside a drainage tunnel when a sudden downpour caused the floodgate of an existing stormwater box connected to the drainage tunnel to open automatically, and stormwater flowed into the drainage tunnel; three victims, including a prime contractor employee who had entered the tunnel to spread the emergency alert and guide evacuation, were submerged and died.
1542.재해유발요인: While organizing temporary electrical wiring inside a drainage tunnel, a sudden downpour caused rainwater to flow into the tunnel and the victim drowned
1542.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install alarm equipment when working inside tunnels
▶ Place emergency equipment inside the tunnel and inspect it at all times
▶ Suspend work inside the tunnel during rainy periods

1543.위험성감소대책:
▶ When workers may be endangered by bad weather, immediately suspend work and implement safety measures such as evacuating workers
▶ Establish a signal system such as radios so that when rainwater flows into the covered structure due to heavy rain, etc., work is immediately suspended and workers can evacuate quickly

1547.재해개요: Around April 2019, in the machine room of OOOOOO located in OO-dong, OO-gu, OO City, OO Province, while a blind flange was being installed at the end of a boiler pipe to replace the pipe's safety valve, steam condensate poured onto two daily-worker victims; this is presumed to be an accident in which they sustained second-degree burns on parts of their bodies.
1547.재해유발요인: While installing a blind flange on a pipe end in the machine room to replace the safety valve of a boiler pipe, steam condensate poured onto the victim, causing burns
1547.위험성감소대책:
▶ When replacing existing safety valves, perform the replacement work with the high-temperature steam, etc., inside removed
▶ When replacing existing safety valves, suspend work if it is difficult to identify the substances inside

1548.재해개요: Around May 2020, at the OOOO Co., Ltd. OOOO reinforcement development project site located in OO-myeon, OO County, OOO Province, the victim was performing welding and installation work on a water supply pipe connected to the flap valve inside the reservoir agricultural-water discharge basin structure; after drinking water at a nearby work vehicle and returning to the inside of the discharge basin, he slipped on riprap on the embankment slope, slid and fell into the discharge basin, and died.
1548.재해유발요인: While moving, a worker slipped on riprap on the embankment slope and fell into the reservoir discharge basin

▶ When working at heights where workers may fall or trip, install guardrails and implement fall prevention measures, and where unavoidable, install access barriers, etc.
▶ When working at heights where workers may fall or trip, provide and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmets, safety harnesses, etc.)

1549.재해개요: Around February 2018, at the OO demolition work site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim was transporting dismantled materials and moving on ceiling finishing material (plywood, t=6mm) for dismantling work on fire sprinklers in the 2nd-floor ceiling of a model house when the ceiling finishing material he was stepping across, unable to bear his weight, broke, and he fell to the 2nd-floor floor (H≒4m) and died.

1550.재해개요: Around December 2020, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. 1550.위험성감소대책:

1551.재해개요: Around January 2018, at the OO interior work site, the victim was dismantling the timber formwork shores supporting the loess slab of a sauna room in basement 1 when he was crushed under the collapsing loess slab and died.

1552.재해개요: Around May 2020, at the OO neighborhood-living-facility new construction site constructed by OO General Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, belonging to a subcontractor, and a co-worker were moving during wall rebar placement work on the 1st above-ground floor when his foot caught on a horizontal rebar (H≒100mm) installed on top of the floor slab to fix the vertical splice rebars of a bathroom wall, and as he fell over, his face (beside the right nostril) was pierced by a vertical rebar (L≒400mm) installed ahead (approx. 850mm), and he died.

▶ When performing on-site work such as wall rebar assembly, install safe passages leading to the workplace or within the workplace

1553.재해개요: Around January 2018, at the OO reinforcement work site, the victim, belonging to OO Development, was assisting the transport of steel members (H-beam) for slab reinforcement next to a forklift when the 2nd-floor floor slab (1st-floor ceiling) collapsed, and he was crushed under the slab and died.

▶ Before dismantling existing structures, secure structural stability by supporting them with jack supports, etc.

▶ Implement rebar puncture prevention measures such as installing puncture-prevention caps

1557.재해유발요인: While transporting steel pipes for septic tank construction, a worker lost footing at the edge of the soil beside the foundation formwork and fell onto rebar embedded in the floor

▶ Provide safety protective equipment (safety harness) before work and manage fastening status

▶ When work on the building exterior is needed, avoid working by leaning out from the inside, and supervise so that work is done using aerial work platforms or suspended scaffolds, etc.
▶ For finishing material removal work, plan the work in the order of removing finishing materials such as panels first and then removing supports, to prevent accidents such as unexpected falling of finishing materials

1658.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO neighborhood-living-facility new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., during formwork-shore organizing and transport work on the 9th floor (H≒33.0m), a formwork-shore square timber fell and flew, bounced off the end of the 3rd-tier falling-object prevention net, and struck the head of the victim, who was resting sitting on a boundary stone between the sidewalk and the road approx. 10m across from the site, and he died.
1658.재해유발요인: Without adequate measures against falling and flying objects, while organizing and transporting formwork shores on a ground floor, a square timber from the formwork shores fell and flew, bounced off the end of the falling-object prevention net, and struck a worker sitting on the curb between the sidewalk and road across from the site
1658.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install falling-object prevention nets in strict compliance with the hazard prevention measure standards for falling objects
( Install with a projecting length of at least 2m, but preferably 3m or more)
▶ Thoroughly supervise so that workers always wear safety helmets while resting, moving, or working around site areas with falling or flying object risks

1659.재해개요: Around March 2019, at the OO General Construction Co., Ltd. OO foundation work site, the victim, in order to go down to the pit floor (depth approx. 2.4m) for pit wall rebar assembly of a machine foundation (COOLING PART) in a factory, stepped on a stepped section of the excavated face (depth 0.9m, width 0.6m), when he lost his balance and fell approx. 1.5m to the concrete floor below, and his head was pierced by a vertical floor-slab rebar (protruding length ≒21cm) pre-installed for splicing the wall's vertical rebars, and he died.
1659.재해유발요인: The moment the victim stepped on the stepped part of the excavation face to descend to the pit bottom, the victim lost balance and fell onto the concrete floor, and the victim's head was punctured by vertical floor-slab rebar pre-installed for wall vertical rebar splicing
1659.위험성감소대책:
▶ Where there is a puncture risk, install work passages on the side without assembled rebar
▶ Where there is a puncture risk due to protruding rebar, install protective caps on the rebar protrusions

1660.재해개요: Around August 2020, at a housing redevelopment improvement project site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim, belonging to a subcontractor, was found collapsed in front of a bathroom sink after finishing work by the security foreman, who reported to 119; he was transported to a hospital and died during treatment.
1660.재해유발요인: After finishing work, the victim was found collapsed in front of the bathroom sink due to multiple organ failure caused by heatstroke
1660.위험성감소대책:
▶ During outdoor frame work exposed to heat waves, install appropriate rest facilities that can accommodate all workers
▶ Utilize shade canopies made of materials that completely block sunlight, and place supplies such as chairs, mats, and water dispensers in the natural shade formed near soundproof walls to provide rest for workers
▶ According to the type of heat wave warning, recommend 10 minutes of rest per hour when a heat wave advisory (33℃) is issued, and 15 minutes when a heat wave alert (35℃) is issued

1664.재해개요: Around February 2020, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO apartment construction work section 1 site, the victim, belonging to a subcontractor, was performing surface preparation work using a hand grinder for utility-tunnel waterproofing work when he collapsed into a collecting well (water puddle) and died.

1664.위험성감소대책:

▶ When working at locations with an electric shock risk, such as near sumps, use waterproof plugs and outlets
▶ When installing outlets at locations where electricity is used while the body is wet, connect them to circuits protected by residual current devices for personal electric shock protection

▶ Avoid leaning out of the scaffold to carry materials, tools, etc., and improve to safe work methods such as lowering them using a winch
▶ Have workers fasten safety harnesses when working and moving on exterior scaffolds

1672.재해개요: Around November 2017, at a pine-tree transplanting work site, the victim was waiting in front of a stove when the work clothes he was wearing caught fire, and he was burned and died.

▶ Keep fire extinguishers and other firefighting equipment placed on site at all times
