1733.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO factory construction site, the victim, a worker belonging to structural work partner company OO Industry Co., Ltd., together with 2 fellow workers, was carrying out work in which 3 workers sequentially passed up formwork materials such as plywood and square timber on the external steel pipe scaffold by a hand-over-hand method to move them from the 3rd floor to the 4th floor above ground, when the victim fell (H = 5.7 m) through the opening (width = 60cm) between the 4th-floor slab edge and the steel pipe scaffold ledger to the 3rd-floor slab and died.
1733.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures at openings and working platform edges, while a worker on an external scaffold was relaying formwork materials to the upper floor by hand-passing, the formwork shifted off-center or the worker lost footing, lost balance, and fell through the opening between the slab edge and the scaffold
1733.위험성감소대책:
▶ When hoisting formwork materials, work using lashing appropriate to the materials along with pulleys and hoisting equipment
▶ When working at fall-risk locations, implement fall protection measures such as installing guardrails at the edges

1734.재해개요: Around January 2019, at the OO Co., Ltd. new construction site, the victim(worker), after completing the work of organizing dismantled formwork (Euroform) at the top of the 6th tier of the internal system scaffold in the pharmaceutical building, was climbing down to the ground via the outside of the system scaffold when he lost his balance and fell to the first-floor ground (H ≒ 8 m) and died.
1734.재해유발요인: With no access passage installed, while moving on the outside of the external scaffold, the victim lost footing and fell
1734.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install ascent/descent passages such as ladders and stairs between the upper and lower scaffold working platforms
▶ Install guardrails or covers, etc., at fall-risk working platforms, passage ends, and openings
▶ When installing opening covers, mark them as openings to prevent fall hazards

1735.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO detached house construction site carried out by OO Development Co., Ltd., the victim, a worker belonging to OO Development Co., Ltd., was assembling (or moving) the external formwork for the 3rd-floor wall on the topmost (3rd-tier) working platform of the external double-row scaffold when he fell over the outer edge of the working platform (H = 5.0 m) and died.
1735.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, after fixing pins for exterior wall formwork on the working platform of an external double-row steel pipe scaffold at a ground floor, while moving on the scaffold's upper working platform, the worker lost footing, lost balance, and fell through the opening between the concrete wall and the double-row steel pipe scaffold
1735.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-prevention nets in fall-risk sections between the scaffold and the structure
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails or safety harness anchorage facilities

1736.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. neighborhood living facility construction site, the victim was performing form-tie pin and wedge pin fixing work on the rooftop-level external wall formwork from the top of the working platform of the external steel pipe double-row scaffold at the 5th floor above ground, and while moving (from the 11th to the 12th tier of the working platform at the top of the external scaffold), he missed his footing and fell through the opening (0.5 m) between the concrete wall and the steel pipe double-row scaffold (height: about 27 m) and died.
1736.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, after fixing pins for exterior wall formwork on the working platform of an external double-row steel pipe scaffold at a ground floor, while moving on the scaffold's upper working platform, the worker lost footing, lost balance, and fell through the opening between the concrete wall and the double-row steel pipe scaffold
1736.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-prevention nets in fall-risk sections between the scaffold and the structure
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails or safety harness anchorage facilities

1737.재해개요: Around October 2016, at a neighborhood living facility and multi-household housing construction site, while the victim(worker) was performing wall formwork assembly work for the 3rd floor above ground on the working platform (5th tier) of the external double-row scaffold, the working platform came off, and the victim fell about 9 m below and died.
1737.재해유발요인: With the working platform unfixed, while assembling ground-floor wall formwork on the working platform of an external double-row scaffold, the working platform came loose and the worker fell
1737.위험성감소대책:
▶ Fix working platforms installed on scaffolds to two or more supports (right-angle clamps, etc.) so they do not flip over or fall
▶ In fall-risk sections, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or work after wearing safety harnesses

1738.재해개요: Around June 2019, at the OO apartment exterior painting work site, while the victim(worker) had boarded the suspended scaffold work seat and was preparing for crack repair work, the working rope of the suspended scaffold came off the fixing anchor, and the victim fell together with the suspended scaffold about 37 m to the ground below and died.
1738.재해유발요인: Without a vertical lifeline installed for suspended scaffold work, while boarding the suspended scaffold work seat and preparing for crack repair work, the suspended scaffold's work rope came off the fixing anchor and the worker fell together with the suspended scaffold
1738.위험성감소대책:
▶ During suspended scaffold work, implement dislodgement prevention measures for the rope fixing rings and install anchors
▶ During suspended scaffold work, install vertical lifelines and fasten fall arresters to the vertical lifelines

1739.재해개요: Around July 2019, at the OO apartment construction site carried out by OOOO Co., Ltd., while the victim, a partner company worker, was performing formwork assembly work on the working platform of the system scaffold, the guardrail at the edge of the system scaffold working platform came off, and the victim fell about 5 m to the concrete ground below and died.
1739.재해유발요인: With the temporary guardrail at the system scaffold working platform edge poorly installed, while assembling formwork on the system scaffold working platform, the guardrail at the platform edge came off and the worker fell
1739.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at fall-risk locations such as system scaffold working platform edges, firmly install guardrails
▶ Where guardrail installation is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

1740.재해개요: Around January 2020, at the OO construction site being built by OOOO Co., Ltd., the victim, a partner company worker, climbed onto a cage (working platform) installed on the outer edge of the 5th-floor slab of Building OO to release the sling belt of a table support (formwork shore) hoisted by tower crane, and while moving toward the table support, the cage detached from the slab, and the victim fell together with the cage to the first-floor ground (H ≒ 21 m) and died.
1740.재해유발요인: Without preparing a heavy-material handling work plan and without designating a work supervisor, while climbing onto and moving along a working platform installed on the perimeter of a ground-floor slab to release the sling belts of formwork shores lifted by tower crane onto the same-floor slab, the working platform came loose and the worker fell
1740.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing working platforms, install them firmly to prevent detachment and have the supervisor confirm the installation condition
▶ When handling heavy loads, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor so that work is performed according to the work plan

1741.재해개요: Around February 2021, on the 8th floor of the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO construction site, the victim (form carpenter), a subcontractor worker, moved from the ramp floor to the outside of the scaffold to reach the work position for receiving system shore joist members, and in the process of entering the inner side where the working platform was located, he lost his balance and fell to the 2nd-floor ground (height ≒ 23.4 meters) and died.
1741.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, after fixing pins for exterior wall formwork on the working platform of an external double-row steel pipe scaffold at a ground floor, while moving on the scaffold's upper working platform, the worker lost footing, lost balance, and fell through the opening between the concrete wall and the double-row steel pipe scaffold
1741.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-prevention nets in fall-risk sections between the scaffold and the structure
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails or safety harness anchorage facilities

1742.재해개요: Around May 2021, at the OO construction site, the victim fell from the working platform of the external system scaffold at the front of the 3rd floor to the first-floor ground (H = 7.7 m) and died.
1742.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, after fixing pins for exterior wall formwork on the working platform of an external double-row steel pipe scaffold at a ground floor, while moving on the scaffold's upper working platform, the worker lost footing, lost balance, and fell through the opening between the concrete wall and the double-row steel pipe scaffold
1742.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-prevention nets in fall-risk sections between the scaffold and the structure
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails or safety harness anchorage facilities

1743.재해개요: Around May 2021, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO neighborhood living facility construction site, while the victim(worker) was working on the external scaffold for assembling the exterior wall formwork on the 3rd floor above ground of the structure, he missed his footing on the working platform and fell 11.3 m to the ground below and died.
1743.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, after fixing pins for exterior wall formwork on the working platform of an external double-row steel pipe scaffold at a ground floor, while moving on the scaffold's upper working platform, the worker lost footing, lost balance, and fell through the opening between the concrete wall and the double-row steel pipe scaffold
1743.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-prevention nets in fall-risk sections between the scaffold and the structure
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails or safety harness anchorage facilities

1744.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO construction site, the victim, a partner company worker, was dismantling the 3rd-floor exterior wall formwork from a working platform on the external scaffold when he fell about 5.4 m through the opening (length 1,700㎜ x width 800㎜) between the building's exterior wall and the scaffold to the first-floor concrete floor below and died.
1744.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, while dismantling ground-floor exterior wall formwork from a working platform on an external scaffold, the worker fell through the opening between the building exterior wall and the scaffold
1744.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-prevention nets in fall-risk sections between the scaffold and the structure
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails or safety harness anchorage facilities

1745.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the OO neighborhood living facility and multi-household housing construction site, the victim(worker) fell to the floor (H ≒ 9.6) and died while performing formwork dismantling work on the working platform of the external steel pipe scaffold installed at the height of the 4th floor above ground.
1745.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, while dismantling ground-floor exterior wall formwork from a working platform on an external scaffold, the worker fell through the opening between the building exterior wall and the scaffold
1745.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-prevention nets in fall-risk sections between the scaffold and the structure
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails or safety harness anchorage facilities

1746.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO Industry Co., Ltd. OO construction project site, the victim, a partner company worker, was organizing shore materials on the scaffold at the apartment's main gate when he fell about 6 m from a working platform whose guardrail had been dismantled to the ground below and died.
1746.재해유발요인: While organizing shore materials on a scaffold working platform whose guardrails had been dismantled, the worker fell
1746.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails at locations where workers may fall from working platform edges
▶ Where guardrail installation is difficult, install fall-prevention nets within a vertical distance of 10m from the work surface to the installation point

1747.재해개요: Around February 2019, at the OOOO Co., Ltd. OO factory construction site, the victim, a partner company worker, lost his balance while dismantling the building wall formwork (Euroform) from the top of the working platform (2nd tier) of the external steel pipe double-row scaffold, and fell about 4.7 m to the concrete floor below and died.
1747.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, while dismantling ground-floor exterior wall formwork from a working platform on an external scaffold, the worker fell through the opening between the building exterior wall and the scaffold
1747.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install fall-prevention nets in fall-risk sections between the scaffold and the structure
▶ When performing work with a fall risk, implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails or safety harness anchorage facilities

1748.재해개요: Around August 2020, at a neighborhood living facility construction site carried out by OO Co., Ltd., while the victim was performing dismantling and organizing work on the exterior wall formwork of the rooftop E/V Pit on the 7th floor above ground, at the request of a fellow worker he attempted to climb down from the system scaffold (H ≒ 3.8 m) outside the rooftop E/V Pit to fetch materials (nails) from the first floor, when he lost his balance and fell to the rooftop-level concrete floor and died.
1748.재해유발요인: Although passage markings should have been provided so workers could pass safely, they were not; while dismantling and organizing exterior wall formwork inside the rooftop elevator shaft, the worker descended to the ground floor via the system scaffold outside the elevator room, lost balance, and fell
1748.위험성감소대책:
▶ Mark passages at their main sections and instruct all workers in the workplace to recognize and use them
▶ When installing temporary passages at locations with a high fall risk, install guardrails at the edges
▶ When working at fall-risk locations such as edges and openings, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

1749.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OO neighborhood living facility construction site, the victim (deceased), a partner company worker, and 4 others were hoisting a large formwork panel by crane after dismantling it from the 3rd-floor exterior wall in order to assemble it on the 4th floor, when the sling belt hooked to the formwork came off, and due to the impact, the victim, who was working on the external scaffold at the 3rd-floor height of the building, fell about 15 m to an adjacent site below, resulting in 1 death and 1 injury.
1749.재해유발요인: Without preparing a work plan for handling heavy materials such as large forms, after dismantling a large form installed on a ground-floor exterior wall and lifting it for assembly on another floor, the sling belt hooked to the form came off, and the impact caused a worker working on the external scaffold to fall
1749.위험성감소대책:
▶ When handling heavy loads such as large forms, use correct rigging methods (such as tying vertical/horizontal members together into knots)
▶ When working at fall-risk locations such as on exterior building scaffolds, install working platforms at points close to the work section
▶ Where working platform installation is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

1750.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO Development Co., Ltd. mixed-use residential building construction site, the victim, after tightening a gap at the corner of the gang form on the 6th floor above ground with steel wire, was climbing down while holding the vertical member (square pipe) of the gang form when he fell about 22 m to the ground and died.
1750.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, after tightening the gap at a ground-floor exterior wall corner gang form joint with steel wire, the victim fell while climbing down holding the gang form vertical member (square pipe)
1750.위험성감소대책:
▶ Mark passages at their main sections and instruct all workers in the workplace to recognize and use them
▶ When installing temporary passages at locations with a high fall risk, install guardrails at the edges

1751.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO district construction site carried out by OO Construction Co., Ltd., 3 victims moved to the cage of another gang form working platform hoisted to the rooftop level for gang form (large panel form) hoisting work at the stairwell of the 12th floor above ground of apartment Building 402, and while they were waiting, the gang form detached from the wall and fell, and the victims fell together with the gang form to the first-floor exterior ground (height ≒ 35 m), resulting in 2 deaths and 1 injury.
1751.재해유발요인: Without safety measures for the gang form, while moving for gang form lifting work, the gang form working-platform cage separated from the wall and the worker fell
1751.위험성감소대책:
▶ Immediately after lifting the gang form, fasten all 9 shear bolts at the lowest part, and fix them so that the embedded bolt and shear bolt connections are completely fastened
▶ Comply with preparing gang form assembly drawings specifying the fixing bolt positions during lifting, member joint methods, etc., so that workers can identify them
▶ After lifting the gang form, support the wire rope at two or more points to prevent eccentricity and comply with working so that verticality can be maintained

1752.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO apartment housing construction site, the victim, a worker belonging to the gang form installation partner company, was installing working platforms on the lower cage of the gang form of apartment Building OO when an unfixed platform came off and fell, and the victim fell together with the platform about 14 m to the basement level 3 concrete floor below and died.
1752.재해유발요인: While installing the lower cage working platform of a gang form, an unfixed platform came loose and the worker fell
1752.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with the gang form lower cage installation height (backfill the basement level first)
▶ Install separate working platforms when installing the cage
▶ Where separate working platform installation is not possible, fix the platform using steel wire, etc., and attach lifelines or safety harnesses to the gang form while moving and working

1753.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OOOO Co., Ltd. OO block apartment construction site, the victim, a partner company worker, was waiting on the gang form working platform after removing the connection pins between gang forms for gang form hoisting work on the 20th floor of Building OO, when the gang form detached from the exterior wall, and the victim fell together with the gang form about 56 m to the ground below and died.
1753.재해유발요인: Without safety measures for the gang form, after removing the connecting pins between gang forms for ground-floor gang form lifting work, while waiting on the gang form working platform, the gang form separated from the exterior wall and the worker fell
1753.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling and lifting the gang form, perform the work after suspending the gang form from lifting equipment
▶ Prohibit removing supports or fixing hardware first, before suspending from lifting equipment

1754.재해개요: Around June 2017, at an apartment housing construction site, while the victim was crossing from one unit to Unit 3 via the gang form, he stepped on an unfixed working platform of the gang form, which came off, and he fell to the floor (H ≒ 6.3 m) and died.
1754.재해유발요인: While installing the lower cage working platform of a gang form, an unfixed platform came loose and the worker fell
1754.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with the gang form lower cage installation height (backfill the basement level first)
▶ Install separate working platforms when installing the cage
▶ Where separate working platform installation is not possible, fix the platform using steel wire, etc., and attach lifelines or safety harnesses to the gang form while moving and working

1755.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO housing redevelopment apartment construction site, the victim, a partner company worker, with the side-wall gang form (10m*3.1m, weight about 3 tons) installed on the 21st floor of the apartment suspended from a T/C, dismantled the lowest anchor bolts and then, the moment he dismantled the wedge pins (7) connected to the balcony-side gang form (400*3,100, weight about 125kg), he fell together with the balcony-side gang form about 67 m to the ground-level floor and died.
1755.재해유발요인: Without safety measures for the gang form, to dismantle a side-wall gang form installed on a ground floor, with the form suspended from a tower crane, after dismantling the lowest fixing anchor bolts, the moment the wedge pins of the balcony-side gang form connected to the side-wall gang form were dismantled, the worker fell together with the balcony-side gang form
1755.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling or dismantling a gang form separated into two or more parts, suspend each of the separated gang forms from lifting equipment such as a tower crane before removing the connection bolts, wedge pins, and other fixing hardware
▶ The scope of assembly, dismantling, etc., and the work procedures shall be communicated in advance to the workers engaged in the work

1756.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO Industry Co., Ltd. OO construction site, the victim, a partner company worker, was dismantling connecting hardware on the gang form working platform installed on the exterior wall of the 28th floor of apartment Building OO in order to dismantle and raise the gang form, when the gang form on which the victim was standing detached and fell, and the victim fell together with the gang form about 78 meters to the first-floor concrete floor below and died.
1756.재해유발요인: Without safety measures for the gang form, while dismantling connecting hardware for apartment exterior wall gang form dismantling and raising, the gang form working platform came loose and the worker fell
1756.위험성감소대책:
▶ Always inspect the gang form supports and fixing hardware for abnormalities, and replace or supplement them when abnormalities are found
▶ Perform work after suspending the gang form from lifting equipment, and comply with not removing supports or fixing hardware in advance before suspending from lifting equipment
▶ Conduct a structural review considering the anchor capacity to determine the number of fixing bolts to be controlled through fall prevention devices before performing the work

1757.재해개요: Around November 2016, at an apartment housing construction site being built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, after finishing tie-bolt dismantling work on the 2nd-tier working platform of the gang form on the 11th floor above ground, was moving when a portion of the gang form working platform (about 500mm×700mm) that had been partially cut due to interference with the wall bracing for fixing the tower crane came off (at the welded part), and the victim fell together with the platform about 25 m to the 2nd-floor ground below and died.
1757.재해유발요인: Without safety measures for the gang form, after tie-bolt dismantling work on a ground-floor gang form working platform, while moving, the gang form working platform, which had been partially cut due to interference with the tower crane fixing wall bracing, came loose and the worker fell
1757.위험성감소대책:
▶ Where an opening has occurred because part of the gang form working platform caught on the tower crane wall bracing was removed, install a cover and mark the opening immediately after the gang form lifting is completed
▶ When working at fall-risk locations at heights of 2m or more, fix the working platform to two or more supports

1758.재해개요: Around January 2017, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO reconstruction improvement project site, the victim, a partner company worker, climbed onto the gang form working platform to dismantle the gang form (formwork with integrated working platform) installed on the front balcony of the 14th-floor rooftop of Unit 4 of apartment Building OO without securing it to the tower crane, and while dismantling the lower fixing bolts supporting the gang form, he fell together with the gang form about 45 m to the ground below and died.
1758.재해유발요인: Without fall-prevention measures, to dismantle a gang form installed on the front balcony of the rooftop, the worker climbed onto the gang form working platform and was dismantling the lower fixing bolts when the worker fell together with the gang form
1758.위험성감소대책:
▶ During gang form dismantling work, perform the work after suspending the gang form from a tower crane to prevent overturning
▶ When working at fall-risk locations, install working platforms and fall-prevention nets
▶ Where fall-prevention net installation is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

1759.재해개요: Around November 2017, at the OO apartment site carried out by OOOO Co., Ltd., the victim, a partner company worker, during dismantling work to hoist the gang form of the 29th floor of Building OO to the rooftop level, moved to the adjacent gang form and, the moment he dismantled the connection pin with the gang form to be hoisted, the gang form on which the victim was standing detached and fell, catching on the wall support of a construction lift about 3 m below, while the victim fell about 80 m to the ground and died.
1759.재해유발요인: Without safety measures for the gang form, to dismantle a side-wall gang form installed on a ground floor, with the form suspended from a tower crane, after dismantling the lowest fixing anchor bolts, the moment the wedge pins of the balcony-side gang form connected to the side-wall gang form were dismantled, the worker fell together with the balcony-side gang form
1759.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling or dismantling a gang form separated into two or more parts, suspend each of the separated gang forms from lifting equipment such as a tower crane before removing the connection bolts, wedge pins, and other fixing hardware
▶ The scope of assembly, dismantling, etc., and the work procedures shall be communicated in advance to the workers engaged in the work

1760.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the OO commercial building construction site, while the victim(worker) was vertically transporting materials (rebar) to the 3rd floor of the building, he lost his balance and fell outside the external scaffold from a height of about 8.6 m and died.
1760.재해유발요인: While transporting rebar, the victim lost balance on an external scaffold where no guardrail was installed and fell
1760.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install top and middle guardrails at worker fall-risk locations such as exterior scaffold working platforms
▶ When working at fall-risk locations, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

1761.재해개요: Around May 2021, at the OO Industry Co., Ltd. OO center construction site, the victim, a partner company worker, fell from the system scaffold (height 3.8m) to the first-floor ground and died.
1761.재해유발요인: While transporting rebar, the victim lost balance on an external scaffold where no guardrail was installed and fell
1761.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install top and middle guardrails at worker fall-risk locations such as exterior scaffold working platforms
▶ When working at fall-risk locations, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

1762.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the OO Construction Co., Ltd. OO construction site, the victim(worker) was climbing down into the building interior from the external scaffold on the 6th floor above ground, stepping on wall rebar and window frame formwork under assembly, when he lost his balance and missed his footing, falling to the 6th-floor concrete floor (H ≒ 1.2 m) and died.
1762.재해유발요인: While moving on an external scaffold, the worker stepped on wall rebar and window formwork under assembly to climb down into the building interior, lost balance, and fell
1762.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safe passages of a structure meeting safety standards, such as ramps, temporary stairs, and ladders, between buildings with a high fall risk and exterior scaffolds
▶ When working at fall-risk locations, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

1763.재해개요: Around February 2017, at a road construction site, the victim(worker) climbed onto the top of an unstable 2nd-tier platform of a steel pipe frame scaffold to assemble rebar for the central wall of a waterway box culvert, and while assembling rebar, he fell from the edge of the platform to the concrete ground (H ≒ 3.4 m) and died.
1763.재해유발요인: For rebar assembly of the central wall of a box culvert, the worker climbed onto the platform of a steel-tube frame scaffold without braces and horizontal members installed and, during rebar assembly work, lost balance and fell
1763.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing working platforms, install them with a width of 40cm or more, fastened to two or more supports
▶ Where the placement of heavy loads on top of the platform is involved, install the main frames at intervals of 1.8m or less
▶ Install bracing members, horizontal members, and wall ties without omission to prevent scaffold movement
▶ Install guardrails at fall-risk locations such as working platform edges

1764.재해개요: Around October 2018, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO civil and building construction site, while the victim(worker) was performing rebar placement (splicing) work on the external scaffold, he fell through the gap between the upper guardrail on the outer side of the scaffold and the working platform (H ≒ 5.7 m) and died.
1764.재해유발요인: While placing rebar on an external scaffold, the worker lost balance and fell through the gap between the top rail on the outer side of the scaffold and the working platform
1764.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working on external scaffolds, install working platforms and guardrails tightly and firmly across the entire work section before work
▶ If installation of working platforms and guardrails is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities to which safety harnesses can be attached
▶ Thoroughly wear personal protective equipment when working in places with fall risk

1765.재해개요: In December 2020, at the OO facility construction site being built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, a worker belonging to the reinforced concrete work partner company, was performing wall rebar assembly work on the 3rd-tier working platform of the system scaffold at the rear of the building when he toppled backward and fell 5.3 m to the soil ground below and died.

1798.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install guardrails in 2 tiers on the inside and outside of the scaffold, and where guardrails cannot be installed due to work conditions, install fall-prevention nets
▶ Where installing guardrails or fall-prevention nets is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and supervise so that work is performed after fastening safety harnesses

1807.재해개요: Around July 2017, at the OO school exterior wall painting work site, the moment the victim boarded a suspended scaffold from the rooftop to carry out exterior wall painting work, he fell together with the suspended scaffold (H ≒ 18 m) and died.

1807.위험성감소대책:
▶ Tie suspended scaffold ropes to two or more solid anchorage points, such as rings embedded in concrete or the building's concrete or steel structures, so they do not come loose
▶ Install protective pads at corners where the hanging ropes contact the structure to prevent abrasion
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

2111.위험성감소대책:

▶ When installing guardrails, use metal pipes with a diameter of at least 2.7cm or materials of greater strength, and install with a structure that can withstand a load of at least 100kg acting in the weakest direction at the structurally weakest point
▶ If installing working platforms and guardrails at slab edges, etc. is difficult, install fall-prevention nets or install safety harness anchorage facilities and manage safety harness fastening to prevent worker falls
▶ When work on the building exterior is needed, avoid working by leaning out from the inside, and supervise so that work is done using aerial work platforms or suspended scaffolds, etc.
▶ For finishing material removal work, plan the work in the order of removing finishing materials such as panels first and then removing supports, to prevent accidents such as unexpected falling of finishing materials

2112.재해개요: Around September 2020, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO research institute new construction site, the victim (panel installer), a subcontractor worker, was adjusting the lower position of anchoring hardware (C-channel) for fixing exterior sandwich panels to a steel column at the 3rd-floor slab edge when he lost his balance and fell approx. 7 m onto a temporary fence post (steel pipe) and died.
2112.재해유발요인: While working at the slab edge, the victim missed a step and fell from the edge
2112.위험성감소대책:
▶ When workers move or work in fall-risk places (slab edges, etc.), install working platforms at least 40cm wide such as by assembling external scaffolds, and firmly install fall-prevention safety facilities such as guardrails at edge sections
▶ When installing guardrails, use metal pipes with a diameter of at least 2.7cm or materials of greater strength, and install with a structure that can withstand a load of at least 100kg acting in the weakest direction at the structurally weakest point
▶ If installing working platforms and guardrails at slab edges, etc. is difficult, install fall-prevention nets or install safety harness anchorage facilities and manage safety harness fastening to prevent worker falls
▶ When work on the building exterior is needed, avoid working by leaning out from the inside, and supervise so that work is done using aerial work platforms or suspended scaffolds, etc.
▶ For finishing material removal work, plan the work in the order of removing finishing materials such as panels first and then removing supports, to prevent accidents such as unexpected falling of finishing materials

2113.재해개요: Around October 2020, at the OO construction project, the victim, who was in the passenger seat of a traffic-control vehicle parked on the road shoulder, was getting out of the vehicle to transfer to a work vehicle when he fell below the bridge (H≒51 m) and died.
2113.재해유발요인: While getting out of the passenger seat of a coworker's traffic-control vehicle parked on the shoulder to transfer to another vehicle, the victim fell below the bridge
2113.위험성감소대책:
▶ Plan vehicle retrieval routes so that disembarking occurs in safe places without fall risk
▶ In unavoidable cases of disembarking on a bridge, conduct management and supervision to ensure disembarking by a safe method

2114.재해개요: Around August 2019, at the 'OOOO replacement work' site built by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO, OO City, OOO Province, the victim was inspecting a power sprayer for seawater pumping on top of a concrete structure located south of OO when he fell from the structure edge; it is presumed that he was found dead at sea approx. 100 m away at around 17:45 that day.
2114.재해유발요인: While inspecting a powered sprayer for seawater pumping on top of a concrete structure, the worker fell from the edge of the structure
2114.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement fall-prevention measures such as guardrails and fences at fall-hazard locations such as structure edges
▶ When working on top of structures adjacent to the sea, thoroughly provide and manage the wearing of life vests in preparation for hazards such as falling into the water

2115.재해개요: Around June 2016, in a house yard, the victim was planting grass when he fell from the edge of the yard 3 m to the ground below and died.
2115.재해유발요인: A worker planting grass in a yard fell from the edge of the yard to the ground
2115.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails or access-prohibition fences at locations with fall hazards
▶ Thoroughly provide and wear personal protective equipment

2116.재해개요: Around December 2021, at the OO construction project, the victim and another worker were installing retaining wall formwork when they were struck by soil and rock falling from the top of a cut slope (h≒8 m), resulting in one death and one injury.
2116.재해유발요인: During retaining wall formwork installation work, the victim was struck by soil and rock falling from the top of the cut slope
2116.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct advance surveys of hazards around the workplace and remove stones before work
▶ Manage in advance the hazard of stones piled on upper slopes around the workplace rolling down the slope, and assign a supervisor to ensure the work is performed safely

2117.재해개요: Around February 2017, at a building new construction site, the victim was struck on the head by soil and rock falling approx. 12 m from the top of temporary earth-retaining facilities and died.
2117.재해유발요인: The victim was struck on the head by soil and rock falling about 12 m from the top of the temporary earth-retaining structure
2117.위험성감소대책:
▶ To prevent falling hazards in earth-retaining temporary facility dismantling sections, stack at an appropriate gradient according to soil type and remove soil and rock at risk of falling from fill slopes
▶ Control worker entry within the working radius of falling-object hazard sections

2118.재해개요: Around May 2021, at a housing redevelopment improvement project site, the victim, together with a fellow worker, was performing cleaning work on the basement floor surface according to work instructions prior to backfilling work for the apartment underground structure, when he was crushed by a rock dropped by an excavator performing backfilling work at the top of the excavation approx. 7 m above the basement floor surface, and died.
2118.재해유발요인: The victim was crushed by a rock dropped by an excavator performing backfill work above the excavation
2118.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct advance surveys of hazards around the workplace before work and share hazard conditions with workers
▶ Prohibit simultaneous work above and below in falling-object hazard sections

2119.재해개요: Around March 2018, at a quarry, the victim was waiting in an excavator 80 meters away in order to load rocks generated after blasting onto a dump truck when a rock (11 kg) generated during blasting work flew over and struck the chest of the victim, who was seated in the operator's seat, and he died.
2119.재해유발요인: While waiting in an excavator for blasted-rock handling (loading work), rock generated by the blasting work flew and struck the chest of the victim sitting in the excavator's operator seat
2119.위험성감소대책:
▶ During blasting work, establish no-entry zones extending to points with flying rock hazards and strictly restrict access
▶ During blasting work, take measures such as installing separate worker refuge areas within the danger zone

2120.재해개요: Around September 2020, at the OOOO Co., Ltd. OOOO infrastructure work site located in OO City, OOO Province, two victims belonging to the subcontractor OOOO Co., Ltd. were working at the bottom of an excavation for sewage pipeline installation when the excavation slope and landscaping stones collapsed, burying the two victims; one died and one was injured. This was a fatal accident.
2120.재해유발요인: During excavation for pipeline laying, the excavation slope and landscaping stones collapsed, burying the worker
2120.위험성감소대책:
▶ During excavation work, implement measures to prevent the overturning of adjacent structures (installing sturdy supports, etc.)
▶ Where existing structures, etc., are nearby, conduct a prior safety assessment for vibration, impact, etc.
▶ Comply with excavation face slope gradient standards and install simple earth retaining, etc.
▶ Conduct a preliminary survey of the ground around the excavation work and prepare a work plan

2121.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OOOO improvement project site built by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO County, OOO Province, the victim, during installation work of stormwater pipes (concrete U-pipes), was carrying a bucket down to a stream located about 5 m from the site to fetch water needed for mixing mortar, the joint material for the stormwater pipe connections, when he lost his balance and fell approx. 1.8 m into the stream below, lost consciousness from the impact, and drowned to death. This was a fatal accident.
2121.재해유발요인: While going down to a nearby stream to fetch water for mixing mortar, the joint material for pipe connections, the victim fell into the stream and drowned
2121.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit workers from unnecessary movement onto the top of slopes, etc., and install movement passages for workers
▶ When working at heights where workers may fall or trip, install guardrails and implement fall prevention measures, and where unavoidable, install access barriers, etc.
▶ When working at heights where workers may fall or trip, provide and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmets, safety harnesses, etc.)

2122.재해개요: Around September 2021, at a water supply pipe installation work site located in OO-dong, OO City, OOO Province, two victims went down into a pipeline trench excavated 0.7 m wide and 0.8 m deep for water pipe burial and were performing floor leveling work and water pipe laying work when landscaping stones adjacent to the excavated section collapsed into the excavated trench; one died and one was injured.
2122.재해유발요인: During excavation for pipeline laying, the excavation slope and landscaping stones collapsed, burying the worker
2122.위험성감소대책:
▶ During excavation work, implement measures to prevent the overturning of adjacent structures (installing sturdy supports, etc.)
▶ Where existing structures, etc., are nearby, conduct a prior safety assessment for vibration, impact, etc.
▶ Comply with excavation face slope gradient standards and install simple earth retaining, etc.
▶ Conduct a preliminary survey of the ground around the excavation work and prepare a work plan

2123.재해개요: Around November 2018, at the OO construction site, the victim, wearing chest waders, was standing on a rock in the river throwing a rope connected to a silt protector to be installed across the Nakdong River when he slipped off the rock and drowned.
2123.재해유발요인: While throwing a rope connected to a silt protector, the victim slipped on a rock and drowned
2123.위험성감소대책: ▶ Keep life-saving equipment on hand during work and have workers wear life vests

2124.재해개요: Around March 2021, at a site-clearing area for farmland development within a housing complex, the victim was working on preventing scattering dust at the soil-hauling vehicle access road and on surrounding cleanup when, while at the bottom of a cut slope, he was struck by falling rock and died.
2124.재해유발요인: While at the bottom of a cut slope where excavation work had been completed, the victim was struck by falling rock
2124.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working below a cut slope, maintain an appropriate separation distance so that rocks, etc. piled on slopes do not roll down the slope
▶ Conduct advance surveys of and remove hazards around the workplace before work

2125.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the OO new construction project, the victim, during plastering work, was found collapsed in front of the utility room on the right side of the site and died.
2125.재해유발요인: During exterior wall plastering work, the victim stepped on brick materials left on the floor, fell over, and struck the head against a boundary stone
2125.위험성감소대책:
▶ Take measures and thoroughly maintain tidiness so there is no risk of tripping or slipping at the workplace
▶ Check ground conditions before work, then level and smooth the ground before performing work

2126.재해개요: Around March 2019, beneath the limestone bin among the 3rd-floor Flux Bins of OOOO Co., Ltd. OOOO, two victims belonging to OOOO were performing cutting-open work on the lower part of the limestone bin in order to check the internal corrosion condition of the bin and perform maintenance when limestone poured out; OOO suffered serious injuries and OOO minor injuries, and the victim (OOO) buried in the limestone died during medical treatment. This was a fatal accident.
2126.재해유발요인: While cutting open the lower part of a limestone bin to check the internal corrosion condition and perform maintenance, limestone poured out and the victim was buried (crushed)
2126.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a dismantling work plan for equipment dismantling work
   - Check information on the structure to be dismantled (drawings, structural review reports, etc.)
   - Dismantling sequence and dismantling methods for the facility
   - Establish tip-over prevention measures and reinforcement measures for dismantling
   - Check substances inside the tank

2127.재해개요: Around June 2017, at a dam construction project site, the victim was performing joint mortar work on a stone masonry face when a stone located on the right slope rolled down and struck his head, and he died.
2127.재해유발요인: While performing joint mortar work on a stone-pitched face, a stone located on the right slope rolled down and struck the worker's head
2127.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct advance surveys of hazards around the workplace and remove stones before work
▶ When performing stone pitching work on waterway floors, manage the hazard of stones piled on slopes rolling down the slope, and assign a supervisor to ensure the work is performed safely

2128.재해개요: Around October 2017, at a detached house new construction site, the victim was performing stone masonry work when, during rigging detachment work, a masonry stone toppled over and crushed him, and he died.
2128.재해유발요인: During landscaping natural-stone stacking work, the moment a natural stone moved with an excavator grapple was set down, the stone overturned and crushed the worker
2128.위험성감소대책:
▶ For landscaping natural stone installation work, implement tip-over prevention measures such as installing diagonal reinforcement between the slope and natural stones or backfilling with soil
▶ Control worker access to the work section concerned
▶ Perform work such as removing stone-handling rigging with workers clear of the working radius

2129.재해개요: Around May 2018, during apartment ancillary civil work, the victim was stacking natural landscaping stones when, the moment a natural stone moved by an excavator grab was set down, the natural stone tipped over and pinched him, and he died.
2129.재해유발요인: During landscaping natural-stone stacking work, the moment a natural stone moved with an excavator grapple was set down, the stone overturned and crushed the worker
2129.위험성감소대책:
▶ For landscaping natural stone installation work, implement tip-over prevention measures such as installing diagonal reinforcement between the slope and natural stones or backfilling with soil
▶ Control worker access to the work section concerned
▶ Perform work such as removing stone-handling rigging with workers clear of the working radius

2130.재해개요: Around March 2019, at a stone removal site, the victim was riding in the bucket of an excavator performing rock-splitting work when a rock toppled and struck the excavator bucket; he fell 6.4 m to the ground and was then crushed by the rolling rock, resulting in two deaths.
2130.재해유발요인: During landscaping natural-stone stacking work, the moment a natural stone moved with an excavator grapple was set down, the stone overturned and crushed the worker
2130.위험성감소대책:
▶ For landscaping natural stone installation work, implement tip-over prevention measures such as installing diagonal reinforcement between the slope and natural stones or backfilling with soil
▶ Control worker access to the work section concerned
▶ Perform work such as removing stone-handling rigging with workers clear of the working radius

2131.재해개요: Around April 2016, at a road construction work site, the victim was performing survey marking work at a tunnel face when rock fell from the face and struck him, and he died.
2131.재해유발요인: Rock fell from the tunnel face and struck the worker
2131.위험성감소대책:
▶ Check the joint condition and location of potential rockfall areas to identify the condition of rocks that may fall
▶ Change work methods, such as using a tunnel aerial work vehicle (charging car), and implement rockfall prevention measures by installing head guards and front guards, etc.
▶ When damage from rockfall, etc. is a concern, implement hazard prevention measures such as removing loose rock, placing shotcrete on the tunnel face, and changing the excavation method

2132.재해개요: Around November 2018, during expressway construction work, the victim was aboard a tunnel aerial work vehicle removing loose rock when he was struck by falling rock and died.
2132.재해유발요인: Rock fell from the tunnel face and struck the worker
2132.위험성감소대책:
▶ Manage shotcrete placement methods and thickness during tunnel support installation work
▶ Check for proper filling of rock bolt anchoring material
▶ Apply reinforcement measures such as shotcrete on the tunnel face when impacts are applied to the face by mechanical excavation and drilling work
▶ Conduct advance surveys of surrounding geology and strata conditions before tunnel excavation work

2133.재해개요: Around April 2020, during road construction work, the victim was clearing loose rock at the tunnel face with an excavator when he was struck by falling rock and died.
2133.재해유발요인: Rock fell from the tunnel face and struck the worker
2133.위험성감소대책:
▶ Manage shotcrete placement methods and thickness during tunnel support installation work
▶ Check for proper filling of rock bolt anchoring material
▶ Apply reinforcement measures such as shotcrete on the tunnel face when impacts are applied to the face by mechanical excavation and drilling work
▶ Conduct advance surveys of surrounding geology and strata conditions before tunnel excavation work

2134.재해개요: Around November 2020, during railway construction work, the victim was clearing loose rock using an excavator when loose rock at the crown collapsed and buried him, and he died.
2134.재해유발요인: Rock fell from the tunnel face and struck the worker
2134.위험성감소대책:
▶ Manage shotcrete placement methods and thickness during tunnel support installation work
▶ Check for proper filling of rock bolt anchoring material
▶ Apply reinforcement measures such as shotcrete on the tunnel face when impacts are applied to the face by mechanical excavation and drilling work
▶ Conduct advance surveys of surrounding geology and strata conditions before tunnel excavation work

2135.재해개요: Around February 2017, during complex development work, the victim finished cutting steel supports inside a pilot tunnel and was moving when part of the tunnel face collapsed and buried him, and he died.
2135.재해유발요인: The moment the victim came out after steel-rib cutting work inside the pilot tunnel, part of the tunnel face collapsed and buried the victim
2135.위험성감소대책:
▶ When there is hazard from rockfall, etc., excavate by sections, install earth-retaining lagging, and support with face jacks to thoroughly prevent hazards from rockfall, etc.
▶ For trenchless passage box work, conduct advance surveys to prevent worker hazards from face collapse
▶ Implement advance responses such as reinforcement measures when there is a face collapse risk due to ground disturbance and loosening

2136.재해개요: Around November 2016, at OO Construction's urban-type multi-household housing new construction site, the victim was at the 5th-floor E/V pit edge lowering waste bags into the E/V pit by tying them with a lifting rope in order to remove them to the outside, when he lost his balance and fell to the E/V pit bottom where previously removed waste bags were stacked, and died.
2136.재해유발요인: The worker missed a step at an elevator pit opening where guardrails were not installed and fell to the pit floor
2136.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement fall-protection measures such as installing guardrails at fall edges such as stairwells
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

2137.재해개요: Around August 2018, at the OO new construction site, the victim was carrying a sand hod on his back, moving through the 3rd-floor stairwell in order to transport sand stacked on the 1st floor to the 4th floor, when he fell through the elevator pit opening (H≒8.5 m) and died.
2137.재해유발요인: After carrying sand stacked on the floor, while resting leaning against the elevator entrance, the victim fell through the elevator pit opening
2137.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement fall-protection measures such as installing guardrails at fall edges such as openings
▶ Provide separate rest areas within the site

2138.재해개요: Around September 2020, at OO Construction Co., Ltd.'s OO housing new construction site, while a fellow worker was carrying square timber in the 5th-floor stairwell, the victim, who was in front of the elevator pit opening, fell into the elevator pit (H≒12.9 m) while dodging the timber, and died.
2138.재해유발요인: While square timber was being carried, the victim, who was in front of the elevator pit, dodged the timber and fell into the elevator pit
2138.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement fall-protection measures such as installing guardrails at fall edges such as stairwells
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

2139.재해개요: Around February 2020, at a multi-household housing new construction site built by 00 Construction Co., Ltd., the victim was performing 1st-floor stairwell formwork assembly work when he toppled into the elevator opening and fell into the elevator pit approx. 1.6 m deep and died.
2139.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures in place, during ground-floor stairwell formwork assembly work, the worker toppled through the elevator opening and fell into the elevator pit
2139.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with a fall risk, install fall-protection nets or guardrails, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses
▶ Install working platforms and fall-prevention nets inside the elevator pit

2140.재해개요: Around October 2020, at 00 Construction Co., Ltd.'s neighborhood living facility new construction site, the victim was performing wall formwork work on the 2nd-floor elevator pit when he fell from the top of a temporary working platform to the floor (H≒2 m) and died.
2140.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures in place, during upper-floor elevator pit wall formwork work, the worker fell from the top of a temporary working platform to the floor
2140.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with a fall risk, install fall-protection nets or guardrails, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses
▶ Install working platforms and fall-prevention nets inside the elevator pit

2141.재해개요: Around September 2016, at OO Construction's apartment and officetel new construction site, the victim was using a grinder to cut exposed rebar (10 mm) of the elevator pit (PIT) on the 8th-floor slab when he lost his balance and fell between the cut rebar to the 1st-floor elevator pit bottom (fall distance 23.8 m) and died.
2141.재해유발요인: While working near a floor opening without guardrails installed, the worker fell
2141.위험성감소대책:
▶ Where there is a risk of falling through openings such as material entry ports, install fall protection facilities such as guardrails or safety nets
▶ If installing guardrails or safety nets is difficult, provide safety harnesses and install safety harness anchorage facilities to which harnesses can be attached

2142.재해개요: Around March 2021, at the OO remodeling site, during work using a winch to lift bags of Remital (ready-mixed mortar) through the elevator pit opening between the 2nd and 3rd floors of a commercial building, the victim fell approx. 8.2 m to the basement floor and died.
2142.재해유발요인: Without fastening a safety harness, while hoisting plastering materials using a winch installed in the elevator pit, the worker lost balance and fell
2142.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in places where workers may fall or trip, install working platforms such as by assembling scaffolds, and take protective measures such as guardrails at edges
▶ If working platform installation is difficult, have workers wear safety harnesses and take measures such as installing anchorage facilities to which harnesses can be attached and used

2143.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the OO new construction project, the victim transported sand from the 3rd floor to the 4th floor using a sand carrier for door-frame mortar-filling work and, while coming back down, lost his balance at the 3rd-floor elevator pit edge and fell (H≒7.5 m) and died.
2143.재해유발요인: Without fastening a safety harness, while hoisting plastering materials using a winch installed in the elevator pit, the worker lost balance and fell
2143.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in places where workers may fall or trip, install working platforms such as by assembling scaffolds, and take protective measures such as guardrails at edges
▶ If working platform installation is difficult, have workers wear safety harnesses and take measures such as installing anchorage facilities to which harnesses can be attached and used

2144.재해개요: Around August 2021, in front of the 3rd-floor elevator pit of the office building within the OO factory new construction site, two victims were standing on a guardrail installing interior panels on the elevator door side when the guardrail dropped downward; the workers lost their balance and fell 8 m to the elevator pit bottom and died.
2144.재해유발요인: While working standing on a guardrail installed at the elevator pit opening, the guardrail being stepped on detached, and the victim lost balance and fell through the opening
2144.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install working platforms by scaffold assembly at fall-hazard locations
▶ Install fall-protection nets when working platform installation is difficult 
▶ Provide and fasten safety harnesses

2145.재해개요: Around September 2021, during elevator fabrication and installation work within the OO new construction project, the victim placed plywood on top of embedded rebar inside the elevator pit and was cutting the rebar with an electric welder when the plywood came off and he fell approx. 10.2 m and died.
2145.재해유발요인: Inside the elevator pit, while sitting on plywood placed over rebar and cutting the rebar, the plywood resting on the cut rebar tilted and the victim fell
2145.위험성감소대책:
▶ When removing rebar used for working platforms in the elevator pit, cut the rebar one at a time and move the cut rebar toward the entrance
▶ At fall-hazard locations such as elevator pits, install safety nets using perimeter ropes and suspension ropes 
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

2146.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO logistics warehouse new construction site, the victim (panel installer), belonging to OO Co., Ltd., the subcontractor for interior and exterior panel installation work, performed installation work of fixing hardware for 4th-floor firewall panels together with one fellow worker and, while moving, fell to the bottom of the basement 2nd-floor E/V room and died.
2146.재해유발요인: While moving, the victim missed a step and fell through the elevator pit opening where guardrails were not installed
2146.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails and fall-prevention nets at places where workers may fall during work or movement
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

2147.재해개요: Around December 2018, at the OO Co., Ltd. OO factory extension work site, the victim, belonging to the subcontractor OO Co., Ltd., was performing panel finishing work on the side of the elevator on the 3rd floor when he fell through the open elevator opening (H≒18.8 m) and died.
2147.재해유발요인: While working around the elevator pit entrance, the victim missed a step and fell through the pit opening whose access door was open
2147.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as installing guardrails and fall-prevention nets at places where workers may fall during work or movement
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

2148.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO Construction office building new construction site, the victim was pulling a cable, raised from the 3rd floor to the 8th floor, out to a distribution box located outside the 8th floor of the elevator pit when the guardrail frame for the elevator opening detached, and he fell approx. 15 m and died.
2148.재해유발요인: While working standing on an opening cover made arbitrarily on site, the opening cover broke and the worker fell to the floor below.
2148.위험성감소대책:
▶ When openings occur, install opening covers and attach hazard signs (opening covers shall be fabricated with a sturdy structure)
▶ If opening covers are not installed, install guardrails around them

2149.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the OOOO Co., Ltd. OOOO factory major-repair work site, in the course of the victim and a fellow worker installing interior urethane panels on the elevator interior walls between the 1st and 2nd floors in order to install conveyor equipment inside the elevator, the victim was performing silicone caulking work on the panel joints when he fell to the elevator pit bottom and died during medical treatment. This was a fatal accident.
2149.재해유발요인: While performing caulking work on wall panel joints inside the E/V, the victim fell through an opening into the E/V pit
2149.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working near openings with a fall risk, implement opening protection measures such as tight installation of working platforms and installation of guardrails
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

▶ When lifting heavy materials such as counterweight block cases in front of elevator doors, assign at least two persons to transport materials in addition to the remote control operator, and proceed with work after implementing safety protection measures such as installing guardrails and safety harness anchorage facilities

2159.재해개요: Around July 2018, at the OOOO solar facility construction site located in OO-ri, OO-myeon, OO County, after solar module panel installation work, during site cleanup work, the victim felt dizzy and reported it to a fellow worker, then sat resting under the shade of a tree; he suddenly stood up, ran about 5~6 m, and collapsed; a fellow worker found him and administered first aid, and he was transported to the hospital via 119 but died during treatment. 2160.재해개요: Around June 2019, on the deck of a barge, the victim was conducting a submarine cable cutting test to verify the performance of the cutting wheel (grinding tool) of a new hydraulic grinder when the cutting wheel shattered and a flying fragment struck his face, and he died.
2160.재해유발요인: While conducting a submarine cable cutting test to check the performance of a grinding tool, the cutting wheel shattered and flying fragments struck the victim's face, resulting in death
2160.위험성감소대책:

▶ Install protective covers on hydraulic grinders

2161.재해개요: Around June 2020, in the downstream-line evacuation gallery section of the OO site, during underwater cutting work for restoration of a flooded tunnel section, the victim died from the impact of an underwater explosion.

2161.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prevent explosion or fire by removing structures above the flame-cutting section and gas-retention areas
▶ Establish vent drilling plans and conduct advance safety inspections and risk assessments

2162.재해개요: Around May 2017, at the OOOO public housing district development work site located in OO City, OOO Province, the victim was using a portable engine cutter to cut a stormwater pipe (concrete hume pipe, D=250mm) when the portable engine cutter kicked back and struck his upper body, and he died.

2162.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using an engine cutter, supplement and install blade contact prevention devices to minimize exposure of the rotating blade during cutting work
▶ When using an engine cutter, perform work with the object fixed in place and use engine cutter equipment appropriate to the size of the object

2163.재해개요: Around July 2018, at OO Co., Ltd.'s OO district undergrounding maintenance site, the victim was cutting timber lagging with a chainsaw and, while pulling out the saw blade stuck in the lagging, his neck was cut by the blade, and he died.

2163.위험성감소대책:
▶ When cutting lagging boards with a chainsaw, install support blocks on both sides of the saw blade so the lagging board does not sink down and pinch the blade
▶ Before using a chainsaw, be familiar with handling methods and install protective devices

2164.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with fire prevention measures such as prohibiting hot work in fire-hazard locations
▶ Comply with installation and maintenance of alarm facilities and devices

2165.재해유발요인: While flame-cutting steel plate with an oxygen cutter to fabricate a transport cart, the dust-proof clothing the victim was wearing caught fire, causing burns
2165.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with fire prevention measures such as prohibiting hot work in fire-hazard locations
▶ Provide personal protective equipment such as protective clothing and protective gloves and manage its wearing condition

2166.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OO new construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., while an approximately 3.5 m high H-beam partially embedded in the core wall was being flame-cut with an oxygen cutting torch in the basement level 2 parking lot of the office building, sparks spread to insulation materials (0.9m × 1.8m, urethane boards, about 180 sheets) stockpiled behind the work area, causing a fire, and the victim died of asphyxiation and burns.
2166.재해유발요인: While flame-cutting an H-beam with an oxygen cutter, sparks spread to stockpiled insulation, causing a fire
2166.위험성감소대책:

▶ Assign a fire watcher

2167.재해개요: Around February 2019, at an apartment new construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., sparks generated during flame-cutting of horizontal members of a gang form on the rooftop (6th floor) ignited non-woven fabric placed on the 1st floor, and the flames spread to the insulation on the 1st-floor ceiling and the dust net outside the scaffold; workers evacuating from the flames suffered burns, with 1 dying during treatment and 2 injured.
2167.재해유발요인: With no fire hazard prevention measures in place, during flame-cutting work on gang form horizontal members on the rooftop, generated sparks ignited non-woven fabric on a lower floor, and the fire spread to the ceiling insulation on the same floor and to the dust screen outside the scaffold, burning workers
2167.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install spark scatter prevention covers, welding fire blankets, etc. during fire-hazard work such as flame cutting
▶ Use hand grinders, etc. with lower fire risk when cutting metal members

2168.재해개요: Around March 2018, at the OO residential-commercial complex new construction site, while a day-labor victim was performing welding work to install anchor hardware for exterior stone work on the 1st-floor outer wall, welding sparks scattered onto insulation stacked at the lower rear of the workplace and started a fire, which spread to insulation already installed on the 1st-floor ceiling; the victim, who was installing formwork for a material lifting opening on the 1st floor of the parking tower, died from the resulting flames and toxic gas.
2168.재해유발요인: During welding work for exterior stone installation and substructure hardware installation, welding sparks scattered onto insulation, causing a fire and generating toxic gas
2168.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work that may cause fire such as welding, implement fire prevention measures such as placing fire extinguishers, installing spark prevention covers, and organizing and removing combustible materials
▶ Conduct periodic inspections of fire extinguishers placed on site to enable rapid response in case of fire on site

2169.재해개요: Around February 2021, at a private house additional construction site built by OO Architecture, the victim was cutting plywood installed on a wall for insulation work on the 2nd-floor balcony when his left leg was cut by the saw blade of the cutting power tool, and he died.

▶ When using a core drill, perform work with the object fixed in place, and cut off power when not in use to prevent sudden power supply

▶ For work that may cause fire such as welding, implement fire prevention measures such as placing fire extinguishers, installing spark prevention covers, and organizing and removing combustible materials

2173.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OOOO demolition site built by OOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO District, OO City, OOO, belonging to a scrap and non-ferrous metal collection company, was flame-cutting the main rope (wire rope) connecting the elevator car and counterweight with an oxygen-LPG welder from the bottom of the elevator pit to dismantle the elevator, when the elevator car located above fell to the ground level and he is presumed to have been crushed to death.
2173.재해유발요인: While flame-cutting the ropes connected to the car and counterweight at the bottom of the pit for elevator dismantling, the car located above fell and crushed the victim
2173.위험성감소대책:
▶ Before elevator dismantling work, prepare an advance work plan to plan work methods and assign a work director capable of supervising during work

2175.재해개요: Around April 2018, on the 5th floor of the OO new construction site of OO Construction, the victim lost balance while removing steel wires from the ceiling on a mobile scaffold and fell to the floor (H≒1.8m) and died.

2175.위험성감소대책:

▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

2176.재해개요: Around April 2017, at the OO construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, together with co-worker Lee Jeong-sang, was dismantling the ground-level 1st-floor column formwork after concrete pouring using a mobile scaffold, and while climbing down from the 3rd-level working platform to the 2nd-level working platform of the mobile scaffold, fell 3.6~5.4 m to the ground-level 1st floor and died.
2176.재해유발요인: Although passage markings should have been provided so workers could pass safely, they were not; while dismantling and organizing exterior wall formwork inside the rooftop elevator shaft, the worker descended to the ground floor via the system scaffold outside the elevator room, lost balance, and fell
2176.위험성감소대책:
▶ Mark passages at their main sections and instruct all workers in the workplace to recognize and use them
▶ When installing temporary passages at locations with a high fall risk, install guardrails at the edges
▶ When working at fall-risk locations such as edges and openings, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

2177.재해개요: Around March 2021, at the OO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, after removing formwork supports (flat ties) on the beam side of basement level 1 from the top of a mobile scaffold, fell to the floor (H=1.5m) while climbing down and died.
2177.재해유발요인: Although passage markings should have been provided so workers could pass safely, they were not; while dismantling and organizing exterior wall formwork inside the rooftop elevator shaft, the worker descended to the ground floor via the system scaffold outside the elevator room, lost balance, and fell
2177.위험성감소대책:
▶ Mark passages at their main sections and instruct all workers in the workplace to recognize and use them
▶ When installing temporary passages at locations with a high fall risk, install guardrails at the edges
▶ When working at fall-risk locations such as edges and openings, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

2178.재해개요: Around October 2017, at the OO golf net expansion construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim, who was installing an indoor golf net on a mobile scaffold, fell about 1.8 m to the floor below while installing a steel structure (Ø60.5＊2.4t, L=4.5m) for fixing the indoor wall golf net and died.

2178.위험성감소대책:

▶ Wear safety helmets and safety harnesses when working in places with a risk of workers falling
▶ When working on mobile scaffolds, the supervisor must check installation of working platforms across the entire upper surface and securing of outer guardrails

2179.재해개요: Around October 2018, at a cattle shed new construction site built by OO Construction, the victim (welder) was welding on top of the 2nd-level working platform of a mobile scaffold for cattle shed steel frame assembly work when he fell to the ground (h=3.2m) and died.
2179.재해유발요인: While performing steel-frame welding work on the upper working platform of a mobile scaffold without guardrails, the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
2179.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling and working on mobile scaffolds, install guardrails on the scaffold top to prevent fall hazards
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses when working on mobile scaffolds
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

2180.재해개요: Around March 2019, at the OOO (individual) new construction site, the victim (welder) was performing final welding of tack-welded steel beams and steel columns on the upper working platform of a mobile scaffold when he fell about 1.8 m to the concrete floor and died.
2180.재해유발요인: While performing steel-frame welding work on the upper working platform of a mobile scaffold without guardrails, the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
2180.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling and working on mobile scaffolds, install guardrails on the scaffold top to prevent fall hazards
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses when working on mobile scaffolds
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

2181.재해개요: Around August 2019, at the OO new construction site, while a mobile system scaffold for masonry work (with wheels attached to the bottom of the vertical members) installed around a column was being moved by manual pushing, the top of the scaffold caught on a roof steel beam; unaware of this, the workers pushed harder, and the system scaffold toppled over, crushing 2 workers underneath and injuring them.
2181.재해유발요인: While manually pushing a mobile scaffold to move it for masonry work, the top of the scaffold caught on a structure and the scaffold overturned, crushing the victim
2181.위험성감소대책:
▶ Proceed with scaffold assembly, dismantling, and modification work under the direction of a supervisor
▶ Inform workers engaged in the work of the timing, scope, and procedures of assembly, dismantling, or modification

2182.재해개요: Around March 2021, at the OO extension construction site, the victim fell from a mobile scaffold during surface finishing work on a protective retaining wall and died.
2182.재해유발요인: While performing plastering and surface-finishing work on a mobile scaffold, the victim lost balance and fell from the edge of the working platform where guardrails were not installed
2182.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install guardrails at the top of mobile scaffolds, and where guardrail installation is difficult due to work conditions, install safety harness anchorage facilities and supervise so that work is performed after fastening safety harnesses
