2254.재해유발요인: During working platform installation work in a retaining wall structure work section, a steel pipe (horizontal member) supporting the working platform suddenly detached and fell to the ground together with the working platform, and a worker working nearby below was struck on the neck by the falling steel pipe
2254.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing working platforms at locations where scaffold height is 2 meters or more, comply with the work method of connecting or fixing platform materials to two or more supports to prevent tipping and detachment
▶ When installing working platforms on scaffolds, implement fall-protection measures by installing safety nets and fences to prevent falls

2255.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO Construction residential-commercial complex new construction site, the victim, with the temporary staircase treads partially dismantled, was handing a tool to a co-worker when he fell 3.9 m onto the retaining wall below and died.
2255.재해유발요인: During temporary stair dismantling work, while handing an impact wrench to a worker below on the stairs, the victim fell from the upper stair landing through the gap between dismantled working platforms
2255.위험성감소대책:
▶ When an opening is created by the exposed landing edge during dismantling work on part of a temporary stair access route, implement opening protection measures by installing guardrails and fences
▶ When installation of guardrails or fences is difficult, implement fall-prevention measures by installing safety nets or providing and wearing safety harnesses

2256.재해개요: Around June 2017, at an expressway construction site, the victim was installing scaffolding on the retaining wall to the left of the tunnel portal at the starting point of the tunnel when he fell from the edge of the exterior scaffold working platform 3.8 m to the concrete floor below and died.
2256.재해유발요인: Without wearing a safety harness, while installing and dismantling external scaffold working platforms, the victim lost balance and fell to the floor
2256.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails and safety nets at locations where workers may fall, such as working platform edges
▶ Where installing guardrails and safety nets is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Implement fall prevention measures such as having workers wear safety harnesses

2257.재해개요: Around July 2017, at a liquid cargo storage facility construction site, the victim was installing working platforms at the top of the interior scaffold in order to erect scaffolding for cleaning work inside a tank when he lost balance and fell to the ground (H≒18m) and died.
2257.재해유발요인: Without wearing a safety harness, while installing and dismantling external scaffold working platforms, the victim lost balance and fell to the floor
2257.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails and safety nets at locations where workers may fall, such as working platform edges
▶ Where installing guardrails and safety nets is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Implement fall prevention measures such as having workers wear safety harnesses

2258.재해개요: Around July 2018, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site built by OO Construction, the victim, carrying two 4 m scaffold pipes on his shoulder, was moving toward the exterior scaffold on the staircase side of the 2nd floor above ground for exterior scaffold extension work when he stepped on an unsecured staircase wall formwork working platform; the working platform flipped over, and he fell together with it 5.4 m to the concrete ground below and died.
2258.재해유발요인: While carrying materials on an external scaffold working platform, the unfixed working platform flipped over and the victim fell
2258.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly fix scaffold working platforms at two or more points before performing work
▶ Install guardrails and safety nets at places where workers may fall, such as platform edges

2259.재해개요: Around December 2019, at a connecting road construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim and 3 others were transporting a bundle of working platforms [11.8 kg per platform, 5 rows × 10 tiers, 50 platforms in total, total weight 590kg] to be used for structure (water culvert) work; while the load (working platforms) hoisted by a truck-mounted crane (7.3ton) was being unloaded onto the concrete floor between the culvert wall rebars, the turntable ring gear fixing bolts of the truck-mounted crane fractured, and the working platforms and the boom of the truck-mounted crane (7.3ton) came down on the victim, who was crushed between the culvert wall rebar and the fallen working platforms and died.
2259.재해유발요인: After hoisting a utility pole with a mobile crane, during loading, the boom broke and fell, striking the worker
2259.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy loads, establish worker exclusion zones in locations at risk of falling objects
▶ Immediately stop work when cracks or similar caused by repeated loads are identified by visual inspection before work
▶ Conduct thorough periodic safety inspections of the mobile crane

2260.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO Church new construction (civil work) site built by OO Construction, the victim fell about 7.3 m to the basement level 2 concrete floor during demolition work on a temporary staircase leading down to basement level 2 and died.
2260.재해유발요인: During temporary stair demolition work, a stair tread came off and the worker on the tread fell to the floor
2260.위험성감소대책:
▶ Provide safety harnesses before work and manage their fastening condition
▶ For work with a fall risk, implement fall-prevention measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets

2261.재해개요: Around October 2018, at a safety passage and guardrail improvement construction site inside the OO factory, the victim was replacing the floor planks of an overhead crane access passage when he lost footing and fell about 27 m to the ground below and died.
2261.재해유발요인: During temporary stair demolition work, a stair tread came off and the worker on the tread fell to the floor
2261.위험성감소대책:
▶ Provide safety harnesses before work and manage their fastening condition
▶ For work with a fall risk, implement fall-prevention measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets

2262.재해개요: Around April 2019, at the OO government building extension site, 2 victims were modifying a temporary staircase and connecting guardrails in the basement level 3 section when the temporary staircase collapsed and they fell to the floor (h≒3.0m, 2.0m), suffering injuries requiring more than 3 months of medical care.
2262.재해유발요인: During temporary stair demolition work, a stair tread came off and the worker on the tread fell to the floor
2262.위험성감소대책:
▶ Provide safety harnesses before work and manage their fastening condition
▶ For work with a fall risk, implement fall-prevention measures such as safety harness anchorage facilities and fall-prevention nets

2263.재해개요: Around January 2021, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site built by OO Construction, the victim was tidying movable electric cables placed (installed) on the railing of the temporary staircase leading from basement level 2 to the ground-level 1st-floor decking structure when he lost footing and fell over the stair railing about 7 m to the basement level 2 floor below and died.
2263.재해유발요인: While arranging portable cables draped over a stair railing, the victim fell below the railing to the basement floor
2263.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly organize and tidy the site, such as removing obstacles from worker movement passages
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness attachment

2264.재해개요: Around December 2019, at the OO apartment housing new construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim turned on a generator to erect an air soundproof wall for blasting; as the air soundproof wall inflated, it interfered with the upper guardrail attached to the column formwork (so-called blue form), so he climbed on top of the blue form and was pushing the air soundproof wall by hand when the blue form toppled over, and he fell about 3 m to the floor below and died.
2264.재해유발요인: To install an air soundproof wall for blasting, the victim climbed on top of column formwork and, while pushing the air soundproof wall by hand, the formwork overturned and the victim fell to the floor
2264.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prohibit work on unstable working platforms

2265.재해개요: Around June 2018, on the 1st floor above ground of the community center new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a subcontractor victim was assembling beam formwork on a working platform when he lost balance and fell about 5.9M to the basement level 1 floor below and died.
2265.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures implemented in the opening section, during elevator-shaft exterior wall formwork assembly work, the worker lost balance because the working platform was not fixed, and fell
2265.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling scaffolds, install them so no gaps occur between the building wall and the scaffold
▶ Install safety nets to prevent falls where gaps have occurred due to work conditions
▶ When installing working platforms at fall-hazard work locations, install guardrails conforming to regulations

2266.재해개요: Around February 2019, at the OO officetel new construction site of OO Industry Co., Ltd., the victim, belonging to structural work subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd., was carrying out materials such as formwork inside the Dry Area on the 1st floor above ground when an unsecured working platform came loose, and he fell together with the working platform about 25 m to the basement level 6 concrete floor and died.
2266.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures implemented in the opening section, during elevator-shaft exterior wall formwork assembly work, the worker lost balance because the working platform was not fixed, and fell
2266.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling scaffolds, install them so no gaps occur between the building wall and the scaffold
▶ Install safety nets to prevent falls where gaps have occurred due to work conditions
▶ When installing working platforms at fall-hazard work locations, install guardrails conforming to regulations

2267.재해개요: The victim, while assembling exterior wall formwork for the 4th-floor elevator room or while moving, lost balance and slipped, falling through the gap (40cm) between the building exterior wall and the scaffold about 9.6 m to the ground-level 1st-floor concrete floor below, and died.
2267.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures implemented in the opening section, during elevator-shaft exterior wall formwork assembly work, the worker lost balance because the working platform was not fixed, and fell
2267.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling scaffolds, install them so no gaps occur between the building wall and the scaffold
▶ Install safety nets to prevent falls where gaps have occurred due to work conditions
▶ When installing working platforms at fall-hazard work locations, install guardrails conforming to regulations

2268.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO new construction site, the victim, who had been assembling beam formwork on a working platform (height: about 4.7m) installed on top of system shores on the 4th floor above ground of Building OO, finished the work and was climbing down when he fell and died.
2268.재해유발요인: With the vertical passage poorly maintained, after beam formwork assembly work on a working platform installed on top of ground-floor system shores, a passage-type working platform was standing at the bottom of the ladder installation area, so the victim moved sideways to climb down and fell
2268.위험성감소대책:
▶ Keep worker passageways in a safe condition available for use at all times
▶ Comply with safety measures such as wearing safety harnesses while workers move

2269.재해개요: Around April 2017, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site, the victim was installing rooftop-level exterior wall formwork on top of a working platform when the joist member [scaffold steel pipe (48.6㎜, L=1m)] supporting the working platform, which was not fixed to the scaffold ledger, came off and the working platform dropped, and he fell about 9.3 m to the floor below and died.
2269.재해유발요인: The scaffold working platform was poorly fixed and detached, and the victim fell
2269.위험성감소대책:
▶ When assembling scaffolds, firmly assemble member connections using dedicated fittings, and fix working platforms at two or more points so they do not detach
▶ In sections with a fall risk, install fall-protection nets or guardrails, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses
▶ Install guardrails in compliance with installation standards and have the supervisor verify

2270.재해개요: Around May 2018, at the OO installation construction site, 3 workers were fastening screws to a work support on top of a horizontal member (steel pipe φ48.6mm) at the front of a greenhouse when the entire clamp-fixed work support rotated, and 2 workers fell about 4 m to the ground; 1 died and 1 was injured.
2270.재해유발요인: While fastening screws on a work-assist stand on top of the horizontal connecting members of system shores without fall-prevention measures, the work-assist stand rotated and the worker fell to the ground
2270.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with a fall risk, install fall-protection nets or guardrails, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses
▶ Install guardrails in compliance with installation standards and have the supervisor verify

2271.재해개요: Around November 2019, 2 victims belonging to OO Co., Ltd. were assembling staircase wall formwork on the 4th floor above ground on a temporary working platform made of timber when the wooden working platform collapsed, and they fell onto the staircase slab and were injured.
2271.재해유발요인: Without preparing a heavy-material handling work plan and without designating a work supervisor, while climbing onto and moving along a working platform installed on the perimeter of a ground-floor slab to release the sling belts of formwork shores lifted by tower crane onto the same-floor slab, the working platform came loose and the worker fell
2271.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing working platforms, install them firmly to prevent detachment and have the supervisor confirm the installation condition
▶ When handling heavy loads, prepare a work plan in advance and assign a supervisor so that work is performed according to the work plan

2272.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the OO new construction site built by OO Co., Ltd., the victim was moving on a working platform (perforated aluminum platform) installed on the horizontal connecting members of system shores in order to replace defective beam formwork fasteners (beam ties) when he lost footing and fell to the basement level 1 floor and died.
2272.재해유발요인: While moving on a working platform installed on the horizontal connecting members of system shores without fall-prevention measures in order to replace defective beam formwork fastening hardware, the worker lost footing and fell
2272.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with a fall risk, install fall-protection nets or guardrails, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses
▶ Install guardrails in compliance with installation standards and have the supervisor verify

2273.재해개요: Around November 2020, at the OO officetel site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a subcontractor victim was installing column formwork supports (so-called bands) on a working platform temporarily installed inside the material removal opening on basement level 4 when the mid-rail came off the guardrail post, and he fell to the basement level 6 floor (h≒10m) and died.
2273.재해유발요인: With guardrail installation requirements and opening protection measures not implemented, while installing column formwork supports on a working platform temporarily installed inside a basement material removal opening, the mid-rail detached from the guardrail post and the worker fell
2273.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with fall hazards, install fall-protection nets and guardrails or work after wearing a safety harness
▶ Install in compliance with guardrail installation standards and have the supervisor verify

2274.재해개요: Around September 2016, the victim was dismantling aluminum forms on the 1st floor of the OO new construction site built by OO Construction, and while performing work to remove the formwork under a beam at a height of about 2.8 m, a working platform temporarily installed on system shores, being unsecured, shook; he lost balance and fell below and died.
2274.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures in place, while removing the formwork under the upper-floor beam for aluminum form dismantling work on the ground floor, a working platform temporarily installed on system shores was not fixed and shook, and the victim lost balance and fell
2274.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with fall risk, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or work after wearing a safety harness
▶ When installing working platforms, firmly secure them so they do not flip over or fall

2275.재해개요: Around January 2017, at the OO neighborhood living facility new construction site, the victim was at the edge of a protruding slab on the 2nd floor above ground cutting the steel wire (6mm) fixing Euroform in order to dismantle the formwork (Euroform) when he lost balance and fell about 3.5 m to the concrete floor below and died.
2275.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures in place, at the edge of a protruding ground-floor slab, while cutting steel wire fixing euro-forms for formwork dismantling, the victim lost balance and fell
2275.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at places with fall potential such as protruding slab edges, install working platforms by assembling double-row scaffolds
▶ In sections with a fall risk, install fall-protection nets or guardrails, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses

2276.재해개요: Around April 2017, at the OO apartment housing new construction site built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a subcontractor victim was dismantling aluminum formwork inside the elevator room (E/V Pit) and stacking it on a working platform (rebar + plywood structure) when the rebar (D=13@300mm) supporting the working platform came off the wall concrete, and he fell to the ground-level 1st floor (H≒35.8m) and died.
2276.재해유발요인: With the support structure of the working platform inside the elevator shaft in poor condition, while dismantling aluminum formwork inside the elevator shaft and stacking it on the working platform, the rebar supporting the working platform detached from the concrete wall and the worker fell
2276.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit excessive stacking of materials on working platforms inside the elevator shaft 
▶ When installing working platforms inside the elevator shaft, install supporting rebar at horizontal intervals within 200mm while securing adequate embedment length
▶ When dismantling formwork on top of working platforms inside the elevator shaft, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ After dismantling, install fall-prevention nets below at intervals within 10m

2277.재해개요: Around June 2018, at the OO multi-family house new construction site, the victim, a form carpenter, installed pipe supports (2 rows, width 17cm) at a height of about 80 cm for use as a working platform in order to dismantle wall formwork in the rooftop staircase room, then climbed on top and was removing the fixing pins of the formwork (Euroform: 600×1200mm) when he lost balance and fell through the opening (800×800mm) between the adjacent winding stairs 13M to the 1st floor below and died.
2277.재해유발요인: To dismantle wall formwork in the penthouse stairwell, without installing a working platform, a pipe support was installed to serve as a working platform; while standing on it and removing formwork fixing pins, the worker lost balance and fell through the opening between adjacent winding stairs
2277.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall-hazard locations, install working platforms by methods such as scaffold assembly along with guardrails at platform edges
▶ When there are winding stairs and openings around the work location, install guardrails and fall-prevention nets to prevent falls, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses

2278.재해개요: Around May 2020, at the OO neighborhood living facility site being built by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, who was dismantling exterior wall formwork on the 8th floor above ground, slipped through the gap between the concrete structure and the working platform and fell to the 5th-floor working platform above ground (H≒13m) and died.
2278.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures in place, during ground-floor exterior wall formwork dismantling work, the victim fell through the opening between the concrete structure and the working platform
2278.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at fall-hazard locations such as openings, install opening covers and highly visible signs
▶ In sections with a fall risk, install fall-protection nets or guardrails, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses

2279.재해개요: Around April 2018, at a new construction site of OO Construction, the victim, with a working platform (pipe supports + square timber + plywood) installed in the elevator shaft on the 12th floor above ground, dismantled and stacked the wall formwork, and at the moment rigging was being attached to hoist it with a tower crane, the working platform collapsed, unable to bear the weight of the stacked wall formwork, and the victim fell to the basement level 1 floor (H≒40m) and died.
2279.재해유발요인: Excessively heavy formwork was stacked on a scaffold working platform, causing the working platform to collapse and a nearby worker to fall
2279.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with a fall risk, install fall-protection nets or guardrails, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses
▶ Install guardrails in compliance with installation standards and have the supervisor verify

2280.재해개요: Around August 2018, at the seawall construction site of OO Enterprise Co., Ltd., a subcontractor victim, in order to install a platform between the climbing platforms of the navigation gate, laid a working platform between the platforms and, while standing on the working platform to be installed, was connecting the working platform and the platform using steel wire when the working platform suddenly slipped out, and he fell together with the working platform to the concrete floor (H≒7.0m) and died.
2280.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures in place, in order to install a platform between the climbing platforms of the ship-passage gate, the victim laid a working platform between the platforms and, while standing on the platform to be installed and attempting to connect the working platform to the other platform, the working platform detached and the worker fell
2280.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing working platforms between climbing platforms, secure hanger bracket supports
▶ During working platform installation work, step on already-installed platforms as much as possible to prevent falls
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses during working platform installation

2281.재해개요: Around March 2018, at an apartment new construction site, during work to raise a hydraulic climbing system working platform (PCS) from the 55th floor to the 56th floor, a member supporting the work deck came off and the working platform fell; 3 victims on board fell 201 m below and died, 1 concrete pump truck operator struck by the lower working platform died, and 4 people were injured after being struck by the working platform that fell to the ground.
2281.재해유발요인: While raising the PCS for exterior curtain wall work, the cone fixing the shoe bracket supporting the work platform detached from the tie rod embedded in the concrete wall, causing the work platform and 3 workers to fall; the falling work platform then struck a worker, and a work platform member that bounced off the ground struck a worker
2281.위험성감소대책:
▶ Check the fastening condition of climbing cones and tie rods
▶ Prohibit simultaneous upper and lower work within the same work zone
▶ Assign a supervisor when assembling, dismantling, and modifying work platforms on building exterior walls

2282.재해개요: Around February 2017, at a detached house new construction site, the victim, a rebar worker, placed a scaffold steel pipe (48.6mm) across horizontal rebars at a height of 1.2~1.5 m on a bathroom wall for rebar assembly work, installed a prefabricated working platform, and climbed on top to work, when the scaffold steel pipe, whose bearing length was short, came off the rebar, and he fell to the floor together with the working platform and died.
2282.재해유발요인: While working on scaffold steel pipes laid across horizontal rebar, a scaffold steel pipe with a short bearing length came off the rebar, and the worker fell together with the platform
2282.위험성감소대책:
▶ For rebar assembly work in confined spaces, assemble mobile scaffolds and install working platforms before performing work
▶ When working in places with a risk of workers falling, strictly wear personal protective equipment and conduct verification and supervision

2283.재해개요: Around November 2017, at a complex building new construction site being built by OO Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to subcontractor OO Construction Co., Ltd., during concrete pouring work on the rooftop level of the 5-story building, stepped onto an exterior scaffold working platform whose guardrails had already been dismantled, in order to disassemble the pump truck hose and other tasks, and while moving or working, fell to the ground (H≒15.0m) and died.
2283.재해유발요인: During concrete pouring work, while standing on a working platform without guardrails to dismantle the pump truck hose, the victim fell
2283.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working around edges with a fall risk, install guardrails and fall-protection nets at the edges
▶ When working at fall-hazard locations 2m or higher, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

2284.재해개요: Around July 2017, at the OOO cattle shed new construction site, the victim lost footing during steel structure work on the cattle shed roof (C-channel steel installation work) and fell to the concrete floor (H≒5.9m) and died.
2284.재해유발요인: While working on top of a steel structure with no fall protection measures in place, the worker fell
2284.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as installing fall-prevention nets
▶ If safety protection measures are difficult due to site conditions, install separate safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Supervise workers' wearing of personal protective equipment

2285.재해개요: Around April 2017, at the OO new construction site, while performing masonry work on an exterior steel pipe scaffold working platform on the 4th floor at the front of the building (main entrance side), the victim lost balance and fell 11 m to the ground below and died.
2285.재해유발요인: While performing masonry work on a working platform, the victim lost balance and fell from the edge of the working platform where guardrails were not installed
2285.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails at fall-hazard locations such as working platform edges 
▶ When guardrail installation is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and work after fastening safety harnesses

2286.재해개요: Around September 2017, at the OO new construction site of OO Construction, victim 1 was moving along the upper working platform of the exterior scaffold on the 3rd floor of the main building for face brick laying work when he slipped and fell into the ELEV.PIT (H=8.5m), striking victim 2, who was working on top of the 1st-floor ELEV, injuring both at the same time.
2286.재해유발요인: While working on an external scaffold working platform, the victim lost footing and fell from the edge of the working platform where guardrails were not installed
2286.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install guardrails at openings with a fall risk
▶ When guardrails cannot be installed due to work conditions, install safety harness anchorage facilities and work wearing safety harnesses

2287.재해개요: Around October 2017, at an officetel and multi-household housing construction site built by OO Construction, the victim, while hoisting face brick materials on an exterior steel pipe scaffold, was trying to pull out a carrier caught on the working platform when he lost balance and fell to the ground below (H≒12.5) and died.
2287.재해유발요인: While working on an external scaffold working platform, the victim lost footing and fell from the edge of the working platform where guardrails were not installed
2287.위험성감소대책:
▶ Firmly install guardrails at openings with a fall risk
▶ When guardrails cannot be installed due to work conditions, install safety harness anchorage facilities and work wearing safety harnesses

2288.재해개요: Around December 2017, at the OO new construction site, while performing exterior masonry mortar jointing work on the 4th-floor exterior scaffold, the victim lost balance and fell outside the scaffold down to the ground-level 1st floor (H≒10.6m) and died.
2288.재해유발요인: While performing exterior masonry mortar jointing work on an external scaffold, the victim lost balance and fell outside the scaffold where guardrails were not installed
2288.위험성감소대책:
▶ Where there is a risk of falling through the opening between the building exterior wall and the scaffold, install fall-prevention nets below or install additional working platforms
▶ When assembling the scaffold, assemble it at an appropriate distance from the structure, considering exterior wall finishing construction
▶ When the inner guardrails of the scaffold are arbitrarily removed for exterior wall finishing work, install fall-prevention nets between the structure and the scaffold working platform and supervise so that work is performed after fastening safety harnesses

2289.재해개요: Around October 2020, at the OO remodeling construction site, the victim fell to the floor (H≒2.0m) while moving on the intermediate slab of the basement pit level and died.
2289.재해유발요인: While moving on an intermediate basement slab without a passageway, the victim fell to the floor
2289.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails at fall-hazard locations such as working platform edges 
▶ When guardrail installation is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and work after fastening safety harnesses

2290.재해개요: Around May 2021, at the OO new construction site, while laying face bricks on the working platform (2nd level, 3.9m) of a system scaffold, the victim fell to the concrete floor below through the gap (width 0.4m) between the inner end of the working platform (2nd level) and the building wall and died.
2290.재해유발요인: With no fall-prevention measures installed, while performing exterior wall surface-finishing work on an external scaffold, the victim lost balance and fell through the opening between the structure's exterior wall and the scaffold
2290.위험성감소대책:
▶ Where there is a risk of falling through the opening between the building exterior wall and the scaffold, install fall-prevention nets below or install additional working platforms
▶ When assembling the scaffold, assemble it at an appropriate distance from the structure, considering exterior wall finishing construction
▶ When the inner guardrails of the scaffold are arbitrarily removed for exterior wall finishing work, install fall-prevention nets between the structure and the scaffold working platform and supervise so that work is performed after fastening safety harnesses

2306.위험성감소대책:
▶ In fall-risk sections on the inside and outside of the scaffold, install guardrails composed of top and middle rails, and firmly fix them using dedicated connection pins or clamps, etc.
▶ Install guardrails in a structure capable of withstanding a load of 100kg or more acting at the structurally weakest point in the weakest direction
▶ Use safety-certified products for the pipes, clamps, etc., used as guardrail materials
▶ The removal of scaffold guardrails is prohibited in principle, and where they must unavoidably be removed for wall finishing construction, review safety in advance and install with the gap between the platform and the wall minimized, or provide workers with safety harnesses and supervise so that they move and work with safety harnesses worn
▶ When installing scaffold working platforms, fix them firmly and install them so that no separate openings occur
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' wearing of personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

2314.재해개요: Around November 2018, at the OO construction project, the victim was installing a light switch box at a slab edge when he fell to the ground (H≒4.2m) and died.
2314.재해유발요인: During installation of light switch boxes, hood caps, lighting conduits, fire-fighting pipes, etc., the worker fell to the floor from a height of 2 m or more
2314.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safe working platforms for high-place work at 2 m or more, then work (install and use mobile scaffolds)
▶ Comply with safety rules when installing and using mobile scaffolds
   - Install guardrails at the top of the mobile scaffold
   - Install outriggers at the bottom to prevent overturning (4 points)
   - Workers on top of working platforms work after fastening safety harnesses
     => When fastening a safety harness to a mobile frame scaffold, fasten it considering the lowest fall point of the safety harness
     => When assembling two or more tiers of mobile frame scaffold at a height of 1.8 m per tier, fasten the safety harness to the frame scaffold
   - Verify the assembly condition of major structural parts when assembling mobile scaffolds (install bracing; prohibit installing working platforms on access ladder rungs)
   - When ascending or descending mobile scaffolds, install hatch platforms and use the access ladder on the inside
   - Prohibit workers' unsafe behavior (working while stepping on the top of the guardrail)

▶ Prohibit opening doors using the feet
▶ Check workers for alcohol consumption before work and exclude those who have consumed alcohol from work

2322.재해개요: Around October 2019, at the OO equipment installation site in the factory building of OOO Co., Ltd. located in OO Town, OO County, OOO Province, a victim belonging to OOOOOO was moving via stairs placed, without being fixed, between the hopper working platform on top of the OO equipment and the raw material feeding device working platform (height difference 775㎜) when the stairs slipped; he lost balance and fell about 5 m to the workshop floor below and died during hospital treatment. This was a fatal accident.
2322.재해유발요인: While moving via stairs laid unfixed between the hopper working platform on top of the ball mill equipment and the raw-material feeding device working platform, the stairs slipped and the victim lost balance and fell to the workshop floor
2322.위험성감소대책:
▶ Check materials for deformation, damage, etc. and inspect for abnormalities before work
▶ When working at fall-hazard locations, install working platforms and fall-protection nets
▶ When installation of fall-protection nets is difficult, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear safety harnesses

2323.재해개요: Around June 2020, at the OOOO gymnasium heating/cooling and air handling unit installation site of OOOO Co., Ltd., a victim belonging to subcontractor OOOOO Co., Ltd. was installing heating/cooling duct piping above the gymnasium ceiling when he fell to the gymnasium floor (H≒8.9m) and died. This was a fatal accident.
2323.재해유발요인: While installing heating and cooling duct piping above the gymnasium ceiling, the victim fell
2323.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in places with a fall risk, comply with fall-prevention measures such as guardrails and fall-protection nets
▶ Prohibit opening doors using the feet
▶ Check workers for alcohol consumption before work and exclude those who have consumed alcohol from work

2324.재해개요: A victim belonging to OO was installing a working platform over an opening for equipment piping work on the 2nd floor above ground when he lost footing and fell through the opening (1.12m×0.97m) together with the working platform to the 1st-floor concrete floor (H≒7.5m) and died.
2324.재해유발요인: While working near a floor opening, the worker lost balance and fell through the floor opening
2324.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with fall-prevention measures such as covers, safety nets, and safety harness anchorage facilities in fall-hazard sections such as openings
▶ Provide personal protective equipment before work and manage its wearing status

2325.재해개요: Around September 2018, at an elevator replacement construction site, the victim, in order to dismantle the chain block and electric hoist installed for dismantling the existing elevator, was performing electric hoist dismantling work on a tilted scaffold working platform installed inside the elevator located on the 3rd floor when he fell through an opening around the working platform 12 m to the elevator pit bottom and died.
2325.재해유발요인: Fell while moving or working on scaffold working platforms and temporary stairs where no guardrails were installed
2325.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform work after implementing fall-prevention measures such as installing working platforms and guardrails or fall-prevention nets in fall-hazard sections
▶ When installation of fall-prevention safety facilities such as guardrails is difficult, firmly install safety harness anchorage facilities in workers' work sections, provide safety harnesses to workers, and inspect and supervise their fastening

2326.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the 'OOOO Co., Ltd., OOOO new construction' site located in OO District, OO City, OOO Province, the victim was installing guide rails when the hook hoisting a guide rail released and the guide rail toppled over, and the working platform came off its supports; the victim, who was holding the rail, fell together with the rail to the elevator pit bottom (H=19.8m) and died. This was a fatal accident.
2326.재해유발요인: During E/V guide rail installation work, the hook lifting a rail released, the rail member toppled, the working platform detached from its supports, and the worker holding the rail fell together with the rail
2326.위험성감소대책:
▶ Use hooks with latch devices when lifting and installing guide rails
▶ When installing elevators, aim to install dedicated boarding equipment on the hoist; when installing working platforms because there is no separate dedicated boarding equipment, install the platforms firmly and tightly using hoistway brackets, etc. so they do not move or detach

2327.재해개요: Around May 2018, at an expressway maintenance site, for bridge bearing repair work, a welding generator that had been on the road shoulder was placed on the inclined access staircase leading to the pier, and the moment the workers stepped onto the staircase, the set anchor bolts supporting the staircase came off, and they fell 30.9 m below; 4 people died.
2327.재해유발요인: An anchor bolt shallowly embedded in concrete, which was supporting an inclined access stair, could not withstand the upper load and detached, and the worker fell to the ground
2327.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install anchor bolts to the required embedment depth (minimum insertion depth)
▶ When the embedment depth cannot be satisfied due to interference from internal rebar, etc., change the construction method, such as changing the anchor bolt installation position
▶ Periodic management and supervision are needed so that workers do not arbitrarily change construction methods

2328.재해개요: Around May 2017, at a railway construction site, the victim was dismantling a shield TBM when the segment roundness-keeping device toppled over and struck him, and he died.
2328.재해유발요인: While preparing for shield TBM dismantling work, a segment roundness-maintaining device without overturn-prevention measures tilted, and the victim was caught between the roundness-maintaining device and the guardrail installed on the working platform
2328.위험성감소대책:
▶ Place the H-beam supporting the roundness-maintaining device on the erector (transport equipment), weld-fix the roundness-maintaining device so it does not detach, then release hydraulic pressure and dismantle the tilt protection (tip-over prevention member) (thorough tip-over prevention)
▶ When transporting and fixing heavy objects into the shield TBM steel cylinder using the erector (heavy-object transport equipment), prepare a heavy-object handling work plan
▶ Establish a signaling system among workers, designate a work director, and work according to signals

2329.재해개요: Around June 2019, at the OO construction project, the victim was guiding a reversing dump truck (25-ton) when the dump truck collided with a utility pole behind it, and the victim was struck by the toppling utility pole and died.
2329.재해유발요인: While guiding a dump truck, the reversing dump truck collided with a utility pole, and the victim was struck by the toppling utility pole
2329.위험성감소대책:
▶ Assign spotters and comply with signals when using vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ Conduct advance surveys of workplace surroundings before work and address hazards before proceeding

2330.재해개요: Around January 2019, at a building new construction site, the victim was replacing a damaged cable connection device (outlet) when he received an electric shock (220V) and died.
2330.재해유발요인: While replacing a damaged cable connector (outlet) connected to a portable cable, the victim received an electric shock
2330.위험성감소대책:
▶ Implement protective measures for live parts and temporary electrical distribution panels, etc. 
▶ When maintaining or repairing electrical machinery, devices, and wires, always cut off the power and verify the de-energized state with a voltage detector before performing work

2331.재해개요: Around March 2017, during communication line relocation work, the victim slipped during backfilling work at the excavated embedment area of a steel pipe pole and fell 3.5 m to the riverbed below and died.
2331.재해유발요인: After electric wire relocation work on a utility pole, while climbing down to the ground, the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
2331.위험성감소대책:
▶ When ascending and descending utility poles, implement fall-prevention measures such as step bolts, aerial work vehicles, and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Provide safety harnesses before work and manage their fastening condition

2332.재해개요: Around April 2018, at a transmission line patrol inspection site, the victim, after completing a tower inspection, was standing on a wire and separating a grounding wire by hand when he received an electric shock from induced current (estimated at 353V or higher) and died.
2332.재해유발요인: After completing steel tower inspection, the victim disconnected the grounding wire by hand and received an electric shock from current induced from an adjacent live line
2332.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with an electric shock risk, provide insulating gloves, insulating protective equipment, etc. and manage their wearing condition
▶ Implement safety protection measures such as live-line work devices (aerial work vehicles, etc.) and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ When working near live lines, maintain an appropriate separation distance to prevent electric shock
▶ For work with an electric shock risk, implement safety protection measures such as wiring insulation and live-part protection

2333.재해개요: Around September 2018, during obstructing utility pole relocation work, the victim, after wire relocation work, was climbing down to the ground when he fell 4.5 m to the ground and died.
2333.재해유발요인: After electric wire relocation work on a utility pole, while climbing down to the ground, the victim lost balance and fell to the ground
2333.위험성감소대책:
▶ When ascending and descending utility poles, implement fall-prevention measures such as step bolts, aerial work vehicles, and safety harness anchorage facilities
▶ Provide safety harnesses before work and manage their fastening condition

2334.재해개요: Around April 2016, at the 'OOOO sewer pipe maintenance project' site carried out by OOOO located in OO County, OO Province, OOO, belonging to subcontractor OOOO Co., Ltd., was drilling the lower part of a sewer manhole (PE) with a portable drilling machine to connect a sewer pipe (PE, D200) when the insulation broke down and he received an electric shock from leakage current applied to the metal casing of the drilling machine; he was transported to hospital and died during treatment. This was a fatal accident.
2334.재해유발요인: While drilling the lower part of a sewer manhole (PE) with a portable drilling machine to connect a sewer pipe, insulation breakdown caused leakage current to be applied to the drilling machine's metal casing, and the worker received an electric shock
2334.위험성감소대책:
▶ Ground metal enclosures, metal sheaths, metal frames, etc. 
▶ Install ground-fault circuit interrupters for electric shock prevention on electrical machinery to prevent electric shock hazards from current leakage
▶ When using mobile or portable electrical machinery, use double-insulated or otherwise protected electrical devices to prevent electric shock hazards from insulation damage

2335.재해개요: Around February 2016, during demolition work on the OO house, the victim was climbing a utility pole stepping on the step bolts in order to remove electric service wires left on the pole when he fell to the asphalt surface (H≒6m) and died.
2335.재해유발요인: While climbing a utility pole on its step bolts to dismantle remaining electrical service wires on the pole, the victim fell to the ground
2335.위험성감소대책:
▶ Review appropriate work methods such as using aerial work vehicles
▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

2336.재해개요: Around January 2018, at the OO road opening construction site, the victim was dismantling a wall-tie steel pipe (L=4m) connecting the exterior dust net and the structure for demolition work when the wall-tie steel pipe contacted a railway feeder line (Busan direction, 25kV) about 2 m away; he received an electric shock and fell about 8 m to the floor below and died.
2336.재해유발요인: While dismantling a wall-tie steel pipe connecting the external dust screen and the structure, it contacted a nearby railway feeder line, and the victim received an electric shock and fell to the ground
2336.위험성감소대책:
▶ Assign a watcher for electric shock hazard warning
▶ Maintain an appropriate separation distance (3m) to prevent electric shock

2337.재해개요: Around August 2018, at the OO service work site, the victim, during preparation work to remove a large signboard at the entrance of an indoor market arcade, was cutting a live 220V wire with pliers when he received an electric shock and died.
2337.재해유발요인: During preparation work for large signboard removal, the victim received an electric shock while cutting an electric wire with pliers
2337.위험성감소대책:
▶ For electrical work, shut off the relevant circuit before performing work
▶ Provide appropriate insulating protective equipment to workers handling live lines

2338.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the OO construction site, in order to remove a telecommunication pole (L=7m, about 370kg), the pole was tied with a single wire rope (Ø16mm), raised, and hoisted with a mobile crane (4.5-ton), and while it was being laid down with its base resting on the poles stacked in the truck bed, the wire rope came off the crane hook and the pole fell (H≒8m), striking the head of the victim, who was moving to perform backfilling work at the pole extraction area beside the truck bed, and he died.
2338.재해유발요인: While dismantling a utility pole with a crane, the wire rope came off the crane hook and the utility pole fell, striking the head of the victim nearby
2338.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform lifting work after fastening two or more wire ropes according to the utility pole shape
▶ Check for installation of hook latch devices and prohibit worker access within the working radius

2339.재해개요: Around February 2017, at a building extension and remodeling construction site, the victim was dismantling scaffolding on the exterior scaffold when a scaffold pipe contacted a nearby high-voltage line (22.9 kV); he received an electric shock and fell from the height of the 4th floor above ground to the basement level 1 concrete floor (H≒12.8m) and died.
2339.재해유발요인: While climbing the scaffold to dismantle the external scaffold, the victim contacted an overhead power line, received an electric shock, and fell to the ground
2339.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working near overhead power lines, implement electric shock prevention measures such as shutting off the overhead line and using insulating protective devices
▶ Provide insulating safety protective equipment (insulating gloves, insulating shoes, safety work clothing, AE-type safety helmets, etc.) before work and manage its wearing condition

2340.재해개요: Around November 2017, at an obstructing tower relocation site, 6 scaffold workers (including the victim) were assembling a foothold scaffold to prevent contact with a ground obstruction (22.9KV live line) during 154KV transmission line stringing work; the victim, who was working on the 9th level of the scaffold, was working in close proximity (within about 50 cm) to the 22.9KV charged line whose live parts were exposed due to partially missing insulating protective tubes, when he received an electric shock through direct contact with the live part or through induced current and fell to the ground (H≒14m) and died.
2340.재해유발요인: While climbing the scaffold to dismantle the external scaffold, the victim contacted an overhead power line, received an electric shock, and fell to the ground
2340.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working near overhead power lines, implement electric shock prevention measures such as shutting off the overhead line and using insulating protective devices
▶ Provide insulating safety protective equipment (insulating gloves, insulating shoes, safety work clothing, AE-type safety helmets, etc.) before work and manage its wearing condition

2341.재해개요: Around May 2018, at a multi-family house new construction site, the victim approached the charged line (22.9kv) of the transformer unit on a utility pole adjacent to the exterior scaffold on the road in front of the building and, while moving, contacted it; he received an electric shock and fell to the ground (H≒10m) and died.
2341.재해유발요인: While climbing the scaffold to dismantle the external scaffold, the victim contacted an overhead power line, received an electric shock, and fell to the ground
2341.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working near overhead power lines, implement electric shock prevention measures such as shutting off the overhead line and using insulating protective devices
▶ Provide insulating safety protective equipment (insulating gloves, insulating shoes, safety work clothing, AE-type safety helmets, etc.) before work and manage its wearing condition

2342.재해개요: Around June 2018, at a business facility new construction site built by OO Construction, 2 victims were dismantling and carrying a steel pipe (L=4m) for exterior scaffold dismantling work on the 8th floor above ground when the steel pipe contacted the charged line (22.9kV) of the high-voltage power receiving equipment installed on the rooftop of the neighboring building (clearance about 1.0m), causing electric shock; victim 1, who was handing over the steel pipe, was electrocuted and died, and victim 2, who was receiving the steel pipe on the 7th-floor exterior scaffold, had current pass through him and fell onto the scaffold working platform installed between the 3rd and 4th floors and was injured.
2342.재해유발요인: While climbing the scaffold to dismantle the external scaffold, the victim contacted an overhead power line, received an electric shock, and fell to the ground
2342.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working near overhead power lines, implement electric shock prevention measures such as shutting off the overhead line and using insulating protective devices
▶ Provide insulating safety protective equipment (insulating gloves, insulating shoes, safety work clothing, AE-type safety helmets, etc.) before work and manage its wearing condition

2343.재해개요: Around August 2020, at a demolition work site within a housing redevelopment improvement project built by OO Construction, the victim was climbing the exterior scaffold installed on the building to be demolished in order to dismantle it when he contacted an adjacent overhead line (22.9kV), received an electric shock, and fell to the floor (H≒10m) and died.
2343.재해유발요인: While climbing the scaffold to dismantle the external scaffold, the victim contacted an overhead power line, received an electric shock, and fell to the ground
2343.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working near overhead power lines, implement electric shock prevention measures such as shutting off the overhead line and using insulating protective devices
▶ Provide insulating safety protective equipment (insulating gloves, insulating shoes, safety work clothing, AE-type safety helmets, etc.) before work and manage its wearing condition

2344.재해개요: Around April 2021, at the OO-dong demolition work site, during scaffold dismantling work, a dismantled steel pipe contacted the 22,900V extra-high-voltage charged line of a nearby utility pole, and 2 victims were injured.
2344.재해유발요인: While climbing the scaffold to dismantle the external scaffold, the victim contacted an overhead power line, received an electric shock, and fell to the ground
2344.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working near overhead power lines, implement electric shock prevention measures such as shutting off the overhead line and using insulating protective devices
▶ Provide insulating safety protective equipment (insulating gloves, insulating shoes, safety work clothing, AE-type safety helmets, etc.) before work and manage its wearing condition

2345.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO business facility new construction site, the victim was installing scaffolding for a falling-object prevention net using steel pipes on the exterior scaffold at the height of the 4th floor above ground (about 11m) when a steel pipe (6m) touched the live part of an overhead line (22.9KV distribution line); he suffered burns over his entire body from the resulting arc and electric shock and fell to the ground.
2345.재해유발요인: While erecting a scaffold for falling-object prevention net installation using steel pipes, a steel pipe contacted a live part, generating an arc, and the victim received an electric shock and burns
2345.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with an electric shock risk, implement safety protection measures such as de-energized work and insulating protective equipment
▶ Implement no-access measures near live lines

2346.재해개요: Around June 2020, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site, the victim, after completing temporary cable service work from a utility pole on the existing road, was fixing the temporary cable to the pole when he fell about 4 m to the existing road surface below and died.
2346.재해유발요인: While fixing temporary electrical cables to a utility pole without wearing a safety harness, the victim lost balance and fell
2346.위험성감소대책: ▶ Inspect and supervise workers' personal protective equipment and safety harness fastening

2347.재해개요: Around July 2016, at an electric service line replacement construction site, the victim was on an aluminum ladder connecting the electric service line from the utility pole side to the building's service entrance when he contacted a live part, received an electric shock, and died.
2347.재해유발요인: While performing connection work at a building's service entrance, the victim contacted a live part and received an electric shock
2347.위험성감소대책:
▶ For electrical work, shut off the relevant circuit before performing work
▶ For live-line work, implement live-line work measures such as providing insulating protective equipment

2348.재해개요: Around December 2018, at the OO Center electrical work site, the victim and 3 others were installing bus ducts (large-capacity power cables) on basement level 1 for the construction of a computer room when the bus duct being installed struck the live part of an adjacent energized bus duct, and an electric arc caused by a short circuit occurred; all 4 suffered burns and 1 victim died.
2348.재해유발요인: During large-capacity power cable installation work, a bus duct was struck, generating an electric arc that caused burns
2348.위험성감소대책:
▶ If busbars installed adjacent to the work section are live, implement temporary insulation measures using covers
▶ When working near live lines, implement safety measures such as de-energizing the live line and installing insulating covers on live parts

2349.재해개요: Around June 2019, at a pool villa new construction site built by OO Construction, the victim was drilling into a concrete retaining wall in Room 2 on the 1st floor of Building O with a wet core drill when he received an electric shock from 220v current leaking to the metal casing of the core drill and died.
2349.재해유발요인: While drilling with a core drill, the victim received an electric shock from 220V current leaking to the core drill's metal casing
2349.위험성감소대책:
▶ For electrical work, shut off the relevant circuit before performing work
▶ For live-line work, implement live-line work measures such as providing insulating protective equipment

2350.재해개요: Around December 2015, at the OO Co., Ltd. 'maintenance equipment for two-way radio train wireless communication devices' site, the victim was installing a radio transceiver antenna on top of railway maintenance equipment (ballast regulator) when his upper body contacted the overhead catenary line (25KV); he received an electric shock, and his work clothes caught fire from the arc, causing burns, and he died.
2350.재해유발요인: While performing cleanup and repair work, the victim touched a live wire without live-part protection and received an electric shock
2350.위험성감소대책:
▶ Improve work methods such as cutting off circuit power when working adjacent to live lines
▶ Use insulating protective devices and protective equipment
▶ Strengthen worker management such as assigning watchers

2351.재해개요: Around September 2016, at a rural water development project site, the victim received an electric shock while checking the operating condition of a submersible pump installed in a puddle.
2351.재해유발요인: The victim entered a puddle to check the operating condition of a submersible pump and received an electric shock from the pump, which had an electrical leak
2351.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install ground-fault circuit interrupters for electric shock prevention appropriate to the circuit concerned to prevent electric shock hazards from current leakage
▶ Before pumping work, connect the power cable to a power terminal equipped with a ground-fault circuit interrupter, check for leakage abnormalities, and upon finding abnormalities, immediately repair or reinstall before performing work

2352.재해개요: Around August 2017, at the 2nd-floor interior renovation work site of the OOO Co., Ltd. building, carried out by OO Construction Co., Ltd., directly employed worker OOO, together with co-worker OO, boarded a truck-mounted aerial work platform and was inspecting a leaking area of the exterior wall when, at the moment the victim stepped up onto the mid-rail on the side of the platform basket, his head touched the COS (CutOut Switch) of a 22.9㎸ charged line; after receiving an electric shock, he fell about 9 m to the ground through the gap between the basket and the building and died.
2352.재해유발요인: While performing cleanup and repair work, the victim touched a live wire without live-part protection and received an electric shock
2352.위험성감소대책:
▶ Improve work methods such as cutting off circuit power when working adjacent to live lines
▶ Use insulating protective devices and protective equipment
▶ Strengthen worker management such as assigning watchers

2353.재해개요: Around January 2019, in the basement electrical room of the OO facility construction site, a victim of an electrical work subcontractor was organizing materials and cleaning the electrical room for the completion confirmation inspection when he received an electric shock from the power receiving equipment (voltage 22.9kV) and died.
2353.재해유발요인: While performing cleanup and repair work, the victim touched a live wire without live-part protection and received an electric shock
2353.위험성감소대책:
▶ Improve work methods such as cutting off circuit power when working adjacent to live lines
▶ Use insulating protective devices and protective equipment
▶ Strengthen worker management such as assigning watchers

2354.재해개요: While equipment work was being performed on the 3rd floor above ground, a fire broke out in a refrigerator on basement level 1 and spread to the ceiling insulation, generating toxic gas; while evacuating via the exterior scaffold, 1 person fell to the ground-level 1st floor (H≒3.9m) and died, and 2 people were injured by smoke inhalation and other causes.
2354.재해유발요인: While performing mechanical equipment work on the basement level, tracking caused a short circuit in an electric wire, resulting in a fire
2354.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish and operate an alarm operation system enabling rapid response in case of fire on site
▶ Conduct periodic site management and safety inspections to minimize the effects of moisture, dust, etc.

2355.재해개요: Around March 2018, at a stair landing on the 2nd floor above ground of the OO new construction site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, who was fabricating and installing formwork with a portable circular saw, received an electric shock from leakage current on the metal casing of the circular saw, whose insulation had broken down, and died.
2355.재해유발요인: During formwork fabrication work, the victim received an electric shock from leakage current on the metal casing of a circular saw whose insulation had broken down
2355.위험성감소대책:
▶ For electrical work, shut off the relevant circuit before performing work
▶ For live-line work, implement live-line work measures such as providing insulating protective equipment

2356.재해개요: Around August 2016, at a seawater desalination facility construction site, the victim was processing rebar using a portable hydraulic cutter when the insulation broke down and he received an electric shock from leakage current flowing through the casing of the hydraulic cutter and died.
2356.재해유발요인: While processing rebar using a portable hydraulic cutter, insulation breakdown caused leakage current to flow on the hydraulic cutter's casing, and the victim received an electric shock
2356.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using mobile or portable electrical machinery and devices exceeding 150 volts to ground, such as hand grinders, inspect and address the operating condition of ground-fault circuit interrupters
▶ Ground the metal parts such as metal enclosures, metal sheaths, and metal frames of electrical machinery and devices such as hand grinders
▶ Use electrical machinery and devices fitted with insulated handles

2357.재해개요: Around July 2016, at a detached house building construction site, the victim was sitting on a rebar pile on the 1st-floor slab assembling beam rebar when he received an electric shock from current leaking from a rebar cutter on the rebar pile and died.
2357.재해유발요인: While a worker was sitting on a rebar pile on the slab assembling beam rebar, the worker received an electric shock from current leaking from a rebar cutter on the rebar pile
2357.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using electrical devices with exposed non-current-carrying metal parts such as rebar cutters, always connect the grounding wire along the power supply path 
▶ Portable rebar cutters used in places with temporary wiring circuits shall draw power through a ground-fault circuit interrupter to prevent electric shock from current leakage

2358.재해개요: Around August 2019, at the OO tower reinforcement work site carried out by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (steel frame worker), in order to replace bolts of an aged transmission tower, was adjusting his position on the tower members or moving to another work location (at a point 15.8 m above the ground) when he lost footing and fell onto a lower tower member (at a point about 6.0 m above the ground) and died.
2358.재해유발요인: To replace bolts on an aged transmission tower, while adjusting position or moving to another work position on tower members without wearing a safety harness, the worker lost footing and fell
2358.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities so that safety harnesses can be used during bolt replacement work on transmission towers
▶ Provide and wear personal protective equipment

2359.재해개요: Around October 2016, at the OO new construction site, in order to cut fixing anchor hardware installed in a window frame, the victim was working with a hand grinder on an exterior scaffold (H=1.7m) when he died of electric shock.
2359.재해유발요인: While working with a hand grinder on an external scaffold to cut anchor hardware, the victim received an electric shock due to an electrical leak from the hand grinder
2359.위험성감소대책:
