2490.위험성감소대책:
▶ Where the soil strata of the excavation face are not uniform, perform work after installing simple earth retaining (TS panels, etc.)
▶ During excavation, comply with excavation face slope gradients and prohibit placing heavy loads or soil near excavation slopes
▶ When excavating at locations close to structures such as retaining walls and concrete walls, implement hazard prevention measures such as reinforcing, relocating, or removing collapse risk factors
▶ When descending into the lower excavation area, manage the wearing of personal protective equipment (safety helmets) to guard against falling objects such as rocks
▶ Conduct a preliminary survey of the ground around the excavation work and prepare a work plan

2491.재해개요: Around May 2018, at the OO new construction site under construction by OO Construction Co., Ltd., the victim, employed by a subcontractor, was dismantling the connection pins of formwork installed on the exterior wall of the 2nd basement level when the soil of the excavation slope (about 5.6 tons) collapsed onto him, and he was crushed and died.
2491.재해유발요인: With no collapse and falling-object hazard prevention measures in place, while removing the connecting pins of formwork installed on the basement exterior wall, soil from the excavation slope collapsed and crushed the worker
2491.위험성감소대책:
▶ Grade the ground to a safe slope and remove soil and rock at risk of falling, or install retaining walls, earth-retaining shoring, etc.
▶ When there is a hazard of ground collapse, structure collapse, or falling soil and rock, implement prevention measures after advance surveys

2492.재해개요: Around November 2016, at the OO project, the victim was performing cable cutting and extension work at the excavation bottom to extend and relocate the tower crane power cable (380V) when the excavation slope collapsed (V≒1.5m3), and he was buried and died.
2492.재해유발요인: After entering the excavation bottom, while cutting and extending cables within the excavation bottom, the excavation slope collapsed and the worker was buried
2492.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with a ground collapse risk, implement collapse protection measures by installing earth-retaining shoring
   - Install temporary earth-retaining facilities when trench excavation reaches 1.5m or deeper (TS panels, SK panels, etc.)
▶ To prevent collapse during excavation work, comply with excavation face gradients according to the type of ground

2493.재해개요: Around December 2021, at an OO road improvement work site, in the process of installing a sign (fog light) between the road guardrail and the reinforced-earth retaining wall, the victim slipped on the slope and fell about 8.6M below.
2493.재해유발요인: While installing a sign (fog light) between the road guardrail and a reinforced-earth retaining wall, the victim slipped on the slope and fell
2493.위험성감소대책: ▶ At locations with a slipping hazard, installation workers shall work after fastening safety harnesses

2494.재해개요: Around May 2017, at a tunnel construction site, the victim was hauling and unloading a dump truck when the ground subsided, and he fell 12m below and died.
2494.재해유발요인: While reversing and parking a dump truck, the ground at the edge subsided and the vehicle overturned, and the worker was pinned in the driver's seat
2494.위험성감소대책:
▶ Assign equipment spotters when performing work using construction machinery
▶ Conduct advance surveys before work to prevent differential settlement and collapse of the ground
▶ Prohibit approaching excessively close to edge ends during unloading work
▶ During dump truck unloading work, always wear protective equipment such as seat belts to guard against emergencies such as vehicle overturning

2495.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO project, the victim and others were performing rebar assembly work on the wall of a gate-type structure for passage under a bridge foundation when LP gas that had leaked into the excavated space exploded; 4 died and 10 were injured.
2495.재해유발요인: During frame work under a bridge, gas leaking from a gas cylinder (LPG) that had been used the day before the accident and not retrieved exploded due to sparks from flame-cutting work
2495.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with explosion and fire prevention measures for gas welding, flame cutting, etc.
▶ Comply with storage regulations for hazardous materials such as LP gas
▶ Implement ventilation measures for underground workplaces

2496.재해개요: Around July 2016, to check the quantity of sludge dredging work inside a retention tank at the OO pumping station, victim 1 went down through the retention tank entrance to the bottom (4m) and, in the process of coming back up after checking, lost consciousness and collapsed; victim 2 went down to the bottom of the retention tank to rescue him but lost consciousness and collapsed, and both died.
2496.재해유발요인: To check sludge dredging work inside a retention tank, the victim went down inside the tank and, while coming back up after checking, lost consciousness due to hydrogen sulfide poisoning, collapsed, and died
2496.위험성감소대책:
▶ Measure hazardous gas concentrations in advance and maintain an appropriate air condition, such as supplying air through ventilation equipment
▶ Take measures to prohibit entry into the confined space by persons other than those involved in the relevant work

2497.재해개요: Around November 2019, at a gas pipeline relocation work site, the victim entered the inside of a gas pipeline (diameter 500mm) and was performing welding work when he suddenly lost consciousness, collapsed, and died.
2497.재해유발요인: After TIG welding work on a bend section, the victim entered the pipe to check the internal weld bead and perform grinding work, and lost consciousness due to oxygen deficiency
2497.위험성감소대책:
▶ For work with an asphyxiation risk, identify asphyxiation-hazard spaces and implement no-entry measures
▶ Perform work after ventilation measures based on gas concentration measurement before work

2498.재해개요: Around March 2016, at a point 891m from working shaft No. OO toward working shaft No. OO at the OOOO waterworks aged-pipe rehabilitation work site located in OO-myeon, OOO City, 3 workers employed by OOOO Co., Ltd. were performing drilling work on the water pipe inside the sluice valve chamber to drain the water from the underground water pipe when they were asphyxiated by toxic gas.
2498.재해유발요인: While drilling a water supply pipe in a valve chamber to replace an aged water supply pipe, the victim was asphyxiated by toxic gas
2498.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside confined spaces, verify workability through oxygen and hazardous gas concentration measurement before work 
▶ When working inside confined spaces, keep escape equipment on hand such as supplied-air respirators, lifelines, safety harnesses, and ladders

2499.재해개요: Around June 2017, at the OOOO soil environment improvement work site of OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-dong, OO District, OO City, the victim was using an oxygen cutting torch to cut the lower part of the manhole connection pipe (manhole guide) on the top of a fuel tank in order to fit it to the tank's curved surface, when sparks entered the tank and ignited the oil vapor, causing an explosion; the impact threw him against the gas station ceiling 5.1m above, after which he fell to the floor and died. This was a fatal accident.
2499.재해유발요인: While a worker was flame-cutting the lower part of a connection pipe with an oxygen cutter to fit the manhole guide on top of an oil tank to the tank's curved surface, generated sparks ignited oil vapor and caused an explosion, and the victim struck the ceiling and then fell to the floor
2499.위험성감소대책:
▶ Considering oil vapor generation, ventilate continuously after cleaning
▶ Install devices with gas detection and alarm capability on site
▶ Conduct risk assessments within the work site in advance to prevent explosion accidents

2500.재해개요: Around May 2019, at an OOOO waterworks manhole work site located in OO District, OOO City, 3 workers were poisoned by carbon monoxide and other harmful gases generated by a water pump (internal combustion engine) used for drainage work inside the manhole; 1 died and 2 were injured. This was the accident.
2500.재해유발요인: Inside a manhole, the victim was poisoned by carbon monoxide from a water pump used for drainage work
2500.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside confined spaces, verify workability through oxygen and hazardous gas concentration measurement before work 
▶ When working inside confined spaces, keep escape equipment on hand such as supplied-air respirators, lifelines, safety harnesses, and ladders

2501.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the sewer pipeline new installation (expansion) work [OOOO] site in front of OOOO located in OO District, OO City, during underground sewer pipe new installation work (800mm-diameter steel pipe jacking method), the victim (OOO) entered the steel pipe with a cutting torch (oxygen+LPG) to cut waste inside the pipe (presumed to be rebar, iron, steel materials, etc.), and an explosion occurred; fellow victims (OOO, OOO) who detected the explosion sound entered the steel pipe one after another for rescue, and all victims were poisoned by the carbon monoxide generated during the explosive combustion and died. This was a fatal accident.
2501.재해유발요인: At a sewer steel-pipe jacking site, an explosion occurred during flame-cutting of waste inside the steel pipe. Afterwards, 2 coworkers who entered for rescue were poisoned by carbon monoxide generated by the explosion
2501.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside confined spaces, verify workability through oxygen and hazardous gas concentration measurement before work 
▶ When working inside confined spaces, keep escape equipment on hand such as supplied-air respirators, lifelines, safety harnesses, and ladders

2502.재해개요: Around June 2020, at a rain gutter (catch basin) new installation work site in front of OOOOOO, during preliminary survey work for the catch basin installation, victim 1 (OOO) opened the manhole cover and, in trying to descend into the manhole, rested his upper body on both elbows at the manhole entrance before descending, but fell into the water in which sludge had accumulated to a height of about 2.8m inside the manhole. When victim 1's (OOO) body could not be seen, victim 2 (OOO), an excavator operator near the accident manhole, tied a rope (length about 2m) to the excavator bucket, entered the manhole holding the rope, and, holding the rope in one hand and the manhole's internal ladder in the other, stirred the sludge with his feet for several seconds trying to find victim 1 (OOO); he is presumed to have fallen into the sludge-laden water due to oxygen deficiency. The victims (OOO, OOO) were later found dead by the fire department rescue operation. This was the accident.
2502.재해유발요인: While entering a manhole for a preliminary survey for storm drain installation, the worker was asphyxiated by toxic gas and fell. The excavator operator who tried to rescue him was also asphyxiated and fell as well
2502.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside confined spaces, verify workability through oxygen and hazardous gas concentration measurement before work 
▶ When working inside confined spaces, keep escape equipment on hand such as supplied-air respirators, lifelines, safety harnesses, and ladders

2503.재해개요: Around October 2016, at an OO demolition work site, during torch-cutting work on the manhole covers of the silo roof and body side for dismantling a terephthalic acid (TPA) storage silo, an explosion occurred inside the silo and the victim, who was on top of the silo roof, died.
2503.재해유발요인: During dismantling and flame-cutting work on a TPA (terephthalic acid) storage silo, an explosion occurred inside the silo
2503.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform work after establishing hazard work plans for fire and explosion
▶ Perform flame-cutting work after removing combustible dust inside

2504.재해개요: Around October 2016, at an OO construction work site, the victim was preparing pipe cleaning work in order to bury a crude oil pipeline being removed, when an explosion caused by flammable vapor occurred and he died.
2504.재해유발요인: While preparing pipe cleaning work in order to bury a crude oil pipeline, friction caused an explosion of flammable vapor
2504.위험성감소대책:
▶ Perform work after establishing hazard work plans for fire and explosion
▶ Prohibit use of tools that may generate sparks from friction or impact

2505.재해개요: Around April 2016, at an OO multi-family housing new construction site, the victim was burning leftover alcohol in a steel drum in the 1st-floor parking lot to dispose of it; while pouring alcohol from a plastic container into the burning steel drum, the plastic container exploded, and he suffered burns and died.
2505.재해유발요인: While burning alcohol in a steel drum to dispose of it, in the process of pouring in additional alcohol from a plastic container, the plastic container or the metal container exploded, burning a nearby worker
2505.위험성감소대책:
▶ For alcohol disposal work, perform disposal at incinerators and incineration sites free from explosion, fire, and other hazards
▶ For work with explosion or fire potential, place fire extinguishers nearby and prohibit placement of ignition-source objects

2506.재해개요: Around February 2017, inside the vaporizer (gas-liquid separator) of the OOO manufacturing line for petrochemical products, the victim was removing impurities and cleaning the inside of the vaporizer and the inner walls of the piping when he was poisoned (presumed) by toxic organic solvents and collapsed into the water pooled inside the vaporizer, then died.
2506.재해유발요인: While cleaning the inside of washing equipment, the victim was poisoned by residual vapor
2506.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside confined spaces, verify workability through oxygen and hazardous gas concentration measurement before work
▶ Provide sufficient ventilation during confined space work

2507.재해개요: Around March 2017, at the new building construction site of OOO and 1 other, the victim, employed by OO Manpower, mistook a cleaning agent (efflorescence remover) contained in a bottled-water bottle for drinking water, drank it, and died.
2507.재해유발요인: Before work, the victim mistook cleaning agent contained in a bottled-water bottle for drinking water and drank it
2507.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare and provide material safety data sheets
▶ Designate transport and storage locations for controlled hazardous substances

2508.재해개요: Around June 2017, at a sewage manhole near the OO sewer pipe improvement work site constructed by OO Construction, the victim entered the manhole, lost consciousness, fell from the ladder, and died.
2508.재해유발요인: While entering a manhole, the victim lost consciousness and fell
2508.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside confined spaces, verify workability through oxygen and hazardous gas concentration measurement before work
▶ When working inside confined spaces, keep escape equipment on hand such as supplied-air respirators, lifelines, safety harnesses, and ladders

2509.재해개요: Around August 2017, in the sluice valve chamber inside a manhole on the road in front of the OO apartment, 2 victims employed by OO Construction Co., Ltd. went down to check the valves in the sluice valve chamber inside the manhole about 3m deep to supply tap water to the apartment units, then lost consciousness and collapsed, and both died.
2509.재해유발요인: While entering a manhole, the victim lost consciousness and fell
2509.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside confined spaces, verify workability through oxygen and hazardous gas concentration measurement before work
▶ When working inside confined spaces, keep escape equipment on hand such as supplied-air respirators, lifelines, safety harnesses, and ladders

2510.재해개요: Around September 2018, in the CO2 fire-extinguishing system manifold room located on the 1st basement level of the office building of the OO line of OOOO Co., Ltd., CO2 gas was discharged due to the detachment of a selector valve and leaked outside the manifold room; 3 workers employed by OOO Industry Co., Ltd., who were organizing materials in the passage outside the manifold room, inhaled the CO2 gas, and 2 died and 1 was injured. This was the accident.
2510.재해유발요인: In a CO2 fire-extinguishing system manifold room, a selector valve came off and CO2 gas was released, leaking outside the manifold room, and 3 workers who were arranging materials in the passageway outside the manifold room inhaled the CO2 gas
2510.위험성감소대책: ▶ Supervise proper installation of the CO2 fire suppression system after installation completion

2511.재해개요: Around September 2018, in the confined space inside a desulfurization reactor, a worker who had been performing unloading work for catalyst replacement was climbing a ladder from the bottom of the reactor to the opening located at the top for shift change; at a point about 3m from the opening, he removed his safety harness and the air-line mask connected to it by himself and attempted to climb up, then fell.
2511.재해유발요인: During spent catalyst removal work inside a reactor, while climbing up a ladder for a shift change, the victim's hand slipped in the process of adjusting the safety harness being worn, and the victim fell to the floor
2511.위험성감소대책:
▶ When installing ladder-type passages, install the top so that it extends at least 60cm above the opening
▶ Measure oxygen and hazardous gas concentrations before working inside confined spaces

2512.재해개요: Around October 2018, at the OO division of OOOO Co., Ltd., during bag filter replacement work on the dust collector (BF-15) installed on top of coal storage silo (D), at the moment the inspection manhole was opened to identify the cause of smoke occurring inside the dust collector, a backdraft occurred; 1 died and 4 were injured.
2512.재해유발요인: During dust collector bag filter replacement work, the moment an inspection manhole was opened to identify smoke generated inside the dust collector, a backdraft occurred due to oxygen inflow, causing burns
2512.위험성감소대책:
▶ For dust collector interiors, etc., implement spontaneous combustion prevention measures such as removing residual coal, installing non-combustible gas fire suppression systems, inert gas replacement, and installing water spray systems to prevent temperature rise
▶ Thoroughly comply with maintenance standards and procedures for dust collector maintenance such as periodic inspection (at least twice a year) and bag filter replacement (once a year)

2513.재해개요: Around May 2019, at an OO detached house new construction site (private), while warming up by a wood fire lit before starting work, a metal container containing adhesive* nearby exploded, and the victim, who was nearby, suffered 2nd-3rd degree burns and died.
2513.재해유발요인: While burning alcohol in a steel drum to dispose of it, in the process of pouring in additional alcohol from a plastic container, the plastic container or the metal container exploded, burning a nearby worker
2513.위험성감소대책:
▶ For alcohol disposal work, perform disposal at incinerators and incineration sites free from explosion, fire, and other hazards
▶ For work with explosion or fire potential, place fire extinguishers nearby and prohibit placement of ignition-source objects

2514.재해개요: Around June 2019, the victim entered a trichloroethylene (TCE) cleaning facility and was cleaning foreign matter in the cleaning tank when he was poisoned by TCE vapor remaining inside the cleaning facility, fell over, dropped into the cleaning tank behind him, and died.
2514.재해유발요인: While cleaning the inside of washing equipment, the victim was poisoned by residual vapor
2514.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working inside confined spaces, verify workability through oxygen and hazardous gas concentration measurement before work
▶ Provide sufficient ventilation during confined space work

2515.재해개요: Around December 2015, at the OO new construction site constructed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim employed by a subcontractor poured flammable liquid (gasoline or thinner) into a stove in which firewood was burning, at which moment flames erupted and set fire to the clothes of the victim and another victim; 2 were injured.
2515.재해유발요인: Due to unsafe use of hazardous substances, the moment flammable liquid (gasoline or thinner) was poured into a stove in which firewood was burning, flames erupted and the victim's clothes caught fire, causing burns
2515.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with fire and explosion prevention measures during work
▶ Comply with storage regulations for hazardous materials such as flammable liquids (gasoline or thinner)

2516.재해개요: Around December 2017, on the basement level of the auxiliary facilities at an urban-type residential housing new construction site, 2 victims employed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a subcontractor of OO Co., Ltd., died of asphyxiation by carbon monoxide while replacing a coconut-shell charcoal stove that had been lit that day for insulation and curing.
2516.재해유발요인: At a site using charcoal stoves for insulated curing after concrete pouring in winter, a worker who entered the workplace without measuring gas concentrations and without wearing an air-supplied mask was asphyxiated
2516.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using heaters burning lignite, charcoal, coconut shell charcoal, etc. for insulation curing of concrete in winter, periodically ventilate the workplace
▶ When using heaters for insulation curing of concrete in winter, ensure that hazards such as the carbon monoxide emission test results of the materials (coconut shell charcoal, lignite, etc.) and asphyxiation accidents that may occur when used in enclosed spaces are checked in advance before use
▶ When using heaters for insulation curing of concrete in winter and replacing them after a certain period of use, always wear respiratory protective equipment and use a hazardous gas concentration meter to guard against asphyxiation accidents

2517.재해개요: Around December 2017, at an apartment building new construction site, a worker (the first witness) employed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., a subcontractor of OO Co., Ltd., lit a stove (bamboo charcoal) for concrete insulation curing after pouring the 2nd rooftop floor of Building 1, and the victim, who later went up to the location to check the condition of the stove, died.
2517.재해유발요인: At a site using charcoal stoves for insulated curing after concrete pouring in winter, a worker who entered the workplace without measuring gas concentrations and without wearing an air-supplied mask was asphyxiated
2517.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using heaters burning lignite, charcoal, coconut shell charcoal, etc. for insulation curing of concrete in winter, periodically ventilate the workplace
▶ When using heaters for insulation curing of concrete in winter, ensure that hazards such as the carbon monoxide emission test results of the materials (coconut shell charcoal, lignite, etc.) and asphyxiation accidents that may occur when used in enclosed spaces are checked in advance before use
▶ When using heaters for insulation curing of concrete in winter and replacing them after a certain period of use, always wear respiratory protective equipment and use a hazardous gas concentration meter to guard against asphyxiation accidents

2518.재해개요: Around January 2019, on the 2nd rooftop floor of Building 106 at the OO Co., Ltd. apartment building new construction site, 2 victims employed by OO Development Co., Ltd., a subcontractor, were replenishing charcoal briquettes in drum stoves lit for insulation curing after concrete pouring when they were poisoned and asphyxiated by carbon monoxide generated as the charcoal burned, and died.
2518.재해유발요인: At a site using charcoal stoves for insulated curing after concrete pouring in winter, a worker who entered the workplace without measuring gas concentrations and without wearing an air-supplied mask was asphyxiated
2518.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using heaters burning lignite, charcoal, coconut shell charcoal, etc. for insulation curing of concrete in winter, periodically ventilate the workplace
▶ When using heaters for insulation curing of concrete in winter, ensure that hazards such as the carbon monoxide emission test results of the materials (coconut shell charcoal, lignite, etc.) and asphyxiation accidents that may occur when used in enclosed spaces are checked in advance before use
▶ When using heaters for insulation curing of concrete in winter and replacing them after a certain period of use, always wear respiratory protective equipment and use a hazardous gas concentration meter to guard against asphyxiation accidents

2519.재해개요: Around February 2019, on the 2nd rooftop floor of Building 101 at the OO Co., Ltd. apartment construction site, the victim was poisoned and asphyxiated by carbon monoxide generated by the burning of coconut charcoal in a drum stove lit for insulation curing after concrete pouring, and died.
2519.재해유발요인: At a site using charcoal stoves for insulated curing after concrete pouring in winter, a worker who entered the workplace without measuring gas concentrations and without wearing an air-supplied mask was asphyxiated
2519.위험성감소대책:
▶ When using heaters burning lignite, charcoal, coconut shell charcoal, etc. for insulation curing of concrete in winter, periodically ventilate the workplace
▶ When using heaters for insulation curing of concrete in winter, ensure that hazards such as the carbon monoxide emission test results of the materials (coconut shell charcoal, lignite, etc.) and asphyxiation accidents that may occur when used in enclosed spaces are checked in advance before use
▶ When using heaters for insulation curing of concrete in winter and replacing them after a certain period of use, always wear respiratory protective equipment and use a hazardous gas concentration meter to guard against asphyxiation accidents

2520.재해개요: Around August 2016, at the open-cut main-line section at the tunnel entrance of Station 102 of the OO urban railway (17.2m underground), 3 workers including foreman Park OO began underground SHEET waterproofing work under the instruction of their site manager; Mr. Lee OO applied asphalt primer containing a large amount of "toluene" on the lowest level, while foreman Park OO and Mr. Kim OO performed waterproofing sheet attachment work on the level above. During the work, the sheets ran short, so Mr. Kim OO went up to the 1st floor above ground to bring more sheets; on his way back, foreman Park OO was nowhere to be seen and a sound came from the lowest level, and upon checking he found foreman Park OO and Mr. Lee OO collapsed. Mr. Kim OO went down to rescue them but also felt dizzy, briefly lost consciousness, came up to the concourse and collapsed, and asked another worker for help. Nearby carpenters rescued foreman Park OO and Mr. Lee OO, who had collapsed underground, and reported to 119 around 14:00; they were transported to a hospital, but Mr. Park OO died and 1 was injured.
2520.재해유발요인: During underground SHEET waterproofing work in the open-cut main line section at the tunnel entrance, the worker who was applying asphalt primer containing large amounts of 'toluene' and other substances was found collapsed underground
2520.위험성감소대책:
▶ When applying primer containing large amounts of hazardous chemical compounds such as toluene in places where natural ventilation is difficult such as underground, implement forced ventilation measures using blowers, ventilation equipment, etc.
▶ When applying primer containing large amounts of hazardous chemical compounds such as toluene in places where natural ventilation is difficult such as underground, provide supplied-air respirators or gas masks and ensure they are worn

2521.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OO mixed-use residential building new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (waterproofing worker), employed by OO Construction Co., Ltd., was performing urethane waterproofing work on the exterior wall on the 1.5th-tier working platform (height: 2.9m) of the scaffold installed between the exterior wall of the Building 302 underground parking lot and the earth-retaining wall (length: 19m, width: 2.5m, depth: 15m), when he was poisoned by the vapor of the applied organic solvent (primer), lost consciousness, fell 2.9m to the floor below, and died; 3 fellow workers were poisoned.
2521.재해유발요인: During basement waterproofing work, the victim was poisoned by vapor from the applied organic solvent and died
2521.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly install and operate ventilation equipment when working in special locations handling organic chemicals
▶ Thoroughly provide and wear respiratory personal protective equipment such as supplied-air respirators
▶ Assign watchers such as supervisors

2522.재해개요: Around April 2019, in the underground water tank of the machine room within a hazardous materials storage facility new construction site, the victim (waterproofing worker) was performing waterproofing (primer) work when he died of poisoning by volatile organic compounds.
2522.재해유발요인: During basement waterproofing work, the victim was poisoned by vapor from the applied organic solvent and died
2522.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly install and operate ventilation equipment when working in special locations handling organic chemicals
▶ Thoroughly provide and wear respiratory personal protective equipment such as supplied-air respirators
▶ Assign watchers such as supervisors

2523.재해개요: Around May 2019, at the OO Co., Ltd. office building new construction site, 2 victims employed by OOOO Co., Ltd., a waterproofing subcontractor, were performing repair work on the waterproofing inside the fire-fighting water tank on the 2nd basement level when a fire broke out, and both died of burns.
2523.재해유발요인: In locations with fire hazards, work should be performed after conducting concentration monitoring such as measuring concentrations before work, but this was not observed; during repair work on waterproofing inside an underground fire-fighting water reservoir, a fire occurred and the worker died of burns
2523.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly ventilate fire-hazard locations and monitor flammable vapor concentrations
▶ Prohibit the use of open flames in fire-hazard locations
▶ Thoroughly manage the handling of flammable liquids when working in fire-hazard locations

2524.재해개요: Around August 2019, at a residential-lodging facility new construction site constructed by OO Co., Ltd., the victim (waterproofing worker) suffered burns and died from a fire that occurred during torch ignition work to remove moisture from the floor inside the elevator PIT.
2524.재해유발요인: The use of open flames must be prohibited in locations with fire hazards, but during torch ignition work to remove moisture from the floor inside an elevator pit, a fire occurred, and the worker suffered burns and died
2524.위험성감소대책: ▶ Prohibit the use of open flames in fire-hazard locations where flammable substances are used

2525.재해개요: Around October 2020, in the water tank in the pump room on the 1st floor above ground at the OO new construction site, the victim (painter) was performing waterproofing (base coat) work inside the water tank (width 4.8m, length 2.8m, depth 1.6m) when he was poisoned by the vapor of the applied organic solvent and died.
2525.재해유발요인: During basement waterproofing work, the victim was poisoned by vapor from the applied organic solvent and died
2525.위험성감소대책:
▶ Thoroughly install and operate ventilation equipment when working in special locations handling organic chemicals
▶ Thoroughly provide and wear respiratory personal protective equipment such as supplied-air respirators
▶ Assign watchers such as supervisors

2526.재해개요: Around February 2017, in the piloti section within the OO apartment reconstruction site, the victim, employed by a subcontractor, drank antifreeze agent that had been drawn and set aside for floor stone sample installation, and died of poisoning.
2526.재해유발요인: The victim drank antifreeze admixture that had been put in a paper cup for stone sample installation, and died
2526.위험성감소대책:
▶ Keep MSDS for chemicals such as antifreeze agents in suitable locations where handling workers can view them
▶ Attach warning labels when handling chemicals such as antifreeze agents in containers
▶ Absolutely prohibit placing chemicals such as antifreeze agents in containers such as paper cups from which workers might drink without suspicion, and when chemicals must unavoidably be placed in paper cups, etc., monitor so that nearby workers do not drink them

2527.재해개요: Around December 2020, at a balcony window replacement work site, urethane foam containers and other items stored in the living room of a unit exploded due to the influence of an adjacent electric heater, causing a fire, and 2 victims who were performing window replacement work fell.
2527.재해유발요인: While working on a balcony, materials stacked nearby (urethane foam containers, etc.) exploded and caught fire due to an adjacent electric heater, and the victim fell to the floor
2527.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit the use of open flames in places using explosion and fire hazard materials such as urethane foam containers
▶ Remove used urethane foam containers, etc. from the site or store them in hazardous material storage boxes with controlled access to open flames

2528.재해개요: Around January 2017, at a multi-household housing new construction site, the victim (plasterer) was moving along the stairs when the flame of an insulation-curing stove (alcohol fuel) installed on the stairs spread to his work clothes, and he suffered burns and died.
2528.재해유발요인: Flames from a stove used for thermal curing caught the work clothes of the victim(worker) who was moving through the work section, causing burns
2528.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit workers from taking concrete curing fuel off site without authorization for other purposes, and prevent fuel in use for curing from tipping over by prohibiting access to its surroundings or installing appropriate facilities underneath
▶ When heating is needed on site, use quality-assured heating equipment fitted with fire and burn prevention safety devices
▶ Implement access prevention measures for locations using open flames and install fire suppression equipment such as fire extinguishers and fire sand

2529.재해개요: Around January 2016, at the interior work site of the 2nd and 3rd floors of an OO Co., Ltd. neighborhood living facility (gym interior work), 3 workers including the victim were together installing partition frames (metal studs) for interior partition (magnesium board, gypsum board, etc.) work in the men's changing room section on the 2nd floor; at the moment they were thawing a work tool near an ethanol temporary stove, the temporary stove was knocked over by a strong wind, and ethanol splashed onto the pants of the victims (2 persons) and caught fire; 1 died and 1 was injured.
2529.재해유발요인: Strong winds knocked over the stove, and the flames spread to the victim(worker)'s work clothes, causing burns
2529.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit workers from taking concrete curing fuel off site without authorization for other purposes, and prevent fuel in use for curing from tipping over by prohibiting access to its surroundings or installing appropriate facilities underneath
▶ When heating is needed on site, use quality-assured heating equipment fitted with fire and burn prevention safety devices
▶ Implement access prevention measures for locations using open flames and install fire suppression equipment such as fire extinguishers and fire sand

2530.재해개요: Around December 2016, at the OO project, the victim and others drilled through the interior wall of the 1st floor of a cold storage warehouse, installed piping with combustible materials exposed, and were welding the connections when welding sparks fell onto the combustible materials (sandwich panels, etc.) inside the wall, causing a fire; 1 died of toxic gas asphyxiation and 2 were injured.
2530.재해유발요인: While welding galvanized steel pipe piping on the interior wall of a cold storage warehouse, welding sparks fell onto combustible materials (sandwich panels, urethane foam) of the exposed wall, causing a fire, and a worker died of asphyxiation from toxic gas
2530.위험성감소대책:
▶ For pipe connection work with combustible materials exposed, use a pipe joint connection work method using couplers
▶ Comply with protective measures of tightly covering exposed combustible material surfaces with non-combustible materials such as galvalume or welding fire blankets and fixing them in place
▶ For unavoidable welding work, comply with spark scatter prevention measures such as installing spark prevention covers

2531.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO thermal power Units 1-4 high-voltage circuit breaker and accessory materials purchase and installation work site, the victim was re-energizing a newly installed 6.9KV high-voltage circuit breaker when an arc occurred, and he died of burns from the resulting explosive combustion.
2531.재해유발요인: Death due to an arc explosion while energizing current after new installation of a 6.9kV high-voltage circuit breaker at a thermal power plant
2531.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing work with electric shock hazards, implement electric shock prevention measures using insulating protective equipment (AE-type safety helmet, insulating gloves, insulating shoes) and protective devices
▶ Comply with approach limit distances according to voltage when working near live lines
▶ Wear and comply with flame-retardant-treated work clothing or work clothing with flame-resistant performance to prevent burns from arc explosions

2532.재해개요: Around September 2018, at the OO project, hearing the sound of a fellow worker, who had been organizing cables inside a manhole, falling to the manhole bottom (water), the victim entered the manhole for rescue, then lost consciousness, fell to the bottom (water), and died of drowning.
2532.재해유발요인: The victim(worker) lost consciousness and collapsed while organizing optical cables inside a manhole
2532.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with safety rules during confined space work
   - Measure and check gas concentrations before and during work
   - Install and continuously operate ventilation equipment
   - Workers shall enter wearing personal protective equipment (supplied-air respirators, etc.)
   - Assign a watcher and provide rescue supplies
   - Establish a communication system between the watcher and workers
   - Post entry restriction signs at the confined space entrance
   - Prepare a work permit or work plan before starting work and keep it on site

2533.재해개요: Around May 2016, inside the Chamber of the OO manufacturing process at the OO factory of OOOOO Co., Ltd., 1 person from the maintenance team, 1 person from the production team, and 2 subcontractor workers, wearing air-line masks (full-face type), were performing replacement work (changing the position from close to open) on the spectacle blind installed on the phosgene vent piping in preparation for a major overhaul, when pressurized phosgene gas inside the target piping leaked between the flanges, and 1 subcontractor employee was poisoned by the gas and died. This was the accident.
2533.재해유발요인: While replacing a blind flange installed on a phosgene vent pipe, pressurized phosgene gas inside the pipe being worked on leaked through the flange gap, causing gas poisoning
2533.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling tank connections etc., open the tank and remove residual substances in advance
▶ Measure residual substances before starting work (gas concentration measurement, etc.) 
    - Wear personal protective equipment during measurement (protective clothing, boots, etc.)
▶ Conduct training on the hazardous substances handled in the tank
    - MSDS training and on-site placement of substance data
▶ Wear personal protective equipment during work such as dismantling tanks containing hazardous substances
▶ Implement ventilation measures so that hazardous gases do not accumulate in the work section (continuous operation)

2534.재해개요: Around June 2016, in the sulfuric acid manufacturing process of Team OO2 (OO Line 3) inside the OOOO factory located in OO-eup, OO County, OO City, process operation was stopped to prepare for repair work, and at the moment 2 persons including OOO of OOOOO Co., Ltd. opened the blind flange (300A) installed on the circulation piping (600A) of the final absorption tower, sulfuric acid (about 98 wt%) remaining inside the absorption tower and piping poured out (about 39,000 liters), and 5 persons [OOOOO Co., Ltd.], including the 2 workers opening the blind flange and workers nearby, suffered burns. This was the accident.
2534.재해유발요인: In a sulfuric acid manufacturing process, when process operation was stopped to prepare for maintenance work and the blind flange installed on the circulation pipe of the absorption tower was opened, sulfuric acid (approx. 98 wt%) remaining inside the absorption tower and piping poured out, causing burns
2534.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling tank connections etc., open the tank and remove residual substances in advance
▶ Measure residual substances before starting work (gas concentration measurement, etc.) 
    - Wear personal protective equipment during measurement (protective clothing, boots, etc.)
▶ Conduct training on the hazardous substances handled in the tank
    - MSDS training and on-site placement of substance data
▶ Wear personal protective equipment during work such as dismantling tanks containing hazardous substances
▶ Implement ventilation measures so that hazardous gases do not accumulate in the work section (continuous operation)

2535.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the 1st basement work area of the OOOO neighborhood living facility new construction site constructed by OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-dong, OO City, OO Province, 3 workers, in order to perform sprinkler piping work, were putting steel pipes and connecting materials into a container about 1/4 filled with thinner and shaking it to clean the threaded parts, then stacking them nearby, when the vapor generated from the thinner container and around the thinner-soaked threads was ignited by sparks (presumed ignition source) flying from a high-speed cutter operating nearby, causing a fire. When initial extinguishing with fire extinguishers failed, the flames spread to the 110mm rigid polyurethane board installed on the 1st basement ceiling, and due to the toxic gases (hydrogen cyanide, hydrogen chloride, carbon monoxide, etc.) generated during combustion and the flames, 2 workers on the 1st basement level died and 1 was severely injured; 3 duct workers who were working on the 2nd basement level recognized the fire and were evacuating when they were poisoned by the toxic gas, and 2 died and 1 was severely injured — in total, 4 died and 2 were severely injured. This is the presumed accident.
2535.재해유발요인: Oil vapor generated around a thinner container and materials soaked with thinner was ignited by sparks flying from a high-speed cutter operating nearby, causing a fire and toxic gas
2535.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with explosion and fire prevention measures for gas welding, flame cutting, etc.
▶ Comply with storage regulations for hazardous materials such as thinner and LP gas
▶ Implement ventilation measures for underground workplaces

2536.재해개요: Around September 2016, at the OO test facility of OOOOOOO Co., Ltd., the victim, employed by OOOO Co., Ltd., was performing pump installation work; as the lower part of the pump was interfering, he was cutting the pump support with an oxygen cutting torch when a fire occurred, and he suffered burns and died during treatment. This was a fatal accident.
2536.재해유발요인: A fire occurred from cutting a pump support base with an oxygen cutter during pump installation work
2536.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling tank connections, etc., open the tank and remove residual substances in advance
▶ Measure residual substances before starting work (gas concentration measurement, etc.) 
    - Wear personal protective equipment during measurement (protective clothing, boots, etc.)
▶ Conduct training on the hazardous substances handled in the tank
    - MSDS training and placement of substance data on site
▶ Wear personal protective equipment during work such as dismantling tanks containing hazardous substances
▶ Implement ventilation measures so hazardous gases do not accumulate in the work section (continuous operation)
▶ Implement spark scatter prevention measures during welding and cutting work

2537.재해개요: Around November 2016, in OO District, OO City, OOO Province, 6 workers including the victim OOO, employed by OOO Co., Ltd., stopped steam production due to an abnormality in the SRF (solid refuse fuel) incinerator and were performing inspection work with the inspection port installed on the ash discharge chute open, when molten solid material and flames burst out from the inspection port and engulfed them; 1 died and 5 suffered burns. This was the accident.
2537.재해유발요인: After steam production was stopped due to an SRF (solid refuse fuel) incinerator malfunction, while performing inspection work with the inspection port installed on the ash discharge chute open, the worker was engulfed by molten solids and flames ejected from the inspection port
2537.위험성감소대책:
▶ When inspecting incinerators, provide personal protective equipment that blocks heat and flames in preparation for situations such as sudden explosions, and supervise its wearing
▶ Conduct risk assessments within the work site in advance to prevent explosion accidents

2538.재해개요: Around November 2016, on the upper part of a suspended scaffold on the 5th floor above ground of Building OOO of OOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-ri, OO-myeon, OO City, after completing TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas welding) welding of an air-transfer SUS pipe (700mm), the victim entered the pipe to remove the gas leakage prevention pad (purge cap) and was asphyxiated by argon gas remaining inside the pipe; he was rescued by a fellow worker, given emergency measures including CPR, and transported to a hospital, but died during treatment. This was a fatal accident.
2538.재해유발요인: Asphyxiated by argon gas remaining inside the pipe
2538.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with safety rules during confined space work
   - Measure and check gas concentrations before and during work
   - Install and continuously operate ventilation equipment
   - Workers shall enter wearing personal protective equipment (supplied-air respirators, etc.)
   - Assign a watcher and provide rescue supplies
   - Establish a communication system between the watcher and workers
   - Post entry restriction signs at the confined space entrance
   - Prepare a work permit or work plan before starting work and keep it on site

2539.재해개요: Around July 2017, at the pig-house circulation system modification work site of OOOO located in OO-myeon, OO County, OOO Province, after completing the work of raising the lower support of the cyclone (settling tank), one of the system components, by about 1m, the victim was welding a bracket (C-channel) to support the top plate of the cyclone (settling tank) against a building column when welding sparks entered the cyclone (settling tank) and the gas (methane) generated from and remaining in the manure exploded; he was thrown flying together with the cyclone top plate, fell to the ground, and died. This was a fatal accident.
2539.재해유발요인: During welding work on pig-house circulation system equipment, welding sparks entered the sedimentation tank, causing a manure gas (methane) explosion
2539.위험성감소대책:
▶ When inspecting incinerators, provide personal protective equipment that blocks heat and flames in preparation for situations such as sudden explosions, and supervise its wearing
▶ Conduct risk assessments within the work site in advance to prevent explosion accidents

2540.재해개요: Around July 2017, during work to replace the drainage pump installed inside the final drainage tank (排水槽) of the sewage treatment facility of OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-dong, OO District, OO City, 2 workers were asphyxiated by harmful gas; 1 died and 1 was injured. This was the accident. - A worker who had opened the manhole (diameter about 0.6m) cover at ground level and first gone down to the underground drainage tank (depth about 2.2m) was climbing back up the ladder when he suddenly lost consciousness and fell to the bottom; when he collapsed, a fellow worker entered the drainage tank to rescue him and collapsed as well; another worker working at ground level reported to 119, and after rescue they were transported to a hospital, where 1 died during treatment and 1 was injured.
2540.재해유발요인: Asphyxiated by hazardous gas while replacing a drainage pump at a sewage treatment facility
2540.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with safety rules during confined space work
   - Measure and check gas concentrations before and during work
   - Install and continuously operate ventilation equipment
   - Workers shall enter wearing personal protective equipment (supplied-air respirators, etc.)
   - Assign a watcher and provide rescue supplies
   - Establish a communication system between the watcher and workers
   - Post entry restriction signs at the confined space entrance
   - Prepare a work permit or work plan before starting work and keep it on site

2541.재해개요: Around August 2017, at OOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO City, OOO Province, after completing the relocation of an ethanol washer-fluid tank (60ton), while drilling a hole with a welder to install a drain valve on the water supply piping, an explosion occurred; 2 persons were injured, and the washer-fluid tank and some office windows were damaged. This was the accident.
2541.재해유발요인: Explosion while drilling a hole with a welder to install a valve on an ethanol washer fluid tank pipe
2541.위험성감소대책:
▶ When inspecting incinerators, provide personal protective equipment that blocks heat and flames in preparation for situations such as sudden explosions, and supervise its wearing
▶ Conduct risk assessments within the work site in advance to prevent explosion accidents

2542.재해개요: Around December 2018, at the channel cover of the heat exchanger downstream of the reactor in the OCU process inside the OOO Co., Ltd. factory located in OOOO, Mixed C4 and propylene leaked and ignited, and a subcontractor worker who was performing insulation work on the heat exchanger suffered burns to the face. This was the accident.
2542.재해유발요인: Mixed C4 and propylene leaked from the channel cover of the heat exchanger downstream of the reactor and ignited, causing burns to the face of a worker who was performing insulation work on the heat exchanger
2542.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with fire and explosion prevention measures during work
▶ Comply with storage regulations for hazardous materials such as flammable liquids (gasoline or thinner)

2543.재해개요: Around April 2019, in the OO process of OOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO City, the victim, employed by OOOOOO Co., Ltd., dismantled the transfer pump of the underground tank in the Process Sewer Sump and was lifting it with a mobile crane when he was poisoned by harmful gas generated at the connection between the transfer pump and the tank; he was transported to a hospital and died during treatment. This was a fatal accident.
2543.재해유발요인: While dismantling the transfer pump of an underground tank in the Process Sewer Sump of a diesel desulfurization process and lifting it with a mobile crane, the worker was poisoned by hazardous gas generated at the connection between the transfer pump and the tank and died
2543.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling tank connections etc., open the tank and remove residual substances in advance
▶ Measure residual substances before starting work (gas concentration measurement, etc.) 
    - Wear personal protective equipment during measurement (protective clothing, boots, etc.)
▶ Conduct training on the hazardous substances handled in the tank
    - MSDS training and on-site placement of substance data
▶ Wear personal protective equipment during work such as dismantling tanks containing hazardous substances
▶ Implement ventilation measures so that hazardous gases do not accumulate in the work section (continuous operation)

2544.재해개요: Around October 2019, on the exterior wall of the slop oil storage tank in the OOOO outdoor tank storage area of the OO factory of OOOOOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO City, the outside subcontractor OOOOOO Co., Ltd. was performing welding work on pipe supports for installing a water spray fire-extinguishing system when, due to the high temperature, the flammable vapor remaining in the tank exploded inside the tank, and 2 workers were injured. This was the accident.
2544.재해유발요인: During equipment welding work on the outer wall of an oil storage tank, flammable vapor remaining in the tank exploded inside the tank due to high heat
2544.위험성감소대책:
▶ When inspecting incinerators, provide personal protective equipment that blocks heat and flames in preparation for situations such as sudden explosions, and supervise its wearing
▶ Conduct risk assessments within the work site in advance to prevent explosion accidents

2545.재해개요: Around February 2017, at an apartment new construction site, the victim was moving along the top of the 1st-tier corner wale of the earth-retaining shoring when he lost his balance and fell 10m to the ground below, resulting in death.
2545.재해유발요인: Fell while moving to the excavation bottom via earth-retaining shoring where no travel passage was installed
2545.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working at height locations such as on top of earth-retaining shoring, implement measures to prevent worker falls such as installing working platforms in the work section 
▶ Install safe passageways for workers to use 
▶ Maintain passageways in a safe condition available for use at all times

2546.재해개요: Around May 2015, at a building new construction site, the victim was waiting on top of a wale for welding work when lagging boards spilled out, and from the impact he fell 4m to the lower excavation area and died.
2546.재해유발요인: While pushing a soldier pile with a backhoe bucket (to adjust verticality), the bucket slipped and struck the lagging boards, and the impact caused the previously installed lagging boards to pour down, crushing the worker
2546.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare work plans and designate work directors for the use of vehicle-type construction machinery 
▶ For earth-retaining shoring assembly work, eliminate hazard factors reflecting site conditions and perform work by safe methods

2547.재해개요: Around April 2016, at a sewage treatment facility installation project, the victim was about to install a thick steel plate used for temporary earth-retaining facilities for the purpose of preventing soil collapse when the hook fixing the steel plate came loose, and the plate toppled and crushed him, resulting in death.
2547.재해유발요인: With no hook safety latch installed, the hook securing a steel plate came off and the plate fell over, crushing the worker
2547.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy objects, perform work after verifying installation of hook latch devices to prevent tipping
▶ Control worker entry and assign spotters during heavy-object handling work

2548.재해개요: Around June 2016, at the OO convenience facility installation work site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim was dismantling an inspection walkway installed on top of the earth-retaining shoring when he lost his balance and fell about 5.45m to the concrete floor below, resulting in death.
2548.재해유발요인: While moving along a strut without wearing a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell to the excavation bottom
2548.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails or fall-prevention nets when working in locations with fall hazards
▶ When working in locations with fall hazards, provide safety harnesses and perform work while wearing them
▶ Install temporary passageways that allow workers to move safely

2549.재해개요: Around September 2016, at a neighborhood living facility new construction site, the victim was bending forward to measure the spacing (No. 3-4) for installing corner strut No. 4 of the temporary earth-retaining facility when he fell to the excavation bottom (about 7m) and died.
2549.재해유발요인: While moving along a strut without wearing a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell to the excavation bottom
2549.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails or fall-prevention nets when working in locations with fall hazards
▶ When working in locations with fall hazards, provide safety harnesses and perform work while wearing them
▶ Install temporary passageways that allow workers to move safely

2550.재해개요: Around January 2018, at a complex cultural facility new construction project, the victim was performing earth anchor strand tensioning work when the earth anchor bracket rotated and the tensioning jack cylinder struck his head, and he died.
2550.재해유발요인: During earth anchor strand tensioning work, the earth anchor seat rotated due to defective materials used, and the worker collided with the tensioner cylinder
2550.위험성감소대책:
▶ Conduct prior inspection of earth-retaining shoring members such as earth anchors (cross-section loss and deformation, defective welding, corrosion, whether reused temporary equipment, etc.)
▶ Replace and reinforce defective members through periodic inspections

2551.재해개요: Around May 2020, at an officetel new construction site, the victim was moving along the earth-retaining shoring (corner strut, 6th tier) when he lost his footing and fell about 8m below, resulting in death.
2551.재해유발요인: While moving along a strut without wearing a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell to the excavation bottom
2551.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails or fall-prevention nets when working in locations with fall hazards
▶ When working in locations with fall hazards, provide safety harnesses and perform work while wearing them
▶ Install temporary passageways that allow workers to move safely

2552.재해개요: Around June 2020, at Section 1 of a waterworks service-line work site, the victim was driving sheet piles, temporary earth-retaining materials, into the ground with a vibro hammer; as they could not be driven in any further, he was cutting the protruding part to match the height of the sheet pile when the sheet pile overturned, and he died.
2552.재해유발요인: While cutting protruding sections to match the height of sheet piles, a sheet pile overturned and crushed the worker
2552.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prepare a work plan and designate a work supervisor for the use of vehicle-type construction machinery
▶ When assembling earth-retaining shoring, eliminate risk factors (falls, falling objects, overturning) reflecting site conditions, then carry out the work using safe work methods

2553.재해개요: Around July 2020, at a business facility new construction site, the victim was installing an anti-slip member for the corner strut on the second tier of the temporary earth-retaining facility when a wale (H-440×300, L≒17m, W≒2.1t) being installed above the work area fell down (H≒40cm), striking his head, and he died.
2553.재해유발요인: A worker working in a falling-object hazard zone was struck by a wale that fell while being installed above
2553.위험성감소대책:
▶ Establish no-entry zones in areas with risk of falling heavy objects and control personnel access
▶ Restrict simultaneous work above and below in falling-object hazard zones

2554.재해개요: Around December 2020, at a cultural and neighborhood-living office building new construction site, the victim was moving along the top of an H-Beam to install the 2nd tier of corner struts when he lost his balance and fell to the excavation bottom (H≒2.9m), resulting in death.
2554.재해유발요인: While moving along a strut without wearing a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell to the excavation bottom
2554.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install guardrails or fall-prevention nets when working in locations with fall hazards
▶ When working in locations with fall hazards, provide safety harnesses and perform work while wearing them
▶ Install temporary passageways that allow workers to move safely

2555.재해개요: Around March 2016, at Block 15 of the underpass within an access road construction project, the victim was dismantling circular steel pipe struts when he lost his balance and fell 4.8m to the concrete floor below, resulting in death.
2555.재해유발요인: While moving along a strut without wearing a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell to the excavation bottom
2555.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall-hazard zones, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or install safety harness anchorage facilities and perform work after wearing a harness, to prevent workers' fall accidents
▶ When assembling and dismantling earth-retaining wales, improve work methods so that workers can work in a safe posture, such as installing working platforms in consideration of conditions like working height
▶ Strictly control simultaneous work above and below in falling-object hazard zones

2556.재해개요: Around October 2016, at a reconstruction improvement project site, the victim was dismantling a wale (H-beam) of the temporary earth-retaining facility when the wale, which was being lifted connected by a beam clamp to a single-line wire rope sling, struck him in the abdomen, and he died.
2556.재해유발요인: During earth-retaining shoring wale dismantling work, the worker first collided with a wale (tied to a mobile crane boom) that came off its installation point, then secondarily struck against a concrete retaining wall
2556.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy objects, prepare a work plan covering the work sequence and method, equipment used, prevention of the lifted load dropping, and prohibition of worker entry
▶ Control worker access and deploy a spotter during heavy-object handling work
▶ When dismantling temporary earth-retaining facilities, establish a stage-by-stage dismantling plan and implement it in sequence

2557.재해개요: Around November 2016, at a stormwater retention facility installation project site, the victim was dismantling the temporary earth-retaining facility (1st-tier strut) when he was struck by a strut member that sprang out due to earth pressure, and he died.
2557.재해유발요인: During earth-retaining shoring wale dismantling work, the worker first collided with a wale (tied to a mobile crane boom) that came off its installation point, then secondarily struck against a concrete retaining wall
2557.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy objects, prepare a work plan covering the work sequence and method, equipment used, prevention of the lifted load dropping, and prohibition of worker entry
▶ Control worker access and deploy a spotter during heavy-object handling work
▶ When dismantling temporary earth-retaining facilities, establish a stage-by-stage dismantling plan and implement it in sequence

2558.재해개요: Around October 2017, at a logistics center new construction site, the victim was dismantling the 5th tier of earth-retaining wales when the earth-retaining wall and the structural wall collapsed momentarily; 1 died, 2 were severely injured, and 7 were slightly injured.
2558.재해유발요인: During earth-retaining wall dismantling work, the earth-retaining wall and structure wall suddenly collapsed, burying the worker in soil
2558.위험성감소대책:
▶ Determine whether the yield stress is exceeded based on load-cell measurement results, and take reinforcement measures when abnormalities such as increased earth pressure occur
▶ Comply with the work method and sequence for structure walls
▶ Confirm whether the structure wall is integrated with the slab, and stop work in unstable conditions such as cantilevers

2559.재해개요: Around April 2018, at a tunnel construction site, the victim was working below the dismantling section of the temporary earth-retaining facility (wale) in the underpass section when he was struck by the temporary earth-retaining facility (wale) that had been cut and fell, and he died.
2559.재해유발요인: While dismantling an H-beam suspended from a mobile crane, the worker was struck by the swinging H-beam and fell to the floor
2559.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall-hazard zones, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or install safety harness anchorage facilities and perform work after wearing a harness, to prevent workers' fall accidents
▶ When assembling and dismantling earth-retaining wales, improve work methods so that workers can work in a safe posture, such as installing working platforms in consideration of conditions like working height
▶ Strictly control simultaneous work above and below in falling-object hazard zones

2560.재해개요: Around May 2018, at an apartment new construction site, the victim was dismantling an H-beam, a temporary earth-retaining material, slung from a mobile crane when he was struck by the slung H-beam and fell to the 1st basement floor (height about 5m), resulting in death.
2560.재해유발요인: While dismantling an H-beam suspended from a mobile crane, the worker was struck by the swinging H-beam and fell to the floor
2560.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall-hazard zones, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or install safety harness anchorage facilities and perform work after wearing a harness, to prevent workers' fall accidents
▶ When assembling and dismantling earth-retaining wales, improve work methods so that workers can work in a safe posture, such as installing working platforms in consideration of conditions like working height
▶ Strictly control simultaneous work above and below in falling-object hazard zones

2561.재해개요: Around August 2018, at a road expansion and paving work site, the victim was dismantling earth-retaining shoring wales at the excavation bottom of a concrete retaining wall installation section when a wale (H-beam, connected to the boom of a truck-mounted mobile crane) suddenly detached from its installation point, striking him first, and he then secondarily struck the concrete retaining wall and died.
2561.재해유발요인: During earth-retaining shoring wale dismantling work, the worker first collided with a wale (tied to a mobile crane boom) that came off its installation point, then secondarily struck against a concrete retaining wall
2561.위험성감소대책:
▶ When lifting heavy objects, prepare a work plan covering the work sequence and method, equipment used, prevention of the lifted load dropping, and prohibition of worker entry
▶ Control worker access and deploy a spotter during heavy-object handling work
▶ When dismantling temporary earth-retaining facilities, establish a stage-by-stage dismantling plan and implement it in sequence

2562.재해개요: Around September 2018, the victim was performing bolt dismantling work on the temporary earth-retaining facility when the strut and diagonal member detached from the wale, and he fell about 3.3m to the concrete floor below and died.
2562.재해유발요인: While dismantling bolts at the wale-strut connection on top of a steel strut, the strut came off the wale and the worker fell to the concrete floor
2562.위험성감소대책:
▶ When performing work such as transporting formwork near floor openings, install them firmly to prevent falls through the openings
▶ Take protective measures at openings as well, such as covers or fall-prevention nets

2563.재해개요: Around June 2019, at an underground public walkway installation work site, the victim was performing dismantling work (H-Pile cutting) on a previously buried ground-reinforcement temporary earth-retaining structure at the excavation bottom at G.L.-7m when the soil behind and existing grouting debris collapsed and toppled, and he died.
2563.재해유발요인: During earth-retaining wall dismantling work, the earth-retaining wall and structure wall suddenly collapsed, burying the worker in soil
2563.위험성감소대책:
▶ When adjacent buildings or structures are expected to be at risk of collapse due to excavation, etc., evaluate their stability through safety diagnosis, etc., and eliminate the risk
▶ Conduct a prior survey of ground stratum conditions, presence of buried objects, etc., before ground excavation

2564.재해개요: Around August 2019, at a double-track railway roadbed new construction and miscellaneous work site, the victim was using an oxygen cutting torch to dismantle an earth-retaining wale welded to the soldier piles (H-Pile) of the excavation area of pier No.43 of the Sinseok No.1 viaduct when the welded joint (while cutting the 7th of 8 points) fractured and the wale (H-beam) rolled down, striking him in the face, and he died.
2564.재해유발요인: While dismantling an H-beam suspended from a mobile crane, the worker was struck by the swinging H-beam and fell to the floor
2564.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall-hazard zones, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or install safety harness anchorage facilities and perform work after wearing a harness, to prevent workers' fall accidents
▶ When assembling and dismantling earth-retaining wales, improve work methods so that workers can work in a safe posture, such as installing working platforms in consideration of conditions like working height
▶ Strictly control simultaneous work above and below in falling-object hazard zones

2565.재해개요: Around August 2019, at an urban flood prevention project site, after burying a sewer pipeline (PC BCX), the victim was struck by an earth-retaining shoring member (H-pile) that detached from the clamp and fell while the H-pile was being lifted by an excavator for dismantling, and he died.
2565.재해유발요인: While dismantling an H-beam suspended from a mobile crane, the worker was struck by the swinging H-beam and fell to the floor
2565.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit worker entry during earth-retaining shoring dismantling work to prevent accidents such as falling objects
▶ When lifting heavy objects, apply appropriate lifting methods, lifting equipment, etc., reflecting site conditions

2566.재해개요: Around March 2021, at an urban-type residential housing new construction site, the victim was performing earth-retaining dismantling work when he lost his balance on a wale (width=35cm) where no safety harness anchorage had been installed, fell (H≒3.3m), and died.
2566.재해유발요인: While moving along a strut without wearing a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell to the excavation bottom
2566.위험성감소대책:
▶ When working in fall-hazard zones, install fall-prevention nets and guardrails, or install safety harness anchorage facilities and perform work after wearing a harness, to prevent workers' fall accidents
▶ When assembling and dismantling earth-retaining wales, improve work methods so that workers can work in a safe posture, such as installing working platforms in consideration of conditions like working height
▶ Strictly control simultaneous work above and below in falling-object hazard zones

2567.재해개요: Around June 2016, at an apartment new construction site, the victim was lifting and retrieving a gas cutting torch (oxygen+LPG) at the top of the earth-retaining wall when he lost his balance and fell 6m to the ground below, resulting in death.
2567.재해유발요인: While moving along a strut without wearing a safety harness, the worker lost balance and fell to the excavation bottom
2567.위험성감소대책: ▶ Firmly install guardrails at the excavation edge of the temporary earth-retaining facility

2568.재해개요: Around August 2016, at a sewer pipeline new construction site, the victim was separating TS panels, which had been used as earth retention for the sewer pipeline, into individual members at a storage yard; while dismantling the connecting bolts with a strut (H=1.35m, 1,048kg), one of the members, stood vertically on uneven ground, the strut overturned and the victim was crushed between the ground and the strut, resulting in death.
2568.재해유발요인: While dismantling connection bolts with struts stood vertically on uneven ground, a strut overturned and the worker was caught between the struts
2568.위험성감소대책:
▶ When dismantling TS panel struts, work horizontally, and when standing struts upright, take overturning-prevention measures by firmly fixing the struts using triangular supports, supporting walls, etc.
▶ Select work methods and use equipment appropriate for the work, and carry out the work after addressing possible hazards

2569.재해개요: Around September 2019, at the OOOO mixed-use residential building new construction site of OOOO Co., Ltd. located in OO-dong, OO City, OO Province, the victim, who was directing the lifting work of a steel sump pit, confirmed that the guide rope installed at the bottom of the sump pit was caught on an earth-retaining strut, and, in order to pass the guide rope over to the opposite side, was walking along the top of the strut without wearing a safety harness when he fell to the foundation blinding concrete floor (H≒7.3m) and died.
2569.재해유발요인: During lifting work of a steel sump pit, the guide rope caught on an earth-retaining strut, and the worker fell while moving on top of the strut
2569.위험성감소대책:
▶ Prohibit workers from unnecessary movement onto the top of slopes, etc., and install movement passages for workers
▶ When working at heights where workers may fall or trip, install guardrails and implement fall prevention measures, and where unavoidable, install access barriers, etc.
▶ When working at heights where workers may fall or trip, provide and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmets, safety harnesses, etc.)

2570.재해개요: Around April 2020, at the OO new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., a victim employed by an earthwork subcontractor was moving along the earth-retaining edge to fix a screen for controlling the main entrance when he fell to the 1st basement floor (H≒3.9m); his chest was pierced by vertical wall rebar installed on the floor, and he died.
2570.재해유발요인: Lost balance and fell while moving on top of an earth-retaining wall without guardrails installed
2570.위험성감소대책:
▶ Comply with fall-prevention measures such as covers and guardrails in fall-hazard zones such as openings
▶ Install safe passageways for workers

2571.재해개요: Around January 2021, during underground foundation concrete pouring, due to rain, the victim was replacing the electric cable to install a water pump in the sump pit; while lowering the upper electric cable, the cable got caught on the 1st-tier wale, and as he was going down onto the noise-blocking sandwich panel on top of the earth-retaining shoring to free the cable, he slipped and fell through the skylight (polycarbonate) section (17.5m).
2571.재해유발요인: While moving on a roof, slipped onto a skylight, which broke, causing a fall
2571.위험성감소대책:
▶ When moving on the upper part of the temporary earth-retaining facility at height, install working platforms and guardrails or install fall-prevention nets to prevent workers' fall accidents
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities and perform work after wearing a harness

2572.재해개요: Around January 2020, at the OO new construction project site of OO Construction Co., Ltd., a victim employed by a subcontractor installed inclined supports (shores) on the struts to prevent overturning of the single-sided wall formwork on the 1st basement level of the annex building, then was moving along a strut when he lost his balance and fell to the 3rd basement floor (H≒15m), resulting in death.
2572.재해유발요인: With no fall prevention measures in place, after installing shores on struts to prevent overturning of basement double-sided wall formwork, the worker lost balance while moving on the strut and fell
2572.위험성감소대책:
▶ In sections with a fall risk, install fall-protection nets or guardrails, and/or work after wearing safety harnesses
▶ Install guardrails in compliance with installation standards and have the supervisor verify

2573.재해개요: Around January 2019, at the OO new construction site of OO Co., Ltd., the victim (concrete placement worker), employed by a subcontractor, was moving along the earth-retaining shoring (corner strut) for underground column concrete pouring when he fell about 4.9M to the concrete floor and died.
2573.재해유발요인: While moving on earth-retaining shoring without guardrails installed for underground column concrete pouring, the worker lost balance and fell
2573.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install working platforms when working in locations with fall hazards, and install guardrails at openings
▶ Install underground single-sided wall supports during single-sided wall work, and install temporary stairs, working platforms, and guardrails to prevent falls
▶ For work at heights of 2 m or more, install safety harness anchorage facilities and wear a safety harness

2574.재해개요: Around June 2019, at a water conveyance facility project, the victim went down a vertical shaft and was checking the welding position of an earth-retaining shoring wale when he fell 3m to the concrete floor below, resulting in death.
2574.재해유발요인: Lost balance and fell while working on diagonal reinforcement members of earth-retaining shoring without wearing a safety harness
2574.위험성감소대책:
▶ Install safety harness anchorage facilities and provide safety harnesses to prevent falls
▶ Supervise workers to hook onto the safety harness when working or moving
